local local_class = newclass('KanterburyHighSchoolMainSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = KanterburyHighSchoolMain @
		Comment = 천왕 등장 @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.battle_Scene_npcs = {}
	self.battle_Scene_npcs_pos_list = {}
	self.battle_Scene_npcs_dir_list = {}

	self.middle_scene_npcs = {}
	self.middle_scene_npcs_pos_list = {}
	self.middle_scene_npcs_dir_list = {}

	self.last_Scene_npcs = {}
	self.last_Scene_npcs_pos_list = {}
	self.last_Scene_npcs_dir_list = {}

	self.elites = {}
	self.elite_student_npcs = {}
	self.battle_gate_students = {}
	self.battle_monster = {}

	self.twinkle_effect_pool = nil
	self.back_light_effect_pool = nil
	self.door_light_effect_pool = nil
	self.bounce_effect_pool = nil
	self.emoticon_pool = nil
	self.weapon_preset = nil
	self.smoke_preset = nil
	self.introduce_pool_name = nil

	self.is_battle = false
	self.end_battle = false

	self.marker_name = "kanterbury_highschool_main"
	self.tracker_name = "kanterbury_highschool_main_s2_tracker_0"
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')

	for i = 0, 3 do
		table.insert(self.elites, get_character(string.format("elite%d", i)))
	end

	-- 이벤트 씬에서 사용할 캐릭터는 스테이지 내부의 이 시점에서 사용하지 않는 캐릭터를 가져다가 썼다가 원래대로 돌려줌

	-- battle_Scene_npcs 내부 8명의 캐릭터 설정
	-- tease_student_1 ~ 4 , drug_student_intro_1,2 , bad_student, run_student_1
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local bn1 = get_character(string.format("tease_student_%d", i))

		table.insert(self.battle_Scene_npcs, bn1)
		table.insert(self.battle_Scene_npcs_pos_list, bn1.Position)
		table.insert(self.battle_Scene_npcs_dir_list, bn1.Direction)
	end

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local bn2 = get_character(string.format("drug_student_intro_%d", i))

		table.insert(self.battle_Scene_npcs, bn2)
		table.insert(self.battle_Scene_npcs_pos_list, bn2.Position)
		table.insert(self.battle_Scene_npcs_dir_list, bn2.Direction)
	end

	table.insert(self.battle_Scene_npcs, get_character("bad_student"))
	table.insert(self.battle_Scene_npcs_pos_list, get_character("bad_student").Position)
	table.insert(self.battle_Scene_npcs_dir_list, get_character("bad_student").Direction)

	table.insert(self.battle_Scene_npcs, get_character("run_student_1"))
	table.insert(self.battle_Scene_npcs_pos_list, get_character("run_student_1").Position)
	table.insert(self.battle_Scene_npcs_dir_list, get_character("run_student_1").Direction)

	-- middle_scene_npcs 내부 8명의 캐릭터 설정
	-- love_student_0 ~ 6 , run_student_2
	for i = 0, 6 do
		local mn = get_character(string.format("love_student_%d", i))

		table.insert(self.middle_scene_npcs, mn)
		table.insert(self.middle_scene_npcs_pos_list, mn.Position)
		table.insert(self.middle_scene_npcs_dir_list, mn.Direction)
	end

	table.insert(self.middle_scene_npcs, get_character("run_student_2"))
	table.insert(self.middle_scene_npcs_pos_list, get_character("run_student_2").Position)
	table.insert(self.middle_scene_npcs_dir_list, get_character("run_student_2").Direction)

	-- last_Scene_npcs 내부 8명의 캐릭터 설정
	-- fight_student_see_0 ~ 6, princess_student_3
	for i = 0, 6 do
		local ln = get_character(string.format("fight_student_see_%d", i))

		table.insert(self.last_Scene_npcs, ln)
		table.insert(self.last_Scene_npcs_pos_list, ln.Position)
		table.insert(self.last_Scene_npcs_dir_list, ln.Direction)
	end

	table.insert(self.last_Scene_npcs, get_character("princess_student_3"))
	table.insert(self.last_Scene_npcs_pos_list, get_character("princess_student_3").Position)
	table.insert(self.last_Scene_npcs_dir_list, get_character("princess_student_3").Direction)

	-- elite student 설정
	for i = 0, 7 do
		table.insert(self.elite_student_npcs, get_character(string.format("elite_student_%d", i)))
	end

	-- battle gate student 설정
	for i = 1, #self.battle_Scene_npcs do
		table.insert(self.battle_gate_students, self.battle_Scene_npcs[i])
	end

	for i = 1, #self.middle_scene_npcs do
		table.insert(self.battle_gate_students, self.middle_scene_npcs[i])
	end

	-- monster 설정
	for i = 0, 4 do
		table.insert(self.battle_monster, get_character(string.format("battle1_%d", i)))
	end

	--npc 초기 배치
	for i = 1, #self.battle_monster do
		self.battle_monster[i].Position = field:GetMarker(string.format(
				"start_battle_monster_%d", i - 1)).position
	end

	for i = 1, 8 do
		self.battle_Scene_npcs[i].Position = field:GetMarker(string.format(
				"start_battle_student_1_%d", i - 1)).position
		self.battle_Scene_npcs[i].OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance

		self.middle_scene_npcs[i].Position = field:GetMarker(string.format(
				"start_battle_student_2_%d", i - 1)).position
		self.middle_scene_npcs[i].OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end

	--Effects
	self.twinkle_effect_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_Object_Twinkle")
	self.back_light_effect_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("fx_event_char_backlight")
	self.door_light_effect_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("fx_event_doorlight")
	self.bounce_effect_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_minotaur_buttbounce")

	CS.Oak.CriticalHitEffect.Preload()

	self.emoticon_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("emoticon")

	--preset
	self.weapon_preset = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("test_empty_effect")
	self.smoke_preset = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_Common_Jump_small")

	-- 선택한 언어로 UI 나오도록 설정
	self.main_language = game_string.MainLanguage


	--TODO: Fallback
	--해당 언어에 맞는 Prefab이 없을 경우 영문Prefab으로 대체한다.
	local pool_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ObjectPoolData")
	local spec = pool_data:GetSpec("Highschool_Introduce_" .. self.main_language)

	if spec ~= nil then
		self.introduce_pool_name = "Highschool_Introduce_" .. self.main_language
	else
		self.introduce_pool_name = "Highschool_Introduce_enUS"
	end

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.introduce_pool_name)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	local marker = field:GetMarker('end_battle_leader')
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(
			self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, marker.position)
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.battle_Scene_npcs = nil
	self.battle_Scene_npcs_pos_list = nil
	self.battle_Scene_npcs_dir_list = nil
	self.middle_scene_npcs = nil
	self.middle_scene_npcs_pos_list = nil
	self.middle_scene_npcs_dir_list = nil
	self.last_Scene_npcs = nil
	self.last_Scene_npcs_pos_list = nil
	self.last_Scene_npcs_dir_list = nil
	self.elites = nil
	self.elite_student_npcs = nil
	self.battle_gate_students = nil
	self.battle_monster = nil

	self.twinkle_effect_pool = nil
	self.back_light_effect_pool = nil
	self.door_light_effect_pool = nil
	self.bounce_effect_pool = nil
	self.emoticon_pool = nil
	self.weapon_preset = nil
	self.smoke_preset = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == "battle1" then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.appear_elites, self))
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) and
				e.Zone.Name == "start_battle" and not self.is_battle then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.elites_battle, self))
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:appear_elites()
	self.end_battle = true
	CS.Oak.PartyUtil.ReviveParty()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local ghost_buster = get_character("ghost_buster_2")
	local teatan_hero = get_character("teatan_hero_npc")
	local picture_girl = get_character("picture_girl")
	local battle_npc = get_character("battle_npc")

	for k,v in pairs(self.battle_Scene_npcs) do
		character_util.set_emotion(v, {name = "love"})
		v.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	end

	for k,v in pairs(self.middle_scene_npcs) do
		character_util.set_emotion(v, {name = "love"})
		v.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, "linear")

	-- 씬 전환 전 세팅
	character_util.convert_to_npc(ghost_buster)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(teatan_hero)

	local marker = field:GetMarker("end_battle_leader")
	camera_util.move(marker.position, 0)

	character_util.align_party(marker.position, "up", 0, "linear")

	ghost_buster.Position = user_party_leader.Position + vector(-0.8, 0, -1)
	teatan_hero.Position = user_party_leader.Position + vector(0.8, 0, -1)
	character_util.set_direction(ghost_buster, "up")
	character_util.set_direction(teatan_hero, "up")

	rolling_param = CS.Oak.RollingNumberParam()
	rolling_param.Target = battle_npc.Transform
	rolling_param.Number = 100
	rolling_param.RollingNumberEaseType = CS.Oak.RollingNumberEaseType.InOutCirc
	rolling_param.RollingTime = 0
	rolling_param.Color = unity_class.color(1, 1, 1, 1)

	CS.Oak.RollingNumberManager.Instance:ShowRollingNumber(rolling_param)

	for i = 1, #self.elites do
		self.elites[i].Position = field:GetMarker(string.format("end_battle_elites%d", i - 1)).position
	end

	picture_girl.Position = field:GetMarker("end_battle_pictureGirl").position
	battle_npc.Position = user_party_leader.Position + 4 * unity_class.vector3.right

	for i = 1, #self.battle_Scene_npcs do
		marker = field:GetMarker(string.format("end_battle_student_1_%d", i - 1))
		self.battle_Scene_npcs[i].Position = marker.position
		character_util.set_anim(self.battle_Scene_npcs[i], {name = "idle"})
	end

	character_util.set_direction(self.battle_Scene_npcs[2], "right")
	character_util.set_direction(self.battle_Scene_npcs[3], "right")
	character_util.set_direction(self.battle_Scene_npcs[4], "up")
	character_util.set_direction(self.battle_Scene_npcs[5], "up")
	character_util.set_direction(self.battle_Scene_npcs[6], "left")
	character_util.set_direction(self.battle_Scene_npcs[7], "left")

	for i = 1, 8 do
		marker = field:GetMarker(string.format("end_battle_student_2_%d", i - 1))
		self.middle_scene_npcs[i].Position = marker.position
		character_util.set_anim(self.middle_scene_npcs[i], {name = "idle"})

		if i < 5 then
			character_util.set_direction(self.middle_scene_npcs[i], "right")
		else
			character_util.set_direction(self.middle_scene_npcs[i], "left")
		end
		self.middle_scene_npcs[i]:RemoveEmotion()

		marker = field:GetMarker(string.format("end_battle_student_3_%d", i - 1))
		self.last_Scene_npcs[i].Position = marker.position
		self.last_Scene_npcs[i].Direction = marker.direction
		self.last_Scene_npcs[i]:RemoveAnimation()
		self.last_Scene_npcs[i]:RemoveEmotion()

		marker = field:GetMarker(string.format("end_battle_elite_student_%d", i - 1))
		self.elite_student_npcs[i].Position = marker.position
	end

	for i = 1, #self.battle_Scene_npcs do
		self.battle_Scene_npcs[i]:RemoveEmotion()
	end

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.7, unity_class.color.black, "linear")

	local rolling_param = self.controller:create_rolling_number_param(nil, 0, CS.Oak.RollingNumberEaseType.Linear, 1)

	rolling_param.Target = user_party_leader.Transform
	self.controller.rolling_number_data[rolling_param.Target] =
	self.controller.rolling_number_data[rolling_param.Target] + 100
	rolling_param.Number = self.controller.rolling_number_data[rolling_param.Target]
	CS.Oak.RollingNumberManager.Instance:RollingNumber(rolling_param)

	local rolling_param_for_npc = CS.Oak.RollingNumberParam()
	rolling_param_for_npc.Target = battle_npc.Transform
	rolling_param_for_npc.Number = 0
	rolling_param_for_npc.RollingNumberEaseType = CS.Oak.RollingNumberEaseType.InOutCirc
	rolling_param_for_npc.RollingTime = 1
	rolling_param_for_npc.Color = unity_class.color(1, 1, 1, 1)
	CS.Oak.RollingNumberManager.Instance:RollingNumber(rolling_param_for_npc)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_small_jump_01')

	character_util.jump(teatan_hero, 0.5, 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	character_util.set_anim(teatan_hero, {name = "embarrassed"})

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_02')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(teatan_hero, {key = "highschool_appear_elites_1", skip = true,
	                                                                bubble_direction = "rt"})

	local emoticon_obj = self.emoticon_pool:Instantiate(user_party_leader.Position)
	local emoticon = emoticon_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.Emoticon))
	emoticon:Init()
	emoticon:ShowOn(user_party_leader, vector(1, 1, 1), CS.Oak.EmoticonType.Question)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ghost_buster,
		{key = "highschool_appear_elites_2", skip = true, bubble_direction = "lt"})
	teatan_hero:RemoveAnimation()

	user_party_leader:SetAnimation("question", false)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	battle_npc:SetAnimation("hurt", true)
	battle_npc:SetEmotion("tired", true)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(battle_npc, {key = "highschool_appear_elites_3", skip = true})
	character_util.set_anim(battle_npc, {name = "idle"})
	character_util.set_emotion(battle_npc, {name = "mad"})

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(battle_npc, {key = "highschool_appear_elites_4", skip = true,
	                                                                bubble_type = "shout"})

	character_util.move_to_async(battle_npc, user_party_leader.Position + 2.5 * unity_class.vector3.right,
			nil, 4, true, true, nil)
	character_util.jump(battle_npc, 1, 2)
	character_util.move_to(battle_npc, user_party_leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.right, 1,
	nil, true)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	user_party_leader:SetAnimation("idle", true)

	character_util.set_anim(battle_npc, {name = "attack", loop = false, scale = 0.5})

	-- bgm_transition: Field(ondemand/highschool.preload:bgm_highschool_main) -> Muted, 1.5
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		state = 'muted', mix = 1.5
	})

	local slow_motion_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_slowmotion_01'
	})

	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Mod(0.3, "highschool_main")

	local hit_pos = user_party_leader.Position + vector(0.8, 1, 1)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_weapon_routine, self,
	hit_pos + 10 * unity_class.vector3.forward, hit_pos, 0.5))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--목검에 맞고 날아가는 학생
	for k,v in pairs(self.battle_Scene_npcs) do
		character_util.set_emotion(v, {name = "surprise"})
	end

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.Direction.Right)
	character_util.set_direction(teatan_hero, CS.Oak.Direction.Right)
	character_util.set_direction(ghost_buster, CS.Oak.Direction.Right)

	user_party_leader:RemoveAnimation()
	teatan_hero:RemoveAnimation()
	ghost_buster:RemoveAnimation()

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_critical_01')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_projectile_01')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_victim_fly_01')

	character_util.set_emotion(picture_girl, {name = "surprise"})
	CS.Oak.CriticalHitEffect.Instance:Hit(battle_npc, battle_npc)
	battle_npc:RemoveAnimation()
	battle_npc:RemoveEmotion()
	character_util.set_emotion(battle_npc, {name = "damaged"})
	character_util.spine_rotate(battle_npc, 360 * 6, 1)

	character_util.move_to(battle_npc, battle_npc.Position + 8 * unity_class.vector3.back,
			nil, 7)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	slow_motion_sfx:FadeOut(0.3)

	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod("highschool_main")

	wait_for_sec(0.9)

	--4천왕 등장
	CS.Oak.RollingNumberManager.Instance:HideRollingNumber(user_party_leader.Transform)

	character_util.jump(user_party_leader, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.Direction.Up)

	character_util.jump(teatan_hero, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.set_direction(teatan_hero, CS.Oak.Direction.Up)

	character_util.jump(ghost_buster, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.set_direction(ghost_buster, CS.Oak.Direction.Up)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_count_01')

	camera_util.shake(0.7, 0.3)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.elites[2],
			{key = "highschool_appear_elites_5", skip = true, bubble_type = "shout",
			 world_pos = self.elites[2].Position + vector( -1.5, 0, -3.5)})

	user_party_leader:RemoveEmotion()
	teatan_hero:RemoveEmotion()
	ghost_buster:RemoveEmotion()

	for k,v in pairs(self.battle_Scene_npcs) do
		v:RemoveEmotion()
		character_util.shake(v, 0.02, 5)
	end
	picture_girl:RemoveEmotion()
	character_util.shake(picture_girl, 0.02, 5)

	for i = 2, 4 do
		character_util.move_to(self.elites[i], self.elites[i].Position + 3.4 * unity_class.vector3.back,
		3.5, nil, true, true)
	end

	local buzz_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2
	})

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 1, #self.battle_Scene_npcs do
		marker = field:GetMarker(string.format("appear_elites_student_1_%d", i - 1))
		character_util.move_to(self.battle_Scene_npcs[i], marker.position, nil, 2, nil, true)

		if i < 4 then
			character_util.set_direction(self.battle_Scene_npcs[i], "right")
		else
			character_util.set_direction(self.battle_Scene_npcs[i], "left")
		end
	end

	marker = field:GetMarker("appear_elites_pictureGirl")
	character_util.move_to(picture_girl, marker.position, nil, 3, nil, true)
	character_util.set_direction(picture_girl, "right")

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.align_party(user_party_leader.Position + 1.5 * unity_class.vector3.back, "down")
	character_util.move_to(ghost_buster, ghost_buster.Position + 1.5 * unity_class.vector3.back,
	nil, 2, nil, true)
	character_util.move_to(teatan_hero, teatan_hero.Position + 1.5 * unity_class.vector3.back,
			nil, 2, nil, true)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.battle_Scene_npcs[1],
			{key = "highschool_student_talk_1", skip = true, bubble_direction = "lb"})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.battle_Scene_npcs[3],
			{key = "highschool_student_talk_2", skip = true, bubble_direction = "lt"})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.battle_Scene_npcs[4],
			{key = "highschool_student_talk_4", skip = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.battle_Scene_npcs[5],
			{key = "highschool_student_talk_5", skip = true})

	wait_for_sec(1)

	CS.Oak.RollingNumberManager.Instance:HideRollingNumber(user_party_leader.Transform)

	camera_util.resize_to(2, 0.6)
	camera_util.move_async(self.elites[2].Position + 0.4 * unity_class.vector3.forward, 0.6)

	local twinkle_list = {}
	for i = 2, 4 do
		table.insert(twinkle_list, self.twinkle_effect_pool:Instantiate(self.elites[i].Position))
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_count_final_01')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_fade_out_03')

	buzz_sfx:FadeOut()

	-- 4천왕 소개 연출 UI
	local introduce_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.introduce_pool_name)

function local_class:throw_weapon_routine(start_pos, target_pos, duration)
	local sprite_name = "jukdo"
	local default_angle = -90
	local weapon = self.weapon_preset:Instantiate(start_pos)

	local shadow_setter = weapon:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.StageShadowSetter))
	local main_sprite = weapon.transform:Find('projectiles'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local shadow_sprite = weapon.transform:Find('shadow'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local main_color = main_sprite.TintColor
	local shadow_color = shadow_sprite.TintColor

	if shadow_setter == nil or main_sprite == nil or shadow_sprite == nil then
		return
	end

	weapon.transform.localScale = 1.5 * unity_class.vector3.one

	main_sprite.SpriteName = sprite_name
	shadow_sprite.SpriteName = sprite_name

	main_sprite:Rebuild()
	shadow_sprite:Rebuild()

	local time_passed = 0
	local diff =  target_pos - start_pos

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_normal_slash_01')

	weapon.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -default_angle +
			unity_class.vector3.Angle(unity_class.vector3.right, diff.normalized), 0)

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		shadow_setter.Position = start_pos + CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration) * diff

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local fall_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(5, 12.5, target_pos.y, 1)

	fall_calculator:ScaleTime(1.5)
	fall_calculator:SetElasticity(0.4)

	local last_pos = target_pos
	local end_pos = target_pos + 5 * unity_class.vector3.right
	local last_bounce = 0

	while not fall_calculator:IsDone() do
		local horizontal_speed
		if fall_calculator:NumBounced() > 0 then
			horizontal_speed = 2
		else
			horizontal_speed = 6
		end

		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		time_passed = time_passed + dt
		local new_pos = last_pos + (end_pos - target_pos):GetX0z().normalized * (dt * horizontal_speed)
		local floor = field:GetTileInfoAt(new_pos):GetHeightAt(new_pos)
		fall_calculator:Proceed(dt, floor)
		new_pos.y = fall_calculator:GetDistance()

		weapon.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(360 * 8 * time_passed, unity_class.vector3.up)
		shadow_setter.Position = new_pos

		local target_alpha = 1 - CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(
				last_bounce * 0.7 + fall_calculator:GetProgress() * 0.3, 0, 1, 1)
		main_color.a = target_alpha
		shadow_color.a = target_alpha

		main_sprite.TintColor = main_color
		shadow_sprite.TintColor = shadow_color

		main_sprite:Rebuild()
		shadow_sprite:Rebuild()

		if last_bounce ~= fall_calculator:NumBounced() then
			last_bounce = fall_calculator:NumBounced()

			local effect = self.smoke_preset:Instantiate(weapon.transform.localPosition)
			effect.transform.localScale = 0.4 * unity_class.vector3.one
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		last_pos = shadow_setter.Position
	end

	weapon.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	main_sprite.SpriteName = ""
	shadow_sprite.SpriteName = ""

	main_color.a = 1
	shadow_color.a = 1

	main_sprite.TintColor = main_color
	shadow_sprite.TintColor = shadow_color

	main_sprite:Rebuild()
	shadow_sprite:Rebuild()

	weapon:Dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

function local_class:ogre_run()
	local leader = user_party_leader
	local ghost_buster = get_character('ghost_buster_2')
	local teatan_hero = get_character("teatan_hero_npc")
	local ogre_student1 = self:ogre_student1()
	local ogre_student2 = self:ogre_student2()
	local rotye = self:rotye()

	ogre_student1.Position = vector(13, 0, 106)
	ogre_student2.Position = vector(15, 0, 106)

	ogre_student1:SetEmotion("mad", true)
	ogre_student2:SetEmotion("mad", true)

	local ogre_speed = 5

	local function pos_to_pos_duration(start_pos, end_pos, speed)
		return (end_pos - start_pos):GetX0z().magnitude / speed
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.06,
			pos_to_pos_duration(ogre_student2.Position, vector(3, 0, 106), ogre_speed),
			nil, 'ogre_run')

	character_util.move_waypoint(ogre_student1, vector(1, 0, 106),
			ogre_speed, true, nil, nil, "right", true)

	character_util.move_waypoint(ogre_student2, vector(3, 0, 106),
			ogre_speed, true, nil, nil, "left", true)

	ogre_student1.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 2)
	ogre_student2.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 2)

	stage.SmokeManager:SetCharacterSmoke(ogre_student1)
	stage.SmokeManager:SetCharacterSmoke(ogre_student2)

	local move_duration = pos_to_pos_duration(ogre_student1.Position, rotye.Position, ogre_speed)
	wait_for_sec(move_duration)

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local c = user_party[i]
		character_util.set_anim(c, { name = 'embarrassed' })
		character_util.set_emotion(c, { name = 'surprise' })
	end

	character_util.set_anim(teatan_hero, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(teatan_hero, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_anim(ghost_buster, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(ghost_buster, { name = 'surprise' })

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_big_01')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_game_die_01')

	local pool = self:stun_effect_pool()
	self.stun_effect = pool:Instantiate(rotye.Position + vector(-0.15, 1, 0))
	self.stun_effect.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1) * 0.3

	CS.Oak.CriticalHitEffect.Instance:Hit(rotye, rotye)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(rotye)

	character_util.set_anim(rotye, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false})
	character_util.set_emotion(rotye, { name = 'confused' })

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local c = user_party[i]
		character_util.move_waypoint(c,
				vector(c.Position.x, 0, c.Position.z - 1.8),
				5, true, nil, nil, "up")
	end

	character_util.move_waypoint(teatan_hero,
			vector(teatan_hero.Position.x, 0, teatan_hero.Position.z - 1.8),
			5, true, nil, nil, "up")

	character_util.move_waypoint(ghost_buster,
			vector(ghost_buster.Position.x, 0, ghost_buster.Position.z - 1.8),
			5, true, nil, nil, "up")

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if user_party.Count > 1 then
		local index = 1

		while index < user_party.Count do
			local c = user_party[index]
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(c)
			index = index + 1
		end
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ghost_buster)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(teatan_hero)

	stage.SmokeManager:UnsetCharacterSmoke(ogre_student1)
	stage.SmokeManager:UnsetCharacterSmoke(ogre_student2)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_heavy_slash_01')

	character_util.set_direction(ogre_student2, CS.Oak.Direction.Right)

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_heavy_slash_01')

	character_util.set_direction(ogre_student2, CS.Oak.Direction.Left)

	self.normal_talk_async(ogre_student1, 'highschool_meet_rotye_23')

	self.normal_talk_async(ogre_student2, 'highschool_meet_rotye_24')

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.MoveTo(
			ogre_student1, ogre_student1.Position + vector(0, 0, 2), nil, 3, true, true))

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	character_util.set_direction(ogre_student1, CS.Oak.Direction.Right)

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	character_util.set_direction(ogre_student1, CS.Oak.Direction.Left)

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.MoveTo(
			ogre_student1, ogre_student1.Position - vector(0, 0, 2), nil, 3, true, true))

	character_util.set_direction(ogre_student1, CS.Oak.Direction.Left)

	stage.SmokeManager:SetCharacterSmoke(ogre_student1)
	stage.SmokeManager:SetCharacterSmoke(ogre_student2)

	character_util.move_waypoint(ogre_student1, vector(-10, 0, 106),
			ogre_speed, true, nil, nil, "left", true)

	character_util.move_waypoint(ogre_student2, vector(-10, 0, 106),
			ogre_speed, true, nil, nil, "left", true)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local c = user_party[i]
		character_util.move_waypoint(c,
				vector(c.Position.x, 0, c.Position.z + 1.8),
				5, true, nil, nil, "right")
	end

	character_util.move_waypoint(teatan_hero,
			vector(teatan_hero.Position.x, 0, teatan_hero.Position.z + 1.8),
			5, true, nil, nil, "right")
	character_util.move_waypoint(ghost_buster,
			vector(ghost_buster.Position.x, 0, ghost_buster.Position.z + 1.8),
			5, true, nil, nil, "right")

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	stage.SmokeManager:UnsetCharacterSmoke(ogre_student1)
	stage.SmokeManager:UnsetCharacterSmoke(ogre_student2)

	leader:RemoveAnimation()
	leader:RemoveEmotion()
	yield_return_func(character_util.mario_jump, user_party_leader, "right")

	local move_info = character_util.move_waypoint(leader,
			rotye.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			3, false, nil, nil, "right")
	move_duration = move_info:GetDuration(leader.Position)

	if user_party.Count >= 2 then
		local index = 1
		while index < user_party.Count do
			local c = user_party[index]
			character_util.move_waypoint(c,
					c.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
					3, false, nil, nil, "right")
			index = index + 1
		end
	end
	character_util.move_waypoint(ghost_buster,
			ghost_buster.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
			3, false, nil, nil, "right")
	character_util.move_waypoint(teatan_hero,
			teatan_hero.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
			3, false, nil, nil, "right")

	wait_for_sec(move_duration)

	self.stun_effect.transform.position = rotye.Position + vector(0, 1.2, 0)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')

	character_util.shake(rotye, 0.04, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.stun_effect:Dispose()
	self.stun_effect = nil

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_popup_01')

	rotye:RemoveAnimation()
	rotye:RemoveEmotion()
	yield_return_func(character_util.mario_jump, rotye, "left")

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

-- Helper function 들
function local_class:remove_animation_and_emotion(character, owner)
	if owner == nil then
		owner = self.controller.cs_controller
	end

	character:RemoveAnimation(owner)
	character:RemoveEmotion(owner)
end

function local_class:emotion(character, request, owner)
	if owner == nil then
		owner = self.controller.cs_controller
	end

	character:SetEmotion(owner, request)
end

function local_class:animation(character, request, owner)
	if owner == nil then
		owner = self.controller.cs_controller
	end

	character:SetAnimation(owner, request)
end


function local_class:set_emotion_animation(fo, data, owner)
	if owner == nil then
		owner = self.controller.cs_controller
	end

	if data.animation ~= nil then
		fo:SetAnimation(owner, data.animation)
	end

	if(data.emotion ~= nil) then
		fo:SetEmotion(owner, data.emotion)
	end
end

function local_class:remove_emotion(fo, owner)
	if owner == nil then
		owner = self.controller.cs_controller
	end

	fo:RemoveEmotion(owner)
end

function local_class:remove_animation(fo, owner)
	if owner == nil then
		owner = self.controller.cs_controller
	end

	fo:RemoveAnimation(owner)
end

return local_class

function local_class:talk_with_kendo_leader()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.kendo_leader)

	character_util.align_party(self.kendo_leader, "down")

	if self.is_talk_with_kendo_leader == false then
		self.is_talk_with_kendo_leader = true

		character_util.jump(self.kendo_leader, 0.4, 0.3)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kendo_leader, { key = 'kanterbury_highschool_main_s8_0', skip = true })

		self.kendo_leader:SetAnimation("question", false)
		self.kendo_leader:SetEmotion("attack", true)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kendo_leader, { key = 'kanterbury_highschool_main_s8_1', skip = true })

		self.kendo_leader:RemoveAnimation()
		self.kendo_leader:RemoveEmotion()
	end

	local waitForBranch = true
	local choice = 0

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

	local talk_branch_1 = {
		Text = game_string:GetString("kanterbury_highschool_main_s8_talk_branch_0"),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			choice = 0
			waitForBranch = false
		end}

		Text = game_string:GetString("kanterbury_highschool_main_s8_talk_branch_1"),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
		Callback = function()
			choice = 1
			waitForBranch = false
		end}

		Text = game_string:GetString("kanterbury_highschool_main_s8_talk_branch_2"),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			choice = 2
			waitForBranch = false
		end}

	branches:Add(talk_branch_1)
	branches:Add(talk_branch_2)
	branches:Add(talk_branch_3)

	while choice ~= 2 do
		local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
		choice_state.Branchs = branches
		choice_state.Talker = self.kendo_leader
		ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)

		while waitForBranch do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if choice == 0 then
			self.kendo_leader:SetAnimation("cross_arm", true)

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kendo_leader, { key = 'kanterbury_highschool_main_s8_2', skip = true })

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kendo_leader, { key = 'kanterbury_highschool_main_s8_3', skip = true })

			self.kendo_leader:RemoveAnimation()
			self.kendo_leader:RemoveEmotion()
		elseif choice == 1 then
			self.kendo_leader:SetAnimation("cross_arm", true)

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kendo_leader, { key = 'kanterbury_highschool_main_s8_4', skip = true })

			self.kendo_leader:SetAnimation("release", true)
			self.kendo_leader:SetEmotion("attack", true)

			character_util.add_animation_sfx(self.kendo_leader, '01_swing_01')

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kendo_leader, { key = 'kanterbury_highschool_main_s8_5', skip = true })

			self.kendo_leader:RemoveAnimation()
			self.kendo_leader:RemoveEmotion()
		else

			stage.QuestTracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

			self.kendo_leader:SetEmotion("attack", true)

			coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.MoveTo(
					self.kendo_leader, self.kendo_leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 2), 1, nil, true, true))

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kendo_leader, { key = 'kanterbury_highschool_main_s8_7', skip = true })

			self.kendo_leader:RemoveEmotion()

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kendo_leader, { key = 'kanterbury_highschool_main_s8_9', skip = true })

			camera_util.move(user_party_leader.Position, 1)

			self.kendo_leader:SetAnimation("question", false)
			self.kendo_leader:RemoveEmotion()

			self.kendo_leader:SetAnimation("katana_batto_end", false)

function local_class:enter()

		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent), 'on_event')

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.fx_shockwave_name)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.sword_slash_name)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.fx_hit_name)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.fx_disappear_name)

		self.kendo_leader = get_character(self.kendo_leader_name)
		self.kendo_leader.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

		character_util.set_direction(self.kendo_leader, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)

		self.jukdo_giver = get_character(self.jukdo_giver_name)
		self.jukdo_giver.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.kendo_leader_door_name))
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == 'highschool_1_2' then
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.jukdo_giver)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(
				self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.kendo_leader)

		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name))

		-- 이전 섹션에서 넘어온 경우 대화 이어서 진행됨
		if self.controller.starting_inner_progress ~= 8 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_kendo_leader, self, false))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name == 'highschool_1_2' then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent))

		self.kendo_leader.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		self.kendo_leader = nil

		self.jukdo_giver.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		self.jukdo_giver = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent) then
		self:on_item_get_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent) then
		self:on_stage_control_start_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.kendo_leader) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_kendo_leader, self, true))
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.jukdo_giver) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_jukdo_giver, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_item_get_event(e)
	if e.Item.ItemId == self.reversed_blade_item_id then
		-- 죽도 얻고 플레이어가 패배 시에 나오는 역날검 마커 제거
		if self.break_jukdo then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(
					self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.kendo_leader)
		end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	local house_owner = self.get_house_owner()
	if lua_helper.type_compare(house_owner.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		house_owner.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	local snowman = self.get_snowman()
	if lua_helper.type_compare(snowman.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		snowman.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.brazier_coroutine = nil

	if self.fire_sfx ~= nil then
		self.fire_sfx:Stop()
	end
	self.fire_sfx = nil

	if self.fire_small_sfx ~= nil then
		self.fire_small_sfx:Stop()
	end
	self.fire_small_sfx = nil

	if self.sleep_sfx ~= nil then
		self.sleep_sfx:Stop()
	end
	self.sleep_sfx = nil

	if self.snowman_fire_effect ~= nil then
		self.snowman_fire_effect:Dispose()
	end
	self.snowman_fire_effect = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local house_owner = self.get_house_owner()
	local snowman = self.get_snowman()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, house_owner) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_house_owner, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, snowman) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_snowman, self))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local brazier = self.get_brazier()

	if e.FullEnter then
		if not self.is_snowman_burning then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, brazier) and e.Zone.Name == self.snowman_event_zone_name and brazier.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.brazier_close_snowman, self)
				return true
			elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) and e.Zone.Name == self.house_event_zone_name and not brazier.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning then
				self.brazier_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.brazier_near_to_get_chimney, self))
			end
		else
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
				if not self.is_saw_house_burning and e.Zone.Name == self.house_front_event_zone_name then
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.out_house, self)
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.house_event_zone_name then
				if self.brazier_coroutine ~= nil then
					stop_coroutine(self.brazier_coroutine)
					self.brazier_coroutine = nil
				end
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 집이 폭발하는 연출
function local_class:explosion_house(fo)
	local focus_in_time = 2.5
	local stay_time = 2.5
	local focus_out_time = 0.4
	local explosion_time_step = 0.25

	local boss_die_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_boss_die_01', parent = fo, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })

	self.get_explosion_efffect_pool():Instantiate(fo.Bounds.center)

	fo:Shake(0.05, 1000)

	camera_util.shake(0.04, focus_in_time, false)

	local time_left = focus_in_time
	local is_stay = false

	while time_left > 0 do
		local pos = self:get_rand_pos_by_ifo(fo)

		local explosion = self.get_explosion_small_efffect_pool():Instantiate(pos)

		wait_for_sec(unity_class.mathf.Min(explosion_time_step, time_left))
		time_left = time_left - explosion_time_step

		local gold_pos = self:get_rand_pos()

		CS.Oak.DropGold.Create(fo.Position + gold_pos, 100)

		if not is_stay and time_left <= 0 then
			time_left = stay_time
			is_stay = true

			camera_util.shake(0.06, stay_time, false)
		end
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.08, focus_out_time, false)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.3, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	for i = 1, 5 do
		local pos = self:get_rand_pos()

		CS.Oak.DropGold.Create(fo.Position + vector(0, 2, 0), fo.Position + pos, 100)
	end

	boss_die_sfx:Stop()
	self.fire_sfx:Stop()
	self.fire_sfx = nil
	self.fire_small_sfx:Stop()
	self.fire_small_sfx = nil

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_explosion_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.05)

	fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

	-- 이 오브젝트가 파괴되었음을 브로드캐스팅 한다.
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent.Create(fo, fo.Position, fo.Hitbox))

	wait_for_sec(focus_out_time - 0.05)
end

-- 폭파 시에 사용되는, x축으로 -2 ~ 2, z축으로 -2 ~ 2 사이의 랜덤 벡터를 설정하는 함수
function local_class:get_rand_pos()
	local rand_x = unity_class.random.Range(-2, 2)
	local rand_z = unity_class.random.Range(-2, 2)

	local pos = vector(rand_x, 0, rand_z)

	return pos
end

-- 폭파 시에 사용되는, 오브젝트의 위치를 기반으로 x축으로 -2 ~ 2, z축으로 -2 ~ 2 사이의 랜덤 벡터를 설정하는 함수
function local_class:get_rand_pos_by_ifo(ifo)
	local center = ifo.Bounds.center
	local x_width = ifo.Hitbox.size.x
	local z_depth = ifo.Hitbox.size.z
	local radius_rand = 0 + unity_class.random.value + 0.5

	x_width = x_width * radius_rand
	z_depth = z_depth * radius_rand

	local rand = unity_class.random.value * unity_class.mathf.PI * 2
	local pos = center + vector(unity_class.mathf.Cos(rand) * x_width, 0, unity_class.mathf.Sin(rand) * z_depth)

	return pos
end

function local_class:burn_sign_board(fire_effect_list)
	local sign_board_1 = self.get_sign_board(1)
	local sign_board_2 = self.get_sign_board(2)
	local sign_board_3 = self.get_sign_board(3)
	local sign_board_4 = self.get_sign_board(4)
	local sign_board_5 = self.get_sign_board(5)
	local sign_board_6 = self.get_sign_board(6)
	local sign_board_7 = self.get_sign_board(7)

	table.insert(fire_effect_list, self.get_fire_effect_pool():Instantiate(sign_board_3.Position))
	table.insert(fire_effect_list, self.get_fire_effect_pool():Instantiate(sign_board_4.Position))
	wait_for_sec(1)

	table.insert(fire_effect_list, self.get_fire_effect_pool():Instantiate(sign_board_2.Position))
	table.insert(fire_effect_list, self.get_fire_effect_pool():Instantiate(sign_board_5.Position))
	wait_for_sec(1)

	table.insert(fire_effect_list, self.get_fire_effect_pool():Instantiate(sign_board_1.Position))
	table.insert(fire_effect_list, self.get_fire_effect_pool():Instantiate(sign_board_6.Position))
	wait_for_sec(1)

	table.insert(fire_effect_list, self.get_fire_effect_pool():Instantiate(sign_board_7.Position))
end

-- 화로가 벽난로에 가까이 갔을 때 불을 붙임
function local_class:brazier_near_to_get_chimney()
	local brazier = self.get_brazier()
	local chimney = self.get_chimney()

	while true do
		local distance = (brazier.Position - (chimney.Position + vector(0.5, 0, -0.5))).sqrMagnitude

		-- 1.5의 제곱
		if distance <= 1.7 then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	command_util.execute_burn(chimney, brazier)

	self.brazier_coroutine = nil
end

return local_class

	self.lazy_leaf_fairy.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		end

		character_util.set_anim(self.lazy_leaf_fairy, {name = "idle"})

		character_util.align_party(self.lazy_leaf_fairy, "right")
	else
		user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	end

	if not self.skip_request then
		local scene_name = string.format("talk_%d", self.current_talk_num)

		lua_helper.call_nullable(self.controller.scene, scene_name, self.controller.scene)

		if self.current_talk_num == 1 then

			CS.Oak.QuestIcon.SetQuestAccepted(self.lazy_leaf_fairy)

			self.lazy_leaf_fairy.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			self.lazy_leaf_fairy.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
		end
	else
		CS.Oak.QuestIcon.SetQuestNotice(self.lazy_leaf_fairy)
		self.current_talk_num = self.current_talk_num + 1
		self.lazy_leaf_fairy.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		self.lazy_leaf_fairy.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	user_party:ResetControllers()

	character_util.set_direction(self.lazy_leaf_fairy, "right")

	self.consumed_gold = false

	self.kayden_chronicle_id = 20085

function local_class:enter()

	if stage.Name == "substage_1_6" then

		end

	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.drop_gold = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Interactor, user_party_leader) and e.Target ~= nil then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.lazy_leaf_fairy) then
				if self.had_book_count == 0 then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.no_has_book, self))
				elseif self.had_book_count == 3 then

					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.collected_all_book, self))
				else
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.collected_part_of_books, self))
				end
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent) then
		if e.Getter == user_party_leader then
			if e.Item.ItemId == 70001 then
				self.consumed_gold = true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

end

function local_class:collected_all_book()

end

function local_class:give_books_to_fairy()
	local holderlist = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.ItemPlaceholder))
	holderlist:Add({
		ItemId = self.legend_of_hyper_id,
		NotForInventory = true
	})
	holderlist:Add({
		ItemId = self.ann_and_secret_room_id,
		NotForInventory = true
	})
	holderlist:Add({
		ItemId = self.kayden_chronicle_id,
		NotForInventory = true
	})

	local targetpointlist = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	targetpointlist:Add(user_party_leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.left +
	unity_class.vector3.forward)
	targetpointlist:Add(user_party_leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.left)
	targetpointlist:Add(user_party_leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.left +
	unity_class.vector3.back)
	local books = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.DropItem)
	local booksstartpoints = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

	for i = 0, holderlist.Count - 1 do
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_swing_01")
		books:Add(drop_item_util.create_item({pos = user_party_leader.Position, target = targetpointlist[i],
		itemid = holderlist[i].ItemId, notforinven = holderlist[i].NotForInventory, lootstate = "dontfindlooter"}))
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.2))
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	for i = 0, 2 do
		booksstartpoints:Add(books[i].Position)
	end

	local flytime = 0.2
	local targetpos = self.lazy_leaf_fairy.Position
	local tp = 0

	while tp <= flytime do
		local progress = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(tp, 0, 1, flytime))

		for i = 0, books.Count - 1 do
			local book = books[i]
			book.Position = booksstartpoints[i] * (1 - progress) + targetpos * progress
		end

		tp = tp + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 0, books.Count - 1 do
		books[i].ConsumeTarget = self.lazy_leaf_fairy
		books[i]:ConsumeComplete()
	end
end

function local_class:collected_part_of_books()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	character_util.set_emotion(self.lazy_leaf_fairy, {name = "idle"})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lazy_leaf_fairy,
			{key = {"lazy_leaf_fairy_talk_2", self.had_book_count}, skip = true, portraitname = "leaf_fairy.png"})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lazy_leaf_fairy,
			{key = "lazy_leaf_fairy_talk_3", skip = true, portraitname = "leaf_fairy.png"})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lazy_leaf_fairy,
			{key = "lazy_leaf_fairy_talk_4", skip = true, portraitname = "leaf_fairy.png"})

	character_util.set_emotion(self.lazy_leaf_fairy, {name = "sleep"})

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:give_reward_to_player()
	local fairy = get_character("lazy_leaf_fairy")
	local gold = CS.Oak.DropGold.Create(fairy.Position, user_party.Leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.left, 1)
	gold.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	coroutine.yield(quest_util.progress_section(self.controller))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:say_about_get_books()
	local chosen = -1
	local wait = true

	local remove_choose_list = create_generic_list(CS.System.Int32)

	for i=1, 3 do
		wait = true
		local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
		for j = 1, 3 do
			if not remove_choose_list:Contains(j) then
				branches:Add({
					Text = game_string:GetString(string.format('%s_%d', "lazy_leaf_fairy_branch", j)),
					Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
					Callback = function()
						wait = false
						chosen = j
					end})
			end
		end

		local acs = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
		acs.Talker = user_party_leader
		acs.Branchs = branches
		ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, acs)

		while wait do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if i == 3 then
			break
		end

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lazy_leaf_fairy,
				{key = string.format("%s_%d", "lazy_leaf_fairy_answer", chosen),
		skip = true, portraitname = "leaf_fairy.png"})

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lazy_leaf_fairy, {key = "lazy_leaf_fairy_ask_loop",
		skip = true, portraitname = "leaf_fairy.png"})

		remove_choose_list:Add(chosen)
	end

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function() wait = false end })

	local acs = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
	acs.Branchs = branches
	acs.Talker = user_party_leader
	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, acs)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

function local_class:get_lazy_leaf_fairy()
	local lazy_leaf_fairy = self.lazy_leaf_fairy
	local is_max_party = user_party.Count >= CS.Oak.User.Me.Party.MaxLimitCharacterCount

	local char_spec = CS.Oak.CharacterSpecId
	local character = CS.Oak.User.Me:GetCharacter(char_spec.LeafFairy, true)
	local already_has_character = (character ~= nil)

	local character_theatre_data = CS.Oak.CharacterTheatreData()
	character_theatre_data.Character = lazy_leaf_fairy
	character_theatre_data.CardName = "leaf_fairy"
	character_theatre_data.Title = game_string:GetString("lazy_leaf_fairy_title")
	character_theatre_data.Subtitle = game_string:GetString("lazy_leaf_fairy_subtitle")
	character_theatre_data.Desc = game_string:GetString("lazy_leaf_fairy_desc")
	character_theatre_data.IsMaxParty = is_max_party
	character_theatre_data.AlreadyHasInParty = already_has_character
	character_theatre_data.VoiceId = 28
	character_theatre_data.VoiceType = CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.JoinParty

	local is_ended_threatre = false

	CS.Oak.NewCharacterTheatre.ShowThreatre(character_theatre_data, function()
		is_ended_threatre = true
	end)

	while not is_ended_threatre do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	coroutine.yield(quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0, false,
			false, true, true, nil))


	if not is_max_party and not already_has_character then
		local gotten_character = CS.Oak.User.Me:GetCharacter(char_spec.LeafFairy)
		CS.Oak.AddHeroStageLogic.Execute(lazy_leaf_fairy, gotten_character, CS.Oak.User.Me, user_party)
	end
end

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

		coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:GetLazyFairy())

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lazy_leaf_fairy,
				{key = string.format("lazy_leaf_fairy_%d", talk_code + (self.talk_count - 1))
				, skip = true, portraitname = "leaf_fairy.png"})
	end

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	self.interact_coroutine = nil

	self.quest_spec = nil

			end

function local_class:quest_request(statue_no)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	CS.Oak.Party.MyParty:StopAndDisableControl()
	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()

	yield_return(stage.FieldUINarrationBox, "SetNarration",
			game_string:GetString("legend_of_akayuki1_statue_narration_1"), 0, 1.0)
	yield_return(stage.FieldUINarrationBox, "HideAnimation")

	local salute = false
	local wait = true

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString("legend_of_akayuki1_s1_branch_0"),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
		Callback = function()
			salute = true;
			wait = false;
		end
	})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString("legend_of_akayuki1_s1_branch_1"),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false;
		end
	})

	local u  = ui_overlay_util
	u.push_overlay(nil, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	if salute then
		local item = {}
		local item_data = game_data_service.GetData("ItemData")
		item.ItemId = item_data:GetSpec(self.katana_list[statue_no]).Id
		item.NotForInventory = true

		local katana = CS.Oak.DropItem.Create(unity_class.vector3(999, 0, 999),
				unity_class.vector3(999, 0, 999), item, false, false, CS.Oak.DropItem.LootState.DontFindLooter)
		local player = user_party_leader
		coroutine.yield(align_party(player.Position -
				CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.To4WayVector3(CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetOpposite(player.Direction)),
				CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetOpposite(player.Direction), 1, 'arc'))

		local dir = (self.statue_list[statue_no].Position - player.Position):ToDirection()
		if (dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up) then
			player.Direction = dir
		else
			player.Direction = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(dir)
		end

		character_util.set_anim(player, {name =  "salute", loop = false, scale = 0.7})
		CS.Oak.CharacterAnimationSfxExtensions.TryAddSfxHandler(player, "02_twohand_stomp_jump_01")

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.5))

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_earthquake_03")
		stage_camera:Shake(0.3, 5.0)
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))
		local temp_pos = self.statue_list[statue_no].Position + unity_class.vector3(0, -1, 1)
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_gatcha_bling_01")
		local light = self.light_object_pool:Instantiate(temp_pos)

	local move_start_time = 0.0

	local effect_scale = 0.05
	local light_p = self.light_object_pool

			move_pos.y = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(float_time - move_start_time,

			move_pos.z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(float_time - move_start_time,

		twinkle.transform.position = move_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)

	player:RemoveAnimation()

	move_pos.z = move_pos.z - 0.2

	quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(self.invisible_katana)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

	stage_camera:ResizeTo(3.5, 0.7)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.1))

	local target_y = old_katana.Position.y + 1

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_gatcha_point_01")
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_queen_spell_01")

	while move_pos.y < target_y do
		float_time = float_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		move_pos = old_katana.Position
		move_pos.y = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(float_time, move_pos.y, target_y - move_pos.y, 0.3)
		old_katana:SetPosition(move_pos, true)
		twinkle.transform.position = old_katana.Position
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	player:SetEmotion("surprise", true)

	float_time = 0
	while angle > -42 do
		float_time = float_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		angle = angle - float_time * 20
		old_katana.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90,
				unity_class.vector3(1, 0, 0)) * unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3(0, 0, 1))
		old_katana.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90,
				unity_class.vector3(1, 0, 0)) * unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3(0, 0, 1))

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	player:RemoveAnimation()
	player:HideWeapon(false)

	player.SpineController:Jump(0.4, 0.3)
	float_time = 0
	move_pos = old_katana.Position
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_light_turn_on_01")
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("02_hit_light_01")

	local target_x = move_pos.x + 20
	while (move_pos.x < target_x) do

		move_pos = old_katana.Position
		move_pos.x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(float_time, move_pos.x, target_x - move_pos.x, 2)
		old_katana:SetPosition(move_pos, true)
		twinkle.transform.position = old_katana.Position
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	twinkle:Dispose()
	old_katana:ConsumeComplete()
	player.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.0))

	-- quest와 엮인 서브스테이지는 Quests 시트의 Pre/ProgressOpenStages를 이용해서 열고 클라단에서는 연출만 보여주도록 수정
	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.SubStageLogic.ExecuteOpenSubStage, 'substage_8_8', 'legend_of_akayuki1_statue_substage_narration')

	player:RemoveEmotion()
	quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0, true, true, true, true, nil)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.instant_fight = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if self.akayuki == nil then
		self.akayuki = get_character("akayuki_1")
	end
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local aka = get_character("akayuki_monster_" .. tostring(i))
		character_util.convert_to_npc(aka)
		self.akayuki_monster[i] = aka
	end

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress > -1 then
		self.akayuki.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		self.akayuki:SetEmotion("smile", true)
		self.akayuki.Position = self.akayuki.Position + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, -1.5)
	else
		self.instant_fight = true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
	self.akayuki.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadBossTitle()
	self.controller.scene:add_callback("BranchTalk", { controller = self, func = self.branch_talk })

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.instant_fight then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(CS.Oak.Game.Instance.gameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fight, self))
	else
		quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(self.akayuki)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	self.akayuki.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)

	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.controller = nil

	self.akayuki_monster = nil
	self.parties = nil
	self.akayuki = nil

	self.instant_fight = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.akayuki) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(CS.Oak.Game.Instance.gameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.before_fight, self))
		end
	end

	if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		for i = 1, 3 do
			if e.BattleGroupName == "akayuki_" .. tostring(i) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.next_step, self, i))
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:before_fight()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.akayuki)
	coroutine.yield(align_party(self.akayuki.Position, CS.Oak.Direction.Left, 1, 'arc'))

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local wait = true
	local go = false

	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString("legend_of_akayuki2_s0_branch_7"),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
			go = true
		end})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString("legend_of_akayuki2_s0_branch_8"),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
			go = false
		end})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party_leader, branches)
	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if go then
		yield_return(self, "fight")
	else
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.akayuki,
				{key = "legend_of_akayuki2_s0_20", skip = true, portraitname = "akayuki.png"})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.akayuki,
				{key = "legend_of_akayuki2_s0_21", skip = true, portraitname = "akayuki.png"})
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.akayuki)
	end

	CS.Oak.Party.MyParty:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:fight()
	CS.Oak.Party.MyParty:StopAndDisableControl()
	local boss_title_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("boss_title")

	character_util.set_anim(self.akayuki, {name = "katana_attack2", loop = false})
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.333))
	character_util.set_anim(self.akayuki, {name = "katana_batto_end", loop = false})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.akayuki,
			{key = "legend_of_akayuki2_s0_23", skip = true, portraitname = "akayuki.png"})
	character_util.set_anim(self.akayuki, {name = "katana_idle", loop = true})
	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:AkayukiAccpet())

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.akayuki,
			{key = "legend_of_akayuki2_s0_24", skip = true, portraitname = "akayuki.png"})

	local party_count = CS.Oak.Party.MyParty.Count
	if party_count > 1 then
		for i = 1, party_count - 1 do
			self.parties[i] = CS.Oak.Party.MyParty[1]
			character_util.convert_to_npc(self.parties[i])
		end
	end

	self.akayuki_monster[1].Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	self.akayuki_monster[1].Position = self.akayuki.Position
	self.akayuki.Position = unity_class.vector3(99, 0, 99)

	while boss_title_pool.State ~= CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolState.Loaded do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	screen_util.show_boss_title(game_string:GetString("legend_of_akayuki_1_boss_title"),
			game_string:GetString("legend_of_akayuki_1_boss_desc"), 2, false)

	for i = 1, 4 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create("battlegate" .. tostring(i)))
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(2))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShowBossHPEvent.Create(self.akayuki_monster[1]))

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	CS.Oak.Party.MyParty:ResetControllers()

	character_util.convert_to_monster(self.akayuki_monster[1], "akayuki_1", nil)
	self.akayuki_monster[1].DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.None
	command_util.execute_cmd(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeCommand.Create(self.akayuki_monster[1],
			user_party_leader, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(false))
end

function local_class:next_step(step)
	CS.Oak.Party.MyParty:StopAndDisableControl()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	local player = user_party_leader

	if (step ~= 3) then
		local cur_akayuki = self.akayuki_monster[step + 1]

		character_util.convert_to_npc(self.akayuki_monster[step])

		stage_camera:Move( self.akayuki_monster[step], 1, nil)
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.akayuki_monster[step],
				{key = "legend_of_akayuki2_s1_" .. tostring(0 + (step - 1) * 2), skip = true, portraitname = "akayuki.png"})
		if step == 2 then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.akayuki_monster[step],
					{key = "legend_of_akayuki2_s1_2_0", skip = true, portraitname = "akayuki.png"})
		end

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("02_magic_shield_01")
		screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color(1, 1, 1, 1), CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.sender = nil
		heal_info.target = self.akayuki_monster[step]
		heal_info.heal = self.akayuki_monster[step].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.isRevive = true

		command_util.publish_cmd(heal_info.Owner, CS.Oak.HealCommand.Create(heal_info))

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))
		cur_akayuki.Position = self.akayuki_monster[step].Position
		if cur_akayuki.Position.x > player.Position.x then
			cur_akayuki.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		else
			cur_akayuki.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		end

		self.akayuki_monster[step].Position = unity_class.vector3(99, 0, 99)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_fade_out_01")

		screen_util.fade_in_async(0.25, unity_class.color(1, 1, 1, 1), CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.25))
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cur_akayuki,
				{key = "legend_of_akayuki2_s1_" .. tostring(1 + (step - 1) * 2), skip = true, portraitname = "akayuki.png"})

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShowBossHPEvent.Create(cur_akayuki))

		camera_util.move(player.Position, 1, { end_target = player })
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))
		character_util.convert_to_monster(cur_akayuki, "akayuki_" .. tostring(step + 1))
		cur_akayuki.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.None

		command_util.execute_cmd(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeCommand.Create(cur_akayuki,
				user_party_leader, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
	else
		for i = 1, 4 do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create("battlegate" .. tostring(i)))
		end

		yield_return(self, "party_back")

		character_util.convert_to_npc(self.akayuki_monster[3])
		coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:playerWin())
		local already_has_character = user:GetCharacter(CS.Oak.CharacterSpecId.Akayuki, true) ~= nil
		local tmp_akayuki = self.akayuki


		yield_return(quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0, true, true, false, true, nil))

		local is_max_party = CS.Oak.Party.MyParty.Count >= user.Party.MaxLimitCharacterCount
		local ctd = CS.Oak.CharacterTheatreData()
		ctd.Character = tmp_akayuki
		ctd.CardName = "akayuki"
		ctd.Title = game_string:GetString("akayuki_character_title")
		ctd.Subtitle = game_string:GetString("akayuki_character_subtitle")
		ctd.Desc = game_string:GetString("akayuki_character_description")
		ctd.IsMaxParty = is_max_party
		ctd.AlreadyHasInParty = already_has_character
		ctd.VoiceId = 101
		ctd.VoiceType = CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.JoinParty

		local is_theatre_ended = false

		CS.Oak.NewCharacterTheatre.ShowThreatre(ctd, function()
			is_theatre_ended = true
		end)

		while (not is_theatre_ended) do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if (not is_max_party) and (not already_has_character) then
			local got_character = user:GetCharacter(CS.Oak.CharacterSpecId.Akayuki)
			CS.Oak.AddHeroStageLogic.Execute(tmp_akayuki, got_character, user, CS.Oak.Party.MyParty)
		end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(true))
	end

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	CS.Oak.Party.MyParty:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:branch_talk()
	local wait = true

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString("legend_of_akayuki2_s1_7"),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party_leader, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:party_back()
	for key,value in pairs(self.parties) do
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.parties[key], CS.Oak.Party.MyParty, nil)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('LilithTowerAndroidEngineerSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = LilithTowerAndroidEngineer @
		Comment =  2스테이지 안드로이드 기술자 구출 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.progress_enum = {
		none = 1,
		-- 안드로이드가 수리된 상태
		repairing_android = 2
	}

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.none

	-- npc
	self.get_android = function() return get_character('android_engineer_android') end

	-- 기믹
	self.get_android_head = function() return get_field_object('android_engineer_android_head') end
	self.get_android_head_reset_switch = function() return get_field_object('rolling_ball_reset_switch') end

	-- 마커
	self.get_android_head_pos = function() return field:GetMarker('android_engineer_android_head_pos').position end
	self.get_android_body_pos = function() return field:GetMarker('android_engineer_android_body_pos').position end
	self.get_android_waypoint = function(num) return field:GetMarker('android_engineer_waypoint_'..num).position end

	-- 이펙트
	self.get_change_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_levelup_new') end
	self.get_jump_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Common_Jump_small') end

	-- 엔지니어가 있는 방의 문
	self.engineer_door_name = 'android_engineer_door'
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	-- 안드로이드 머리 세팅
	local android_head_pos = self.get_android_head_pos()
	local android_head = self.get_android_head()
	android_head.Position = android_head_pos + vector(-2, 0, 4)

	local reset_switch = self.get_android_head_reset_switch()
	reset_switch.Position = android_head_pos + vector(-4, 0, 5)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.engineer_door_name))
	return true
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_change_effect()
	self.get_jump_effect()
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(_)
	return false
end

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local android_head = self.get_android_head()
	-- 안드로이드 머리가 안드로이드 몸 주변에 있을 때 이벤트
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, android_head, 'android_engineer_near_body') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.repair_android, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 안드로이드를 수리
function local_class:repair_android()
	self.controller.repaired_android = true

	local android_head = self.get_android_head()
	local android = self.get_android()

	character_util.set_active_state(android, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_anim(android, { name = 'dead2', loop = false, scale = 5 })
	character_util.set_emotion(android, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_direction(android, 'left')

	local android_body_pos = self.get_android_body_pos()

	message_system:SendSync(android_head, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)

	android_head.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullCrashBehaviour.Instance

	-- 구르는 애니메이션
	local spine_controller = android_head.UnityGameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
	spine_controller.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(android_body_pos - android_head.Position)

	local base_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)
	local current_anim_entry = spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation.state:GetCurrent(base_track)
	current_anim_entry.TimeScale = 1

	-- 몸통 주변으로 이동
	local pos = android_body_pos + 0.3 * (android_head.Position - android_body_pos).normalized
	character_util.move_to_async(android_head, pos, 0.5, nil)

	current_anim_entry.TimeScale = 0

	self.get_change_effect():Instantiate(android_body_pos)

	-- 안드로이드 머리와 안드로이드 몸을 완성된 안드로이드로 변경
	android.Position = android_body_pos

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_revive_01', parent = android })

	if self.controller.android_body then
		self.controller.android_body:ConsumeComplete()
		self.controller.android_body = nil
	end

	android_head.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	local reset_switch = self.get_android_head_reset_switch()
	reset_switch.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	wait_for_sec(2)

	android.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', parent = android })
	character_util.shake(android, 0.05, 0.5)
	character_util.set_emotion(android, { name = 'mad' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_emotion(android, { name = 'damaged' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', parent = android })
	character_util.shake(android, 0.05, 0.5)
	character_util.set_emotion(android, { name = 'mad' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_emotion(android, { name = 'idle' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', parent = android })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_worker_01', parent = android })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(android, { name = 'jump' })

	self.get_jump_effect():Instantiate(android_body_pos)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	local move_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
		{ sfx_name = '01_walk_robot_01', parent = android, loop = true })

	-- 안드로이드가 지정한 위치로 이동
	for i = 1, 11 do

		if not move_sfx then
			move_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
				{ sfx_name = '01_walk_robot_01', parent = android, loop = true })
		end

		local android_waypoint = self.get_android_waypoint(i)
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(android, android_waypoint, 2.7)

		while not screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(android.Position) do
			if move_sfx then
				move_sfx:Stop()
				move_sfx = nil
			end
			wait_for_sec(0.2)
		end
	end

	if move_sfx then
		move_sfx:Stop()
		move_sfx = nil
	end

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(
		android, android.Position + vector(0, 0.51, 0.85), 1)

	-- 안드로이드 쇼케이스 들어간 후 세팅
	character_util.set_direction(android, 'down')
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(android, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	character_util.set_anim(android, { name = 'idle', loop = false })
	character_util.set_active_shadow(android, false)
	character_util.set_active_state(android, 'visible')
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_walk_robot_01', parent = android })

	while not screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(android.Position) do
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local door = get_field_object('android_engineer_door')
	camera_util.move_async(door.Position, 1)

	android.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.engineer_door_name, false))
	wait_for_sec(1)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end



return local_class
