local local_class = newclass('LilithTowerAndroidEngineerSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = LilithTowerAndroidEngineer @
		Comment = LilithTowerAndroidEngineer 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- npc
	self.get_engineer = function() return get_character('android_engineer_engineer') end
	self.get_room_engineer_android = function(index) return get_character('android_engineer_room_android_' .. index) end

	-- 기믹
	self.get_room_android = function(index) return get_field_object('engineer_room_android_' .. index) end

	-- 마커
	self.get_room_engineer_android_pos = function(index) return field:GetMarker('room_android_pos_' .. index).position end

	self.interact_android_index = 2
end

function local_class:enter()
	return true
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_item_get_event()
end

function local_class:start()
	-- 기술자 검은색 틴트
	local engineer = self.get_engineer()
	engineer.SpineController:AddColor('engineer_tint', unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(engineer, 'right')

	if not self.controller.on_exclusive then
		-- …
		engineer.Interactable.Talk = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_1'

		for i = 1, 2 do
			local room_android = self.get_room_engineer_android(i)
			local pos = self.get_room_engineer_android_pos(i)
			room_android.Position = pos
			character_util.add_listener(room_android, self.controller)
		end
	end

	local gimmick_room_android_1 = self.get_room_android(1)
	gimmick_room_android_1.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	local gimmick_room_android_2 = self.get_room_android(2)
	gimmick_room_android_2.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
end

function local_class:exit()
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local room_android = self.get_room_engineer_android(i)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(room_android, self.controller)
	end

	local engineer = self.get_engineer()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(engineer, self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(e)
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local room_android = self.get_room_engineer_android(i)
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, room_android) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_android, self, room_android)
			return true
		end
	end

	local engineer = self.get_engineer()
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, engineer) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_engineer, self, engineer)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 안드로이드에 상호작용
function local_class:interact_android(room_android)
	self.controller.interact_android = true

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local android = self.get_room_engineer_android(i)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(android, self.controller)
	end

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local engineer = self.get_engineer()

	leader:HideWeapon(true)

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(leader,
		0.3 * direction_util.to_vector3(leader.Direction),0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(leader, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
	character_util.shake(room_android, 0.06, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	leader:HideWeapon(false)

	if self.interact_android_index < 6 then
		-- …그, 그렇게 막 만지면 안되는데…
		-- 왼쪽 견갑골 조인트는 손때라도 타면 닦기 힘든데…
		-- …아..아아… 골반 기판을 그렇게 더듬으면…
		-- …..
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(engineer,
			{ key = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_' .. self.interact_android_index, skip = true })

		self.interact_android_index = self.interact_android_index + 1

		for i = 1, 2 do
			local android = self.get_room_engineer_android(i)
			character_util.add_listener(android, self.controller)
		end
	else
		local dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(vector_util.to_side_dir(leader.Position - engineer.Position))

		camera_util.shake(0.08, 99)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		-- 네놈은 네 어머니도 그렇게 더듬냐?!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(engineer,
			{ key = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_6', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

		camera_util.cancel_shake()

		engineer.SpineController:RemoveColor('engineer_tint', 0.5)

		-- 기술자가 밖으로 나옴
		local engineer_waypoint = {
			engineer.Position + vector(dir_vector.x * 2.3, 0, 0),
			engineer.Position + vector(dir_vector.x * 2.3, 0, -0.5)
		}

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(engineer, engineer_waypoint, 5,
			true, nil, nil, 'down', true)

		-- …핫
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(engineer,
			{ key = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_7', skip = true })

		-- 나, 나도 모르게 흥분해서…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(engineer,
			{ key = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_8', skip = true })

		character_util.set_direction(engineer, vector_util.to_direction(dir_vector))
		character_util.set_anim(engineer, { name = 'frustration', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
		-- 아아…벨레누스 님. 지옥으로 보낸다면 부디 부유성 안드로이드들의 폐기장으로 가게 해주세요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(engineer,
			{ key = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_9', skip = true })

		engineer.Interactable.Talk = nil
		character_util.add_listener(engineer, self.controller)
	end
end

--- 안드로이드 기술자와 대화
function local_class:talk_with_engineer(engineer)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(engineer, self.controller)

	local leader = user_party.Leader

	party_util.align_to_target(engineer, engineer.Direction, 1, 'linear')

	-- 뭐, 뭐해…? 끝장을 내지 않고…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(engineer,
		{ key = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_10', skip = true })

	-- 주인공 (attack, release)
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	-- …테러리스트가 아니야?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(engineer,
		{ key = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_11', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(engineer)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	-- 그, 그러고보니 그럴 관상이 아닌 것 같기도 하고…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(engineer,
		{ key = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_12', skip = true })

	-- …
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(engineer,
		{ key = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_13', skip = true })

	-- 오해해서 미안해.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(engineer,
		{ key = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_14', skip = true })

	-- 난 타워의 안드로이드 전시관 기술자야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(engineer,
		{ key = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_15', skip = true })

	-- 일이 터졌을 때, 하다못해 죽을거라면 안드로이드들 사이에서 죽자..라고 생각해서 이곳에 숨어있었지.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(engineer,
		{ key = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_16', skip = true })

	-- 그런데 넌 왜 숨어있지 않고 이렇게 돌아다니고 있는거야?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(engineer,
		{ key = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_17', skip = true })

	-- 주인공 설명하는 포즈 (hold_loop 같은 것으로)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'hold_loop' })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	-- 세이프 하우스..? 보안 시스템 설계자..?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(engineer,
		{ key = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_18', skip = true })

	-- …그런게 있었구나…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(engineer,
		{ key = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_19', skip = true })

	-- 알려줘서 고마워. 바로 그곳으로 가볼게.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(engineer,
		{ key = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_20', skip = true })

	-- 아.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(engineer,
		{ key = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_21', skip = true })

	-- 이걸 받아줄래?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(engineer,
		{ key = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_22', skip = true })

	-- (안드로이드 컨트롤러 던져줌. 주인공 획득 연출)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(engineer, { name = 'throw' })

	local controller_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
		{ pos = engineer.Position, target = leader.Position + 0.3 * direction_util.to_vector3(leader.Direction),
		  itemid = 20448, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true, sprscale = 0.75 })

	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'eat' })
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	controller_item.ConsumeTarget = leader
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	eat_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	screen_util.item_get_event(
		'lilithtower_android_controller',
		'lilithtower_android_controller',
		'lilithtower_android_controller_subtitle',
		'lilithtower_android_controller_desc'
	)

	-- 그게 있으면 타워의 안드로이드들을 조종할 수 있어.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(engineer,
		{ key = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_23', skip = true })

	-- 분명 그 아이들이 도움이 될거야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(engineer,
		{ key = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_24', skip = true })

	-- 주인공 웃는 표정으로 song 포즈
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'sing' })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	-- …쑤, 쑥스럽네…다, 당연한 일을 한 것 뿐인데..
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(engineer,
		{ key = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_25', skip = true })

	-- …다음 안드로이드는 널 모델로…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(engineer,
		{ key = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_26', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'question')

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	-- 아, 아무것도 아니야! 그럼 난 세이프 하우스로 가볼게!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(engineer,
		{ key = 'lilithtower_android_engineer_27', skip = true })

	-- 밖으로 나가는 기술자
	local dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(leader.Direction)
	local engineer_waypoint = {
		engineer.Position + 0.8 * dir_vector,
		engineer.Position + 0.8 * dir_vector + vector(0, 0, -3),
		engineer.Position + 2.3 * dir_vector + vector(0, 0, -3),
		engineer.Position + 2.3 * dir_vector + vector(0, 0, -10)
	}

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(engineer, engineer_waypoint, 7, true,
		nil, nil, nil, true)

	engineer.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

--[[QuestAttribute

]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 현재 섹션의 상태들
	self.section_state = {
		-- 초기 상태
		init = 1,
		-- 베스가 혼나는 이벤트 재생 중.
		schooled_playing = 2,
		-- 베스가 혼나는 이벤트 끝남.
		schooled_finished = 3
	}

	-- 현재 섹션내 상태
	self.cur_state = self.section_state.init

	-- 베스가 혼나는 이벤트 실행 구역
	self.schooled_event_zone_name = 'beth_pre_schooled'

	self.stage_name = 'lilithtower_1_1'
	self.script_key = 'lilith_tower_beth_pre_'
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return false end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	local beth = self.controller.get_beth()
	beth:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, nil)
	beth:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, nil)
	beth.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')
	character_util.set_position(beth, field:GetMarker('beth_init_pos').position)
	character_util.set_direction(beth, 'right')
	character_util.set_active_state(beth, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_emotion(beth, { name = 'drunken' })
	character_util.set_anim(beth, { name = 'idle' })

	local janitor_1 = self.controller.get_janitor_by_idx(1)
	character_util.set_position(janitor_1, field:GetMarker('janitor_1_init_pos').position)
	character_util.set_direction(janitor_1, 'right')
	character_util.set_active_state(janitor_1, 'enabled')

	local janitor_2 = self.controller.get_janitor_by_idx(2)
	character_util.set_position(janitor_2, field:GetMarker('janitor_2_init_pos').position)
	character_util.set_direction(janitor_2, 'right')
	character_util.set_active_state(janitor_2, 'enabled')

	character_util.set_position(manager, field:GetMarker('beth_manager_init_pos').position)

function local_class:start()
	--region 개발용
	--character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, vector(-20.75, 0, 39.5))
	--party_util.reset_controllers()
	--endregion
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

--region 이벤트들
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if (zone_name == self.schooled_event_zone_name) then
		if (self.cur_state == self.section_state.init) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.play_beth_schooled, self))
		end
	end

	return true
end
--endregion

--region 연출 함수들
function local_class:play_beth_schooled()
	self.cur_state = self.section_state.schooled_playing

	yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)

	-- 여직원 : 기가 막혀서.. 이게 대체 몇번째인지 알아요?!
	local manager = get_character('beth_manager')
	character_util.set_emotion(manager, { name = 'mad' })
	--music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_02', loop = false, parent = manager })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(manager, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(manager, self.script_key .. 1)

	-- 미화원 1 : 정말 죄송합니다 선생님. 이 녀석에겐 제가 따끔히 한 마디 해놓겠습니다.

	character_util.remove_anim(janitor_1)

	-- 미화원 2 : 요즘 컨디션이 별로 안 좋은 모양이라..

	--music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_female_shout_01')
	-- 보이스가 존재할 경우 해당 효과음은 생략한다.
	if not CS.Oak.ResourceSelector.Instance:HasScenarioDialogue(music_player.CurrentVoiceBundleCode) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_female_shout_01', loop = false, parent = manager })
	end
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(manager, self.script_key .. 4)

	-- 여직원 : 불평 민원 처리하는게 얼마나 힘든 일인지 알아요?
	character_util.set_anim(manager, { name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(manager, self.script_key .. 5)
	character_util.remove_anim(manager)

	-- 여직원 : 자꾸 이런식이면 업체를 바꿀 수 밖에 없어요.
	character_util.set_emotion(manager, { name = 'attack' })
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(manager, self.script_key .. 6)

	-- 미화원 1 : 아이고… 선생님. 여기 일 끊기면 저희는 길거리에 나앉아야 합니다..!
	--character_util.normal_double_jump(janitor_1, true)
	for _ = 1, 2 do
		character_util.normal_jump(janitor_1, false)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', loop = false, parent = janitor_1 })
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))
	end
	character_util.set_emotion(janitor_1, { name = 'scared' })
	--music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_sadness_01', loop = false, parent = janitor_1 })
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(janitor_1, self.script_key .. 7)

	-- 미화원 2 : 다 저희 불찰입니다. 선생님 고생하시는 것 저희가 다 알지요. 그럼요.

	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(janitor_2, self.script_key .. 8)
	character_util.remove_anim(janitor_2)

	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = janitor_2.Position,

		itemid = 20339,
		sprscale = 0.6,
		lootstate = 'FixLooter',
		skip_text = true
	})
	item.ConsumeTarget = manager
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 미화원 2 : 이걸로 보약 좀 지어드시고… 스트레스에는 몸 보신이 제일입죠..
	character_util.set_emotion(janitor_2, { name = 'smile' })
	--music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gatcha_point_01', loop = false, parent = janitor_2 })
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(janitor_2, self.script_key .. 9)

	-- 여직원 : ….
	character_util.remove_emotion(manager)
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(manager, self.script_key .. 10)

	character_util.remove_emotion(janitor_1)
	character_util.remove_emotion(janitor_2)

	-- 여직원 : ..앞으로 조심 좀 해주세요.
	character_util.set_anim(manager, { name = 'question', loop = false})
	character_util.set_emotion(manager, { name = 'sleep_deep'})
	--music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(manager, self.script_key .. 11)

	-- (여직원 계단 쪽으로 걸어가다가 잠시 멈춰서 베스 쪽 바라보고)
	local manager_waypoint_to_stair = {
		manager.Position + vector(0, 0, 2),
		manager.Position + vector( -1.55, 0, 2)
	}
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(manager, manager_waypoint_to_stair, 2.5, false,
	false, false, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(manager, 'down')

	-- 여직원 : 흥. 별꼴이야 진짜.
	character_util.set_emotion(manager, { name = 'attack' })
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(manager, self.script_key .. 12)
	character_util.remove_emotion(manager)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(manager, 0, 0.5)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(manager, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 미화원 1 : ….겨우 한숨 돌렸구먼
	character_util.set_direction(janitor_1, 'down')
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(janitor_1, self.script_key .. 13)

	-- 미화원 2 : 아니 아가씨! 청소할 때 변기 안쪽까지 구석구석 닦으라고 내가 몇 번 말했어?
	character_util.set_direction(janitor_2, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(janitor_2, { name = 'mad' })
	character_util.set_anim(janitor_2, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(janitor_2, self.script_key .. 14)
	character_util.remove_anim(janitor_2)

	-- 미화원 2 : 그릇 위쪽에 물나오는 부분 제대로 안 닦으면 물곰팡이를 못 막는다고..!
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(janitor_2, self.script_key .. 15)

	character_util.set_direction(janitor_1, 'left')

	-- 베스 : ...
	local beth = self.controller.get_beth()
	--music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', loop = false, parent = beth })
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(beth, self.script_key .. 16)

	-- 베스 : …죄...
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(beth, self.script_key .. 17)

	-- 미화원 2 : 이런 식이면 아가씨 추천한 우리는 뭐가 돼?!
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(janitor_2, { name = 'shoot' }, { name = 'attack'})
	--music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01', loop = false, parent = janitor_2 })
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(janitor_2, self.script_key .. 18)
	character_util.remove_anim(janitor_2)

	-- 미화원 1 : 됐네. 어린애도 아니고 다 알아들었겠지.
	character_util.set_direction(janitor_1, 'down')
	--music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', loop = false, parent = janitor_1 })
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(janitor_1, self.script_key .. 19)
	character_util.remove_emotion(janitor_2)

	-- 베스 : …
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(beth, self.script_key .. 20)

	-- 미화원 1 : 너무 마음에 두지 말고 오늘 하루도 할 수 있는 선에서 최선을 다해줘.
	character_util.set_direction(janitor_1, 'left')
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(janitor_1, self.script_key .. 21)

	-- 미화원 1 : 우리도 먹고 살자고 하는 일이니 이 친구 말이 조금 거친 것도 이해해주고.

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', loop = false, parent = janitor_1 })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(janitor_1, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(janitor_1, self.script_key .. 22)

	-- 베스 : …
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(beth, self.script_key .. 23)

	-- (베스 끄덕끄덕)
	character_util.nod_twice(beth)
	character_util.set_anim(beth, { name = 'idle' })

	-- (베스 양동이 들고 계단 쪽으로 향한다.)
	local beth_waypoint_to_door = {
		beth.Position + vector(0, 0, 2),
		beth.Position + vector( 0.5, 0, 2)
	}

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(beth, beth_waypoint_to_door, 2.5, false,
			false, false, 'up')

	--character_util.move_distance_async(beth, vector(0, 0, 2), nil, 2.5,
	--		true,true)

	--music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', loop = false, parent = janitor_1 })
	character_util.set_direction(janitor_1, 'up')
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(janitor_1, self.script_key .. 24)

	-- (베스 뒤돌아보지 않고 멈춘다.)

	-- 미화원 1 : ...술은 좀 적당히 해.
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(janitor_1, self.script_key .. 25)

	-- 미화원 1 : 그러다 몸 상해..
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(janitor_1, self.script_key .. 26)

	-- (베스 잠시 멈춰있다가 계단으로 사라진다.)\
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(beth, nil, 'silence')
	character_util.move_distance_async(beth, vector(0, 0, 1), nil, 1.25,

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(beth, 0, 0.5)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(beth, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 미화원 2 : ...자넨 너무 무르다니까.
	character_util.set_direction(janitor_1, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(janitor_2, 'up')
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(janitor_2, self.script_key .. 27)

	-- 미화원 1 : 애초에 노숙하는게 딱하다고 일 구해주자고 한건 자네 아닌가?

	--music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01', loop = false, parent = janitor_2 })
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(janitor_2, self.script_key .. 29)

	-- 미화원 1 : 됐네 됐어. 일 끝나고 다 같이 한 잔 하고 풀어.
	self:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(janitor_1, self.script_key .. 30)

	self.cur_state = self.section_state.schooled_finished
end

function local_class:show_speech_bubble_check_zone_async(target, dialogue_key)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(target, {
		key = dialogue_key,
		skip = false,
		dialogue = field:IsInSameCameraGrid(user_party.Leader.Position, target.Position)
	})
end
--endregion

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	-- exclusive event가 켜진 상태라면 일찍 탈출
	if (self.controller.exclusive_on == true) then return end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:debug_loop()
	while not self.game_ended do
		if CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.Q) then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestStartEvent.Create('detected_by_terrorist', true))
		end

		if CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.W) then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestEndEvent.Create('detected_by_terrorist', true))
		end

		if CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.O) then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestStartEvent.Create('detected_by_terrorist', false))
		end

		if CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.P) then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestEndEvent.Create('detected_by_terrorist', false))
		end

		if CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.A) then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestStartEvent.Create(self.controller.beth_quest_key, false))
		end

		if CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.S) then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestEndEvent.Create(self.controller.beth_quest_key, false))
		end

		if CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.U) then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestStartEvent.Create(self.controller.beth_quest_key, true))
		end

		if CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.I) then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestEndEvent.Create(self.controller.beth_quest_key, true))
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	if (e.Key ~= self.controller.beth_quest_key) then
		if (self.cur_state >= self.section_state.init) then
			local beth = self.controller.get_beth()
			character_util.remove_relate_event(beth, self.controller)
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(beth, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			beth.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	if (e.Key ~= self.controller.beth_quest_key) then
		if (self.cur_state >= self.section_state.init) then
			local beth = self.controller.get_beth()
			character_util.add_listener(beth, self.controller)

			-- 프페임 다운의 원인이 되는 log를 피하기 위해 1프레임 쉬고 SetUI를 해준다.
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				coroutine.yield(nil)
				field_ui_manager:SetUI(beth, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			end))
			beth.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if (zone_name == self.restroom_zone) then
		if (self.cur_state == self.section_state.init) and (self.controller.exclusive_on == false) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.play_entered_restroom_event, self)
		elseif (self.cur_state == self.section_state.gave_beth_predator) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.controller.play_beth_fall_down, self.controller)
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local target = e.Target

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.controller.get_beth()) then
		if (self.cur_state == self.section_state.entered_toilet) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.play_talk_with_beth_event, self)
		elseif (self.cur_state == self.section_state.had_talk_with_beth) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.play_interacted_again, self)
		end
	end

	return true
end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(beth, { key = self.script_key .. 45, skip = true })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(beth, { key = self.script_key .. 46, skip = true })

	-- (미화원 있는 쪽 바라보고)
	character_util.set_direction(beth, 'left')

	-- 베스 : 저 오염 종족 꼰대들…
	character_util.set_emotion(beth, { name = 'normal_eye2' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(beth, { key = self.script_key .. 47, skip = true })

	-- 베스 : 내가 없으면 10 분도 버티지 못하고 당할거야.
	character_util.set_anim(beth, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(beth, { key = self.script_key .. 48, skip = true })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- (주인공 쪽 바라본 후)
	character_util.set_direction(beth, 'right')

	-- 베스 : 이곳에서 나간 후라면 언제든지 그 검을 받아주겠어.
	character_util.set_anim(beth, { name = 'idle' })
	--character_util.set_emotion(beth, { name = 'blush' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(beth, { key = self.script_key .. 49, skip = true })

	-- (베스 눈 감고)
	character_util.set_emotion(beth, { name = 'sleep_deep' })

	-- 베스 : ….부탁할게.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(beth, { key = self.script_key .. 50, skip = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(beth, { name = 'drunken' })

	-- (챕터 12 에서 프레데터를 받아놓지 않았다면 여기서 대화 종료.
	-- 다시 말 걸면 “이곳에서 나간 후라면 언제든지 그 검을 받아주겠어” 대사 반복)
	if (self.controller.has_predator == false) then
		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
		return
	end

	-- 선택지ㅊ
	self:play_choose_giving_predator_back_event()
end

function local_class:play_interacted_again()
	self:play_choose_giving_predator_back_event()
end

function local_class:play_choose_giving_predator_back_event()
	local beth = self.controller.get_beth()
	party_util.align_to_target(beth, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	local choose_result = self.controller:play_choose_giving_predator_back_event()

	if (choose_result == 1) then
		self.controller:play_gave_predator_event()
		self.cur_state = self.section_state.gave_beth_predator
	end

function local_class:push_restroom_block(push_target, pusher)
	local dist_vec = vector(-1, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_anim(pusher, { name = 'walk', loop = true})
	character_util.set_anim(pusher, { name = 'push', loop = true, upper = true })

	character_util.move_distance_async(pusher, dist_vec, 1)

	local door = get_field_object('restroom_shakable_door')

	while (self.keep_shake_door == true) do
		door:Shake(0.06, 0.1)
		wait_for_sec(0.25)
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

	}

end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	--

	--	character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, vector(-23, 0, 62))
	--	field_ui_manager:Show()
	--	party_util.reset_controllers()
	--endregion
end

function local_class:debug_loop()
	while not self.game_ended do
		if CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.Q) then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestStartEvent.Create('detected_by_terrorist', false))
		end

		if CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.W) then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestEndEvent.Create('detected_by_terrorist', false))
		end

		if CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.O) then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestStartEvent.Create('detected_by_terrorist', true))
		end

		if CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.P) then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestEndEvent.Create('detected_by_terrorist', true))
		end

		if CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.A) then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestStartEvent.Create(self.controller.beth_quest_key, false))
		end

		if CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.S) then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestEndEvent.Create(self.controller.beth_quest_key, false))
		end

		if CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.U) then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestStartEvent.Create(self.controller.beth_quest_key, true))
		end

		if CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.I) then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestEndEvent.Create(self.controller.beth_quest_key, true))
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	-- exclusive event가 켜진 상태라면 일찍 탈출
	if (self.controller.exclusive_on == true) then return end

	if (event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent)) then
		-- 대화건 상대가 베스가 아니면 탈출
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.get_beth()) then return end

		if (self.controller.has_predator == true) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.play_talked_to_beth_again_event, self)
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.play_when_have_not_predator_event, self)
		end
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	if (e.Key ~= self.controller.beth_quest_key) then
		if (self.cur_state == self.section_state.init) then
			local beth = self.controller.get_beth()
			character_util.remove_relate_event(beth, self.controller)
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(beth, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			beth.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	if (e.Key ~= self.controller.beth_quest_key) then
		if (self.cur_state == self.section_state.init) then
			local beth = self.controller.get_beth()
			character_util.add_listener(beth, self.controller)

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				coroutine.yield(nil)
				field_ui_manager:SetUI(beth, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			end))
			beth.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if (zone_name == self.restroom_zone) and (self.cur_state == self.section_state.gave_beth_predator) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.controller.play_beth_fall_down, self.controller)
	end

	return true
end
function local_class:play_talked_to_beth_again_event()
	self:play_when_have_not_predator_event()

	local choose_result = self.controller:play_choose_giving_predator_back_event()

	if (choose_result == 1) then
		self.controller:play_gave_predator_event()
		self.cur_state = self.section_state.gave_beth_predator
	end
end

function local_class:play_when_have_not_predator_event()
	local beth = self.controller.get_beth()
	party_util.align_to_target(beth, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(beth, { key = 'lilith_tower_beth_s1_49', skip = true })
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

			self.typing_text.Widget:SetAnchor(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, 1, 90, 1, 110);
			self.typing_text.Widget.topAnchor.relative = 0;
			self.typing_text.Widget:UpdateAnchors();
			self.typing_text.Label.fontSize = 32;
		end)
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	local main_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)

	if main_quest_progress ~= nil and main_quest_progress.InnerProgress >= self.need_main_quest_progress then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.announcement, self))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	if self.typing_text then

	end

		self.resource_holder = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent) then
		return self:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if e.QuestId == self.main_quest_id and e.CurrentProgress >= self.need_main_quest_progress then
		self.is_quest_progressed = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.is_quest_progressed then
		return false
	end

	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.announcement_zone_name then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.announcement, self))
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:announcement()
	-- 어딘가의 이벤트에서 연출중이면, 끝날 때 까지 대기
	while lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 타워 스피커로 안내 방송이 나온다. 흔한 공공기관에서 하듯 딩동댕~ 하는 효과음이 나온 후 방송이 나오는데 방송 내용은 하단 자막으로 타아핑 텍스트로 틀어줄 것. 멈춰서는 이벤트.

	-- (딩동댕 효과음과 동시에) 리리스 타워 내 여러분께 안내 방송 드립니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_broadcast_03')
	self:show_subtitle('lilith_tower_cafe_1_1')

	-- 보이스가 존재할 경우 해당 효과음은 생략한다.
	if not CS.Oak.ResourceSelector.Instance:HasScenarioDialogue(music_player.CurrentVoiceBundleCode) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_broadcast_04')
	end
	-- 묘한 착각으로 용사 가디언의 구조 활동을 방해하는 분이 계십니다.
	self:show_subtitle('lilith_tower_cafe_1_2')

	-- 쓸데없는 일에 시간을 낭비하기 보다는 남은 시간을 소중한 사람과 보내는 것은 어떨까요?
	self:show_subtitle('lilith_tower_cafe_1_3')

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:show_subtitle(key)
	local param = CS.TypingTextParam(key)
	param.bubbleWidth = 1000
	param.typeSpeed = 0.05

	if not user_util.has_knight_male() then
		param.overrideKey = key .. '_alt'
	end

	yield_return_func(self.typing_text.SetTypedText, self.typing_text, param)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('LilithTowerChosenOnePostSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = post @
		QuestName = LilithTowerChosenOne @
		Comment = LilithTowerChosenOne 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'lilithtower_1_2'

	-- 스타 피스 이름
	self.star_piece_name = controller.star_piece_name

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.fire_harpy_event_zone_name = 'fire_harpy_star_piece'

	-- 스타피스를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_star_piece = controller.get_star_piece

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_priest = controller.get_priest
	self.get_fire_harpy = controller.get_fire_harpy
	self.get_believer = controller.get_believer

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_fragment = function(num) return get_field_object('chosen_one_dead_fragment_' .. num) end

	-- 마커를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_fragment_marker = function(num) return field:GetMarker('chosen_one_fragment_' .. num) end

	-- Custom Data Key
	self.star_piece_custom_data_key = controller.star_piece_custom_data_key

	--self.is_appear_star_piece = false

	-- 가장 최근에 동작중인 ExclusiveEvent 루틴의 id
	self.current_request_id = 0
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	local priest_1 = self.get_priest(1)
	character_util.add_listener(priest_1, self.controller)

	if self.controller.is_complete_when_start then
		if not self.controller.is_moved_safe_house then
			-- 세이프 하우스로 보내지 못했을 때
			local priest_direction_list = {
				'right', 'left'
			}
			local priest_offset_list = {
				vector(0, 0, 0.5),
				vector(-0.25, 0, 0)
			}
			for i = 1, #priest_direction_list do
				local priest = self.get_priest(i)
				local direction = priest_direction_list[i]
				local offset = priest_offset_list[i]

				priest.Position = priest.Position + offset
				character_util.set_direction(priest, direction)
				character_util.set_emotion(priest, { name = 'hurt' })
				character_util.set_anim(priest, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false })
				priest.SpineController:AddColor(nil, unity_color({ 0.5, 0.7, 0.7, 0.5 }), 1, 0)
				character_util.add_listener(priest, self.controller)
				field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(priest, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			end

			local believer_direction_list = {
				'left', 'right', 'left', 'right'
			}
			local believer_offset_list = {
				vector(-0.5, 0, 1),
				vector(0.25, 0, 0.25),
				vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5),
				vector(0.5, 0, 0)
			}
			for i = 1, #believer_direction_list do
				local believer = self.get_believer(i)
				local direction = believer_direction_list[i]
				local offset = believer_offset_list[i]

				believer.Position = believer.Position + offset

				character_util.set_direction(believer, direction)
				character_util.set_emotion(believer, { name = 'hurt' })
				character_util.set_anim(believer, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false })
				believer.SpineController:AddColor(nil, unity_color({ 0.5, 0.7, 0.7, 0.5 }), 1, 0)
				character_util.add_listener(believer, self.controller)
				field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(believer, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			end

			for i = 1, 3 do
				local fragment = self.get_fragment(i)
				local marker = self.get_fragment_marker(i)

				fragment.Position = marker.position
			end
		else
			-- 세이프 하우스로 보냈을 때
			for i = 1, 2 do
				local priest = self.get_priest(i)
				character_util.set_active_state(priest, 'disabled')
			end
			for i = 1, 4 do
				local believer = self.get_believer(i)
				character_util.set_active_state(believer, 'disabled')
			end
		end
	end

	if self.controller.is_appear_star_piece then
		local fire_harpy = self.get_fire_harpy()
		character_util.set_active_state(fire_harpy, 'disabled')
	else
		local fire_harpy = self.get_fire_harpy()
		character_util.set_direction(fire_harpy, 'left')
		fire_harpy.Position = vector(26.5, 0, 88)
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local priest = self.get_priest(i)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(priest, self.controller)
	end
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local believer = self.get_believer(i)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(believer, self.controller)
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.controller.is_exclusive then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local priest_1 = self.get_priest(1)
	local priest_2 = self.get_priest(2)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, priest_1) then
		if self.controller.is_complete_when_start and not self.controller.is_moved_safe_house then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_priest, self)
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.controller.interact_priest, self.controller)
		end

		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, priest_2) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_priest, self)
		return true
	else
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local believer = self.get_believer(i)
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, believer) then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_priest, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if not self.controller.is_appear_star_piece and e.Zone.Name == self.fire_harpy_event_zone_name then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.appear_star_piece, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.exclusive_start, self, e.Fade))

	return true
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.exclusive_end, self, e.Fade))

	return true
end
--endregion

-- 3섹션에서 막 넘어온 직후

-- NPC들이 남아있는 경우
-- NPC들이 남아있지 않은 경우
-- NPC들이 죽은 경우?

-- 예외 / 신틸라가 남아있거나 남아있지 않은 경우

--region exclusive
function local_class:exclusive_start(is_fade)
	local fire_harpy = self.get_fire_harpy()
	local priest_execute = function(execute_func)
		for i = 1, 2 do
			local priest = self.get_priest(i)
			execute_func(priest)
		end
	end
	local believer_execute = function(execute_func)
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local believer = self.get_believer(i)
			execute_func(believer)
		end
	end

	if not self.controller.is_appear_star_piece then
		fire_harpy.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end
	if not self.controller.is_moved_safe_house then
		priest_execute(function(priest)
			priest.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end)
		believer_execute(function(believer)
			believer.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end)
	end

	-- FIXED : [PS-9920] ExclusiveQuestEvent 타이밍 이슈로 인해 캐릭터가 꺼져있는 이슈 조치
	self.current_request_id = self.current_request_id + 1
	local request_id = self.current_request_id

	if not is_fade then
		if not self.controller.is_appear_star_piece then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fire_harpy, 0, 1)
		end
		if not self.controller.is_moved_safe_house then
			priest_execute(function(priest)
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(priest, 0, 1)
			end)
			believer_execute(function(believer)
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(believer, 0, 1)
			end)
		end
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	-- 현재 요청 id와 다른 경우 루틴 생략
	if request_id ~= self.current_request_id then
		return
	end

	if not self.controller.is_appear_star_piece then
		character_util.set_active_state(fire_harpy, 'disabled')
	end
	if not self.controller.is_moved_safe_house then
		priest_execute(function(priest)
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(priest, 0, 0)
			character_util.set_active_state(priest, 'disabled')
		end)
		believer_execute(function(believer)
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(believer, 0, 0)
			character_util.set_active_state(believer, 'disabled')
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:exclusive_end(is_fade)
	local fire_harpy = self.get_fire_harpy()
	local priest_execute = function(execute_func)
		for i = 1, 2 do
			local priest = self.get_priest(i)
			execute_func(priest)
		end
	end
	local believer_execute = function(execute_func)
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local believer = self.get_believer(i)
			execute_func(believer)
		end
	end

	if not self.controller.is_appear_star_piece then
		fire_harpy.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	end
	if not self.controller.is_moved_safe_house then
		priest_execute(function(priest)
			priest.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
		end)
		believer_execute(function(believer)
			believer.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
		end)
	end

	if not self.controller.is_appear_star_piece then
		character_util.set_active_state(fire_harpy, 'enabled')
	end
	if not self.controller.is_moved_safe_house then
		priest_execute(function(priest)
			character_util.set_active_state(priest, 'enabled')
		end)
		believer_execute(function(believer)
			character_util.set_active_state(believer, 'enabled')
		end)
	end

	-- FIXED : [PS-9920] ExclusiveQuestEvent 타이밍 이슈로 인해 캐릭터가 꺼져있는 이슈 조치
	self.current_request_id = self.current_request_id + 1
	local request_id = self.current_request_id

	if not is_fade then
		if not self.controller.is_appear_star_piece then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fire_harpy, 1, 1)
		end
		if not self.controller.is_moved_safe_house then
			priest_execute(function(priest)
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(priest, 1, 1)
			end)
			believer_execute(function(believer)
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(believer, 1, 1)
			end)
		end
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	-- 현재 요청 id와 다른 경우 루틴 생략
	if request_id ~= self.current_request_id then
		return
	end

	if not self.controller.is_moved_safe_house then
		priest_execute(function(priest)
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(priest, 1, 0)
		end)
		believer_execute(function(believer)
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(believer, 1, 0)
		end)
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:interact_priest()
	-- 그리드 벗어났다가 여기 다시 돌아와보면, 모두 잔해에 깔려 쓰러져있다.
	-- 인터렉트 시 나레이션 박스
	-- 아무 대답이 없다. 그냥 시체인 것 같다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_62' })
end

function local_class:appear_star_piece()
	-- 어느 선택지를 고르던, 다음 그리드로 이동하면 신틸라가 기다리고 있다.
	self.controller.is_appear_star_piece = true

	local fire_harpy = self.get_fire_harpy()

	character_util.set_emotion(fire_harpy, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.normal_jump_async(fire_harpy, true)

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, fire_harpy, vector(24, 0, 88), 7, true, nil, nil, 'left', true),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.align_party, vector(23, 0, 88), 'left', 1, 'arc')
	})

	-- 신틸라: 방금 시험을 통과한 거지?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.look_at(fire_harpy, user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_anim(fire_harpy, { name = 'sing' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fire_harpy, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_63', skip = true })

	-- 플레이어 nod
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party.Leader, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	-- 신틸라: 너… 겉보기엔 평범해보이는데, 갑옷 안엔 엄청난 근육을 가지고 있나보네!
	character_util.set_anim(fire_harpy, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fire_harpy, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_64', skip = true })

	-- 신틸라: 역시… 용사라는 건 대단하구나!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(fire_harpy)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fire_harpy, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_65', skip = true })

	-- 선택지: 용사 후보생이다. / 평범한 기사일 뿐이다. / 좀 더 감탄해도 좋다.
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_65_1', 'mercy' }, { 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_65_2', 'intellect' }, { 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_65_3', 'forced' } })
	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 선택지: 용사 후보생이다.
		-- 신틸라: 너 정도 되는 사람이 후보생이라니…
		character_util.set_emotion(fire_harpy, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.normal_jump(fire_harpy, true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fire_harpy, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_66', skip = true })
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		-- 선택지: 평범한 기사일 뿐이다.
		-- 신틸라: 너 정도 되는 사람이 평범하다니…
		character_util.set_emotion(fire_harpy, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.normal_jump(fire_harpy, true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fire_harpy, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_67', skip = true })
	else
		-- 선택지: 좀 더 감탄해도 좋다.
		-- 신틸라: 응…! 정말 멋져!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		character_util.set_anim(fire_harpy, { name = 'sing' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fire_harpy, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_68', skip = true })
	end

	-- 신틸라: 역시 대단해! 다른 용사교 지부도 찾아봐야겠어.
	character_util.set_emotion(fire_harpy, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(fire_harpy, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fire_harpy, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_69', skip = true })

	-- 신틸라: 이건 용사교 사제가 상심 말라고 줬던 건데, 너 줄게.
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.remove_emotion(fire_harpy)
	character_util.set_anim(fire_harpy, { name = 'eat' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fire_harpy, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_70', skip = true })
	eat_sfx:Stop()

	-- 스타피스 던져준다.
	local star_piece = self.get_star_piece()
	character_util.set_anim(fire_harpy, { name = 'get' })
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, fire_harpy.Position)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 신틸라: 난 아직 근육이 말랑해서, 이런 거 먹으면 근손실 오거든.
	character_util.remove_anim(fire_harpy)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fire_harpy, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_71', skip = true })

	-- 신틸라: 그럼 다음에 또 봐, 숨겨진 근육이 멋진 용사님!
	character_util.set_anim(fire_harpy, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_stage_intro_jump_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fire_harpy, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_72', skip = true })

	-- 신틸라 퇴장한다.
	character_util.remove_anim(fire_harpy)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(fire_harpy, fire_harpy.Position + vector(0, 0, -12), 4, false, nil, nil, 'down')

	character_util.set_active_state(fire_harpy, 'disabled')

	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.star_piece_custom_data_key, 1)
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	local fire_harpy = self.get_fire_harpy()
	local waiter = self.get_waiter()
	local table_marker = self.get_table_marker()

	character_util.set_direction(fire_harpy, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(fire_harpy, { name = 'eat' })

	character_util.set_anim(waiter, { name = 'hold_loop' })

	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')
	local item_id = item_data:GetSpec(self.banquet_item_spec_name).Id
	self.meat_1 = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = table_marker.position, itemid = item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true })
	self.meat_2 = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = waiter.Position + vector(0, 1, 0), itemid = item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true })

	self.meat_1_shadow_sprite = self.meat_1.ShadowTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	self.meat_2_item_sprite = self.meat_2.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	self.meat_2_shadow_sprite = self.meat_2.ShadowTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

		return
	end

		self.meat_1:ConsumeComplete()
		self.meat_1 = nil
	end

	if self.meat_2 then
		self.meat_2:ConsumeComplete()
		self.meat_2 = nil
	end

	self.meat_1_item_sprite = nil
	self.meat_1_shadow_sprite = nil
	self.meat_2_item_sprite = nil
	self.meat_2_shadow_sprite = nil

	if self.eat_sfx then
		self.eat_sfx:Stop()
		self.eat_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.controller.is_exclusive then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if self.current_progress < self.progress.meet_fire_harpy and e.Zone.Name == self.meet_fire_harpy_event_zone_name then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.meet_fire_harpy, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.exclusive_start, self, e.Fade))

	return true
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.exclusive_end, self, e.Fade))

	return true
end

--region exclusive
function local_class:exclusive_start(is_fade)
	local fire_harpy = self.get_fire_harpy()
	local waiter = self.get_waiter()

	fire_harpy.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	waiter.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	-- FIXED : [PS-9920] ExclusiveQuestEvent 타이밍 이슈로 인해 캐릭터가 꺼져있는 이슈 조치
	self.current_request_id = self.current_request_id + 1
	local request_id = self.current_request_id

	if not is_fade then
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fire_harpy, 0, 1)
		if self.current_progress < self.progress.waiter_exit then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(waiter, 0, 1)
		end

		local time_passed = 0
		local duration = 1
		local item_start_color = unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 1 })
		local shadow_start_color = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 0.375 })
		local end_color = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 0 })

		-- 현재 요청 id와 다른 경우 루틴 생략
		while time_passed < duration and request_id == self.current_request_id do
			local progress = time_passed / duration

			self.meat_1_item_sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.Lerp(item_start_color, end_color, progress)
			self.meat_1_shadow_sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.Lerp(shadow_start_color, end_color, progress)
			self.meat_1_item_sprite:Rebuild(true)
			self.meat_1_shadow_sprite:Rebuild(true)

			self.meat_2_item_sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.Lerp(item_start_color, end_color, progress)
			self.meat_2_shadow_sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.Lerp(shadow_start_color, end_color, progress)
			self.meat_2_item_sprite:Rebuild(true)
			self.meat_2_shadow_sprite:Rebuild(true)

			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end
	end

	-- 현재 요청 id와 다른 경우 루틴 생략
	if request_id ~= self.current_request_id then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_active_state(fire_harpy, 'disabled')
	if self.current_progress < self.progress.waiter_exit then
		character_util.set_active_state(waiter, 'disabled')
	end

	if self.meat_1 then
		self.meat_1_item_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 0 })
		self.meat_1_item_sprite:Rebuild(true)
		self.meat_1_shadow_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 0 })
		self.meat_1_shadow_sprite:Rebuild(true)
	end
	if self.meat_2 then
		self.meat_2_item_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 0 })
		self.meat_2_item_sprite:Rebuild(true)
		self.meat_2_shadow_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 0 })
		self.meat_2_shadow_sprite:Rebuild(true)
	end
end

function local_class:exclusive_end(is_fade)
	local fire_harpy = self.get_fire_harpy()
	local waiter = self.get_waiter()

	fire_harpy.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	waiter.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

	character_util.set_active_state(fire_harpy, 'enabled')
	if self.current_progress < self.progress.waiter_exit then
		character_util.set_active_state(waiter, 'enabled')
	end

	-- FIXED : [PS-9920] ExclusiveQuestEvent 타이밍 이슈로 인해 캐릭터가 꺼져있는 이슈 조치
	self.current_request_id = self.current_request_id + 1
	local request_id = self.current_request_id

	if not is_fade then
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fire_harpy, 1, 1)
		if self.current_progress < self.progress.waiter_exit then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(waiter, 1, 1)
		end

		local time_passed = 0
		local duration = 1
		local item_end_color = unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 1 })
		local shadow_end_color = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 0.375 })
		local start_color = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 0 })

		-- 현재 요청 id와 다른 경우 루틴 생략
		while time_passed < duration and request_id == self.current_request_id do
			local progress = time_passed / duration

			self.meat_1_item_sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.Lerp(start_color, item_end_color, progress)
			self.meat_1_shadow_sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.Lerp(start_color, shadow_end_color, progress)
			self.meat_1_item_sprite:Rebuild(true)
			self.meat_1_shadow_sprite:Rebuild(true)

			self.meat_2_item_sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.Lerp(start_color, item_end_color, progress)
			self.meat_2_shadow_sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.Lerp(start_color, shadow_end_color, progress)
			self.meat_2_item_sprite:Rebuild(true)
			self.meat_2_shadow_sprite:Rebuild(true)

			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end
	end

	-- 현재 요청 id와 다른 경우 루틴 생략
	if request_id ~= self.current_request_id then
		return
	end

	if self.meat_1 then
		self.meat_1_item_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 1 })
		self.meat_1_item_sprite:Rebuild(true)
		self.meat_1_shadow_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 0.375 })

		self.meat_2_item_sprite:Rebuild(true)
		self.meat_2_shadow_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 0.375 })
		self.meat_2_shadow_sprite:Rebuild(true)
	end
end

function local_class:meet_fire_harpy()
	self.current_progress = self.progress.meet_fire_harpy

	local fire_harpy = self.get_fire_harpy()
	local waiter = self.get_waiter()
	local table_marker = self.get_table_marker()
	local waiting_for_exclusive_end = function()
		local is_wait = false

		while self.controller.is_exclusive do
			if not is_wait then
				is_wait = true
				if self.eat_sfx then
					self.eat_sfx:Stop()
				end
			end

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		if is_wait then
			if self.eat_sfx then
				self.eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_eat_01', loop = true, parent = fire_harpy, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc' })
			end
		end
	end

	-- 신틸라 최초 조우(1층)
	-- 신틸라가 식당에 앉아 고기를 먹고 있다.(멈추지 않는 이벤트)
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 3
	local item_sprite_transform = self.meat_1.SpriteTransform
	self.eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_eat_01', loop = true, parent = fire_harpy, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc' })

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		item_sprite_transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (1 - progress)

		coroutine.yield()
		waiting_for_exclusive_end()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.eat_sfx:Stop()
	self.eat_sfx = nil
	item_sprite_transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
	self.meat_1:ConsumeComplete()
	self.meat_1 = nil

	character_util.set_anim(fire_harpy, { name = 'seat' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	waiting_for_exclusive_end()

	-- 신틸라가 고기를 다 먹자, 직원이 신틸라 앞에 고기를 내려놓는다.
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local start_position = self.meat_2.Position
		local end_position = table_marker.position

		local time_passed = 0
		local duration = 0.5

		while time_passed < duration do
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			self.meat_2.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress)

			coroutine.yield()
			waiting_for_exclusive_end()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		self.meat_2.Position = end_position
	end))
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_throw_01', parent = waiter, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(waiter, { name = 'throw' })
	waiting_for_exclusive_end()

	-- 직원: 여기 주문하신 고기 나왔습니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(waiter, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_1' })
	waiting_for_exclusive_end()

	-- 신틸라: 고마워! 덕분에 근손실 피하겠어.
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_positive_01', parent = fire_harpy, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.set_emotion(fire_harpy, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fire_harpy, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_2' })
	waiting_for_exclusive_end()

	-- 신틸라: 그런데 여기 스포츠용품점은 어디로 가야해?
	character_util.set_anim(fire_harpy, { name = 'release', upper = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fire_harpy, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_3' })
	waiting_for_exclusive_end()

	-- 직원: 아, 2층으로 가시면 됩니다.
	character_util.remove_anim(fire_harpy, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(waiter, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_4' })
	waiting_for_exclusive_end()

	-- 신틸라: 고마워! 상완근이 멋진 친구!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', parent = fire_harpy, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.normal_jump(fire_harpy)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fire_harpy, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_5' })
	waiting_for_exclusive_end()

	-- 직원: 네, 좋은 하루 되세요.
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(waiter, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(waiter, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_6' })
	waiting_for_exclusive_end()

	-- 직원, 퇴장한다.
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		waiter.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(waiter, waiter.Position + vector(-12.5, 0, 0), 4, false, nil, nil, 'left')
		waiting_for_exclusive_end()

		self.current_progress = self.progress.waiter_exit
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(waiter, 0, 0.25)
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(waiter, waiter.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 4, false, nil, nil, 'left')
		waiting_for_exclusive_end()

		waiter.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
		character_util.set_active_state(waiter, 'disabled')
	end))

	-- 신틸라 마저 고기 먹더니 자리에서 일어나서 왼쪽으로 퇴장한다.
	character_util.set_direction(fire_harpy, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(fire_harpy, { name = 'eat' })

	time_passed = 0
	duration = 3
	item_sprite_transform = self.meat_2.SpriteTransform
	self.eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_eat_01', loop = true, parent = fire_harpy, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc' })

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		item_sprite_transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (1 - progress)

		coroutine.yield()
		waiting_for_exclusive_end()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.eat_sfx:Stop()
	self.eat_sfx = nil
	item_sprite_transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
	self.meat_2:ConsumeComplete()
	self.meat_2 = nil

	character_util.remove_emotion(fire_harpy)
	character_util.set_anim(fire_harpy, { name = 'seat' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	waiting_for_exclusive_end()

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_jump_01', parent = fire_harpy, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.remove_anim(fire_harpy)
	character_util.mario_jump_new(fire_harpy, 'right', 0.3, 0.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(fire_harpy, fire_harpy.Position + vector(0, -0.5, -1), 0.3, nil)
	waiting_for_exclusive_end()

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_land_01', parent = fire_harpy, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	waiting_for_exclusive_end()

	fire_harpy.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(fire_harpy, fire_harpy.Position + vector(-11.5, 0, 0), 4, false, nil, nil, 'left')
	waiting_for_exclusive_end()

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fire_harpy, 0, 0.25)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(fire_harpy, fire_harpy.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 4, false, nil, nil, 'left')
	waiting_for_exclusive_end()

	fire_harpy.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	character_util.set_active_state(fire_harpy, 'disabled')

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

return local_class
