		character_util.set_anim(fire_harpy, { name = 'unique/dumbbell_curl' })
		fire_harpy.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)
	else
		character_util.set_anim(fire_harpy, { name = 'release' })
	end
	fire_harpy.Interactable.Talk = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_11'

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

	local priest_1 = self.get_priest(1)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(priest_1, self.controller)

	local fire_harpy = self.get_fire_harpy()
	fire_harpy.Interactable.Talk = ''

	self:stop_do_you_believe()

	if self.crowd_sfx then
		self.crowd_sfx:Stop()
		self.crowd_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.controller.is_exclusive then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.priest_event_zone_name then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.do_you_believe, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.priest_event_zone_name then
				self:stop_do_you_believe()
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local priest_1 = self.get_priest(1)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, priest_1) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_priest, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.exclusive_start, self, e.Fade))

	return true
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.exclusive_end, self, e.Fade))

	return true
end
--endregion

--region exclusive
function local_class:exclusive_start(is_fade)
	local fire_harpy = self.get_fire_harpy()
	local priest_execute = function(execute_func)
		for i = 1, 2 do
			local priest = self.get_priest(i)
			execute_func(priest)
		end
	end
	local believer_execute = function(execute_func)
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local believer = self.get_believer(i)
			execute_func(believer)
		end
	end

	self:stop_do_you_believe()

	fire_harpy.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	priest_execute(function(priest)
		priest.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end)
	believer_execute(function(believer)
		believer.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end)

	-- FIXED : [PS-9920] ExclusiveQuestEvent 타이밍 이슈로 인해 캐릭터가 꺼져있는 이슈 조치
	self.current_request_id = self.current_request_id + 1
	local request_id = self.current_request_id

	if not is_fade then
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fire_harpy, 0, 1)
		priest_execute(function(priest)
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(priest, 0, 1)
		end)
		believer_execute(function(believer)
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(believer, 0, 1)
		end)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	-- 현재 요청 id와 다른 경우 루틴 생략
	if request_id ~= self.current_request_id then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_active_state(fire_harpy, 'disabled')
	priest_execute(function(priest)
		character_util.set_active_state(priest, 'disabled')
	end)
	believer_execute(function(believer)
		character_util.set_active_state(believer, 'disabled')
	end)
end

function local_class:exclusive_end(is_fade)
	local fire_harpy = self.get_fire_harpy()
	local priest_execute = function(execute_func)
		for i = 1, 2 do
			local priest = self.get_priest(i)
			execute_func(priest)
		end
	end
	local believer_execute = function(execute_func)
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local believer = self.get_believer(i)
			execute_func(believer)
		end
	end

	fire_harpy.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	priest_execute(function(priest)
		priest.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	end)
	believer_execute(function(believer)
		believer.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	end)

	character_util.set_active_state(fire_harpy, 'enabled')
	priest_execute(function(priest)
		character_util.set_active_state(priest, 'enabled')
	end)
	believer_execute(function(believer)
		character_util.set_active_state(believer, 'enabled')
	end)

	-- FIXED : [PS-9920] ExclusiveQuestEvent 타이밍 이슈로 인해 캐릭터가 꺼져있는 이슈 조치
	-- 이 루틴에서 굳이 request_id를 들고있을 필요가 없어 생략한다.
	self.current_request_id = self.current_request_id + 1

	if not is_fade then
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fire_harpy, 1, 1)
		priest_execute(function(priest)
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(priest, 1, 1)
		end)
		believer_execute(function(believer)
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(believer, 1, 1)
		end)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end
end
--endregion

-- 방 한켠에 용사교도들 2명과 사람들 4명이 모여있다.
function local_class:do_you_believe()
	-- 플레이어가 용사교 사제1에게 말 걸기 전까지 반복 이벤트 진행

	local priest_1 = self.get_priest(1)
	local priest_2 = self.get_priest(2)
	local believer_1 = self.get_believer(1)
	local believer_2 = self.get_believer(2)
	local believer_3 = self.get_believer(3)
	local believer_4 = self.get_believer(4)
	local believer_list = {
		believer_1,
		believer_2,
		believer_3,
		believer_4
	}

	local waiting_for_interact = function()
		while lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end
	local waiting_for_exclusive_end = function()
		local is_wait = false

		while self.controller.is_exclusive do
			if not is_wait then
				is_wait = true
				if self.crowd_sfx then
					self.crowd_sfx:Stop()
				end
			end

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		if is_wait then
			if self.crowd_sfx then
				self.crowd_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_02', loop = true, play_pos = priest_1.Position, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc' })
			end
		end
	end

	self.is_play_priest_event = true
	if self.crowd_sfx then
		self.crowd_sfx:Stop()
	end
	self.crowd_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_02', loop = true, play_pos = priest_1.Position, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc' })

	self.priest_event_req_id = self.priest_event_req_id + 1
	local req_id = self.priest_event_req_id
	while req_id == self.priest_event_req_id and self.is_play_priest_event do
		-- 용사교 사제1: 용사님이 오실 것을 믿습니까?
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_ready_01', parent = priest_1, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		character_util.set_emotion(priest_1, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_anim(priest_1, { name = 'hold_loop' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_1, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_7' })
		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		waiting_for_interact()
		waiting_for_exclusive_end()
		if req_id ~= self.priest_event_req_id or not self.is_play_priest_event then
			break
		end

		-- 일동(shout): 믿습니다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_shout_07', parent = believer_2, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		character_util.set_group_anim(believer_list, { name = 'cast2' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(believer_2, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_8', bubble_type = 'shout' })
		character_util.remove_group_anim(believer_list)
		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		waiting_for_interact()
		waiting_for_exclusive_end()
		if req_id ~= self.priest_event_req_id or not self.is_play_priest_event then
			break
		end

		-- 용사교 사제2: 그분이 오실 때까지 모두 기도하세요!
		character_util.set_anim(priest_2, { name = 'cast' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_2, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_9' })
		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		waiting_for_interact()
		waiting_for_exclusive_end()
		if req_id ~= self.priest_event_req_id or not self.is_play_priest_event then
			break
		end

		-- 일동(shout): 용사님 만세!
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_shout_07', parent = believer_3, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		character_util.set_group_anim(believer_list, { name = 'cast2' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(believer_3, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_10', bubble_type = 'shout' })
		character_util.remove_group_anim(believer_list)
		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		waiting_for_interact()
		waiting_for_exclusive_end()
		if req_id ~= self.priest_event_req_id or not self.is_play_priest_event then
			break
		end

		wait_for_sec(3)

		waiting_for_interact()
		waiting_for_exclusive_end()
		if req_id ~= self.priest_event_req_id or not self.is_play_priest_event then
			break
		end
	end

	if req_id == self.priest_event_req_id and self.crowd_sfx then
		self.crowd_sfx:FadeOut()
		self.crowd_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:stop_do_you_believe()
	self.is_play_priest_event = false
end

function local_class:interact_priest()
	local priest_1 = self.get_priest(1)
	local priest_2 = self.get_priest(2)
	local believer_2 = self.get_believer(2)
	local believer_3 = self.get_believer(3)

	-- 용사교 사제1에게 말걸면 이벤트 진행 가능
	party_util.align_to_target(priest_1, 'left', 1, 'arc')

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(priest_1)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(priest_2)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(believer_2)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(believer_3)

	-- 용사교 사제1: 용사님, 만세!
	self.crowd_sfx:FadeOut(2)
	self.crowd_sfx = nil
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(priest_1, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(priest_1, { name = 'hold_loop' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_1, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_16', skip = true })

	-- 용사교 사제1: 무슨 일이신가요? 헤실한 기사님.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.look_at(priest_2, user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(priest_2)
	character_util.look_at(priest_1, user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(priest_1)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_1, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_17', skip = true })

	-- 플레이어 선택지 : 대피소로 피난을 권고한다. / 내가 바로 용사다. / 아무 일도 아니다.
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_17_1', 'mercy' }, { 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_17_2', 'forced' }, { 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_17_3', 'intellect' } })
	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 대피소로 피난을 권고한다.
		-- 용사교 사제1: 저희는 교주님의 예언에 따라 이곳에 파견을 왔습니다.
		character_util.set_anim(priest_2, { name = 'cast' })
		character_util.set_anim(priest_1, { name = 'cast' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_1, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_18', skip = true })

		-- 용사교 사제1: 그분께선 이곳에 검은 역병이 돌지만, 용사님께서 나타나 모두를 구원한다 하셨습니다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(priest_1, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_anim(priest_1, { name = 'hold_loop' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_1, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_19', skip = true })

		-- 용사교 사제2: 검은 역병을 뿌리는 테러리스트들이 나타난 것처럼…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_2, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_20', skip = true })

		-- 용사교 사제2: 예언대로 용사님도 이곳에 나타나실 겁니다.
		character_util.set_anim(priest_2, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_2, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_21', skip = true })

		-- 용사교 사제1: 그때까지 저흰 이곳을 떠날 수 없습니다.
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(priest_2)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(priest_1)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_1, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_22', skip = true })

		-- 용사교 사제2: 아니면 당신도 저희와 용사님을 기다리시겠습니까?
		character_util.set_emotion(priest_2, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_anim(priest_2, { name = 'handgun_idle' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_2, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_23', skip = true })

		-- 선택지 : 사양한다. / 내가 바로 용사다.
		choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_23_1', 'mercy' }, { 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_17_2', 'forced' } })
		if choose_result == 1 then
			-- 선택지: 사양한다.
			-- 용사교 사제1: 믿음을 강요할 순 없죠.
			character_util.remove_anim(priest_1)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_1, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_24', skip = true })

			-- 용사교 사제2: 하지만 용사교에 관심이 생기시면 언제든 말씀 주세요.
			character_util.remove_emotion(priest_2)
			character_util.set_anim(priest_2, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_2, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_25', skip = true })

			-- 이벤트 해제(말 걸면 처음부터)
			character_util.set_direction(priest_1, 'down')
			character_util.set_direction(priest_2, 'down')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(priest_1)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(priest_2)

			self.crowd_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_02', loop = true, play_pos = priest_1.Position, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc' })
			return
		else
			-- 선택지: 내가 바로 용사다.
			-- 이벤트 진행
		end
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		-- 선택지: 내가 바로 용사다.
		-- 이벤트 진행
	else
		-- 아무 일도 아니다.
		-- 용사교 사제1: 용사교에 관심이 생기시면 언제든 말씀 주세요.
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(priest_2)
		character_util.set_anim(priest_1, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_1, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_26', skip = true })

		character_util.set_direction(priest_1, 'down')
		character_util.set_direction(priest_2, 'down')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(priest_1)

		self.crowd_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_02', loop = true, play_pos = priest_1.Position, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc' })
		return
	end

	-- 내가 바로 용사다. 선택
	-- 용사교 사제1: 세상에, 용사셨군요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_05')
	character_util.set_emotion(priest_2, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.remove_anim(priest_2)
	character_util.normal_jump(priest_2)
	character_util.set_emotion(priest_1, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.remove_anim(priest_1)
	character_util.normal_jump(priest_1)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_1, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_27', skip = true })

	-- 용사교 사제1: 역시 그 헤실한 얼굴…! 예언에 나온 그대로네요!
	character_util.set_anim(priest_1, { name = 'handgun_idle' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_1, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_28', skip = true })

	-- 용사교 사제2: 하지만 자매님, 베로니카님께서 그분을 사칭하는 사람들이 있을 거라고 말씀하셨어요.
	character_util.remove_emotion(priest_2)
	character_util.set_anim(priest_2, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_2, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_29', skip = true })

	-- 용사교 사제1: 그랬었죠….아무리 예언대로라도 절차는 절차.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(priest_2)
	character_util.set_direction(priest_1, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(priest_1, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(priest_1, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_1, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_30', skip = true })

	-- 용사교 사제2: {플레이어}님께서 용사라는 것을 증명하려면, 저희의 시험을 통과하셔야 합니다.
	character_util.set_anim(priest_2, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_2, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_31', skip = true })

	-- 용사교 사제1: 준비되시면 제게 말씀해주세요.

	-- 용사교 사제1: 아무래도 저긴 실패인가 보군요.
	party_util.look_at(priest_1)
	character_util.look_at(priest_1, user_party.Leader)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_1, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_51', skip = true })

	-- 용사교 사제1: 역시 예언 속 용사는 {0}님이었나봐요.
	character_util.set_anim(priest_1, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_1, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_52', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(priest_1)

	local complete = false
	local display_items = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.IItem)

	local common_rewards = self.quest_spec.CommonRewards
	for i = 0, common_rewards.Count - 1 do
		local quest_reward = common_rewards[i]
		local item_place_holder = quest_reward.Item

		if item_place_holder ~= nil then
			local item = nil

			if CS.Oak.ItemSpecId.IsAsset(item_place_holder.ItemId) then
				item = CS.Oak.Item.Create(CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(item_place_holder.ItemId), nil, nil, nil, item_place_holder.Amount)
			else
				item = CS.Oak.Item.Create(CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(item_place_holder.ItemId), nil, nil, item_place_holder.Level, item_place_holder.Amount)
			end

			display_items:Add(item)
		end
	end

	stage.FieldUIQuestComplete:PlayQuestComplete(self.quest_progress, function()
		complete = true
	end, display_items)

	while not complete do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 사제1: 여기 시험을 통과했다는 증명입니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_1, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_52_1', skip = true })

	-- 사제1: 부디 이걸 가지고 저희 용사교 지부를 찾아주세요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest_1, { key = 'lilith_tower_chosen_one_52_2', skip = true })

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(priest_1, { name = 'throw' })
	wait_for_sec(0.125)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_02')
	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')
	local item_id = item_data:GetSpec(self.hero_cerification_item_spec_name).Id
	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = priest_1.Position, target = user_party.Leader.Position, itemid = item_id, notforinven = true, skip_text = true })
	item.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- Quest Clear
	-- 퀘스트 보상: 카드, 용사 후보생 8급 자격증
	-- item id: 미정
	-- get item event
	-- 용사 후보생 8급 자격증
	-- 위 사람이 적합한 용사 후보 자격이 있음을 증명합니다.
	-- 더 낮은 지위의 용사교 인원들을 통제할 수 있습니다.
	screen_util.item_get_event(self.hero_cerification_item_spec_name, 'chosen_one_grade_8_license_title', 'chosen_one_grade_8_license_subtitle', 'chosen_one_grade_8_license_desc')

	yield_return_func(self.controller.interact_priest, self.controller, false)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false)
end

return local_class

		none = 1,
		talk = 2,
		safe_house = 3,
	}

	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.none
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.stage_name = stage.Name
	if self.stage_name == self.stage3_name then
		quest_util.load_pool_resource('fx_windowbreak')
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	if self.stage_name ~= self.stage2_name and self.stage_name ~= self.stage3_name then return end -- 방어 코드

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	if self.stage_name == self.stage3_name then
		self:stage3_setting()
	end
end


function local_class:stage3_setting()
	local terrorist_1 = self.get_terrorist(1)
	local terrorist_2 = self.get_terrorist(2)
	local terrorist_3 = self.get_terrorist(3)

	local pos_1 = self.get_terrorist_marker(1).position
	local pos_2 = self.get_terrorist_marker(2).position

	character_util.set_position(terrorist_1, pos_1)
	character_util.set_position(terrorist_2, pos_2)

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(terrorist_1, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(terrorist_2, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(terrorist_3, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	terrorist_3.SpineController:AddColor(terrorist_3.Name, unity_color({0.4,0.4,0.4, 1}), 1, 0)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(terrorist_3,
			{ name = 'dead', loop = false }, { name = 'damaged' })
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.stage_name ~= self.stage2_name and self.stage_name ~= self.stage3_name then return end -- 방어 코드
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.stage_name ~= self.stage2_name and self.stage_name ~= self.stage3_name then return end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.stage_name ~= self.stage2_name and self.stage_name ~= self.stage3_name then return false end -- 방어 코드
	if not self.controller.active_quest then return false end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if not self.controller.active_quest then return false end

	if self.stage_name == self.stage2_name then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_wife()) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.controller.interact_wife, self.controller)
			return true
		end
	elseif self.stage_name == self.stage3_name then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_maclaine()) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.controller.interact_maclaine, self.controller)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.controller.active_quest then return false end
	if self.stage_name == self.stage3_name then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.terrorist_zone_name) then
			if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
				self.current_progress = self.event_progress.talk
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.controller.meet_maclaine, self.controller)
				return true
			end
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'diehard_fade_zone') and
			not self.controller.show_diehard then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				local terrorist_1 = self.get_terrorist(1)
				local terrorist_2 = self.get_terrorist(2)
				local terrorist_3 = self.get_terrorist(3)
				character_util.set_active_state(terrorist_1, 'enabled')
				character_util.set_active_state(terrorist_2, 'enabled')
				character_util.set_active_state(terrorist_3, 'enabled')
				coroutine.yield()
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(terrorist_1, 1, 0.2)
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(terrorist_2, 1, 0.2)
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(terrorist_3, 1, 0.2)
			end))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.stage_name = nil
end

return local_class

		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if not self.controller.active_quest then return false end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_maclaine()) or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_wife()) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.clear_talk, self)
			return true
		end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:clear_talk()
	local wife = self.get_wife()
	local maclaine = self.get_maclaine()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	party_util.align_to_target(maclaine, 'left', 1, 'linear')
	-- 아내 : 션… 무사해서 다행이야…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_female_cry_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(wife, { key = 'lilithtower_diehard_22', skip = true })

	-- 션 맥클레인 : 졸리, 귀여운 우리 아내… 정말 보고 싶었어…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(maclaine, { key = 'lilithtower_diehard_23', skip = true })

	-- 포옹을 푸는 션 맥클레인과 아내
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(maclaine)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(wife)
	-- 두 캐릭터 다 애니메이션 / 이모션 리셋

	character_util.move_to(maclaine, maclaine.Position - vector(0.2,0,0),
			0.5, nil, false, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(wife, wife.Position + vector(0.2,0,0),
			0.5, nil, false, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 션 맥클레인, 아내 플레이어 쪽 바라봄.
	character_util.look_at(maclaine, leader)
	character_util.look_at(wife, leader)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(maclaine, nil, 'notice')

	-- 션 맥클레인 (smile, idle) : …자네 다시 무사히 돌아왔군.
	character_util.set_emotion(maclaine, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(maclaine, { key = 'lilithtower_diehard_24', skip = true })

	-- 션 맥클레인 (smile, release 2회) : 여긴 내 사랑스러운 아내 졸리네. 정말 귀엽지?
	character_util.look_at(maclaine, wife)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(maclaine, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(maclaine, { key = 'lilithtower_diehard_25', skip = true })
	character_util.look_at(maclaine, leader)

	-- 정말 감사해요. 덕분에 무사히 남편과 다시 만날 수 있었어요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_anim(wife, { name = 'sing' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(wife,
			{ key = 'lilithtower_diehard_26', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(wife)

	-- 션 맥클레인 (smile, idle) : 이건 내 작은 보답이네.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(maclaine,
			{ key = 'lilithtower_diehard_27', skip = true })

	-- 션 맥클레인, 스타피스 증정.
	character_util.set_anim(maclaine, { name = 'get', loop = false })

	star_piece_util.appear(get_field_object('diehard_starpiece'), maclaine.Position)
	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(maclaine)
	-- 꼭 이곳에서 무사히 탈출하자고.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(maclaine,
			{ key = 'lilithtower_diehard_30', skip = true })
	-- 이후 션 맥클레인, 아내 마주 봄.
	character_util.look_at(maclaine, wife)
	character_util.look_at(wife, maclaine)

	-- 이벤트 종료
	character_util.set_emotion(maclaine, { name = 'idle' })
	character_util.set_emotion(wife, { name = 'tired' })

				and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.none then

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

		end
	end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

			self.safe_house_people_count = self.safe_house_people_count + #info.members

	end

local local_class = newclass('LilithTowerFishyYouthSection2')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_youth = function() return get_character('fishy_youth') end

	self.get_star_piece = function() return get_field_object('fishy_youth_star_piece') end

	self.event_state = {
		none = 0,
		looking_around = 1,
		talking = 2,
	}
	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.none

	self.on_routine = false
	self.room_grid_name = 'refuge_sequence'

	self.tint_key = 'fishy_youth'

	self.equipping_loop_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	local youth = self.get_youth()

	youth.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(youth)
	youth.Position = field:GetMarker('fishy_youth_wonder_1').position
	character_util.set_direction(youth, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(youth, {name = 'tired'})

	character_util.add_listener(youth, self.controller)
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.talking

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_youth(), self.controller)

	if self.equipping_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.equipping_loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.equipping_loop_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent)) then
		if self.current_event_state ~= self.event_state.talking then
			self.current_event_state = self.event_state.talking
			self:stop_youth_routine()
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_youth, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.room_grid_name)
			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.none then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.looking_around
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.youth_routine, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.room_grid_name) then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.none
		self:stop_youth_routine()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:youth_routine()
	self.on_routine = true

	local youth = self.get_youth()
	local get_wp = function(behave_index, wp_index)
		return field:GetMarker('fishy_youth_wonder_' .. behave_index .. '_' .. wp_index).position
	end
	local behave_infos = {
		{
			state = 'search',
			move_wps = {
				get_wp(2, 1),
				get_wp(2, 2),
			},
			last_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Left,
		},
		{
			state = 'wondering',
			move_wps = {
				get_wp(3, 1),
				get_wp(3, 2),
			},
			last_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Left,
		},
		{
			state = 'search',
			move_wps = {
				get_wp(4, 1),
			},
			last_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Left,
		},
		{
			state = 'wondering',
			move_wps = {
				get_wp(5, 1),
				get_wp(5, 2),
			},
			last_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Right,
		},
		{
			state = 'search',
			move_wps = {
				get_wp(1, 1),
			},
			last_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Left,
		},
	}
	local wp_index = 1

	youth.Position = behave_infos[#behave_infos].move_wps[1]

	while self.current_event_state == self.event_state.looking_around do
		local cur_info = behave_infos[wp_index]
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(youth, cur_info.move_wps,
				3, false, 'stop')

		if self.current_event_state ~= self.event_state.looking_around then
			break
		end

		youth.Direction = cur_info.last_dir

		if cur_info.state == 'search' then
			self:stop_equipping_sfx()
			self.equipping_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
					{sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', parent = youth, loop = true,
					 type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc'})

			character_util.set_anim(youth, {name = 'eat'})

			wait_for_sec(2)

			if self.current_event_state ~= self.event_state.looking_around then
				break
			end

			self:stop_equipping_sfx()
			character_util.remove_anim(youth)

			wait_for_sec(1)
		else
			music_player_util.play_sfx(
					{sfx_name = '01_swing_01', parent = youth,
					 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})

			wait_for_sec(1.5)

			if self.current_event_state ~= self.event_state.looking_around then
				break
			end

			youth.Direction = direction_util.get_opposite(cur_info.last_dir)

			music_player_util.play_sfx(
					{sfx_name = '01_swing_01', parent = youth,
					 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})

			wait_for_sec(1.5)
		end

		wp_index = wp_index % #behave_infos + 1
	end

	self.on_routine = false
end

function local_class:stop_youth_routine()
	character_util.stop(self.get_youth())
	character_util.remove_anim(self.get_youth())
	self:stop_equipping_sfx()
end

function local_class:stop_equipping_sfx()
	if self.equipping_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.equipping_loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.equipping_loop_sfx = nil
	end
end

end

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어 코드

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어 코드
end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	local grandmother = self.get_grandmother()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(grandmother, self.controller)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return false end -- 방어 코드
	if not self.controller.active_quest then return false end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if not self.controller.active_quest then return false end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_grandmother()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_grandmother, self)
		return true
	end
	return false

local local_class = newclass('LilithTowerLifeIsBeautifulSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = LilithTowerLifeIsBeautiful @
		Comment = 환풍구 씬에서 납치 당하는 누나까지 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 환풍구 존
	self.vent_zone = 'life_is_beautiful_vent_zone'

	self.above_vent_zone = 'life_is_beautiful_vent_above_zone'

	-- 창살 얻기
	self.get_lattice = function()
		return get_field_object('life_is_beautiful_lattice')
	end

	-- 퀘스트 진행도
	self.progress = {
		none = 1,
		siblings_talk = 2,
		sacrifice = 3
	}
	self.cur_progress = self.progress.none

	-- 환퐁구 대사 존에 있는지
	self.is_passing_vent = false

	-- 환풍구 대사가 나오고 있는지
	self.playing_vent_dialogue = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_two_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:on_pre_load()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_two_name or not self.controller.can_play_event then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.vent_zone) and
			self.cur_progress ~= self.progress.sacrifice and not self.is_passing_vent then
		self.is_passing_vent = true
		if not self.playing_vent_dialogue then
			-- 환풍구 지나갈 때 남매 대화 보여주는 연출 진행
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.passing_vent_area, self))
		end
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.above_vent_zone) and
			self.cur_progress == self.progress.siblings_talk then
		-- 누나가 동생을 위해 희생하는 연출 진행
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sacrifice_scene, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, self.vent_zone) then
		self.is_passing_vent = false
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event()
	self.is_passing_vent = false
end
--endregion

--- 환풍구 지역 지나갈 때 남매 대화 보여주는 연출
function local_class:passing_vent_area()
	self.is_passing_vent = true

	-- 해당 이벤트 끝나고 4초마다 이벤트 반복 되도록
	while self.is_passing_vent do
		self.playing_vent_dialogue = true

		if self.cur_progress == self.progress.none then
			self.cur_progress = self.progress.siblings_talk
		end

		local lattice = self.get_lattice()
		-- 앗 아쉽다! 탱크 가지고 싶었는데!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lattice, { key = 'lilith_tower_life_is_beautiful_8', scale = 0.8 })

		local time = unity_class.time.time
		while unity_class.time.time - time <= 4 do
			if not self.is_passing_vent then
				self.playing_vent_dialogue = false
				return
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	self.playing_vent_dialogue = false
end

--- 누나가 동생을 위해 희생하는 연출

		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.talked_brother = false

	self.star_piece_name = 'life_is_beautiful_star_piece'

	-- FX_dead 이팩트 가져오기
	self.get_dead_effect = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_two_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_two_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('life_is_beautiful_door', true))

	local trash_can = self.controller.get_trash_can()

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.controller.kids.boy, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_position(self.controller.kids.boy, trash_can.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.15))

	trash_can.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_dead_effect()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_two_name or not self.controller.can_play_event then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.get_trash_can()) and not self.talked_brother then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.get_star_piece_scene, self)
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('LilithTowerMainSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = LilithTowerMain @
		Comment = 오프닝1 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'lilithtower_1_1'

	-- 동적로딩 npc 리스트
	self.optimized_npcs = nil

	self.knight = nil
	self.fairy = nil
	self.knight_real = nil
	self.princess = nil

	self.sound = nil

	self.get_mind_hack_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Char_Debuff_purple') end
	self.get_portal_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_into_otherworld_camera_fx') end

	-- 자막 UI
	self.subtitle = nil

	-- 이벤트 상태값
	self.event_state = {
		none = 0,
		talk_1 = 1,
		talk_2 = 2,
		talk_ing = 3
	}

	-- 현재 이벤트 상태
	self.current_state = self.event_state.none
end
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Char_Debuff_purple')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_into_otherworld_camera_fx')

	self.get_mind_hack_effect()
	self.get_portal_effect()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.load_subtitle, self))
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	self.fairy = get_character('fairy')

	if user_util.has_knight_male() then
		self.knight = get_character('knight_fake_female')
	else
		self.knight = get_character('knight_fake_male')
	end
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.opening_routine, self))
end

function local_class:load_subtitle()
	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local subtitle_object = nil

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			res_holder, 'ui/oneactplay', 'Subtitle', function(p)
				subtitle_object = p
			end)

	local obj_instance = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(subtitle_object)

	local ui_panel = obj_instance:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UIPanel))
	ui_panel.sortingLayerName = 'UI'
	ui_panel.depth = 1006
	ui_panel.sortingOrder = 0
	ui_panel.useSortingOrder = true

	self.subtitle = obj_instance:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.UISubtitle))

	local transform = stage.UISceneManager.UIRootTransform
	self.subtitle.transform:SetParent(transform, false)

	subtitle_object = nil

	self.subtitle:Activate(false)

	res_holder:Dispose()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.subtitle = nil

	self.knight = nil
	self.fairy = nil
	self.knight_real = nil
	self.princess = nil

	function clean_up_npcs(targets)
		local char_count = 0
		for _, character in pairs(targets) do
			character.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			char_count = char_count + 1
		end

		while true do
			local cleaned_count = 0
			for _, character in pairs(targets) do
				if character.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped then
					cleaned_count = cleaned_count + 1
				end
			end

			if char_count == cleaned_count then
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(targets)
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(clean_up_npcs, self.optimized_npcs))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		if self.current_state == self.event_state.talk_ing then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_click_party_preset_01')
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.fairy) then
		if self.current_state == self.event_state.talk_1 then
			self.current_state = self.event_state.talk_ing
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fairy_talk_1, self))
		elseif self.current_state == self.event_state.talk_2 then
			self.current_state = self.event_state.talk_ing
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fairy_talk_retry, self))
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:load_bullet()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.smoke_effect_preset)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_projectile_preset)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.custom_sprite_preset)

	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	-- 총알 프리로드
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
				self.custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				self.custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)

	self.pooled_bullet = {}
	for i = 1, self.pooled_bullet_size do
		self.pooled_bullet[i] = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(
				self.custom_sprite_preset):Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)

		local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet[i].transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
		bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
		bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.6
		bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
		bullet_sprite.Atlas = self.custom_atlas

		bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'virus_bullet_2.png'
		bullet_sprite:Rebuild()
	end

	-- 샹들리에 파괴 이펙트 로드
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'ondemand/v2_22_lilithtower/effects', 'fx_chandelier_break_smoke', function(prefab)
				self.chandelier_break_effect = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				self.chandelier_break_effect:SetActive(false)
			end)
end

	self.is_game_start = true

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_3_name then return end -- 방어코드

	-- 이전 섹션에서 온 경우
	if stage.Name == self.stage_3_name then
		if self.controller.starting_inner_progress ~= 9 then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-94, 0, 129))
		else

					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-0.5, 0, -4))

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		return self:on_touch_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestStartEvent) then
		return self:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestEndEvent) then
		return self:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then return end
	if not e.FullEnter then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.vent_zone_name_2 or zone_name == self.vent_zone_name_2 then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	elseif zone_name == self.elevator_room_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	elseif zone_name == self.first_floor_zone_name and self.is_game_start then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
		quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-0.5,0 ,-4))
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name_1))
	elseif zone_name == self.second_floor_outer_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
		quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(25.5,0 ,99))
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name_1))
	elseif zone_name == self.second_floor_inner_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
		quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-26.5,0 ,128.5))
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name_1))
	elseif zone_name == self.third_floor_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
		quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(17.5,0 ,197.5))
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name_2))
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.chandelier) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_chandelier_event, self)
	end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)

	end
end

function local_class:interact_chandelier_event()

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')

		self.qte_complete = false
		self.cur_touch_event_type = CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe("down")

		while not self.qte_complete do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_heavy_slash_01')

		character_util.jump(get_party_leader(), 1, 1)
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(get_party_leader(), vector(0, 0, -0.5), 0.5, 0.3)
		character_util.set_anim(get_party_leader(), { name = 'twohand_attack2', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })

		wait_for_sec(0.15)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')

		CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Mod(0.2, self.time_scale_key)

		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 2})

		screen_util.fade_out(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(
				get_party_leader().Position + vector(0, 0, -1))
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(
				get_party_leader().Position + vector(0, 0, -1))

		CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod(self.time_scale_key)

		local center = vector(-0.5, 0, 25)
		local radius = 4

		camera_util.move_async(center + vector(0, 0, 1), 0)
		camera_util.resize_to(4.5, 0)

		stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.first_floor_chandelier_name, 'disabled')

		local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(center + vector(0, 0.001, 0), radius)
		attack_range:Show()

		wait_for_sec(0.7)

		screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		-- 게임패드 연결중 일 경우 게임패드 이벤트도 구독
		if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
			self.game_pad_handler = {
				callback = function(_, e)
					if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown or
							e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.BButtonDown or
							e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.XButtonDown or
							e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.YButtonDown then
						message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchEvent.Create(CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap, unity_class.vector2.zero))
						return true
					end
					return false
				end
			}
			message_system:Subscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'callback')
		end

		self.qte_complete = false
		self.cur_touch_event_type = CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTap()

		while not self.qte_complete do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(attack_range.gameObject)

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

		--사용 후 게임패드 구독 해제
		if self.game_pad_handler then
			message_system:Unsubscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
			self.game_pad_handler = nil
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_03')

		camera_util.shake(0.2, 3)

		-- 터치 순간에서 테러리스트들 위치 고정하고 성공 여부 확인
		local is_complete = true
		local save_terrorist_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
		local dead_terrorist_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)

		for i = 0, self.super_terrorist_list.Count - 1 do
			self.super_terrorist_list[i].FieldObjectController.DontFight = true

			local req = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('idle', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Default, true)
			local state = CS.Oak.CharacterMarionetteState.Create(self.super_terrorist_list[i], req)
			local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(state)

			state.CurrentAction = CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped
			message_system:SendSync(self.super_terrorist_list[i].FieldObjectBehaviour, state_change_event)

			if (center - self.super_terrorist_list[i].Position).magnitude > radius then
				is_complete = false

				save_terrorist_list:Add(self.super_terrorist_list[i])
			else
				dead_terrorist_list:Add(self.super_terrorist_list[i])
			end
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_die_fat_ogre_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_iron_02')

local local_class = newclass('LilithTowerMainSection11')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = LilithTowerMain @
		Comment =  3스테이지 고위 관리직 구출 + 라보스 폭탄 발견 @
		Index = 10 @
		NextSections = 11 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 퀘스트 진행도
	self.progress_state = {
		idle = 0,
		see_architect = 1,
		save_architect = 2
	}

	self.current_progress = self.progress_state.idle

	-- 틴트
	self.is_darken = false

	-- 대사
	self.main_script = 'lilith_tower_main_s11_'

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'lilithtower_1_3'

	-- 설계자
	self.architect = nil
	self.architect_name = 'architect'

	self.labose_bomb = nil
	self.labose_bomb_name = 'labose_bomb'

	-- 사운드
	self.room_sfx = nil

	-- 존 이름
	self.architect_event_zone_name = 'section_11_architect'
	self.labose_darken_event_zone_name = 'section_11_labose_bomb_darken'
	self.labose_event_zone_name = 'section_11_labose_bomb'

	-- 틴트 키
	self.tint_key = 'lilith_tower_main'

	-- 퀘스트 마커, 트래커 이름
	self.marker_name = "lilith_tower_main"
	self.tracker_name_1 = "lilith_tower_main_s11_tracker_1"
	self.tracker_name_2 = "lilith_tower_main_s11_tracker_2"

	-- 오브젝트 풀
	self.small_explosion_effect_preset = 'FX_dead'
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.architect = get_character(self.architect_name)
	character_util.add_listener(self.architect, self.controller)
	character_util.shake(self.architect, 0.04, 99999)
	character_util.set_position(self.architect, vector(-0.5, 0, 57))
	character_util.set_direction(self.architect, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(self.architect, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.architect, { name = 'confused' })

	self.labose_bomb = get_character(self.labose_bomb_name)
	self.labose_bomb.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	character_util.set_scale_factor(self.labose_bomb, self.labose_bomb.Name, 2)
	self.labose_bomb.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0), vector(2, 0.75, 2.5))
	self.labose_bomb.SpineController:AddColor(self.labose_bomb.Name, unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 }), 1, 0)
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(self.labose_bomb, 'Default', -1)

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.labose_bomb, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(self.architect)

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(
			self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.architect)

	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name_1))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.architect = nil
	self.labose_bomb = nil

	if self.room_sfx ~= nil then
		self.room_sfx:FadeOut()
		self.room_sfx = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then return end
	if not e.FullEnter then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.see_architect and zone_name == self.architect_event_zone_name then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_state.see_architect

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.architect_scream, self))
	elseif not self.is_darken and zone_name == self.labose_darken_event_zone_name then
		self.is_darken = true

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tv_off_02')

		field:Tint(self.tint_key, unity_color({ 0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1 }), 0.5)
	elseif self.room_sfx == nil and zone_name == self.labose_event_zone_name then
		self.room_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
				{ sfx_name = '01_event_dw_11', loop = true, play_pos = self.labose_bomb.Position,
				  type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'object' })
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then return end
	if not e.FullLeave then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.save_architect and
			zone_name == self.architect_event_zone_name then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.block_architect_event, self)
	elseif self.is_darken and zone_name == self.labose_darken_event_zone_name and
			get_party_leader().Position.z < 62 then
		self.is_darken = false

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

		field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key, 0.5)
	elseif self.room_sfx ~= nil and zone_name == self.labose_event_zone_name then
		self.room_sfx:FadeOut()
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.architect) then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_state.save_architect

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.save_architect_event, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.labose_bomb) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.see_labose_bomb_event, self)
	end
end

function local_class:load_bullet()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_projectile_preset)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.custom_sprite_preset)

	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	-- 총알 프리로드
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
				self.custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				self.custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)

	self.pooled_bullet = {}
	for i = 1, self.pooled_bullet_size do
		self.pooled_bullet[i] = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(
				self.custom_sprite_preset):Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)

		local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet[i].transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
		bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
		bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.6
		bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
		bullet_sprite.Atlas = self.custom_atlas

		bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'virus_bullet_2.png'
		bullet_sprite:Rebuild()
	end
end

-- 그레모리 가방 흔드는 연출
function local_class:shake_bag(bag)
	local magnitude = 0.02
	local base_position = bag.Position

	while self.is_bag_shake do
		local cur_x = unity_class.random.Range(-magnitude, magnitude)
		local cur_z = unity_class.random.Range(-magnitude, magnitude)

		bag.Position = base_position + vector(cur_x, 0, cur_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 총알 난사 연출
function local_class:bullet_wild_shot(save_terrorist_list)
	local cabinet = get_field_object(self.cabinet_name)
	cabinet:Shake(0.04, 9999)

	while self.is_shoot_bullet do
		wait_for_sec(0.083)

		camera_util.shake(0.07, 1)

		for i = 0, save_terrorist_list.Count - 1 do
			local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet[i + 1].transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

			local rand_x = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-0.5, 0.5)
			local rand_z = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-1, 1)

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.fire_bullet_effect, self, bullet_sprite,
							save_terrorist_list[i].Bounds.center +
									CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(save_terrorist_list[i].Direction) * 0.7,
							cabinet.Bounds.center + vector(rand_x, 0, rand_z)))
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.083)
	end

	for i = 0, save_terrorist_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(save_terrorist_list[i], { name = 'rifle_idle' })
	end
end

-- 총알 발사
function local_class:fire_bullet_effect(bullet_sprite, sniper_pos, target_pos)
	bullet_sprite.transform.position = sniper_pos

	local look_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(target_pos - sniper_pos)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = look_rotation * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.MoveTo, bullet_sprite.transform,
			bullet_sprite.transform.position, target_pos, -1, nil, 30, false)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_projectile_preset):Instantiate(target_pos)

	bullet_sprite.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
end

-- 세이프 하우스 NPC들 당황해서 여기저기 둘러보는 이벤트
function local_class:crowd_embarrassed_event()
	local crowd_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = "01_crowd_buzz_02", loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, type_priority = 'event' })

	local crowd_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)

	for i = 0, self.npc_list.Count - 1 do
		if i ~= self.npc_index.princess and i ~= self.npc_index.trouble_shooter and
				i ~= self.npc_index.lilith and i ~= self.npc_index.beth and i ~= self.npc_index.architect then
			crowd_list:Add(self.npc_list[i])
		end
	end

	for n = 3, 5 do
		for i = 0, crowd_list.Count - 1 do
			local mod = i % n

			character_util.set_anim(crowd_list[i], { name = 'cast' })
			character_util.set_emotion(crowd_list[i], { name = 'tired' })

			if mod % 2 == 0 then
				character_util.set_direction(crowd_list[i], 'left')
			elseif mod % 2 == 1 then
				character_util.set_direction(crowd_list[i], 'right')
			end
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	crowd_sfx:FadeOut()
end

-- 바리케이드 만들기 위해 정해진 위치로 움직이는 NPC들
function local_class:move_to_make_barricade(lilith_helper, is_leader_beth)
	local beth = self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth]
	local lilith = self.npc_list[self.npc_index.lilith]

	local trouble_shooter = self.npc_list[self.npc_index.trouble_shooter]
	local mad_scientist = self.npc_list[self.npc_index.mad_scientist]
	local mugger = self.npc_list[self.npc_index.mugger]
	local android_engineer = self.npc_list[self.npc_index.android_engineer]

	for i = 0, self.npc_list.Count - 1 do
		if self.npc_list[i] ~= nil and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], beth) and
				not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], lilith) and
				not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], lilith_helper) and
				not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], architect) then
			local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

			if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], trouble_shooter)
					and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], mad_scientist)
					and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], mugger)
					and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], android_engineer) then
				-- NPC 최초 이동 위치 x좌표 결정
				local first_x

				if self.npc_list[i].Position.x > -1.5 and self.npc_list[i].Position.x < 0.5 then
					first_x = self.npc_list[i].Position.x
				else
					if math.abs(self.npc_list[i].Position.x + 1.5) <
							math.abs(self.npc_list[i].Position.x - 0.5) then
						first_x = unity_class.random.Range(-2, -0.5)
					else
						first_x = unity_class.random.Range(-0.5, 1)
					end
				end

				waypoint_list:Add(vector(first_x, 0, self.npc_list[i].Position.z))
				waypoint_list:Add(vector(first_x, 0, -10))

				character_util.set_anim(self.npc_list[i], { name = 'run' })
				character_util.move_waypoint(self.npc_list[i], waypoint_list, 6,
						true, 'stop', 'floor', 'down', true, 0,
						function(index)
							if index == waypoint_list.Count - 1 then
								character_util.remove_anim(self.npc_list[i])
								character_util.remove_emotion(self.npc_list[i])
							end
						end
				)
			else
				-- 방 안에 남아 있는 NPC들은 직접 이동 처리
				-- 리더가 오딜이면 이동하지 않음
				if is_leader_beth or not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], trouble_shooter) then
					local cur_marker = field:GetMarker(self.npc_list[i].Name..self.barricade_marker_name)
					local last_dir = direction_util.to_str(cur_marker.direction)

					waypoint_list:Add(vector(cur_marker.position.x, 0, self.npc_list[i].Position.z))
					waypoint_list:Add(cur_marker.position)

					character_util.set_anim(self.npc_list[i], { name = 'run' })
					character_util.move_waypoint(self.npc_list[i], waypoint_list, 6,
							true, 'stop', 'floor', last_dir, true, 0,
							function(index)
								if index == waypoint_list.Count - 1 then
									character_util.remove_anim(self.npc_list[i])
									character_util.remove_emotion(self.npc_list[i])
								end
							end
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 리리스 들고 움직이는 비서 혹은 오딜
function local_class:hold_lilith_and_move(lilith, lilith_helper)
	character_util.set_anim(lilith_helper, { name = 'run' })
	character_util.move_to_async(lilith_helper, lilith.Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 0),
			nil, 6, true, true)

	lilith.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	lilith.Holdable.BounceSfxHandleName = nil

	character_util.remove_anim(lilith_helper)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	command_util.execute_holdup(lilith_helper, lilith, lilith_helper.Position)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local lilith_helper_waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	lilith_helper_waypoint_list:Add(vector(0, 0, lilith_helper.Position.z))
	lilith_helper_waypoint_list:Add(vector(0, 0, -28.5))

	character_util.move_waypoint(lilith_helper, lilith_helper_waypoint_list, 6, true,
			'stop', 'floor', 'left', true, 0,
			function(index)
				-- 도착 지점에 오면 리리스 내려놓음
				if index == 1 then
					character_util.remove_anim(lilith_helper)
				end
			end
	)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.stage_name = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end -- 방어코드

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_event')

	self:setting()

	coroutine.yield(self:load_bullet())
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end -- 방어코드

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_event, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))

	self.npc_list = nil

	self.player_pushable_objs = nil
	self.npc_pushable_objs = nil
	self.player_pushable_reset_switch_list = nil

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	self.custom_atlas = nil

	if self.pooled_bullet ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.pooled_bullet.gameObject)
		self.pooled_bullet = nil
	end

	if self.npc_sfx ~= nil then
		self.npc_sfx:FadeOut()

		self.npc_sfx = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	--핸들러 제거
	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
		self.game_pad_handler = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent) then
		self:on_move_fo_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		self:on_touch_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent) then
		self:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_move_fo_event(e)
	if self.current_progress ~= self.progress_state.idle then
		return false
	end

	-- 미는 오브젝트 체크해서 위치 확인
	for _, cur_obj in pairs(self.player_pushable_objs) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, cur_obj.field_object) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_object, self, e, cur_obj))
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap then
		self.tap_num = self.tap_num + 1
	end
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.idle then
		for i = 0, self.player_pushable_reset_switch_list.Count - 1 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.player_pushable_reset_switch_list[i]) then
				if e.IsTurningOn then
					self:reset_player_pushable_obj(i + 1)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 총알 프리팹 로드
function local_class:load_bullet()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_projectile_preset)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.custom_sprite_preset)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.smoke_effect_preset)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.reset_effect_preset)

	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	-- 총알 프리로드
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
				self.custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				self.custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)

	self.pooled_bullet = {}
	for i = 1, self.pooled_bullet_size do
		self.pooled_bullet[i] = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(
				self.custom_sprite_preset)       :Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)

		local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet[i].transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
		bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
		bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.6
		bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
		bullet_sprite.Atlas = self.custom_atlas

		bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'virus_bullet_2.png'
		bullet_sprite:Rebuild()
	end
end

-- 게임 시작 시 실행되는 이벤트
function local_class:start_event()
	-- 이 섹션부터 시작한 경우
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 12 then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		get_party_leader().Position = vector(0, 0, 1)
		character_util.set_direction(get_party_leader(), 'right')

		screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
	end

	self:barricade_default_setting()

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

-- 바리케이드 밀기 이벤트 시작 시 기본 설정
function local_class:barricade_default_setting()
	-- AttackRange로 목표 위치 표시
	self.obj_target_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(
			self.obj_target_pos + vector(0, 0.001, 0), self.obj_target_size,
			CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 76),
			CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 153)
	)

	self.obj_target_range:Show()

	-- 타이머 실행
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')

	timer_util.start_timer(
			{ duration = self.time_limit_barricade, handler = self, callback = 'timer_finished' })

	-- 반복되는 진동 이벤트
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shake_repeat_event, self))

	-- NPC들이 바리케이드 미는 이벤트
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.npc_push_barricade_event, self))

	for _, cur_obj in pairs(self.player_pushable_objs) do
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name .. cur_obj.index, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, cur_obj.field_object)

		cur_obj.field_object.Pushable = CS.Oak.UnitPushable()

		cur_obj.field_object.Position = cur_obj.start_pos
		cur_obj.move_finished = false
	end

	for _, cur_obj in pairs(self.npc_pushable_objs) do
		cur_obj.field_object.Position = cur_obj.start_pos
		cur_obj.move_finished = false
	end

	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name_1))
end

-- 물건 밀 때 처리 (NPC 이동)
function local_class:move_object(move_fo_event, obj_info)
	-- 만약 현 위치가 목표 범위 내에 있을 경우
	if not obj_info.move_finished and
			CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(self.obj_target_bound, obj_info.field_object.Bounds.center) then
		self.player_barricades[obj_info.index] = true

		obj_info.move_finished = true

		-- 마커 제거
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name .. obj_info.index)

		-- 모든 오브젝트 밀었는지 확인해서 밀었다면 다음으로 넘어감
		local obj_move_finished = true

		for i = 1, #self.player_barricades do
			if not self.player_barricades[i] then
				obj_move_finished = false

				break
			end
		end

		if obj_move_finished and self.current_progress ~= self.progress_state.barricade_finished then
			self:timer_finished()
		end
	elseif obj_info.move_finished and
			not CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(self.obj_target_bound, obj_info.field_object.Bounds.center) then
		self.player_barricades[obj_info.index] = false

		obj_info.move_finished = false

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name .. obj_info.index, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, obj_info.field_object)
	end
end

-- 플레이어 오브젝트 초기화 스위치 누르면 발생하는 이벤트
function local_class:reset_player_pushable_obj(index)
	local cur_obj_info = self.player_pushable_objs[index]

	if not vector_util.is_almost_zero(cur_obj_info.field_object.Position - cur_obj_info.start_pos) then
		self.player_barricades[index] = false
		cur_obj_info.move_finished = false

		local reset_effect_1 = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(
				self.reset_effect_preset)       :Instantiate(cur_obj_info.field_object.Bounds.center)
		reset_effect_1.transform.localScale = cur_obj_info.field_object.Bounds.size * 1.5

		local reset_effect_2 = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(
				self.reset_effect_preset)       :Instantiate(cur_obj_info.start_pos)
		reset_effect_2.transform.localScale = cur_obj_info.field_object.Bounds.size * 1.5

		cur_obj_info.field_object.Position = cur_obj_info.start_pos

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name .. index, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, cur_obj_info.field_object)

		-- 플레이어 캐릭터가 PushState 상태일 경우 초기화
		local current_state = get_party_leader().FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState

		if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterUnitPushState) then
			command_util.execute_push_end(get_party_leader(), cur_obj_info.field_object)
		end
	end
end

-- 진동 반복
function local_class:shake_repeat_event()
	local timer = 0
	local duration = 0

	while self.current_progress == self.progress_state.idle do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer > duration then
			timer = 0

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_08')

			local rand_shake = unity_class.random.Range(0.1, 0.3)
			camera_util.shake(rand_shake, 0.5)

			duration = unity_class.random.Range(2, 4)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- NPC들이 바리케이드 미는 이벤트
function local_class:npc_push_barricade_event()
	local sfx_timer = 0
	local sfx_duration = 1

	local start_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	for _, cur_obj in pairs(self.npc_pushable_objs) do
		start_pos_list:Add(cur_obj.field_object.Position)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.npc_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = "01_crowd_buzz_01", loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local move_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	move_pos_list:Add(vector(0, 0, 6))
	move_pos_list:Add(vector(8, 0, 0))
	move_pos_list:Add(vector(-6, 0, 0))
	move_pos_list:Add(vector(2, 0, 0))

	while self.current_progress == self.progress_state.idle do
		sfx_timer = sfx_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local index = 1

		for _, cur_obj in pairs(self.npc_pushable_objs) do
			local cur_move_pos = move_pos_list[index - 1] / self.time_limit_barricade * unity_class.time.deltaTime

			-- 밀고 있는 NPC들이 오브젝트에 겹치지 않도록 Bound 값을 조금 변경함
			local cur_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(
					cur_obj.field_object.Bounds.center + (move_pos_list[index - 1]).normalized * 0.5,
					cur_obj.field_object.Bounds.size)

			-- 앞에 다른 오브젝트가 막고 있으면 이동하지 않는다
			local collided_objs = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetCollidedFieldObjects(cur_bound, cur_move_pos)

			if collided_objs ~= nil then
				local is_collided = false
				local distance_list = collided_objs.Item1
				local fo_list = collided_objs.Item2

				if fo_list ~= nil then
					for n = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
						-- 자기 자신이 아닌 플레이어 캐릭터와 장애물만 체크함
						if (fo_list[n].EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Player) ~= CS.Oak.EntityGroups.None or
								fo_list[n].EntityGroup == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle and
										not lua_helper.reference_equals(fo_list[n], cur_obj.field_object) then
							is_collided = true

							break
						end
					end
				end

				if not is_collided then
					cur_obj.field_object.Position = cur_obj.field_object.Position + cur_move_pos

					for i = 1, #cur_obj.characters do
						cur_obj.characters[i].Position = cur_obj.characters[i].Position + cur_move_pos
					end
				end

				distance_list:Dispose()
				fo_list:Dispose()
			end

			index = index + 1
		end

		if sfx_timer >= sfx_duration then
			sfx_timer = 0

			for _, cur_obj in pairs(self.npc_pushable_objs) do
				music_player_util.play_sfx(
						{ sfx_name = "01_push_rock_unit_04", volume = 0.5,
						  play_pos = cur_obj.field_object.Position, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.npc_sfx ~= nil then
		self.npc_sfx:FadeOut()
	end
end

-- 타이머 종료 시 호출되는 함수
