-- 타이머 종료 후 이벤트
function local_class:timer_finished_barricade_event()
	self.current_progress = self.progress_state.barricade_finished

	timer_util.end_timer(self, true)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- AttackRange 제거
	self.obj_target_range:Hide()

	-- 옮긴 물건 개수 확인, 안 옮긴 물건들 제거, 퀘스트 마커 제거
	local move_object_num = 0

	for _, cur_info in pairs(self.player_pushable_objs) do
		if not cur_info.move_finished then
			stage_util.set_fo_active_state(cur_info.field_object.Name, 'disabled')
		else
			move_object_num = move_object_num + 1

			cur_info.field_object.Pushable = CS.Oak.NonPushable.Instance
		end

		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name .. cur_info.index)
	end

	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

	local start_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	start_pos_list:Add(vector(4, 0, -2.5))
	start_pos_list:Add(vector(4, 0, 2.5))
	start_pos_list:Add(vector(-1, 0, -2.5))
	start_pos_list:Add(vector(-1, 0, 2.5))

	for i = 1, #self.npc_pushable_objs do
		self.npc_pushable_objs[i].field_object.Position = start_pos_list[i - 1]
	end

	local npc_center_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	npc_center_pos_list:Add(vector(self.npc_pushable_objs[3].field_object.Bounds.center.x, 0,
			self.npc_pushable_objs[3].field_object.Bounds.center.z))
	npc_center_pos_list:Add(vector(self.npc_pushable_objs[4].field_object.Bounds.center.x, 0,
			self.npc_pushable_objs[4].field_object.Bounds.center.z))

	for i = 0, self.npc_list.Count - 1 do
		if self.npc_list[i] ~= nil then
			if i ~= self.npc_index.lilith and i ~= self.npc_index.secretary and i ~= self.npc_index.architect then
				character_util.set_direction(self.npc_list[i], 'right')
			end
		end
	end

	self:set_player_pushable_object()

	-- 바리케이드가 설치되어 있는 경우, 플레이어 위치 설정
	local extra_pushable_obj

	if move_object_num > 0 then
		-- 플레이어가 밀던 오브젝트 위치 기본 설정
		extra_pushable_obj = get_field_object(self.extra_pushable_obj_name)
		extra_pushable_obj.Position = vector(1.7 - move_object_num * 0.7, 0, 0.5)

		local player_target_pos

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(extra_pushable_obj, self.player_pushable_objs[1].field_object) then
			player_target_pos = vector(extra_pushable_obj.Bounds.center.x, 0, extra_pushable_obj.Bounds.center.z) +
					vector(-extra_pushable_obj.Bounds.size.x / 2, 0, 0)
		else
			player_target_pos = vector(extra_pushable_obj.Bounds.center.x, 0, extra_pushable_obj.Bounds.center.z) +
					vector(-extra_pushable_obj.Bounds.size.x / 2 - 0.2, 0, 0)
		end

		character_util.set_position(get_party_leader(), player_target_pos)
		character_util.set_direction(get_party_leader(), 'right')
		character_util.shake(get_party_leader(), 0.04, 99999)
		character_util.set_anim(get_party_leader(), { name = 'push', upper = true })
		character_util.set_anim(get_party_leader(), { name = 'walk', scale = 0.2 })
		character_util.set_emotion(get_party_leader(), { name = 'damaged' })

		self:set_position_npc_pushable_object(
				npc_center_pos_list, move_object_num > 0, player_target_pos)
	else
		character_util.set_position(get_party_leader(), vector(0, 0, 0.5))
		character_util.set_direction(get_party_leader(), 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(get_party_leader(), { name = 'smile' })

		self:set_position_npc_pushable_object(npc_center_pos_list, move_object_num > 0, nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if move_object_num > 0 then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music(
				{ name = 'ondemand/v2_22_lilithtower/audio:bgm_lilith_terror_02', state = 'event', mix = 2 })
	else
		character_util.set_anim(get_party_leader(), { name = 'success', sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01' })
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_06')

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local push_obj_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.FieldObject)
	push_obj_list:Add(self.npc_pushable_objs[3].field_object)
	push_obj_list:Add(self.npc_pushable_objs[4].field_object)

	-- 바리케이드가 설치되어 있는 경우
	if move_object_num > 0 then
		push_obj_list:Add(extra_pushable_obj)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_npc_pushable_object, self,
						push_obj_list, vector(1, 0, 0), 3))
	else
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_npc_pushable_object, self,
						push_obj_list, vector(1, 0, 0), 3, true))
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	camera_util.move_async(vector(4, 0, 1), 1.5)

	for i = 0, self.terrorist_list.Count - 1 do
		local mod = i % 2

		character_util.set_active_state(self.terrorist_list[i], 'disabled')
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.terrorist_list[i], 0, 0)
		character_util.set_position(self.terrorist_list[i], vector(11, 0, 1 - mod))
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 바리케이드가 설치되어 있는 경우
	if move_object_num > 0 then
		local is_leader_beth = self.npc_flags[self.npc_flag_index.beth]
		local leader

		if self.npc_flags[self.npc_flag_index.beth] then
			leader = self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth]
		else
			leader = self.npc_list[self.npc_index.trouble_shooter]
		end

		local lilith = self.npc_list[self.npc_index.lilith]
		local secretary = self.npc_list[self.npc_index.secretary]
		local princess = self.npc_list[self.npc_index.princess]
		local architect = self.npc_list[self.npc_index.architect]

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_05')

		for i = 0, self.npc_list.Count - 1 do
			if self.npc_list[i] ~= nil then
				character_util.jump(self.npc_list[i], 0.5, 0.3)

				if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], leader) and
						not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], lilith) and
						not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], secretary) and
						not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], princess) and
						not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], architect) then
					character_util.set_emotion(self.npc_list[i], { name = 'scared' })
				elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], princess) then
					character_util.set_emotion(self.npc_list[i], { name = 'attack' })
				end
			end
		end

		character_util.set_emotion(get_party_leader(), { name = 'scared' })

		for i = 0, self.terrorist_list.Count - 1 do
			local val = math.floor(i / 2)
			local mod = i % 2

			character_util.set_active_state(self.terrorist_list[i], 'enabled')
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.terrorist_list[i], 1, 1)
			character_util.set_direction(self.terrorist_list[i], 'left')
			character_util.set_anim(self.terrorist_list[i], { name = 'rifle_walk' })

			local terrorist_waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
			terrorist_waypoint_list:Add(self.terrorist_list[i].Position + vector(-4 + val, 0, 0))

			character_util.move_waypoint(self.terrorist_list[i], terrorist_waypoint_list, 3,
					false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left', false, 0,
					function(index)
						if index == terrorist_waypoint_list.Count - 1 then
							character_util.set_anim(self.terrorist_list[i], { name = 'rifle_idle' })
							character_util.set_emotion(self.terrorist_list[i], { name = 'attack' })
						end
					end
			)

			if mod == 1 then
				wait_for_sec(0.333)
			end
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.7)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')

		character_util.jump(self.terrorist_list[1], 1, 0.5)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(
				self.terrorist_list[1], { key = self.main_script .. 1, skip = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

		character_util.set_anim(self.terrorist_list[0], { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(
				self.terrorist_list[0], { key = self.main_script .. 2, skip = true })

		for i = 0, self.terrorist_list.Count - 1 do
			character_util.set_anim(self.terrorist_list[i], { name = 'rifle_idle' })
		end

		-- 바리케이드에 난사 시작
		self.is_wild_shot_to_barricade = true

		local shooter_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
		shooter_list:Add(self.terrorist_list[0])
		shooter_list:Add(self.terrorist_list[1])

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bullet_wild_shot_to_barricade, self, shooter_list))

		camera_util.shake(0.15, 1)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		camera_util.shake(0.075, 1)

		camera_util.move_async(get_party_leader().Position, 1, { end_target = get_party_leader() })

		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.stop_shake(princess)
		character_util.remove_anim(princess, true)
		character_util.normal_double_jump(princess, true)

		for i = 0, self.npc_list.Count - 1 do
			if self.npc_list[i] ~= nil and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], princess) and
					not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], lilith) and
					not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], secretary) and
					not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], architect) then
				character_util.set_emotion(self.npc_list[i], { name = 'tired' })
			end
		end

		character_util.set_emotion(get_party_leader(), { name = 'tired' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(
				princess, { key = self.main_script .. 3, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })

		character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'hold_loop' })

		for i = 0, self.npc_list.Count - 1 do
			if self.npc_list[i] ~= nil and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], princess) and
					not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], lilith) and
					not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], secretary) and
					not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], architect) then
				character_util.set_emotion(self.npc_list[i], { name = 'attack' })
			end
		end

		character_util.set_emotion(get_party_leader(), { name = 'attack' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.main_script .. 4, skip = true })

		for i = 0, self.npc_list.Count - 1 do
			if self.npc_list[i] ~= nil and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], lilith) and
					not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], architect) then
				character_util.shake(self.npc_list[i], 0.04, 99999)
			end
		end

		character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'push', upper = true })

		character_util.set_anim(get_party_leader(), { name = 'push', upper = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')

		-- 게임패드 연결중 일 경우 게임패드 이벤트도 구독
		if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
			self.game_pad_handler = {
				callback = function(_, e)
					if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown or
							e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.BButtonDown or
							e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.XButtonDown or
							e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.YButtonDown then
						message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchEvent.Create(CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap, unity_class.vector2.zero))
						return true
					end
					return false
				end
			}
			message_system:Subscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'callback')
		end

		self.qte_complete = false

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1)

		local touch_flags = { false, false }
		local touch_timer = 0

		while not self.qte_complete do
			if not touch_flags[1] and self.tap_num >= 3 then
				touch_flags[1] = true

				for i = 0, self.npc_list.Count - 1 do
					if self.npc_list[i] ~= nil and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], lilith) and
							not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], secretary) and
							not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], architect) then
						character_util.set_anim(self.npc_list[i], { name = 'walk', scale = 0.5 })
					end
				end

				character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'walk', scale = 0.5 })

				character_util.set_anim(get_party_leader(), { name = 'walk', scale = 0.5 })

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_npc_pushable_object, self,
								push_obj_list, vector(1, 0, 0), 1, false, true))
			elseif not touch_flags[2] and touch_timer < 1.5 then
				touch_timer = touch_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			elseif touch_timer >= 1.5 and not touch_flags[2] and self.tap_num >= 6 then
				touch_flags[2] = true
				touch_timer = 0

				for i = 0, self.npc_list.Count - 1 do
					if self.npc_list[i] ~= nil and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], lilith) and
							not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], secretary) and
							not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], architect) then
						character_util.set_anim(self.npc_list[i], { name = 'walk', scale = 0.5 })
					end
				end

				character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'walk', scale = 0.5 })

				character_util.set_anim(get_party_leader(), { name = 'walk', scale = 0.5 })

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_npc_pushable_object, self,
								push_obj_list, vector(1, 0, 0), 1, false, true))
			elseif touch_flags[2] and touch_timer < 1 then
				touch_timer = touch_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			elseif touch_flags[2] and touch_timer >= 1 then
				self.qte_complete = true
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

		--사용 후 게임패드 구독 해제
		if self.game_pad_handler then
			message_system:Unsubscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
			self.game_pad_handler = nil
		end

		for i = 0, self.npc_list.Count - 1 do
			if self.npc_list[i] ~= nil then
				if i ~= self.npc_index.lilith and i ~= self.npc_index.secretary and i ~= self.npc_index.architect then
					local cur_marker = field:GetMarker(self.npc_list[i].Name .. self.safe_house_marker_name)
					local cur_waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

					local obj_bounds_z

					if math.abs(self.npc_list[i].Position.z - 0.5) <
							math.abs(self.npc_list[i].Position.z - 2.5) then
						if math.abs(self.npc_list[i].Position.z - 0.5) <
								math.abs(self.npc_list[i].Position.z + 2.5) then
							obj_bounds_z = 0.5
						else
							obj_bounds_z = -2.5
						end
					else
						if math.abs(self.npc_list[i].Position.z - 2.5) <
								math.abs(self.npc_list[i].Position.z + 2.5) then
							obj_bounds_z = 2.5
						else
							obj_bounds_z = -2.5
						end
					end

					if self.npc_list[i].Position.z < obj_bounds_z then
						cur_waypoint_list:Add(vector(self.npc_list[i].Position.x, 0, obj_bounds_z - 1.2))
						cur_waypoint_list:Add(vector(cur_marker.position.x, 0, obj_bounds_z - 1.2))
					else
						cur_waypoint_list:Add(vector(self.npc_list[i].Position.x, 0, obj_bounds_z + 1.2))

							true, 0,
							function(index)
								if index == cur_waypoint_list.Count - 1 then
									character_util.remove_anim(self.npc_list[i])
								end
							end
					)
				end
			end
		end

		local cur_waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

		cur_waypoint_list:Add(vector(0, 0, 0))

		character_util.stop_shake(get_party_leader())

				function(index)

		wait_for_sec(2)

		for i = 0, self.npc_list.Count - 1 do

						not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], lilith) and
						not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], secretary) and
						not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], architect) then

				end
			end
		end

		character_util.remove_anim(leader)
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'attack' })

		-- 일어의 경우 오딜과 베스의 대사 차이가 있기 때문에 분리함
		if is_leader_beth then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.main_script .. 5, skip = true })

			character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

			character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'normal_eye2' })

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.main_script .. 6, skip = true })

			character_util.remove_anim(leader)

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.main_script .. 7, skip = true })

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

			character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'cast2' })
			character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'attack' })

			character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.main_script .. 14, skip = true })

			character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'cast2' })

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.main_script .. 15, skip = true })
		end

		local battle_npc_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)

		local battle_indexs = { self.npc_index.trouble_shooter, self.npc_index.mad_scientist,
								self.npc_index.police_officer, self.npc_index.nobody_old_man,
								self.npc_index.beth, self.npc_index.diehard_maclaine }

		for i = 0, self.npc_list.Count - 1 do
			if self.npc_list[i] ~= nil and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], lilith) and
					not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], secretary) and
					not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], architect) then
				character_util.set_active_state(self.npc_list[i], 'enabled')
				local is_battle_npc = false

				for j = 1, #battle_indexs do

					end
				end

				end
			end
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

		for i = 0, self.npc_list.Count - 1 do
			if self.npc_list[i] ~= nil then
				if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], leader) and
						not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], lilith) and
						not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], secretary) and
						not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], architect) then

			end
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')

		for i = 0, battle_npc_list.Count - 1 do

		-- 비전투 캐릭터들 이동

		wait_for_sec(2)

		character_util.look_at(get_party_leader(), leader)

		for i = 0, battle_npc_list.Count - 1 do

		end

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.main_script .. 9, skip = true })
		else

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.main_script .. 16, skip = true })
		end

		character_util.remove_anim(leader)

		character_util.set_anim(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.trouble_shooter], { name = 'cross_arm' })

		character_util.set_anim(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.trouble_shooter],

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(
				self.npc_list[self.npc_index.trouble_shooter], { key = self.main_script .. 11, skip = true })

		character_util.set_anim(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.trouble_shooter], { name = 'cast2' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(
				self.npc_list[self.npc_index.trouble_shooter], { key = self.main_script .. 12, skip = true })

		camera_util.move_async(vector(1.5, 0, 1), 1)

		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'attack' })

			end

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.smoke_effect_preset):Instantiate(extra_pushable_obj.Position)

		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		local index = 1

		for _, cur_obj in pairs(self.player_pushable_objs) do
			if cur_obj.move_finished and
					not lua_helper.reference_equals(cur_obj.field_object, most_right_obj_player) then
				stage_util.set_fo_active_state(cur_obj.field_object.Name, 'disabled')

				if index == 1 then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.barricade_particle_fall_event, self, cur_obj.field_object, 0))

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.barricade_particle_fall_event, self, extra_pushable_obj, 0))

	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')

		for i = 0, self.terrorist_list.Count - 1 do
			local val = math.floor(i / 2)
			local mod = i % 2

			character_util.set_active_state(self.terrorist_list[i], 'enabled')
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.terrorist_list[i], 1, 1)
			character_util.set_position(self.terrorist_list[i], vector(11, 0, 1 - mod))

		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')

		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

		-- 바리케이드 세우는 시점으로 리셋
		self.current_progress = self.progress_state.idle

		for i = 0, self.npc_list.Count - 1 do
			if self.npc_list[i] ~= nil and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.npc_list[i], get_party_leader()) then
				local cur_marker = field:GetMarker(self.npc_list[i].Name .. self.npc_barricade_marker_name)

				character_util.stop(self.npc_list[i])
				character_util.set_position(self.npc_list[i], cur_marker.position)
				character_util.set_direction(self.npc_list[i], cur_marker.direction)
				character_util.shake(self.npc_list[i], 0.04, 99999)
				character_util.set_anim(self.npc_list[i], { name = 'push' })
				character_util.set_emotion(self.npc_list[i], { name = 'damaged' })
			end
		end

		for i = 0, self.terrorist_list.Count - 1 do
			character_util.set_active_state(self.terrorist_list[i], 'disabled')
		end

		for i = 1, #self.player_pushable_objs do
			stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.player_pushable_objs[i].field_object.Name, 'enabled')

			self.player_pushable_objs[i].field_object.Position = self.player_pushable_objs[i].start_pos

		end

		for i = 1, #self.npc_pushable_objs do
			stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.npc_pushable_objs[i].field_object.Name, 'enabled')

			self.npc_pushable_objs[i].field_object.Position = self.npc_pushable_objs[i].start_pos
		end

		stage_camera:SetTarget(get_party_leader())

		get_party_leader().SpineController:RemoveColor(get_party_leader().Name, 0)
		character_util.set_position(get_party_leader(), vector(0, 0, 1))
		character_util.set_direction(get_party_leader(), 'right')
		character_util.remove_anim(get_party_leader())
		character_util.remove_emotion(get_party_leader())

		-- 미는 오브젝트 위치 설정 후에 밀어야 하므로 1프레임 대기
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		self:barricade_default_setting()

		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

		field_ui_manager:Show()

		party_util.reset_controllers()
	end
end

-- 플레이어가 밀고 온 바리케이드 위치 설정
function local_class:set_player_pushable_object()
	if self.player_pushable_objs[3].move_finished then
		self.player_pushable_objs[3].field_object.Position = vector(5, 0.5, 0)
		self.player_pushable_objs[3].field_object.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, -45))

		if self.player_pushable_objs[1].move_finished then
			self.player_pushable_objs[1].field_object.Position = vector(4.6, 0, 1)
			self.player_pushable_objs[2].field_object.Position = vector(3.7, 0, 1)
		elseif self.player_pushable_objs[2].move_finished then
			self.player_pushable_objs[2].field_object.Position = vector(4.6, 0, 1)
		end
	else
		if self.player_pushable_objs[1].move_finished then
			self.player_pushable_objs[1].field_object.Position = vector(5, 0, 1)
			self.player_pushable_objs[2].field_object.Position = vector(4.1, 0, 1)
		elseif self.player_pushable_objs[2].move_finished then
			self.player_pushable_objs[2].field_object.Position = vector(5, 0, 1)
		end
	end

	-- 2번 오브젝트는 바리케이드가 가능하도록 회전시킴
	if self.player_pushable_objs[2].move_finished then
		self.player_pushable_objs[2].field_object.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 90, 0))
	end
end

-- 바리케이드 미는 생존자들 위치 설정
function local_class:set_position_npc_pushable_object(cur_obj_pos_list, use_player_obj, cur_player_pos)
	local all_npc_num = 0
	local npc_obj_npc_num = 0
	local player_obj_npc_num = 0

	local all_npc_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	local npc_obj_npc_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	local player_obj_npc_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)

	for i = 0, self.npc_list.Count - 1 do
		if self.npc_list[i] ~= nil then
			if i ~= self.npc_index.lilith and i ~= self.npc_index.secretary and i ~= self.npc_index.architect then
				all_npc_num = all_npc_num + 1

				all_npc_list:Add(self.npc_list[i])
			end
		end
	end

	-- 플레이어 오브젝트가 존재하면 그 곳에도 NPC들이 붙어야 함
	if use_player_obj then
		npc_obj_npc_num = math.floor(all_npc_num * cur_obj_pos_list.Count / (cur_obj_pos_list.Count + 1))
		player_obj_npc_num = all_npc_num - npc_obj_npc_num

		for i = 0, all_npc_list.Count - 1 do
			if i < npc_obj_npc_num then
				npc_obj_npc_list:Add(all_npc_list[i])
			else
				player_obj_npc_list:Add(all_npc_list[i])
			end
		end
	else
		for i = 0, all_npc_list.Count - 1 do
			npc_obj_npc_list:Add(all_npc_list[i])
		end
	end

	-- 각 오브젝트에 NPC들이 붙어 있는 수 저장 테이블
	local npc_num_table = {}
	for i = 1, cur_obj_pos_list.Count do
		npc_num_table[i] = 0
	end

	for i = 0, npc_obj_npc_list.Count - 1 do
		local cur_obj_pos_index = i % cur_obj_pos_list.Count

		local cur_obj_num = npc_num_table[cur_obj_pos_index + 1]

function local_class:move_npc_pushable_object(push_obj_list, move_pos, duration, no_player, crowd_sfx)
	is_no_player = lua_helper.get_or_default(no_player, false)
	is_crowd_sfx = lua_helper.get_or_default(crowd_sfx, false)

	local timer = 0

	local crowd_sfx_timer = 0
	local crowd_sfx_duration = 3

	local start_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	for i = 0, push_obj_list.Count - 1 do
		start_pos_list:Add(push_obj_list[i].Position)
	end

	local end_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	for i = 0, push_obj_list.Count - 1 do
		end_pos_list:Add(push_obj_list[i].Position + move_pos)
	end

	local start_npc_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	for i = 0, self.npc_list.Count - 1 do
		if self.npc_list[i] ~= nil then
			start_npc_pos_list:Add(self.npc_list[i].Position)
		else
			start_npc_pos_list:Add(vector(999, 0, 999))
		end
	end

	local start_player_pos = get_party_leader().Position

	local push_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = "01_push_rock_unit_04", volume = 0.5, loop = true, type_priority = 'event' })

	while timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		crowd_sfx_timer = crowd_sfx_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local dist = move_pos / duration * unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 바리케이드 이동
		for i = 0, push_obj_list.Count - 1 do
			push_obj_list[i].Position = push_obj_list[i].Position + dist
		end

		-- NPC 이동
		for i = 0, self.npc_list.Count - 1 do
			if self.npc_list[i] ~= nil then
				if i ~= self.npc_index.lilith and i ~= self.npc_index.secretary and i ~= self.npc_index.architect then
					self.npc_list[i].Position = self.npc_list[i].Position + dist
				end
			end
		end

		-- 플레이어 이동
		if not is_no_player then
			get_party_leader().Position = get_party_leader().Position + dist
		end

		if is_crowd_sfx then
			if crowd_sfx_timer >= crowd_sfx_duration then
				crowd_sfx_timer = 0

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_07')
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	push_sfx:FadeOut()

	for i = 0, push_obj_list.Count - 1 do
		push_obj_list[i].Position = end_pos_list[i]
	end

	for i = 0, self.npc_list.Count - 1 do
		if self.npc_list[i] ~= nil then
			if i ~= self.npc_index.lilith and i ~= self.npc_index.secretary and i ~= self.npc_index.architect then
				self.npc_list[i].Position = start_npc_pos_list[i] + move_pos
				character_util.remove_anim(self.npc_list[i])
			end
		end
	end

	if not is_no_player then
		get_party_leader().Position = start_player_pos + move_pos
		character_util.remove_anim(get_party_leader())
	end
end

function local_class:bullet_wild_shot_to_barricade(shooter_list)
	local targets = {}
	local barricade_num = 3

	-- 플레이어가 민 가장 우측 오브젝트만 흔들림
	local most_right_obj_player = nil
	local second_right_obj_player = nil

	if self.player_pushable_objs[3].move_finished then
		most_right_obj_player = self.player_pushable_objs[3].field_object

		if self.player_pushable_objs[1].move_finished then
			second_right_obj_player = self.player_pushable_objs[1].field_object
		elseif self.player_pushable_objs[2].move_finished then
			second_right_obj_player = self.player_pushable_objs[2].field_object
		else
			second_right_obj_player = get_field_object(self.extra_pushable_obj_name)
		end
	elseif self.player_pushable_objs[1].move_finished then
		most_right_obj_player = self.player_pushable_objs[1].field_object

		if self.player_pushable_objs[2].move_finished then
			second_right_obj_player = self.player_pushable_objs[2].field_object
		else
			second_right_obj_player = get_field_object(self.extra_pushable_obj_name)
		end
	else
		most_right_obj_player = self.player_pushable_objs[2].field_object
		second_right_obj_player = get_field_object(self.extra_pushable_obj_name)
	end

	table.insert(targets, most_right_obj_player)
	most_right_obj_player:Shake(0.04, 99999)

	-- 우측 NPC 오브젝트만 흔들림
	table.insert(targets, self.npc_pushable_objs[1].field_object)
	self.npc_pushable_objs[1].field_object:Shake(0.04, 99999)

	table.insert(targets, self.npc_pushable_objs[2].field_object)
	self.npc_pushable_objs[2].field_object:Shake(0.04, 99999)

	for i = 0, self.terrorist_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(self.terrorist_list[i], { name = 'rifle_shoot' })
	end

	local index = 1

	local timer = 0
	local shoot_timer = 0
	local shoot_duration = 0.1

	local is_right_barricade_removed = false

	while self.is_wild_shot_to_barricade do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		shoot_timer = shoot_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if shoot_timer > shoot_duration then
			shoot_timer = 0

			local cur_target = targets[index]

			for i = 0, shooter_list.Count - 1 do
				if cur_target.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') then
					local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet[i + 1].transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

					local cur_x = cur_target.Bounds.size.x / 2
					local cur_z = unity_class.random.Range(-cur_target.Bounds.size.z / 2, cur_target.Bounds.size.z / 2)

					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.fire_bullet_effect, self, bullet_sprite,
									shooter_list[i].Bounds.center +
											CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(shooter_list[i].Direction) * 0.7,
									cur_target.Bounds.center + vector(cur_x, 0, cur_z), '02_gun_shoot_07'))
				end
			end

			if index < barricade_num then
				index = index + 1
			else
				index = 1
			end
		end

		if not is_right_barricade_removed and self.is_destroyed_right_barricade then
			is_right_barricade_removed = true

			table.remove(targets, 1)
			table.insert(targets, second_right_obj_player)

			second_right_obj_player:Shake(0.04, 99999)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 0, self.terrorist_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(self.terrorist_list[i], { name = 'rifle_idle' })
	end
end

			for j = 1, #battle_indexs do

			if not is_battle_npc then
				local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

				if self.npc_list[i].Position.x > -1.5 and self.npc_list[i].Position.x < 0.5 then

				else
					if math.abs(self.npc_list[i].Position.x + 1.5) <
							math.abs(self.npc_list[i].Position.x - 0.5) then
						first_x = unity_class.random.Range(-2, -0.5)
					else
						first_x = unity_class.random.Range(-0.5, 1)
					end
				end

				waypoint_list:Add(vector(first_x, 0, self.npc_list[i].Position.z))
				waypoint_list:Add(vector(first_x, 0, -10))

				character_util.set_anim(self.npc_list[i], { name = 'run' })
				character_util.move_waypoint(self.npc_list[i], waypoint_list, 6,
						true, 'stop', 'floor', 'down', true, 0,
						function(index)
							if index == waypoint_list.Count - 1 then
								local cur_marker = field:GetMarker(self.npc_list[i].Name .. self.npc_maginot_line_marker_name)

								coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
										util.cs_generator(self.wait_and_set_position, self, self.npc_list[i], cur_marker))
							end
						end

			end
		end
	end

function local_class:barricade_particle_fall_event(cur_obj, index)
	local particle_index_list = create_generic_list(CS.System.Single)

	if index == 0 then
		particle_index_list:Add(18)
		particle_index_list:Add(19)
	elseif index == 1 then
		particle_index_list:Add(1)
		particle_index_list:Add(2)
		particle_index_list:Add(3)
		particle_index_list:Add(4)
	elseif index == 2 then
		particle_index_list:Add(5)
		particle_index_list:Add(6)
		particle_index_list:Add(7)
		particle_index_list:Add(8)
		particle_index_list:Add(9)
	elseif index == 3 then
		particle_index_list:Add(10)
		particle_index_list:Add(11)
		particle_index_list:Add(12)
		particle_index_list:Add(13)
	elseif index == 4 then
		particle_index_list:Add(14)
		particle_index_list:Add(15)
		particle_index_list:Add(16)
		particle_index_list:Add(17)
	end

	local particle_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.FieldObject)
	for i = 0, particle_index_list.Count - 1 do
		particle_list:Add(get_field_object(self.barricade_particle_name .. math.floor(particle_index_list[i])))
	end

	local target_position_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	local start_position_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

	for i = 0, particle_list.Count - 1 do
		particle_list[i].Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5

		target_position_list:Add(particle_list[i].Position)

		local rand_x = unity_class.random.Range(-1, 1)
		local rand_z

		if index == 0 then
			rand_z = unity_class.random.Range(-0.5, 0.5)
		else
			rand_z = unity_class.random.Range(-1, 1)
		end

		particle_list[i].Position = cur_obj.Bounds.center + vector(rand_x, 0, rand_z)

		start_position_list:Add(particle_list[i].Position)

		stage_util.set_fo_active_state(particle_list[i].Name, 'enabled')
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_01')

	local timer = 0
	local fall_duration = 1.5

	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(6, 8, 0, 0)

	local start_rotation_x = 0
	local end_rotation_x = 360
	local start_rotation_y = 0
	local end_rotation_y = 360 * 3
	local start_rotation_z = 0
	local end_rotation_z = 360

	local start_scale = 0.5
	local end_scale = 1

	while timer < fall_duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = timer / fall_duration

		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		local cur_rotation_x = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_rotation_x, end_rotation_x, progress)
		local cur_rotation_y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_rotation_y, end_rotation_y, progress)
		local cur_rotation_z = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_rotation_z, end_rotation_z, progress)

		local cur_scale = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_scale, end_scale, progress)

		for i = 0, particle_list.Count - 1 do
			particle_list[i].Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(
					start_position_list[i], target_position_list[i], progress) + vector(0, dist_y, 0)
			particle_list[i].Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(
					cur_rotation_x, cur_rotation_y, cur_rotation_z)
			particle_list[i].Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * cur_scale
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = "03_mech_stomp_01", type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	for i = 0, particle_list.Count - 1 do
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(
				particle_list[i].Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(
				particle_list[i].Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

		particle_list[i].Position = target_position_list[i]
		particle_list[i].Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
		particle_list[i].Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	end
end

	self.stage_name = nil

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()

	self:setting()

	coroutine.yield(self:load_bullet())
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_event, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.npc_flags = nil
	self.npc_list = nil

	self.terrorist_list = nil
	self.super_terrorist_list = nil

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	self.custom_atlas = nil

	if self.pooled_bullet ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.pooled_bullet.gameObject)
		self.pooled_bullet = nil
	end

	if self.pooled_bullet_normal ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.pooled_bullet_normal.gameObject)
		self.pooled_bullet_normal = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		self:on_touch_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then
		self:on_damage_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		self:on_fo_destroyed_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown then
		self.qte_complete = true
	end

	if CS.Oak.InputManager.IsPC and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		self.qte_complete = true
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	for i = 0, self.terrorist_list.Count - 1 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.terrorist_list[i]) then
			-- 테러리스트 암살 시 한 방에 죽음
			local require_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Assassinate | CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee

			if e.Info.type & require_damage_type == require_damage_type then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
				damage_info.sender = self.terrorist_list[i]
				damage_info.target = self.terrorist_list[i]
				damage_info.damage = math.floor(self.terrorist_list[i].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 1.5)

				command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
			elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, get_party_leader()) then
				-- 암살 아니면 플레이어 죽는 연출
				if not self.is_detected_player then
					self.is_detected_player = true

					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.detect_game_over, self, e.Info.target, self.cur_leader)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_fo_destroyed_event(e)
	for i = 0, self.terrorist_list.Count - 1 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.terrorist_list[i]) then
			self.kill_num = self.kill_num + 1

			if self.kill_num >= self.kill_target[self.current_progress] then
				if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.player_turn then
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.trouble_shooter_event, self)

					self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1
				elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_state.trouble_shooter_turn then
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.mad_scientist_event, self)

					self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1
				elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_state.mad_scientist_turn then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.center_event, self))
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == self.detected_event_key then
		if not self.is_detected_player then
			self.is_detected_player = true

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.detect_game_over, self, e.Sender, self.cur_leader)
		end
	end
end

-- 총알 프리팹 로드
function local_class:load_bullet()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_projectile_preset)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.custom_sprite_preset)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.assassinate_effect_preset)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.assassinate_hit_effect_preset)

	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	-- 총알 프리로드
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
				self.custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				self.custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)

	self.pooled_bullet = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(
			self.custom_sprite_preset):Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)

	local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.6
	bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
	bullet_sprite.Atlas = self.custom_atlas

	bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'virus_bullet_2.png'
	bullet_sprite:Rebuild()

	self.pooled_bullet_normal = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(
			self.custom_sprite_preset):Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)

	local bullet_sprite_normal = self.pooled_bullet_normal.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	bullet_sprite_normal.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	bullet_sprite_normal.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	bullet_sprite_normal.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.6
	bullet_sprite_normal.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
	bullet_sprite_normal.Atlas = self.custom_atlas

	bullet_sprite_normal.SpriteName = 'sniper_shot_middle.png'
	bullet_sprite_normal:Rebuild()
end

-- 게임 시작 시 실행되는 이벤트
function local_class:start_event()
	-- 플레이어 설정
	self.saved_leader = get_party_leader()
	self.cur_leader = get_party_leader()

	-- 이 섹션부터 시작한 경우
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 13 then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		camera_util.move_async(vector(0, 0, 1), 0)

		local player_marker = field:GetMarker(self.battle_pos_marker_name..'player')

		character_util.set_position(get_party_leader(), player_marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(get_party_leader(), player_marker.direction)

		-- 연출용 테러리스트 설정
		for i = 0, 5 do
			local val = math.floor(i / 2)
			local mod = i % 2

			character_util.set_position(self.terrorist_list[i], vector(7 + val, 0, 1 - mod))
			character_util.set_direction(self.terrorist_list[i], 'left')
		end

		camera_util.shake(0.1, 2.5)

		screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
	end

end

-- 테러리스트 복구
function local_class:reset_character(cur_character, start_marker, position_reset)
	is_position_reset = lua_helper.get_or_default(position_reset, true)

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.heal = cur_character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.isRevive = true
	heal_info.sender = nil
	heal_info.target = cur_character
	heal_info.skipEffect = true

	command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)

	character_util.set_active_state(cur_character, 'enabled')

	if is_position_reset then
		character_util.set_position(cur_character, start_marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(cur_character, start_marker.direction)
	else
		character_util.set_position(cur_character, vector(999, 0, 999))
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(cur_character)
	character_util.remove_emotion(cur_character)
	character_util.spine_rotate(cur_character, 0, 0)
end

-- 플레이어 캐릭터가 발각되어서 게임 오버됨
function local_class:detect_game_over(cur_terrorist, detected_character)
	local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local sniper_pos = cur_terrorist.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0)
	local target_pos = detected_character.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0)

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(detected_character, get_party_leader()) then
		camera_util.move_async(detected_character.Position, 1)
	end

	character_util.look_at(cur_terrorist, detected_character)
	character_util.set_anim(cur_terrorist,
			{ name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false, next_anim = 'rifle_idle' })

	character_util.look_at(detected_character, cur_terrorist)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_01')

	bullet_sprite.transform.position = sniper_pos

	local look_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(target_pos - sniper_pos)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = look_rotation * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

	local move_distance = (sniper_pos - target_pos).magnitude
	local speed = 12

	local timer = 0
	local duration = move_distance / speed

	while timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local current_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(sniper_pos, target_pos, 1 - ((duration - timer) / duration))

		bullet_sprite.transform.position = current_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 피격
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_projectile_preset):Instantiate(
			detected_character.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	bullet_sprite.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(detected_character, 999999, unity_class.color.red, detected_character.Position)

	detected_character.SpineController:AddColor(detected_character.Name, unity_color({0, 0, 0, 1}), 1, 3)
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(
			detected_character, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(cur_terrorist.Direction).normalized * 0.3,
			0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(
			detected_character, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(
			detected_character, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
	character_util.set_side_direction(detected_character)
	character_util.set_anim(detected_character, { name = "dead", loop = false })
	character_util.set_emotion(detected_character, { name = "damaged" })

	wait_for_sec(3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	for i = 0, self.terrorist_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.convert_to_npc(self.terrorist_list[i])
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	detected_character.SpineController:RemoveColor(detected_character.Name, 0)

	local battle_marker

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(detected_character, self.saved_leader) then
		battle_marker = field:GetMarker(self.battle_pos_marker_name..'player')
	else
		battle_marker = field:GetMarker(self.battle_pos_marker_name..detected_character.Name)
	end

	character_util.set_position(detected_character, battle_marker.position)
	character_util.set_direction(detected_character, battle_marker.direction)

	character_util.remove_anim(detected_character)
	character_util.remove_emotion(detected_character)

	self.kill_num = 0

	-- 테러리스트 재설정
	self:set_terrorist(self.current_progress)

	stage_camera:SetTarget(get_party_leader())

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	self.is_detected_player = false
end

-- 총 발사 연출
function local_class:fire_bullet_effect(bullet_sprite, sniper_pos, target_pos, target, is_dead)
	bullet_sprite.transform.position = sniper_pos

	local look_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(target_pos - sniper_pos)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = look_rotation * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

	local move_distance = (sniper_pos - target_pos).magnitude
	local speed = 12

	local timer = 0
	local duration = move_distance / speed

	while timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local current_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(sniper_pos, target_pos, 1 - ((duration - timer) / duration))

		bullet_sprite.transform.position = current_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 피격
	music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = "02_hit_big_01", parent = target, max_distance = 7, type_priority = 'event' })

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(
			target.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	bullet_sprite.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	if not is_dead then
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(
				target, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(target.Direction).normalized * 0.1,
				0.05, 0.025)
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(
				target, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(
				target, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
	else
		character_util.air_spin(target, { offset = vector(1, 0, 0) })
	end
end

function local_class:add_pushable_obj(npc_index, direction, barricade_index, eat_delay, wait_delay, time)

	pushable_obj.cur_time = 0
	pushable_obj.time = time

	pushable_obj.npc = self.npc_list[npc_index]
	pushable_obj.field_object = get_field_object('s15_barricade_' .. barricade_index)

	pushable_obj.start_pos = field:GetMarker('s15_barricade_' .. barricade_index).position
	pushable_obj.end_pos = pushable_obj.start_pos + unity_class.vector3.forward * 2

	-- 도착하고 나서 딜레이 계산용
	pushable_obj.step = 0
	pushable_obj.eat_delay = eat_delay
	pushable_obj.wait_delay = wait_delay
	pushable_obj.delay = 0
	pushable_obj.direction = direction
	pushable_obj.throw_item = nil
	pushable_obj.throw_pos = nil

	table.insert(self.npc_pushable_objs, pushable_obj)
end

-- 액팅에 사용할 테러리스트들 프로젝타일 세팅
function local_class:set_acting_terrorist()
	self.shoot_helper_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.ShootHelper)
	self.attack_ranges = {}
	self.terrorist_list = {}

	-- 프로젝타일 스팩 세팅
	local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ProjectileData'):GetSpec('projectile_virus_bullet')
	local pattern_Info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo()
	pattern_Info.columns = 1
	pattern_Info.spreadDistance = 1
	pattern_Info.parallel = true

	-- 테러리스트 세팅
	for i = 1, self.chase_terrorist_count do
		local terrorist_data = {}
		local terrorist = get_character(self.terrorist_name .. i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(terrorist)

		-- 엔티티그룹만 적으로 바꾸고 암살 불가능하도록
		terrorist.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy
		stage.BattleManager:AddToNoAssassination(terrorist)

		-- 테러리스트 / 경로 / 죽었는지 판단 / hp /
		terrorist_data.state = self.act_terrorist_status.wait
		terrorist_data.terrorist = terrorist
		terrorist_data.waypoints = nil
		terrorist_data.waypoints_count = 1
		terrorist_data.duration = 0
		terrorist_data.delay = 0
		terrorist_data.hp = self.terrorist_hp

		-- 테러리스트 정보 넣기
		table.insert(self.terrorist_list, terrorist_data)

		-- 슈터 정보 넣기
		local shooter = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, terrorist)
		self.shoot_helper_list:Add(CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
				shooter, spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot, 0.8))

		-- 어택 레인지 세팅
		local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector2(30, 0))
		attack_range:Hide()
		table.insert(self.attack_ranges, attack_range)
	end

	-- 수상한 청년 세팅 (퀘스트 클리어 했을 때만)
	if self.npc_flags[self.npc_flag_index.fishy_youth] then
		self.fishy_youth = {}

		local fishy_youth = get_character('fishy_youth')
		fishy_youth.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'virus_rifle_1')
		stage.BattleManager:AddToNoAssassination(fishy_youth)

		self.fishy_youth.terrorist = fishy_youth
		self.fishy_youth.state = self.act_terrorist_status.wait
		self.fishy_youth.waypoints = nil
		self.fishy_youth.waypoints_count = 1
		self.fishy_youth.duration = 0
		self.fishy_youth.delay = 0
		self.fishy_youth.hp = self.terrorist_hp

		-- 아군일 때 정보
		self.fishy_youth.step = 0

		-- 슈터 정보 넣기
		local shooter = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, fishy_youth)
		self.youth_shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
				shooter, spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot, 0.8)

		-- 어택 레인지
		self.youth_attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector2(30, 0))
		self.youth_attack_range:Show()
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드
	-- 섹션 15 인트로 시작
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.intro, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.is_exit = true

	self.is_directing_beth = false
	self.is_acting = false

	for i = 0, self.npc_list.Count - 1 do
		if self.npc_list[i] ~= nil then
			character_util.stop_shake(self.npc_list[i])
		end
	end
	self.npc_list = nil

	for i = 1, #self.terrorist_list do
		-- 다른 섹션에서 사용할 수 있으니 엔티티그룹 및 암살 가능 여부 원복
		local terrorist = self.terrorist_list[i].terrorist
		terrorist.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral0
		stage.BattleManager:RemoveFromNoAssassination(terrorist)
	end
	self.terrorist_list = nil

	for i = 1, #self.npc_pushable_objs do
		local pushable_obj = self.npc_pushable_objs[i]

		pushable_obj.field_object:CancelShake()
		pushable_obj.field_object = nil

		character_util.stop_shake(pushable_obj.npc)
		pushable_obj.npc = nil

		-- 던지던 아이템 리셋
		if pushable_obj.throw_item ~= nil then
			pushable_obj.throw_item:ConsumeComplete()
			pushable_obj.throw_item = nil
		end
		pushable_obj.throw_pos = nil
	end
	self.npc_pushable_objs = nil

	self.pooled_bullet = nil
	self.pooled_bullet_normal = nil
	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	self:dispose_dead_maginot_line()
	self:dispose_throw_npc()
	self:dispose_crowd_sfx(0)
	self:dispose_equip_sfx()

	if self.attack_ranges ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.attack_ranges do
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_ranges[i])
		end
	end
	self.attack_ranges = nil

	-- 수상한 청년 세팅 되어있으면 해제
	if self.npc_flags[self.npc_flag_index.fishy_youth] and self.fishy_youth ~= nil then
		stage.BattleManager:RemoveFromNoAssassination(self.fishy_youth.terrorist)
		self.fishy_youth = nil
		self.youth_shoot_helper = nil
		if self.youth_attack_range ~= nil then
			self.youth_attack_range:Hide()
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.youth_attack_range)
		end
		self.youth_attack_range = nil
	end

	self.npc_flags = nil

	self.shoot_helper_list:Clear()
	self.shoot_helper_list = nil
	self.custom_atlas = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.stage_name = nil
end

--region Dispose

function local_class:dispose_dead_maginot_line()
	if self.dead_maginot_line == nil then
		return
	end

	self.dead_maginot_line:Hide()
	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.dead_maginot_line)
	self.dead_maginot_line = nil
end

-- 던지는 npc 정보 리셋
function local_class:dispose_throw_npc()
	if self.throw_npc_list == nil then
		return
	end

	for _, value in pairs(self.throw_npc_list) do
		self:drop_item_consume_complete(value)
		self:dispose_effect(value)
	end
	self.throw_npc_list = nil
end

function local_class:dispose_crowd_sfx(fade_time)
	if self.crowd_sfx == nil then
		return
	end

	if fade_time > 0 then
		self.crowd_sfx:FadeOut(fade_time)
	else
		self.crowd_sfx:Stop(0)
	end
	self.crowd_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:dispose_equip_sfx()
	if self.equip_sfx == nil then
		return
	end

	self.equip_sfx:Stop(0)
	self.equip_sfx = nil
end

--endregion

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if not self.is_acting then
		return false
	end

	if self.terrorist_list == nil then
		return false
	end

	-- 테러리스트들이 유저의 총알에 맞았을 때 스턴 상태로 변경
	for i = 1, #self.terrorist_list do
		local terrorist = self.terrorist_list[i].terrorist
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, terrorist)
				and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, get_party_leader())
				and self.act_terrorist_status.dead > self.terrorist_list[i].state then
			self:deduct_terrorist_hp(self.terrorist_list[i], true)
			return true
		end
	end

	-- 수상한 청년 체크
	if self.npc_flags[self.npc_flag_index.fishy_youth] then
		local fishy_youth = self.fishy_youth.terrorist
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, fishy_youth)
				and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, get_party_leader())
				and self.act_terrorist_status.dead > self.fishy_youth.state then
			self:deduct_terrorist_hp(self.fishy_youth, true)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_progress ~= self.progress_state.last_progress then
		return false
	end

	local window = get_field_object('s15_ending_window')
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, window) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ending, self, window)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.princess],
			{ key = self.main_script .. 7, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.princess])
	character_util.set_direction(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.trouble_shooter], 'up')

	invisible_block_1.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(15, 0, 1))

	local invisible_block_2 = get_field_object(self.invisible_block_name .. 2)

	invisible_block_2.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(15, 1, 1))

	field_ui_manager:Show()

-- 액팅 연출
function local_class:start_acting()
	-- 카메라를 특정 위치에 고정시킨다.
	camera_util.resize_to(5, 0.75)
	camera_util.move(vector(-0.5, 0, -25), 0.75)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party.Leader, 'up')
	self:wait_for_sec_routine(0.75)

	if self.is_exit then return end

	self.dead_maginot_line = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(
			self.obj_target_pos + vector(0, 0.001, 0), self.obj_target_size,
			CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 53, 70, 76), CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 53, 70, 153))

	self.dead_maginot_line:Show()

	-- pushable 움직이는 npc들 shake 및 애니메이션 변경
	for i = 1, #self.npc_pushable_objs do
		local pushable_obj = self.npc_pushable_objs[i]

		pushable_obj.field_object:Shake(0.04, 99999)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pushable_obj.npc)
		character_util.set_direction(pushable_obj.npc, 'up')
		character_util.set_anim(pushable_obj.npc, { name = 'push' })
		character_util.shake(pushable_obj.npc, 0.04, 99999)
	end

	-- 테러리스트 리젠 시간
	local cur_respawn_time = self.respawn_time

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.is_acting = true
	self.is_fail_acting = false

	while self.is_acting and self.time_passed <= self.acting_time do
		if not self.is_fail_acting then
			local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
			self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

			-- 수상한 청년이 활성화 되어 있을 때, 일정 시간이 지나면 수상한 청년이 등장한다.
			if self.npc_flags[self.npc_flag_index.fishy_youth] and not self.is_show_fishy_youth then
				if self.time_passed > self.show_fishy_youth_time then
					-- 수상한 청년 세팅
					self.is_show_fishy_youth = true
					self:set_fishy_youth()
				end
			end

			-- 일정 시간 마다 대기중인 테러리스트를 활성화 시킨다.
			cur_respawn_time = cur_respawn_time + dt
			if cur_respawn_time >= self.respawn_time then
				cur_respawn_time = 0
				self:activate_waiting_terrorist()
			end

			-- 테러리스트 로직
			self:terrorist_routine(dt)

			-- 수상한 청년 로직이 활성화 되어 있다면 돈다.
			if self.is_show_fishy_youth then
				self:fishy_youth_routine(dt)
			end

			-- 밀고서 돌 던지는 행동 루틴
			self:pushable_routine(dt)

			-- 생존자 로직 2초 지나고 부터 돈다.
			if self.time_passed > 2 then
				-- 베스 연출
				if self.npc_flags[self.npc_flag_index.beth] then
					-- 베스 가운데 찍는 연출 시작
					if self.time_passed >= 5.5 and self.beth_attack_count == 0 then
						self.throw_npc_list.beth.step = 1
					elseif self.time_passed >= 20 and self.beth_attack_count == 1 then
						self.throw_npc_list.beth.step = 1
					elseif self.time_passed >= 32 and self.beth_attack_count == 2 then
						self.throw_npc_list.beth.step = 1
					end
					self:beth_routine(dt)
				end

				-- 공주 연출
				self:princess_routine(dt)

				-- 기본 npc 연출
				self:default_npc_routine(dt)
			end
		else
			if cur_respawn_time < self.respawn_time then
				cur_respawn_time = self.respawn_time
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.is_acting = false
	if self.is_exit then return end

	self:dispose_dead_maginot_line()
	for _, value in pairs(self.throw_npc_list) do
		self:drop_item_consume_complete(value)
		self:dispose_effect(value)
	end

	-- 액팅 종료 및 이벤트 이후 다음 섹션으로
	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.end_acting, self)
end

-- start_acting()에서 시간 처리까지 전부 하고 있기 때문에 여기서는 그냥 타이머 끄기만 함
function local_class:timer_finished()
	timer_util.end_timer(self, true)
end

--region 테러리스트 로직

-- 수상한 청년 세팅
function local_class:set_fishy_youth()
	-- 수상한 청년이 삐졌다면 테러리스트 세팅
	if self.is_up_set_fishy_youth then
		-- 좌표 세팅
		local rnd_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, 2)
		character_util.set_position(self.fishy_youth.terrorist, self.get_respawn_marker(rnd_index).position)

		-- 랜덤한 위치로 이동
		rnd_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, 2)
		local rnd_pos = field:GetMarker('s15_terrorist_random_' .. random_util.get_random_int(1, 3)).position
		self.fishy_youth.waypoints = self:get_terrorist_path(self.fishy_youth.terrorist, rnd_pos)
		self.fishy_youth.waypoints_count = 1
		self.fishy_youth.path_find_count = 1

		self.fishy_youth.duration = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(2.5, 3)
		self.fishy_youth.delay = 0
		self.fishy_youth.hp = self.terrorist_hp
		self.fishy_youth.terrorist.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy
	else
		-- 안삐졌다면 자리 위치만 고정으로 세팅
		self.fishy_youth.terrorist.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral0
		character_util.set_position(self.fishy_youth.terrorist
		, self.get_respawn_marker(1).position + vector(0.5, 0, 0))
		self.fishy_youth.hp = 1
	end

	self.is_dead_fishy_youth = false
	self.fishy_youth.state = self.act_terrorist_status.move
	character_util.remove_anim(self.fishy_youth.terrorist)
	character_util.set_active_state(self.fishy_youth.terrorist, 'enabled')
end

-- 수상한 청년
function local_class:fishy_youth_routine(dt)
	if self.is_up_set_fishy_youth then
		-- 삐졌을 때 루틴, 일반 테러리스트와 동일
		if self.fishy_youth.state ~= self.act_terrorist_status.wait then
			local terrorist = self.fishy_youth.terrorist

			self.fishy_youth.delay = self.fishy_youth.delay + dt

			if self.fishy_youth.state == self.act_terrorist_status.move then
				if self.fishy_youth.waypoints_count > #self.fishy_youth.waypoints then
					if self.fishy_youth.path_find_count <= 0 then
						local goal_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, 2)
						local pos = field:GetMarker('s15_terrorist_goal_' .. goal_index).position
						self.fishy_youth.near_target_index = goal_index == 1
								and self.npc_index.android_engineer or self.npc_index.trouble_shooter
						self.fishy_youth.waypoints = self:get_terrorist_path(terrorist, pos)
						self.fishy_youth.waypoints_count = 1
						self.fishy_youth.path_find_count = 1
					else
						-- 베스가 활성화 되어 있으면 베스 공격하며 해당 테러리스트 사망
						if self.cur_beth_state <= self.beth_state.use then
							self.cur_beth_state = self.beth_state.use
							if self.throw_npc_list.beth.step <= 0 then
								self.throw_npc_list.beth.step = 1
							end
							if not self.act_terrorist_status.beth_directing then
								self.fishy_youth.state = self.act_terrorist_status.beth_directing
								character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'rifle_reload', sfx_name = '02_gun_reload_02'
								, loop = false, next_anim = 'rifle_idle' })
							end
						else
							if self.fishy_youth.near_target_index == nil then
								self.fishy_youth.near_target_index = 1
							end

							local target = self.npc_list[self.fishy_youth.near_target_index]
							coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.acting_near_game_over
							, self, terrorist, self.youth_attack_range, target
							, self.fishy_youth.near_target_index == self.npc_index.android_engineer))
						end
					end
				else
					-- 움직이는 상태
					self.fishy_youth.state = self.act_terrorist_status.moving
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_to, self, self.fishy_youth))
				end
			elseif self.fishy_youth.state == self.act_terrorist_status.moving then
				if self.fishy_youth.delay >= self.fishy_youth.duration then
					self.fishy_youth.state = self.act_terrorist_status.lock_on
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
						-- 어택 레인지 세팅
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_targeted_03')
						character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false })
						local attack_range = self.youth_attack_range
						attack_range:Show(0)
						attack_range:SetAlpha(0.5)

						-- n초간 플레이어를 조준하고 있는다.
						local target_direction = nil
						local attack_time_passed = 0
						while attack_time_passed < self.lock_on_time do
							if self.fishy_youth.state >= self.act_terrorist_status.dead
									or self.is_fail_acting or not self.is_acting then
								break
							end

							attack_time_passed = attack_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
							target_direction = vector_util.get_x0z(get_party_leader().Bounds.center
									- terrorist.Bounds.center).normalized

							attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(attack_range, terrorist.Bounds.center, target_direction, 0.05)

							coroutine.yield(nil)
						end
						attack_range:Hide()

						-- 엑트 실패거나 테러리스트의 스턴 상태일 경우 그냥 탈출
						if self.is_fail_acting or not self.is_acting
								or self.fishy_youth.state >= self.act_terrorist_status.dead then
							return
						end

						-- ShootHelper 통해 프로젝타일 발사
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_09')
						self.youth_shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(
								terrorist.Bounds.center, target_direction, 999, -1, nil, false, 0)

						-- 쏘고 난 뒤 스테이트 변경
						character_util.remove_anim(terrorist)
						self.fishy_youth.delay = 0
						self.fishy_youth.duration = self:get_terrorist_duration()
						self.fishy_youth.state = self.act_terrorist_status.move
					end))
				end
			elseif self.fishy_youth.state == self.act_terrorist_status.stun then
				if self.fishy_youth.delay > self.stun_time then
					self.fishy_youth.delay = 0
					self.fishy_youth.state = self.act_terrorist_status.move
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(terrorist)
				end
			elseif self.fishy_youth.state == self.act_terrorist_status.dead then
				self.fishy_youth.state = self.act_terrorist_status.directing_dead
				self.is_dead_fishy_youth = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
					-- 사라지는 연출 이후에 999로 날리고 wait 상태로 변경
					terrorist.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral0
					character_util.air_spin(terrorist)
					self:wait_for_sec_routine(1)
					if self.is_exit then return end
					self.fishy_youth.state = self.act_terrorist_status.wait
				end))
			end
		end
	else
		local fishy_youth = self.fishy_youth.terrorist
		self.fishy_youth.delay = self.fishy_youth.delay + dt

		-- 뛰어오는 연출 추가
		if self.fishy_youth.step == 0 then
			-- 수상한 청년 내려옴
			self.fishy_youth.delay = 0
			self.fishy_youth.step = 1
			character_util.set_anim(fishy_youth, { name = 'rifle_run' })
			character_util.move_to(fishy_youth
			, vector(-0.5, 0, -22), 2.5, nil, true, false)
		elseif self.fishy_youth.step == 1 then
			if self.fishy_youth.delay >= 2.5 then
				self.fishy_youth.delay = 0
				self.fishy_youth.step = 2
				character_util.set_anim(fishy_youth, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
				character_util.show_emoticon(fishy_youth, nil, 'silence')
			end
		elseif self.fishy_youth.step == 2 then
			if self.fishy_youth.delay >= 2 then
				self.fishy_youth.delay = 0
				self.fishy_youth.step = 3
				character_util.set_anim(fishy_youth, { name = 'rifle_walk' })
				character_util.move_to(fishy_youth
				, vector(-0.5, 0, -21.5), 0.5, nil, false, false)
			end
		elseif self.fishy_youth.step == 3 then
			if self.fishy_youth.delay >= 0.5 then
				self.fishy_youth.delay = 0
				self.fishy_youth.step = 4
				character_util.set_anim(fishy_youth, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
				character_util.show_emoticon(fishy_youth, nil, 'annoyed')
			end
		elseif self.fishy_youth.step == 4 then
			if self.fishy_youth.delay >= 2.2 then
				self.fishy_youth.delay = 0
				self.fishy_youth.step = 5
				character_util.set_anim(fishy_youth, { name = 'rifle_walk' })
				character_util.move_to(fishy_youth
				, vector(-0.5, 0, -22), 0.5, nil, true, false)
			end
		elseif self.fishy_youth.step == 5 then
			if self.fishy_youth.delay >= 0.5 then
				self.fishy_youth.delay = 0
				self.fishy_youth.step = 6
				character_util.set_direction(fishy_youth, 'left')
				character_util.move_to(fishy_youth
				, vector(-3.5, 0, -22), 1.5, nil, true, false)
			end

		elseif self.fishy_youth.step == 6 then
			if self.fishy_youth.delay >= 1.5 then
				self.fishy_youth.delay = 0
				self.fishy_youth.step = 7
				character_util.set_direction(fishy_youth, 'down')
				character_util.move_to(fishy_youth
				, vector(-3.5, 0, -23), 0.5, nil, true, false)
			end
		elseif self.fishy_youth.step == 7 then
			if self.fishy_youth.delay >= 0.5 then
				self.fishy_youth.delay = 0
				self.fishy_youth.step = 8
				character_util.set_direction(fishy_youth, 'left')
				character_util.move_to(fishy_youth
				, vector(-6, 0, -23), 1.35, nil, true, false)
			end
		elseif self.fishy_youth.step == 8 then
			if self.fishy_youth.delay >= 1.35 then
				self.fishy_youth.delay = 0
				self.fishy_youth.step = 9
				character_util.set_direction(fishy_youth, 'up')
				character_util.move_to(fishy_youth
				, vector(-6, 0, -22), 0.5, nil, true, false)
			end
		elseif self.fishy_youth.step == 9 then
			if self.fishy_youth.delay >= 0.5 then
				-- 수상한 청년 시작 지점으로 이동
				self.fishy_youth.delay = 0
				self.fishy_youth.step = 10
				character_util.set_direction(fishy_youth, 'left')
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(fishy_youth, { name = 'seat' }, { name = 'tired' })
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 테러리스트
function local_class:terrorist_routine(dt)
	-- 활성화 된 테러리스트들 로직 돌도록
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	for i = 1, #self.terrorist_list do
		if self.terrorist_list[i].state ~= self.act_terrorist_status.wait then
			local terrorist = self.terrorist_list[i].terrorist
			self.terrorist_list[i].delay = self.terrorist_list[i].delay + dt

			if self.terrorist_list[i].state == self.act_terrorist_status.move then
				-- waypoints_count가 waypoints의 갯수보다 커질 경우 도착지점에 도착한 것이므로 게임오버 혹은 베스 공격
				if self.terrorist_list[i].waypoints_count > #self.terrorist_list[i].waypoints then
					if self.terrorist_list[i].path_find_count <= 0 then
						local goal_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, 2)
						local pos = field:GetMarker('s15_terrorist_goal_' .. goal_index).position
						self.terrorist_list[i].near_target_index = goal_index == 1
								and self.npc_index.android_engineer or self.npc_index.trouble_shooter
						self.terrorist_list[i].waypoints = self:get_terrorist_path(terrorist, pos)
						self.terrorist_list[i].waypoints_count = 1
						self.terrorist_list[i].path_find_count = 1
					else
						-- 베스가 활성화 되어 있으면 베스 공격하며 해당 테러리스트 사망
						if self.cur_beth_state > self.beth_state.de_active and
								self.cur_beth_state <= self.beth_state.use then
							self.cur_beth_state = self.beth_state.use
							if self.throw_npc_list.beth.step <= 0 then
								self.throw_npc_list.beth.step = 1
							end
							if not self.act_terrorist_status.beth_directing then
								self.terrorist_list[i].state = self.act_terrorist_status.beth_directing
								character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'rifle_reload', sfx_name = '02_gun_reload_02'
								, loop = false, next_anim = 'rifle_idle' })
							end
						else
							local target = self.npc_list[self.terrorist_list[i].near_target_index]
							coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.acting_near_game_over
							, self, terrorist, self.attack_ranges[i], target
							, self.terrorist_list[i].near_target_index == self.npc_index.android_engineer))
						end
					end
					break
				end
				-- 움직이는 상태
				self.terrorist_list[i].state = self.act_terrorist_status.moving
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_to, self, self.terrorist_list[i]))
			elseif self.terrorist_list[i].state == self.act_terrorist_status.moving then
				if self.terrorist_list[i].delay >= self.terrorist_list[i].duration then
					-- 록온 상태
					self.terrorist_list[i].state = self.act_terrorist_status.lock_on
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lock_on_routine
					, self, i))
				end
			elseif self.terrorist_list[i].state == self.act_terrorist_status.stun then
				-- 스턴 시간 끝나면 move 상태로 변경한다.
				if self.terrorist_list[i].delay > self.stun_time then
					self.terrorist_list[i].delay = 0
					self.terrorist_list[i].state = self.act_terrorist_status.move
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(terrorist)
				end
			elseif self.terrorist_list[i].state == self.act_terrorist_status.dead then
				self.terrorist_list[i].state = self.act_terrorist_status.directing_dead
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
					-- 사라지는 연출 이후에 999로 날리고 wait 상태로 변경
					terrorist.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral0
					character_util.air_spin(terrorist)
					self:wait_for_sec_routine(1)
					if self.is_exit then return end
					self.terrorist_list[i].state = self.act_terrorist_status.wait
				end))
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 테러리스트 이동 함수
function local_class:move_to(terrorist_info)
	local terrorist = terrorist_info.terrorist

	local start_pos = terrorist.Position
	local target_pos = terrorist_info.waypoints[terrorist_info.waypoints_count]

	if target_pos ~= start_pos then
		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - start_pos)
		local magnitude = vector_util.magnitude(vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - start_pos))
		local duration = magnitude / self.move_speed
		terrorist.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(diff)
		character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'rifle_walk' })

		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < duration do
			if self.is_exit then return end
			if not self.is_acting or self.is_fail_acting
					or terrorist_info.state ~= self.act_terrorist_status.moving then
				break
			end

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			terrorist.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	-- 도착했으면 카운트 올려주고 move상태로 바꿈
	if terrorist_info.state == self.act_terrorist_status.moving then
		terrorist_info.state = self.act_terrorist_status.move
		terrorist_info.waypoints_count = terrorist_info.waypoints_count + 1
	end
end

-- 대기중인 테러리스트를 활성화 시킨다.
function local_class:activate_waiting_terrorist()
	for i = 1, #self.terrorist_list do
		if self.terrorist_list[i].state == self.act_terrorist_status.wait then
			local terrorist_data = self.terrorist_list[i]
			terrorist_data.terrorist.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy

			local rnd_pos = vector(CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-2, 1), 0, -18.7)
			character_util.set_position(terrorist_data.terrorist, rnd_pos)
			rnd_pos = vector(CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-2, 1), 0, CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-24.8, -22.5))
			terrorist_data.waypoints = self:get_terrorist_path(terrorist_data.terrorist, rnd_pos)

			terrorist_data.waypoints_count = 1
			terrorist_data.duration = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(2.5, 3)
			terrorist_data.path_find_count = 0
			terrorist_data.delay = 0
			terrorist_data.hp = self.terrorist_hp

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(terrorist_data.terrorist)
			character_util.set_active_state(terrorist_data.terrorist, 'enabled')
			terrorist_data.state = self.act_terrorist_status.move
			break
		end
	end
end

-- 테러리스트 경로 받아오기
function local_class:get_terrorist_path(terrorist, target_pos)
	-- 패스파인더로 길을 찾음
	local plan_path
	local plan_path_done = false
	field.PathFinder:FindNormalPath(terrorist, target_pos, 100, terrorist, 0, nil
	, function(path, req_key)
				if req_key == 0 then
					plan_path_done = true
					plan_path = path
				end
			end)

	-- 길을 찾을 때까지 대기
	while not plan_path_done do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 찾은 길 정보 return
	local path_list = {}
	for i = 0, plan_path.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(path_list, plan_path[i])
	end
	table.insert(path_list, target_pos)

	return path_list
end

-- 테러리스트가 록온 하는 루틴
function local_class:lock_on_routine(index)
	local terrorist = self.terrorist_list[index].terrorist

	-- 어택 레인지 세팅
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_targeted_03')
	character_util.set_direction(terrorist, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false })
	local attack_range = self.attack_ranges[index]
	attack_range:Show(0)
	attack_range:SetAlpha(0.5)

	-- n초간 플레이어를 조준하고 있는다.
	local target_direction = nil
	local attack_time_passed = 0
	while attack_time_passed < self.lock_on_time do
		if self.is_fail_acting or not self.is_acting then
			break
		end

		if self.terrorist_list[index].state >= self.act_terrorist_status.dead then
			break
		end

		attack_time_passed = attack_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		target_direction = vector_util.get_x0z(get_party_leader().Bounds.center - terrorist.Bounds.center).normalized

		attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(attack_range, terrorist.Bounds.center, target_direction, 0.05)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	attack_range:Hide()

	-- 엑트 실패거나 테러리스트의 스턴 상태일 경우 그냥 탈출
	if self.is_fail_acting or not self.is_acting
			or self.terrorist_list[index].state >= self.act_terrorist_status.dead then
		return
	end

	-- ShootHelper 통해 프로젝타일 발사
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_09')
	self.shoot_helper_list[index - 1]:ShootDirectionAtPosition(
			terrorist.Bounds.center, target_direction, 999, -1, nil, false, 0)

	-- 쏘고 난 뒤 스테이트 변경
	character_util.remove_anim(terrorist)
	self.terrorist_list[index].delay = 0
	self.terrorist_list[index].duration = self:get_terrorist_duration()
	self.terrorist_list[index].state = self.act_terrorist_status.move
end

-- 테러리스트 총알 처리
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	-- 이미 액트 실패일 때는 체크 할 필요 없음
	if self.is_fail_acting then
		return true
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, leader) then
		-- 게임오버 연출
		if not lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
				CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) then
			self.is_fail_acting = true
			self:get_fx_virus_target_hit():Instantiate(move_info.position + vector(0, 0.2, 0))
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.acting_game_over
			, self, nil, leader))
		end
	else
		self:get_fx_virus_hit():Instantiate(move_info.position + vector(0, 0.2, 0))
	end
	return true
end
