-- 미는 연출을 하는 npc 연출용 (소매치기, 안드로이드 그룹 / 미화원 그룹)
function local_class:pushable_npc_directing(index, dt)
	local pushable_obj = self.npc_pushable_objs[index]

	if pushable_obj.is_arrive then
		pushable_obj.delay = pushable_obj.delay + dt
		if pushable_obj.step == 0 then
			-- eat 모션으로 변경
			pushable_obj.delay = 0
			pushable_obj.step = 1
			character_util.set_direction(pushable_obj.npc, pushable_obj.direction)
			character_util.set_anim(pushable_obj.npc, { name = 'eat' })
		elseif pushable_obj.step == 1 then
			-- eat delay 가 다 되었으니 돌 던진다.
			if pushable_obj.delay >= pushable_obj.eat_delay then
				pushable_obj.delay = 0
				pushable_obj.step = 2
				character_util.set_direction(pushable_obj.npc, 'up')
				if self.current_progress <= self.progress_state.acting then
					music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_throw_01', loop = false
					, play_pos = pushable_obj.npc.Position })
				end
				character_util.set_anim(pushable_obj.npc, { name = 'throw', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })
				pushable_obj.throw_pos = self:get_random_throw_pos()
				pushable_obj.throw_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
					pos = pushable_obj.npc.Position, target = pushable_obj.throw_pos, showoncharacter = true,
					itemid = 20019, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', spr_scale = 0.5, skip_text = true })
				pushable_obj.throw_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = vector(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)
				pushable_obj.throw_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = vector(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)
			end
		elseif pushable_obj.step == 2 then
			-- 돌 터진다.
			if pushable_obj.delay >= 0.75 then
				pushable_obj.delay = 0
				pushable_obj.step = 3
				pushable_obj.throw_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
				pushable_obj.throw_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
				pushable_obj.throw_item:ConsumeComplete()
				pushable_obj.throw_item = nil
				self:check_attack_point(pushable_obj.throw_pos)
				if self.current_progress <= self.progress_state.acting then
					music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_projectile_01', loop = false
					, play_pos = pushable_obj.throw_pos })
				end
				self:get_fx_hit():Instantiate(pushable_obj.throw_pos + vector(0, 0.2, 0))
			end
		elseif pushable_obj.step == 3 then
			-- 잠시 대기
			if pushable_obj.delay >= pushable_obj.wait_delay then
				pushable_obj.delay = 0
				pushable_obj.step = 0
				character_util.remove_anim(pushable_obj.npc)
			end
		end
	else
		if pushable_obj.cur_time >= pushable_obj.time then
			-- 시간 다되었으면 도착
			pushable_obj.field_object:CancelShake()
			character_util.stop_shake(pushable_obj.npc)
			pushable_obj.is_arrive = true
		else
			-- 푸셔블을 미는 연출
			pushable_obj.cur_time = pushable_obj.cur_time + dt
			local progress = pushable_obj.cur_time / pushable_obj.time
			local target_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pushable_obj.start_pos, pushable_obj.end_pos, progress)
			pushable_obj.field_object.Position = target_pos
			character_util.set_position(pushable_obj.npc, target_pos + unity_class.vector3.back)
		end
	end
end

-- 경관 연출 (살렸을 때만)
function local_class:police_routine(dt)
	self.throw_npc_list.police_officer.delay = self.throw_npc_list.police_officer.delay + dt

		-- 총알 한방 발사
		character_util.set_direction(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.police_officer], 'up')
		character_util.set_anim(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.police_officer], { name = 'handgun_attack', loop = false })
		self:reset_npc_step(self.throw_npc_list.police_officer, 99)
		local attack_point = self:get_random_throw_pos(-3.5, -0.5)

		local xd = (attack_point.x - self.npc_list[self.npc_index.police_officer].Position.x)
		local zd = (attack_point.z - self.npc_list[self.npc_index.police_officer].Position.z)

			local xd = (attack_point.x - self.npc_list[self.npc_index.police_officer].Position.x)
			local zd = (attack_point.z - self.npc_list[self.npc_index.police_officer].Position.z)

			local angle = rad * 100
			local dir = angle >= 45 and 'right' or 'up'
			character_util.set_direction(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.police_officer], dir)
			local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet_normal.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
			local add_pos = dir == 'right' and vector(0.2, 0.1, 0.3) or vector(0, 0.1, 0.3)
			local shot_pos = self.npc_list[self.npc_index.police_officer].Position + add_pos
			local is_play_sfx = self.current_progress <= self.progress_state.acting
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fire_bullet_effect
			, self, bullet_sprite, shot_pos, attack_point, is_play_sfx and '02_gun_shoot_01' or nil,
					false, function()
						if not self.is_exit and self.throw_npc_list ~= nil then
							self:check_attack_point(attack_point, true)
							self.get_gunshot_groundhit():Instantiate(attack_point + vector(0, 0.2, 0))

-- 베스 연출
function local_class:beth_routine(dt)
	self.throw_npc_list.beth.delay = self.throw_npc_list.beth.delay + dt
	if self.throw_npc_list.beth.step == 0 then
		-- 베스 공중 점프
		if self.throw_npc_list.beth.delay >= 0.5 then
			self:reset_npc_step(self.throw_npc_list.beth, -1)
			character_util.set_direction(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth], 'up')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth])
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.beth_jump
			, self, self.beth_target_pos))
		end
	elseif self.throw_npc_list.beth.step == 1 then
		-- 내려 찍기
		self.beth_attack_count = self.beth_attack_count + 1
		self:reset_npc_step(self.throw_npc_list.beth, 2)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.play_beth_stomp_attack
		, self, self.beth_target_pos))
	elseif self.throw_npc_list.beth.step == 2 then
		-- 사망 판정
		if self.throw_npc_list.beth.delay >= 0.2 then
			self:reset_npc_step(self.throw_npc_list.beth, 3)

			local terrorist_count = 0
			for i = 1, #self.terrorist_list do
				if self.act_terrorist_status.dead > self.terrorist_list[i].state then
					self.terrorist_list[i].state = self.act_terrorist_status.dead
					terrorist_count = terrorist_count + 1
				end
			end

			-- 수상한 청년 삐졌으면 공격 체크
			if self.npc_flags[self.npc_flag_index.fishy_youth] and self.is_up_set_fishy_youth then
				if self.act_terrorist_status.dead > self.fishy_youth.state then
					self.fishy_youth.state = self.act_terrorist_status.dead
					terrorist_count = terrorist_count + 1
				end
			end

			if terrorist_count > 1 then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_victim_scream_02')
			end

			if self.cur_beth_state == self.beth_state.use then
				self.cur_beth_state = self.beth_state.used
				self:reset_npc_step(self.throw_npc_list.beth, 4)
			else
				self:reset_npc_step(self.throw_npc_list.beth, 3)
			end
		end
	elseif self.throw_npc_list.beth.step == 3 then
		if self.throw_npc_list.beth.delay >= 1 then
			self:reset_npc_step(self.throw_npc_list.beth, 0)
		end
	elseif self.throw_npc_list.beth.step == 4 then
		if self.throw_npc_list.beth.delay >= 0.6 then
			self:reset_npc_step(self.throw_npc_list.beth, 3)
			character_util.remove_anim(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth])
			character_util.set_direction(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth], 'right')
			character_util.set_anim(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth], { name = 'release' })
			-- 한눈 팔지마!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth],
					{ key = self.main_script .. 52, bubble_direction = 'lb', life_time = 1 })
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_attack_point(attack_point, is_dead)
	if self.current_progress >= self.progress_state.acting_end then
		return
	end

	if self.terrorist_list == nil then
		return
	end

	is_dead = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_dead, false)
	-- 테러리스트들이 공격 지점에 있었다면 데미지를 준다.
	for i = 1, #self.terrorist_list do
		local terrorist = self.terrorist_list[i].terrorist

		if (attack_point - terrorist.Position).magnitude < 1 and
				self.act_terrorist_status.dead > self.terrorist_list[i].state then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', loop = false
			, play_pos = attack_point })
			self:deduct_terrorist_hp(self.terrorist_list[i], is_dead)
			break
		end
	end
end

function local_class:drop_item_consume_complete(throw_npc)
	if throw_npc.throw_item == nil then
		return
	end

	throw_npc.throw_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	throw_npc.throw_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

	throw_npc.throw_item:ConsumeComplete()
	throw_npc.throw_item = nil
end

-- npc 스탭 리셋
function local_class:reset_npc_step(npc, target_step)
	npc.step = target_step
	npc.delay = 0
end

-- 이팩트 초기화
function local_class:dispose_effect(npc_info)
	if npc_info.effect == nil then
		return
	end

	npc_info.effect:Dispose()
	npc_info.effect = nil
end

function local_class:beth_jump(target_pos)
	local beth = self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth]
	local finished_jump = false
	local jump_duration = 0.35
	local jump_height = 15
	local time_passed = 0

	self.jump_start_position = beth.Position

	stage.StageCamera:Shake(0.4, 0.1)

	character_util.set_anim(beth, { name = 'unique/charge_cast_start', loop = true })

	local pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_m_invaderknight_stomp')
	pool:Instantiate(self.jump_start_position)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_beth_jump_01')
	while finished_jump == false do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / jump_duration
		beth.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position,
				self:get_height_at(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * jump_height * progress
		if time_passed > jump_duration then
			finished_jump = true
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self:wait_for_sec_routine(0.6)
	character_util.remove_anim(beth)
end

function local_class:beth_down_jump(target_pos)
	local beth = self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth]
	local finished_jump = false
	local jump_duration = 0.3
	local jump_height = 15
	local time_passed = 0

	local jump_start_position = beth.Position
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_beth_jump_01')
	while finished_jump == false do
		if not self.is_acting or self.is_fail_acting or self.is_exit then
			break
		end
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / jump_duration
		local pos_y = vector(0, jump_height, 0) - unity_class.vector3.up * jump_height * progress
		beth.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(jump_start_position) + pos_y
		if time_passed > jump_duration then
			finished_jump = true
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	stage.StageCamera:Shake(0.4, 0.1)
	local pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_m_invaderknight_stomp')
	pool:Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(jump_start_position))
	self:wait_for_sec_routine(0.6)

	beth.Position = target_pos
end

function local_class:play_beth_stomp_attack(target_pos)
	local beth = self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth]
	character_util.set_anim(beth, { name = 'invader_knight/attack2', loop = false, scale = 3.5 })
	character_util.set_emotion(beth, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_direction(beth, 'down')

	local time_passed = 0
	local fall_duration = 0.25
	local jump_height = 15
	local is_start_stomp_effect = false
	local did_stomped = false

	while (did_stomped == false) do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if time_passed >= fall_duration - 0.3 and not is_start_stomp_effect then
			self:get_fx_cross_explosion():Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos, self:get_height_at(target_pos) + 0.1))
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_ficklelady_explosion_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_01')
			is_start_stomp_effect = true
		elseif time_passed >= fall_duration - 0.1 then
			stage.StageCamera:Shake(0.6, 0.7)
		end

		if time_passed >= fall_duration then
			did_stomped = true
			time_passed = 0
		elseif time_passed < fall_duration and did_stomped == false then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(time_passed, 0, 1, fall_duration))
			beth.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos, self:get_height_at(self.jump_start_position))
					+ unity_class.vector3.up * jump_height * (1 - progress)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:get_random_throw_pos(min_x, max_x)
	min_x = lua_helper.get_or_default(min_x, -3.5)
	max_x = lua_helper.get_or_default(max_x, 2.5)
	return vector(CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(min_x, max_x), 0.01, CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-25, -22))
end

-- 테러리스트 hp 차감
function local_class:deduct_terrorist_hp(terrorist_info, is_dead)
	local terrorist = terrorist_info.terrorist

	local hit_directing = function(target)
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(target, vector(0.1, 0, 0.1), 0.15, 0.05)
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(target, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.3)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(target, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)
	end

	if terrorist_info.hp <= 1 then
		terrorist_info.delay = 0
		terrorist_info.state = is_dead and self.act_terrorist_status.dead or self.act_terrorist_status.stun
		-- 스턴상태로 바뀐거면 애니메이션 수정
		if terrorist_info.state == self.act_terrorist_status.stun then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
			hit_directing(terrorist)
			character_util.set_direction(terrorist, 'left')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(terrorist, { name = 'seat' }, { name = 'damaged' })
		end
	else
		terrorist_info.hp = terrorist_info.hp - 1
		hit_directing(terrorist)
	end
end

-- 베스가 한번 구해주는 연출
function local_class:beth_saves_once(terrorist_info)
	self.is_directing_beth = true

	local terrorist_data = {}
	table.insert(terrorist_data, terrorist_info)
	terrorist_info.state = self.act_terrorist_status.beth_directing

	-- 타겟 테러리스트의 일정 반경에 있는 테러리스트 들도 가져온다.
	local target_terrorist = terrorist_info.terrorist
	for i = 1, #self.terrorist_list do
		local terrorist = self.terrorist_list[i].terrorist
		if self.terrorist_list[i].state ~= self.act_terrorist_status.wait
				and not lua_helper.reference_equals(terrorist, target_terrorist)
				and (target_terrorist.Position - terrorist.Position).magnitude < 3 then
			self.terrorist_list[i].state = self.act_terrorist_status.beth_directing
			table.insert(terrorist_data, self.terrorist_list[i])
		end
	end

	character_util.set_anim(target_terrorist, { name = 'rifle_reload', sfx_name = '02_gun_reload_02', loop = false
	, next_anim = 'rifle_idle' })

	-- 베스 내려찍기 연출
	local origin_pos = self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth].Position
	self:directing_beth_attack(target_terrorist.Position)

	-- 타겟된 테러리스트들 사망
	for i = 1, #terrorist_data do
		terrorist_data[i].state = self.act_terrorist_status.dead
	end

	self:wait_for_sec_routine(0.8)
	if self.is_exit or self.cur_beth_acting_state == self.beth_acting_state.attack then
		return
	end

	-- 한눈 팔지마!
	character_util.remove_anim(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth])
	character_util.set_direction(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth],
			user_party.Leader.Position.x > self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth].Position.x and 'right' or 'left')

	character_util.set_anim(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth], { name = 'release' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth], { key = '한눈 팔지마!', life_time = 1 })
	self:wait_for_sec_routine(0.5)
	if self.is_exit or self.cur_beth_acting_state == self.beth_acting_state.attack then
		return
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth])
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth], origin_pos,
			6, true, nil, nil, 'up')

	self.is_directing_beth = false
end

-- 베스 내려찍기 연출
function local_class:directing_beth_attack(target_pos)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth], { name = 'attack' })

			self:get_height_at(target_pos) + 0.1))

-- Npc가 연출로 총맞고 액팅 게임 오버로 넘어가는 연출
function local_class:acting_near_game_over(terrorist, attack_range, target, is_left)
	self.is_fail_acting = true

	timer_util.end_timer(self, true)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	character_util.look_at(terrorist, target)

	local target_direction = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Bounds.center - terrorist.Bounds.center).normalized
	attack_range:Show(0)
	attack_range:SetAlpha(0.5)

	attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(attack_range, terrorist.Bounds.center, target_direction, 0.05)

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(terrorist, { name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false }, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	attack_range:Hide()

	-- 총알 발사
	local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	self:fire_bullet_effect(bullet_sprite, terrorist.Bounds.center, target.Bounds.center, '02_gun_shoot_09')

	-- 리더 파닥파닥
	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party.Leader, 'none')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, is_left and 'left' or 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })

	if is_left then
		character_util.set_direction(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.mugger], 'right')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.mugger])
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.mugger]
		, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })

		if self.npc_flags[self.npc_flag_index.police_officer] then
			character_util.set_direction(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.police_officer], 'right')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.police_officer])
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.police_officer]
			, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })
		end
	else
		character_util.set_direction(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.mad_scientist], 'left')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.mad_scientist])
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.mad_scientist]
		, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })

		if self.npc_flags[self.npc_flag_index.beth] then
			character_util.set_direction(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.janitor_1], 'left')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.janitor_1])
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.janitor_1]
			, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })
			character_util.set_direction(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.janitor_2], 'left')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.janitor_2])
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.janitor_2]
			, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })
		end
	end
	-- 게임 오버 연출
	self:acting_game_over(terrorist, target)
end

-- 액팅 게임 오버
function local_class:acting_game_over(terrorist, target)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 활성화 중인 테러리스트들 idle 애니메이션
	for i = 1, #self.terrorist_list do
		if self.terrorist_list[i].state ~= self.act_terrorist_status.wait then
			local terrorist = self.terrorist_list[i].terrorist
			character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
		end
	end

	-- 타겟이 죽는 연출
	character_util.set_locked_dir(target, 'none')

	local dir = (terrorist ~= nil and terrorist.Position.x > target.Position.x) and 'right' or 'left'
	character_util.set_direction(target, dir)
	CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(target, 999999, unity_class.color.red, target.Position)
	target.SpineController:AddColor(target.Name, unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 }), 1, 3)

	dir = terrorist == nil and vector(0.2, 0, 0) or (CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(terrorist.Direction).normalized * 0.3)
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(target, dir, 0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(target, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(target, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(target, { name = 'dead', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01' }
	, { name = "damaged" })
	wait_for_sec(3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	target.SpineController:RemoveColor(target.Name, 0)

	-- 지난 시간 리셋
	self.time_passed = 0
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)

	-- 리더 리셋
	local pos = vector(-0.5, 0, -28)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(get_party_leader())
	character_util.set_position(get_party_leader(), pos)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(get_party_leader(), 'up')

	-- 테러리스트들 기본 좌표 및 상태 리셋
	for i = 1, #self.terrorist_list do
		local terrorist_data = self.terrorist_list[i]

		terrorist_data.state = self.act_terrorist_status.wait
		terrorist_data.waypoints = nil
		terrorist_data.waypoints_count = 1
		terrorist_data.duration = 0
		terrorist_data.delay = 0
		terrorist_data.hp = self.terrorist_hp

		character_util.remove_anim(terrorist_data.terrorist)
		character_util.set_active_state(terrorist_data.terrorist, 'disabled')
		character_util.set_position(terrorist_data.terrorist, vector(999, 0, 999))
	end

	-- 수상한 청년
	if self.npc_flags[self.npc_flag_index.fishy_youth] then
		self.is_show_fishy_youth = false
		self.is_dead_fishy_youth = false

		self.fishy_youth.state = self.act_terrorist_status.wait
		self.fishy_youth.waypoints = nil
		self.fishy_youth.waypoints_count = 1
		self.fishy_youth.duration = 0
		self.fishy_youth.delay = 0
		self.fishy_youth.hp = self.is_up_set_fishy_youth and self.terrorist_hp or 1
		self.fishy_youth.step = 0

		character_util.remove_anim(self.fishy_youth.terrorist)
		character_util.set_active_state(self.fishy_youth.terrorist, 'disabled')
		character_util.set_position(self.fishy_youth.terrorist, vector(999, 0, 999))
	end

	-- 던지는 생존자 리셋
	for _, value in pairs(self.throw_npc_list) do
		value.delay = 0
		value.step = 0
		value.throw_pos = nil
		self:drop_item_consume_complete(value)
		self:dispose_effect(value)
	end

	for i = 1, #self.npc_pushable_objs do
		local pushable_obj = self.npc_pushable_objs[i]

		-- 시간 리셋
		pushable_obj.cur_time = 0
		pushable_obj.delay = 0
		pushable_obj.step = 0
		pushable_obj.is_arrive = false

		-- 밀던거 리셋
		pushable_obj.field_object:CancelShake()
		pushable_obj.field_object.Position = pushable_obj.start_pos
		pushable_obj.field_object:Shake(0.04, 99999)

		-- 캐릭터 리셋
		character_util.stop_shake(pushable_obj.npc)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pushable_obj.npc)
		character_util.set_direction(pushable_obj.npc, 'up')
		character_util.set_anim(pushable_obj.npc, { name = 'push' })
		character_util.shake(pushable_obj.npc, 0.04, 99999)
		character_util.set_position(pushable_obj.npc, pushable_obj.start_pos + unity_class.vector3.back)

		-- 던지던 아이템 리셋
		if pushable_obj.throw_item ~= nil then
			pushable_obj.throw_item:ConsumeComplete()
			pushable_obj.throw_item = nil
		end
		pushable_obj.throw_pos = nil
	end

	if self.npc_flags[self.npc_flag_index.beth] then
		self.beth_attack_count = 0
		self.cur_beth_acting_state = self.beth_acting_state.none
		character_util.set_direction(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth], 'up')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth])
		character_util.set_position(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth], field:GetMarker('beth_maginot_line').position)
	end

	if self.npc_flags[self.npc_flag_index.police_officer] then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.police_officer])
		character_util.set_direction(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.police_officer], 'up')
		character_util.set_anim(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.police_officer], { name = 'handgun_idle' })
	end

	character_util.set_direction(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.trouble_shooter], 'up')
	character_util.set_anim(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.trouble_shooter], { name = 'handgun_idle' })

	character_util.set_direction(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.mad_scientist], 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.mad_scientist])

	-- 공주 어퍼 애니메이션 일 수도 있으니 지워줌
	character_util.set_direction(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.princess], 'up')
	character_util.remove_anim(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.princess], true)
	character_util.set_position(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.princess], vector(1, 0, -30.5))

	-- 다이하드 부부 방향 및 애니메이션 리셋
	if self.npc_flags[self.npc_flag_index.diehard] then
		character_util.set_direction(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.diehard_maclaine], 'right')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.diehard_maclaine], { name = 'eat' }
		, { name = 'attack' })
	end

	if self.npc_flags[self.npc_flag_index.diehard_wife] then
		character_util.set_direction(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.diehard_wife], 'left')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.diehard_wife], { name = 'eat' }
		, { name = 'attack' })
	end

	-- 베스를 사용했다면 다시 활성화 시켜줌
	if self.cur_beth_state == self.beth_state.used or self.cur_beth_state == self.beth_state.use then
		self.cur_beth_state = self.beth_state.active
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0.5, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	self.is_fail_acting = false

	-- 타이머 실행
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')

	timer_util.start_timer(
			{ duration = self.acting_time, handler = self, callback = 'timer_finished' })

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

-- 총알 발사 연출
function local_class:fire_bullet_effect(bullet_sprite, sniper_pos, target_pos, sfx, is_effect, call_back)
	if sfx ~= nil then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = sfx, loop = false, play_pos = sniper_pos })
	end

	bullet_sprite.transform.position = sniper_pos

	local look_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(target_pos - sniper_pos)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = look_rotation * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.MoveTo, bullet_sprite.transform,
			bullet_sprite.transform.position, target_pos, -1, nil, 30, false)

	is_effect = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_effect, true)
	if is_effect then
		self:get_fx_virus_hit():Instantiate(target_pos + vector(0, 0.2, 0))
	end

	bullet_sprite.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	if call_back then
		call_back()
	end
end

function local_class:wait_for_sec_routine(time)
	local s = unity_class.time.time
	while unity_class.time.time - s < time do
		-- exit 호출 됐으면 break
		if self.is_exit then
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 액팅 종료
function local_class:end_acting()
	self.current_progress = self.progress_state.acting_end

	if self.npc_flags[self.npc_flag_index.beth] then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.npc_list[self.npc_index.beth], 'disabled')
	end

	-- 슈퍼 테러리스트들 배치
	local start_pos = vector(-2.75, 0, -11.5)

function local_class:bullet_directing()
	local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	while not self.is_exit do
		local rnd_sniper_pos = vector(unity_class.random.Range(-2, 1), 0, -19)
		local type = random_util.get_random_int(1, 2)
		local rnd_x = 0
		if type == 1 then
			rnd_x = unity_class.random.Range(-5, -3)
		else
			rnd_x = unity_class.random.Range(2, 5)
		end

		local rnd_target_pos = vector(rnd_x, 0, -25.7)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.fire_bullet_effect, self, bullet_sprite, rnd_sniper_pos
				, rnd_target_pos, '02_gun_shoot_09'))
		self:wait_for_sec_routine(2)
	end
end

-- 연출 이후 돌 던지는 연출
function local_class:directing_npc_routine()
	-- exit 불릴 때 까지 npc 돌던지는 루틴 돌린다.
	while not self.is_exit do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if self.current_progress >= self.progress_state.last_progress then
			self:odile_routine(dt)
			self:gremory_routine(dt)

			-- 소매치기, 안드로이드 연출
			self:pushable_npc_directing(1, dt)
			self:pushable_npc_directing(2, dt)
		end

		-- 다이하드 부부 연출
		if self.npc_flags[self.npc_flag_index.diehard]
				or self.npc_flags[self.npc_flag_index.diehard_wife] then
			self:diehard_routine(dt)
		end

		-- 경관 연출
		if self.npc_flags[self.npc_flag_index.police_officer] then
			self:police_routine(dt)
		end

		-- 아무것도 아닌 할아버지 연출
		if self.npc_flags[self.npc_flag_index.nobody_old_man] then
			self:nobody_old_man_routine(dt)
		end

		-- 베스 살렸으면 미화원 연출
		if self.npc_flags[self.npc_flag_index.beth] then
			self:pushable_npc_directing(3, dt)
			self:pushable_npc_directing(4, dt)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('LilithTowerMainSection16')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = LilithTowerMain @
		Comment = 외벽 타기 미니게임 @
		Index = 15 @
		NextSections = 16 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 퀘스트 진행도
	self.progress_state = {
		idle = 0
	}

	self.current_progress = self.progress_state.idle

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'lilithtower_1_4'

	-- 외벽 미니게임
	self.climb_mini_game = nil
	self.game_name = 'ClimbMiniGame'

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_start_window = function() return get_field_object('climb_start_window') end

	-- 이펙트 풀을 가져오는 함수
	self.get_window_break_effect_pool = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_building_climb_windowbreak_1x1') end
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_window_break_effect_pool()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.climb_mini_game_start, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_event')

	if self.climb_mini_game then
		mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame(self.game_name)
		self.climb_mini_game = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent) then
		return self:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.game_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.progress_section, self))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.stage_name = nil
end

function local_class:climb_mini_game_start()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 미니게임 로드
	self.climb_mini_game = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.game_name)

	local is_mini_game_load_complete = false
	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.game_name, 'lilithtower_climb', function()
		is_mini_game_load_complete = true
	end)

	while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	local guardian = self.climb_mini_game:get_guardian()
	local princess = self.climb_mini_game:get_princess()
	local camera = self.climb_mini_game:get_camera()
	local offset = self.climb_mini_game.princess_offset

	guardian.Position = guardian.Position + vector(0, 0, 1.5)
	princess.Position = guardian.Position + offset
	camera.transform.localPosition = camera.transform.localPosition + vector(0, 0, 1.5)

	guardian.SpineController:AddColor(nil, unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 }), 1, 0)
	princess.SpineController:AddColor(nil, unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 }), 1, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(guardian, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(princess, 0, 0)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local window = self.get_start_window()
	local animator = window.Transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	local fx = window.Transform:Find('fx')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_break_window_01')
	fx.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	animator:Play('lilithtower_window_break')
	self.get_window_break_effect_pool():Instantiate(window.Position)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	local camera_move_func = function(duration, move)
		local time_passed = 0
		local start_position = camera.transform.localPosition
		local end_position = start_position + move

		while time_passed < duration do
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			camera.transform.localPosition = vector_util.lerp(start_position, end_position, progress)

			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		camera.transform.localPosition = end_position
	end

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(guardian, 1, 1)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(princess, 1, 1)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(camera_move_func, 3.75, vector(0, 0, -1.5)))

	character_util.set_anim(guardian, { name = 'climbing', sfx_name = '01_climb_01' })
	character_util.move_to(princess, guardian.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5) + offset, nil, 0.4)
	character_util.move_to(guardian, guardian.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5), nil, 0.4)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	guardian.SpineController:RemoveColor(nil, 1)
	princess.SpineController:RemoveColor(nil, 1)
	wait_for_sec(3.75 - 1.5)

	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.game_name)
end

function local_class:progress_section()
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

return local_class

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
    self.controller = controller
    self.quest_spec = quest_spec

    -- 퀘스트 진행도
    self.progress_state = {
        idle = 0,
        checked_shutters = 1,
        checked_computer = 2,
        had_conversation_1 = 3,
        had_conversation_2 = 4,
        princess_regrouped = 5,
        shutters_opened = 6
    }

    self.current_progress = self.progress_state.idle

    -- 현재 스테이지 이름
    self.stage_name = 'lilithtower_1_4'

    -- 대사
    self.main_script = 'lilithtower_main_s17_'

    -- Object Pool
    self.get_legendsword_effect_pool = function()
        return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_PillarLight_legendsword')
    end

    -- 스프라이트
    self.coffee_cup_sprite_horizontal = 'tea_cup_filled'
    self.coffee_cup_sprite_vertical = 'tea_cup_filled_2'

    -- 캐릭터 getter들
    self.get_fake_guardian = function()
        if user_util.has_knight_male() then
            return get_character('fake_guardian_female'), false
        end

        return get_character('fake_guardian_male'), true
    end

    -- 수트 맨손 기사
    self.get_knight_suit = function()
        if user_util.has_knight_male() then
            return get_character('knight_male_suit')
        else
            return get_character('knight_female_suit')
        end
    end

    -- 수트 배트 기사
    self.get_knight_suit_bat = function()
        if user_util.has_knight_male() then
            return get_character('knight_male_suit_bat')
        else
            return get_character('knight_female_suit_bat')
        end
    end

    -- 응애 공주
    self.get_princess = function() return get_character('princess') end

    -- 컴퓨터방 컴퓨터
    self.get_computer = function() return get_field_object('s17_computer') end

    -- 컴퓨터방 의자
    self.get_computer_chair = function() return get_field_object('s17_computer_chair') end

    -- 셔터 인터렉터블 (이벤트 용)
    self.get_shutter_wall = function() return get_field_object('cafe_shutter_interactable') end

	-- 스피치 버블 사용 시 alt 보이스 적용을 위한 편의 기능
	self.speech_bubble_async_alternative = function(talker, is_alternative, speech_data)
		if is_alternative then
			local string_key = speech_data.key
			if type_util.is_array(string_key) then
				speech_data.override_key = string_key[1] .. '_alt'
			else
				speech_data.override_key = string_key .. '_alt'
			end
		end

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(talker, speech_data)
	end

    -- 이벤트 존 이름들
    self.cafe_shutter_zone = 'cafe_shutter'
    self.cafe_corridor_zone = 'cafe_corridor'
	self.cafe_bgm_zone = 'cafe_bgm'

    -- 윈도우 브레이커 이벤트 key
    self.windows_breaker_key = 'windows_breaker'

    -- 윈도우 브레이커를 받았는지 확인하기 위한 플래그
    self.eanred_windows_breaker = false

    -- 카페에 있는 셔터 관련
    self.shutter_count = 4
    self.shutter_name = 'cafe_shutter_'

    -- 사운드
    self.keyboard_typing_sfx = nil

	-- 퀘스트 마커 이름
	self.player_seat_marker = 'player_seat'
end

function local_class:enter()
    if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

    message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

    local princess = self.get_princess()
    character_util.set_position(princess, field:GetMarker('default_start').position + vector(-1, 0, 0))
    character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')

    self:set_field_by_progress()
    self:close_all_shutter()
    self:check_earned_window_breaker()
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
    self.get_legendsword_effect_pool()
end

function local_class:start()
    if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 16 then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.stage_intro, self)
	end

    -- 현재 섹션으로 스테이지 재시작 시, 공부가 파티를 따라다니도록 설정
    if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 16 then
    	character_util.set_active_state(princess, 'enabled')
    	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(princess, user_party, false,
    		CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.Keep, -(user_party.Count - 1))
    end

 	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'shutter', vector(17, 0, 69.5))
end

function local_class:exit()
	quest_marker_util.remove('s17_exit')

    message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

    if self.keyboard_typing_sfx ~= nil then
        self.keyboard_typing_sfx:Stop()
    end

    self.controller = nil
    self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
    local event_type = e:GetType()

    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
        self:on_interact_event(e)
    end

    return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
    self.controller = nil
    self.quest_spec = nil
    self.stage_name = nil
end

function local_class:stage_intro()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local player = user_party.Leader
	local s17_starting_pos = field:GetMarker('s17_starting_pos').position
	local default_start = field:GetMarker('start_lilithtower_1_4').position + vector(2, 0, 0.75)
	character_util.set_position(player, default_start)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.1)
	stage_camera:CancelMove()
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	screen_util.fade_in(2, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	-- 기사, 공주 캐릭터 세팅
	player.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	princess.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.set_active_state(player, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(player, s17_starting_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.2))
	character_util.convert_to_npc(princess)
	character_util.set_direction(player, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_position(princess, player.Position + vector(-0.3, 0.5, 0))
	character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'push' })
	character_util.set_emotion(player, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(player, { name = 'get' })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 점프 이동 하면서 들어옴.
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.free_fall_func, self,
	    player, player.Position, player.Position + vector(4, 0, -0.25), 1))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.free_fall_func, self,
	    princess, princess.Position, princess.Position + vector(4, 0, 0.5), 1))

	-- 0.4
    wait_for_sec(0.4)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.party_break_window, self,
	    player, 0.1, player.Position - vector(1, 0, 0.5), -720, 0.65, 20000))

    coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.party_break_window, self,
        princess, 0.1, princess.Position - vector(1, 0, -0.5), -720, 0.65, 14000))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_break_window_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 1)

	local window = get_field_object('cafe_window_break')
	local animator = window:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	animator:Play('start')

    wait_for_sec(1.4)

	--기사 먼저 부르르떨고 일어나 공주에게 가면 이내 공주 부르르떨고 일어남
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.shake_and_wakeup(player, 'left', 2, nil, true)
			player:HideWeapon(true)
			character_util.set_anim(player, { name = 'idle' })
			character_util.set_direction(player, 'left')
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			wait_for_sec(0.25)
			character_util.shake_and_wakeup(princess, 'right', 2, nil, true)
		end),
	})

    wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(player, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'left')
    wait_for_sec(1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(player, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_anim(player, { name = 'question', loop = false } )
	character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'question', loop = false } )

	wait_for_sec(1.5)
    character_util.set_anim(player, { name = 'idle' })
	character_util.remove_anim(princess)

    local align_pos = field:GetMarker('start_lilithtower_1_4').position

    wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_to_async(princess, align_pos, nil, 1.8, true, true)
			character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_to_async(player, align_pos + vector(0.75, 0, 0), nil, 1.8, true, true)
			character_util.set_anim(player, { name = 'idle' })
			character_util.set_direction(player, 'left')
		end),
	})

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)

    character_util.convert_to_following_npc(princess, user_party, false,
     		CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.Keep, -(user_party.Count - 1))

	character_util.remove_anim(player)

    player.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.DefaultCrashBehaviour.Instance
	princess.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour()

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString("minimap_lilithtower_top_floor"), 1.5)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')

	character_util.set_direction(player, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')
	player:HideWeapon(false)

	character_util.set_anim(player, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false})
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(princess, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false}, {name = 'attack'})

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_22_lilithtower/audio:bgm_lilith_tower', state = 'event', mix = 2 })
	wait_for_sec(1.7)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(player)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)

    camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
end

function local_class:party_break_window(target, wait_sec, start_pos, rotation, rotation_time, power)
	character_util.set_position(target, start_pos)
	character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.set_emotion(target, { name = 'damaged' })

	wait_for_sec(wait_sec)
	character_util.jump(target, 1.5, 0.8)
	wait_for_sec(0.4)
	character_util.spine_rotate(target, rotation, rotation_time)

	local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
		'physics', true, vector(1, 0, 0), power, 0.05,
		CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient, false, true)

	local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(target, knock_back_info)
	target.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_03')
end

function local_class:free_fall_func(object, start_pos, end_pos, duration)
	local time = 0
	local free_fall_fire = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(9.8, 19.6, 0, 0)
	while time < duration do
		time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		free_fall_fire:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall_fire:GetDistance()
		local move_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, time / duration)
		object.transform.position = move_pos + vector(0, 0.5, 0) * dist_y
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:set_field_by_progress()
    if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.idle then
        local shutter = self.get_shutter_wall()
        character_util.add_listener(shutter, self.controller)

        local computer = self.get_computer()
        character_util.set_active_state(computer, 'disabled')

	    local computer_chair = self.get_computer_chair()
	    character_util.set_active_state(computer_chair, 'disabled')

	    local cafe_chair = get_field_object('player_seat_interactable')
		character_util.set_active_state(cafe_chair, 'disabled')

    elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_state.checked_shutters then
        local computer = self.get_computer()
        character_util.set_active_state(computer, 'enabled')
        character_util.add_listener(computer, self.controller)

		quest_marker_util.remove('shutter')
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'computer',computer.Position)

        local chair = self.get_computer_chair()
        character_util.set_active_state(chair, 'enabled')
        character_util.add_listener(chair, self.controller)

    elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_state.checked_computer then
        local computer = self.get_computer()
        character_util.remove_relate_event(computer, self.controller)
        character_util.set_active_state(computer, 'disabled')

        quest_marker_util.remove('computer')

        local chair = self.get_computer_chair()
        character_util.remove_relate_event(chair, self.controller)
        character_util.set_active_state(chair, 'disabled')

        self:set_fake_guardian()
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_state.had_conversation_1 then
		local cafe_chair = get_field_object('player_seat_interactable')
		character_util.set_active_state(cafe_chair, 'enabled')

	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_state.had_conversation_2 then
		self.keyboard_typing_sfx:Stop()
		local princess = self.get_princess()
		character_util.remove_emotion(princess)
    end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
    local fake_guardian = self.get_fake_guardian()
    local computer = self.get_computer()
    local computer_chair = self.get_computer_chair()
    local shutter = self.get_shutter_wall()
	local cafe_chair = get_field_object('player_seat_interactable')

    if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, shutter) then
        if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.idle then
            self.current_progress = self.progress_state.checked_shutters
            sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.play_shutter_inspected_event, self)
        end
    elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, computer) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, computer_chair) then
        if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.checked_shutters then
            self.current_progress = self.progress_state.checked_computer
            sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.play_computer_inspected_event, self)
        end
    elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, fake_guardian) then
        if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.checked_computer then
            self.current_progress = self.progress_state.had_conversation_1
            sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.play_conversation_at_cafe_scene_1, self)
        end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, cafe_chair) then
        if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.had_conversation_1 then
            self.current_progress = self.progress_state.had_conversation_2
            sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.play_conversation_at_cafe_scene_2, self)
        end
    end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
    if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
    if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end

    local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

    if zone_name == self.cafe_corridor_zone then
        if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.had_conversation_2 then
            self.current_progress = self.progress_state.princess_regrouped
            sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.play_princess_regrouped_event, self)
        end

    elseif zone_name == self.cafe_shutter_zone then
        if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.princess_regrouped then
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
                util.cs_generator(self.open_all_shutters, self))
        end

	elseif zone_name == self.cafe_bgm_zone then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.checked_computer then
            music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
        end
    end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave == false then return	end
    if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end

    local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.cafe_bgm_zone then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.checked_computer then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_22_lilithtower/audio:bgm_lilith_tower', state = 'field' })
        end
    end
end

function local_class:set_fake_guardian()
    local fake_guardian = self.get_fake_guardian()

    character_util.set_position(fake_guardian,
        field:GetMarker('fake_guardian_seat_pos').position + vector(-0.125, 0.5, 0))
    character_util.set_direction(fake_guardian, 'left')
    character_util.set_active_state(fake_guardian, 'enabled')
    character_util.set_anim(fake_guardian, { name = 'seat' })
	character_util.set_emotion(fake_guardian, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
    character_util.add_listener(fake_guardian, self.controller)
    self:hold_coffee(fake_guardian)
end

function local_class:play_shutter_inspected_event()
    local shutter = self.get_shutter_wall()
	local shutter_original_pos = shutter.Position
    shutter.Position = vector(999, 0, 9991)
    character_util.remove_relate_event(shutter, self.controller)

    local princess = self.get_princess()

	-- 격벽 앞에 정렬
	party_util.align_party(shutter_original_pos + vector(-0.25, 0, 0), 'left', 1, 'linear')
    character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
    character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')

    -- 꼬마 공주: 음… 역시 막혀있구나.
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'tired'})
	character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'question', loop = false})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.main_script .. 63, skip = true })
    character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)

    -- 꼬마 공주: 잠시 뒤로 돌아가자.
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.main_script .. 64, skip = true })

	-- 꼬마 공주: 아까 지나오면서 본 컴퓨터를 이용하면 열 수 있을 거야.
    character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.main_script .. 5, skip = true })
    character_util.remove_anim(princess)

    self:set_field_by_progress()
end

function local_class:play_computer_inspected_event()
    local computer = self.get_computer()
    character_util.remove_relate_event(computer, self.controller)

    local player = user_party.Leader
    local princess = self.get_princess()
    character_util.convert_to_npc(princess)

    wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_to_async(princess, computer.Position + vector(1, 0, -1), 1, nil, true, true)
			self:enter_chair(princess)
			character_util.set_direction(princess, 'up')
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_to_async(player, computer.Position + vector(1, 0, -0.5), 1, nil, true, true)
		end)
	})

    character_util.set_direction(player, 'left')
    character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')

    -- 꼬마 공주: 조금만 기다려줘.
    character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'smile' })
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.main_script .. 65, skip = true })

    -- 꼬마 공주: 내 생체 정보는 등록되어있으니까 로그인만 하면..
    character_util.remove_emotion(princess)
    character_util.set_direction(princess, 'up')
    character_util.set_anim(princess, {name = 'hold'})
    self.keyboard_typing_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_typing_01', loop = true })
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.main_script .. 66, skip = true })

    -- 꼬마 공주: 마계는 보안 솔루션이 많아서 그런가 인증 스텝이..
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.main_script .. 67, skip = true })

    -- 꼬마 공주: ..17 단계?!
	self.keyboard_typing_sfx:Stop()
	self.keyboard_typing_sfx = nil
    character_util.remove_anim(princess)
    character_util.set_direction(princess, 'up')
    character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'surprise' })
    character_util.normal_jump(princess, '01_small_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess,
		{ key = self.main_script .. 68, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })
    character_util.remove_emotion(princess)

    -- 공주 헝크러진 실타래 이모티콘
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
    character_util.show_emoticon_async(princess, nil, 'annoyed')

    -- 공주 주인공 바라보며 시무룩한 표정으로

		self.speech_bubble_async_alternative(fake_guardian, is_alternative, { key = new_script .. 99, skip = true })

		-- 가짜 가디언: 그것이 다른 사람이라면 한 명의 광인을 뜻하지만..
		self.speech_bubble_async_alternative(fake_guardian, is_alternative, { key = new_script .. 100, skip = true })

		-- 가짜 가디언: ...우리에게 있어선 세계의 운명과 직결된 문제야.
		character_util.remove_anim(fake_guardian)
		self.speech_bubble_async_alternative(fake_guardian, is_alternative, { key = new_script .. 101, skip = true })

		-- 가짜 가디언: 잊지 마.
		self.speech_bubble_async_alternative(fake_guardian, is_alternative, { key = new_script .. 102, skip = true })

	    -- 가짜 가디언 나가며 페이드 아웃
		character_util.move_distance(fake_guardian, vector(4, 0, 0), nil, 2, true, true, false)
		wait_for_sec(0.75)
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })

		character_util.set_position(fake_guardian, vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.set_active_state(fake_guardian, 'disabled')
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.01)

		wait_for_sec(0.25)

		if self.eanred_windows_breaker then
			local knight_suit_bat = self.get_knight_suit_bat()
			character_util.set_active_state(knight_suit_bat, 'enabled')
			character_util.set_position(knight_suit_bat, player.Position)
			character_util.set_direction(knight_suit_bat, player.Direction)
			character_util.set_emotion(knight_suit_bat, { name = 'confused'})
			character_util.set_anim(knight_suit_bat, { name = 'prostrate' })
			character_util.convert_to_manual_character(knight_suit_bat)
			character_util.set_position(player, vector(999, 0, 999))

			player = knight_suit_bat
		end

		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		-- 카메라가 주인공에게 간 상태로 페이드 인. 주인공 쓰러진 상태로 부르르 떨다가 마리오 점프로 일어난 후 컨트롤 돌려준다.
		character_util.shake_and_wakeup(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Direction, 2, nil, true)
	else
		self:release_coffee(player)

		-- … 이모티콘 후 입구쪽으로 걸어서 나감.
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(fake_guardian, nil, 'silence')

		character_util.move_distance_async(fake_guardian, vector(8, 0, 0), nil, 2, true, true, false)
		character_util.set_position(fake_guardian, vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.set_active_state(fake_guardian, 'disabled')

		local knight_suit_bat = nil
		if self.eanred_windows_breaker then
			knight_suit_bat = self.get_knight_suit_bat()
			character_util.set_active_state(knight_suit_bat, 'enabled')
			character_util.set_position(knight_suit_bat, player.Position)
			character_util.set_direction(knight_suit_bat, player.Direction)
			character_util.set_emotion(knight_suit_bat, { name = 'tired'})
			character_util.set_position(player, vector(999, 0, 999))
			knight_suit_bat:HideWeapon(true)

			player = knight_suit_bat
		end

		-- 이후 주인공도 의자에서 내려와 컨트롤 돌아옴.
		self:exit_chair(player)
		character_util.set_direction(player, 'up')
		player:HideWeapon(false)
		character_util.remove_emotion(player)

		if self.eanred_windows_breaker then
			character_util.convert_to_manual_character(knight_suit_bat)
		end
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_22_lilithtower/audio:bgm_lilith_tower', state = 'field' })

	self:set_field_by_progress()
end

function local_class:call_champion_sword(fake_guardian, player)
	-- (공백)
    music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_03', fade_in_time = 1.5, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })
    field:Tint('cafe_fake_guardian', unity_class.color.black, 1)
    camera_util.shake(0.05, 9999)
    wait_for_sec(0.5)

    -- (하늘에서 챔피언 소드가 주인공에게 내리 찍힌다. [주인공 연계기 사용] 주인공 의자에서 뒤로 한바퀴 굴러나 튕겨나 쓰러나서 헤롱헤롱 거린다.
    -- 칼이 찍히는 순간 암전 풀리도록. 진동도 그 순간 크게 흔들고 그 후엔 없도록)
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_champ_sword_01')
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_01')
    self.get_legendsword_effect_pool():Instantiate(player.Position)
    wait_for_sec(0.15)

    field:RemoveTint('cafe_fake_guardian', 0.5)
    camera_util.cancel_shake()
    camera_util.shake(0.5, 0.5)

    character_util.set_emotion(player, { name = 'confused' })
    character_util.set_anim(player, { name = 'embarrassed' })
    character_util.jump(player, 0.5, 0.5)
    character_util.spine_rotate(player, 390, 0.5)
    character_util.move_to_async(player, vector_util.get_x0z(player.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0)), 0.5, nil, false, false)

    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
    character_util.spine_rotate(player, 0, 0)
    character_util.set_anim(player, { name = 'prostrate' })

    local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info('physics', true, vector(-1, 0, 0),
        5000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)
    command_util.publish_knock_back(user_party.Leader.Owner, user_party.Leader, knock_back_info, user_party.Leader.Position)
    wait_for_sec(1)
end

			self.speech_bubble_async_alternative(fo, is_alternative, { key = script_key .. 15, skip = true })

			self.speech_bubble_async_alternative(fo, is_alternative, { key = script_key .. 35, skip = true })

			self.speech_bubble_async_alternative(fo, is_alternative, { key = script_key .. 41, skip = true })

			character_util.remove_emotion(fo)
		end,

        -- '이야기를 끝낸다.'에 대한 반응
        function(fo) end

    local fake_guardian, is_alternative = self.get_fake_guardian()

    while result ~= return_flag do
        result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
            -- 동료들에 대해서.
            { script_key .. 5, 'intellect'},
            -- 공주님에 대해서.
            { script_key .. 12, 'mercy'},
            -- 네 목적은?
            { script_key .. 21, 'forced'},
            -- 이야기를 끝낸다.
            { script_key .. 45, 'normal'}
        })

		result_callback[result](fake_guardian, is_alternative)
    end
end

function local_class:play_princess_regrouped_event()
    -- 공주가 있는 방 입구 쪽으로 가면 멈추고 공주가 복도에서 걸어온다
    local princess = self.get_princess()
	character_util.set_position(princess, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-9, 0, 0))

	character_util.move_to_async(princess, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0), nil, 2, true, true)

    -- 꼬마 공주: 오래 기다렸지! 이제 격벽을 열 수 있을거야!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.main_script .. 77, skip = true })

	--공주 ? 이모티콘
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(princess, nil, 'question')

	-- 꼬마 공주 (여):	..무슨 일 있었어?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.main_script .. 79, skip = true })

	local new_script = self.main_script .. '79_'

	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 아무 일도 없었다
		{ new_script .. 1, 'mercy'},
		-- 탈출을 제안한다.
		{ new_script .. 4, 'intellect'},
	})

	if result == 1 then
		-- 위 선택 시 공주 (... 이모티콘)
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(princess, nil, 'silence')

		-- 꼬마 공주 (여): (끄덕끄덕) ..가자.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.nod_twice(princess)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = new_script .. 2, skip = true })

		-- 꼬마 공주 (여): 여왕님의 집무실은 바로 앞이야..
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = new_script .. 3, skip = true })
	else
		-- 위 선택 시 	(주인공 sad 표정 짓더니 공주에게 다가가려 함)
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'tired' })
		user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(true)
		character_util.move_distance_async(user_party.Leader, vector(-0.15, 0, 0), nil, 1, true, true)

		wait_all({
			util.cs_generator(function()
				character_util.move_distance_async(user_party.Leader, vector(-0.65, 0, 0), nil, 1, true, true)
				character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'idle' })
			end),
			util.cs_generator(function()
				-- 꼬마 공주 (여)	..잠깐.
				wait_for_sec(0.1)
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = new_script .. 5, skip = true })
			end),
		})

		-- 꼬마 공주 (여)	(... 이모티콘)
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(princess, nil, 'silence')

		-- 꼬마 공주 (여)	헤실미소.
		character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = new_script .. 6, skip = true })

		-- 꼬마 공주 (여)	..무슨 이야기를 하려고 하는지 알 것 같아.

function local_class:create_coffee_as_drop_item(fo_from, fo_to)
    local coffee_id = 20431
    character_util.remove_anim(fo_from, true)

    -- 이동 연출용
    local fake_coffee = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = fo_from.Position, itemid = coffee_id,
        notforinven = true, showoncharacter = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })

    local move_duration = 0.5
    local move_height = 1.5
    local from_pos = fo_from.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0)
    local to_pos = fo_to.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)

    local time_passed = 0
    local num_rotations = 2
    while time_passed <= move_duration do
        time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

        local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / move_duration)
        local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(from_pos, to_pos, progress)
        local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * move_height + lerp_pos.y
        local cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(lerp_pos, cur_y)

        local rotate_progress = math.min(1, progress)
        local rotation_angle = rotate_progress * 540 * num_rotations

        fake_coffee.SpriteTransform.position = cur_pos

        fake_coffee.SpriteTransform.localRotation =
            unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right)
            * unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(rotation_angle, unity_class.vector3.forward)
            fake_coffee.ShadowTransform.localRotation =
            unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right)
            * unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(rotation_angle, unity_class.vector3.forward)

        coroutine.yield()
    end

    fake_coffee.SpriteTransform.position = to_pos
    fake_coffee.ShadowTransform.position = to_pos
    fake_coffee:ConsumeComplete()

    -- 습득 연출 용
    local coffee = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = to_pos, itemid = coffee_id,
    notforinven = true, showoncharacter = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
    coffee.ConsumeTarget = fo_to
    wait_for_sec(0.75)

    self:hold_coffee(fo_from)
    self:hold_coffee(fo_to)
end

function local_class:object_shake(fo, duration)
	local position = fo.Position
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		fo.Position = position + vector(unity_class.random.Range(-0.05, 0.05), 0, unity_class.random.Range(-0.05, 0.05))

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end
	fo.Position = position
end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.stage_name = nil
end

	else

	end

		self.boss_bow = get_character('boss_fakeguardian_bow_m')
	else

	end

	else

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.boss_onehand, 0, 0)

	character_util.set_position(self.boss_onehand, vector(999, 0, 999), true)

function local_class:exit()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent))

	self.arrow_infos = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then
		return self:on_damage_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent) then
		return coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_revive_event, self, e))

	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_revive_event(e)
	if e.FieldObject == user_party.Leader then
		coroutine.yield()
		coroutine.yield()

		local ui_dict = field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TopHpBarForBoss)

		if self.qte_1_on == false then
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.ShowBossHPEvent.Create(self.boss_twohand))
		elseif self.qte_2_on == false then
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.ShowBossHPEvent.Create(self.boss_bow))
		else
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.ShowBossHPEvent.Create(self.boss_onehand))
		end

		local top_hp_bar = ui_dict[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TopHpBarForBoss]
		top_hp_bar:SetName(game_string:Format('lilithtower_boss_title', user.Name))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.boss_twohand) then
		if self.boss_twohand.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HpRatio < 0.59 and self.qte_1_on == false then
			character_util.set_immortal(user_party.Leader, true)
			self.qte_1_on = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.qte_1, self, self.boss_twohand, self.boss_bow))
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.boss_bow) then
		if self.boss_bow.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HpRatio < 0.29 and self.qte_2_on == false then
			character_util.set_immortal(user_party.Leader, true)
			self.qte_2_on = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.qte_2, self, self.boss_bow, self.boss_onehand))
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.boss_onehand) then
		if self.boss_onehand.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HpRatio < 0.01 and self.qte_3_on == false then
			character_util.set_immortal(user_party.Leader, true)
			self.qte_3_on = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.qte_3, self, self.boss_onehand))
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
		self.swipe_type = 'left'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
		self.swipe_type = 'right'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
		self.swipe_type = 'up'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
		self.swipe_type = 'down'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		if self.tap_sfx_name then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.tap_sfx_name)
		end
		self.swipe_type = 'tap'
		self.turbo_tap_count = self.turbo_tap_count + 1
		if self.turbo_tap_camera then
			camera_util.resize_to(2 - self.turbo_tap_count * 0.025, 0)
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:qte_1(fo1, fo2)
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	-- region ready
	fo1.CharacterStatsBehaviour:ResetAllAilments()
	local hit_loop = function(dir)
		local hit_pos
		if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
			hit_pos = vector(0.5, 0.3, 0)
		else
			hit_pos = vector(-0.5, 0.3, 0)
		end

		while self.loop == true do
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_big_01')
			camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)
			self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(self.center + hit_pos)
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(user_party.Leader)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(user_party.Leader)
			wait_for_sec(0.2)
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_big_01')
			camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)
			self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(self.center + hit_pos)
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(user_party.Leader)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(user_party.Leader)
			wait_for_sec(0.267)
		end
	end

	local princess_runaway = function(waypoint)
		self.princess.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character_util.set_emotion(self.princess, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.princess, waypoint, 4, true, nil, nil, nil, false)
		character_util.set_anim(self.princess, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	end

	local leader_runaway = function(pos)
		if pos.x > 0.5 then
			character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
		end
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'walk4legs', scale = 2, mix_duration = 0 })
		character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, pos, nil, 1, true, false)
	end

	coroutine.yield()

	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.princess)

	fo1:HideWeapon(true)
	fo2:HideWeapon(true)

	fo1.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
	user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
	self.princess.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(fo1)

	self.princess.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance

	local dir = vector_util.normalized(user_party.Leader.Position - self.center)

	local move_pos = vector(6.5, 0, 4.5)

	if user_party.Leader.Position.x < self.center.x then
		move_pos = vector(-1 * move_pos.x, 0 , move_pos.z)
	end

	if user_party.Leader.Position.z > self.center.z then
		move_pos = vector(move_pos.x, 0 , -1 * move_pos.z)
	end

	local waypoint = {
		vector(self.princess.Position.x, 0, self.center.z + move_pos.z),
		self.center + move_pos
	}

	local dist = vector_util.magnitude(user_party.Leader.Position - self.center)

	while user_party.Leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--endregion

	-- region position_setting

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(princess_runaway, waypoint))

	self:qte_transition()

	coroutine.yield()

	character_util.convert_to_monster(fo2, 'boss')
	fo2.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
	self:give_damage_boss(fo2, fo1, 0.4)

	character_util.remove_anim(fo1)
	character_util.set_emotion(fo1, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(fo1, user_party.Leader.Position, 10, true, nil, nil, nil, false)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)
	character_util.set_anim(fo1, { name = 'push' })
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'damaged' })
	local leader_dir
	if fo1.Position.x < self.center.x then
		character_util.set_direction(fo1, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party.Leader, fo1.Position + vector(0.4, 0, 0), 6, true, nil, 'flying', nil, false)
		character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, fo1.Position + vector(0.4, 0, 0), true)

		28)

function local_class:qte_2(fo1, fo2)
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	-- region ready
	fo1.CharacterStatsBehaviour:ResetAllAilments()
	local rand_hit = function(fo)
		if unity_class.random.Range(-5, 5) > 0 then
			character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'damaged' })
		else
			character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'damaged2' })
		end
		character_util.spine_rotate(fo, unity_class.random.Range(-15, 15), 0)
		camera_util.shake(0.35, 0.05)
		self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(fo.Position + vector(unity_class.random.Range(-0.5, 0.5), 0.3, unity_class.random.Range(-0.5, 0.5)))
		self:give_damage_player(fo2, 0.02)
	end

	coroutine.yield()

	fo2:HideWeapon(true)

	fo1.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(fo1)

	local dir = vector_util.normalized(user_party.Leader.Position - self.center)
	local dist = vector_util.magnitude(user_party.Leader.Position - self.center)

	while user_party.Leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- endregion

	-- region position_setting

	self:qte_transition()

	camera_util.resize_to(5, 0.7)
	camera_util.move(self.center, 0.7)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_boss_rise_01')
	fo2.Position = fo1.Position
	character_util.set_anim(fo1, { name = 'get' })
	character_util.set_anim(fo2, { name = 'get' })
	character_util.set_emotion(fo1, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_emotion(fo2, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'attack' })
	if fo1.Position.x < self.center.x then
		character_util.set_direction(fo1, 'left')
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
		character_util.spine_rotate(fo1, 720, 0.7)
		character_util.spine_rotate(fo2, 720, 0.7)
	else
		character_util.set_direction(fo1, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
		character_util.spine_rotate(fo1, -720, 0.7)
		character_util.spine_rotate(fo2, -720, 0.7)

	character_util.move_to(fo1, self.center, 0.7, nil)
	character_util.move_to(fo2, self.center, 0.7, nil)
	character_util.jump(fo1, 7, 0.7)
	character_util.jump(fo2, 7, 0.7)
	fo1.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	fo2.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fo1, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fo2, 1, 0)
	character_util.set_anim(fo2, { name = 'unique/hero_landing' })
	if user_party.Leader.Position.x < self.center.x then
		character_util.set_direction(fo2, 'left')
	else
		character_util.set_direction(fo2, 'right')
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.35)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_stomp_fire_02')
	camera_util.shake(1, 0.6)
	character_util.spine_rotate(fo2, 0, 0)

		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	else
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
	end

		local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
				'physics', true, dir, 32000 - (dist * 4000), 0.05,
				CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

		user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))
	end

function local_class:start_arrow_shoot_routine()

		self.current_arrow_shooting_state = self.arrow_shooting_state.before_slow
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.arrow_shoot_routine, self))
	end

function local_class:arrow_shoot_routine()
	while self.current_arrow_shooting_state == self.arrow_shooting_state.before_slow do
		for index, _ in pairs(self.arrow_infos) do
			local info = self.arrow_infos[index]

			if info.state == self.arrow_state.before_slow then
				if info.time_passed < info.duration then
					local progress = info.time_passed / info.duration
					info.sprite.localPosition = info.start_pos * (1 - progress) + info.target_pos * progress
					info.time_passed = info.time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				else
					info.state = self.arrow_state.wait_slow
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 슬로우가 걸린 경우 이전과 같은 방식대로 돌림
	local done_left = #self.arrow_infos
	for index, _ in pairs(self.arrow_infos) do
		local info = self.arrow_infos[index]

		info.sprite.localPosition = info.target_pos

		info.time_passed = 0
		info.state = self.arrow_state.after_slow

		local temp_start_pos = info.start_pos
		info.start_pos = info.target_pos

		if info.mid_num ~= nil then
			info.target_pos = temp_start_pos + 10 * info.move_dir
		else
			info.target_pos = temp_start_pos + 7 * info.move_dir
		end

		info.target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(info.target_pos, self.arrow_y_pos)

		info.duration = (info.target_pos - info.start_pos).magnitude / self.arrow_speed
	end

	local start_time = unity_class.time.time
	while done_left > 0 do
		local time_passed = unity_class.time.time - start_time

		for index, _ in pairs(self.arrow_infos) do
			local info = self.arrow_infos[index]

			if info.state == self.arrow_state.after_slow then
				if info.mid_num ~= nil and self.arrow_mid[info.mid_num] == false then
					-- 얘는 위치 날려줄 필요 없음
					info.state = self.arrow_state.done
					done_left = done_left - 1
				elseif time_passed < info.duration then
					local progress = time_passed / info.duration
					info.sprite.localPosition = info.start_pos * (1 - progress) + info.target_pos * progress
				else
					info.sprite.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
					info.state = self.arrow_state.done
					done_left = done_left - 1
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:bat_throw(sprite, origin_pos, target_pos, duration, rotation)
	sprite.localPosition = origin_pos
	self.twohand_look_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(target_pos - origin_pos)
	sprite.localRotation = self.twohand_look_rotation * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, -45, 0)

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		sprite.localPosition = origin_pos + ((target_pos - origin_pos) * progress)
		sprite.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, (rotation * progress), 0)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		local progress = time_passed / duration

		sprite.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, (rotation * progress), 0)
		sprite.localPosition = position + ((target_pos - position) * progress * 2)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / (duration * 2)
		local y_offset = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height

		fo.Position = position + ((pos - position) * progress * 2) + vector(0, y_offset, 0)

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end
	fo.Position = pos + vector(0, height, 0)

function local_class:shoot_and_bomb(shooter, target, dir)
	local vtr
	if dir == 'left' then
		vtr = vector(1, 0, 0)
	else
		vtr = vector(-1, 0, 0)
	end

	character_util.stop(target)

	character_util.set_anim(shooter, { name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false, next_anim = 'rifle_idle', scale = 0.5 })
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	self:fire_bullet_effect(bullet_sprite, shooter.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.2), target.Position)

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.2)
	self.get_fx_critical_hit_blood():Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	character_util.set_direction(target, dir)
	character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'dead2', loop = false, scale = 3 })
	character_util.set_emotion(target, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_active_shadow(target, false)
	target.SpineController:AddColor(target.Name, unity_color({0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1}), 1, 0.5)

	local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
		'physics', true, vtr, 12000, 0.05,
		CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

			renderer.material.color = unity_class.color.black
		else
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('renderer is nil')
		end

		self.circular_origin_pos = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.stage_name = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return false end

	return false
end

function local_class:load_shoot_helpers()
