	local pattern_Info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo()
	pattern_Info.columns = 1
	pattern_Info.spreadDistance = 1
	pattern_Info.parallel = true

	-- ShootHelper 설정
	for i = 1, 5 do
		local terrorist = get_character('safe_house_terrorist_' .. (i + 3))
		local shooter = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, terrorist)
		table.insert(self.shoot_helpers, CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
				shooter, spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot, 0.8))

function local_class:white_tinting(from, to, duration)
	self.white_tint_obj:SetActive(true)

	self.white_tint_renderer.color = unity_color({1, 1, 1, from})

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		self.white_tint_renderer.color = unity_color({1, 1, 1, from * (1 - progress) + to * progress})

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.white_tint_renderer.color = unity_color({1, 1, 1, to})
end

-- 특정 구역에 있는 npc들을 가져온다.
-- 단, 조건을 만족하지 못해서 보여주지 않을 npc들은 마계 시민으로 대체한다.
function local_class:get_or_create_npcs(infos, optimize_spec_index)
	optimize_spec_index = lua_helper.get_or_default(optimize_spec_index, 1)

	local optimized_targets = {}
	local optimized_target_infos = {}
	local total_npcs = {}

	for index, _ in pairs(infos) do
		local info = infos[index]
		self:renew_safe_house_info(info)

		-- 갱신 후에도 여전히 로드 타겟이 아니면
		if info.done == false then
			for _, name in pairs(info.members) do
				local disabled_npc = get_character(name)

				-- 자리를 채워줄 npc를 추가함
				table.insert(optimized_target_infos, {
					target_pos = disabled_npc.Position,
					target_dir = disabled_npc.Direction,
					origin_name = name
				})
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(disabled_npc)
				disabled_npc.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

				table.insert(optimized_targets, self.optimize_spec_names[optimize_spec_index])
				optimize_spec_index = optimize_spec_index % #self.optimize_spec_names + 1
			end
		else
			for _, name in pairs(info.members) do
				table.insert(total_npcs, get_character(name))
			end
		end
	end

	local optimized_npcs = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async(optimized_targets)

	for index, npc in pairs(optimized_npcs) do
		local info = optimized_target_infos[index]
		npc.Position = info.target_pos
		npc.Direction = info.target_dir
		npc.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		-- Dissolve Material의 인덱스를 찾을 때 Character.Name이 필요함
		npc.Name = optimized_targets[index]

		-- 가운데 구역인 경우 캐릭터를 Push 상태로 만듦
		if infos == self.safe_house_hall_infos then
			if index % 2 == 0 then
				character_util.set_emotion(npc, {name = 'scared'})
				character_util.set_anim(npc, {name = 'cast'})
			else
				character_util.set_emotion(npc, {name = 'tired'})
			end
		end

		table.insert(total_npcs, npc)

		if self.optimized_npcs[info.origin_name] == nil then
			self.optimized_npcs[info.origin_name] = npc
		else
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('Optimized NPC Duplicated!!!')
		end
	end

	return total_npcs
end

-- 활성화된 NPC를 가져옴.
-- NPC 이름 키값에 동적할당된 NPC들이 있는 경우, 원본 캐릭터를 사용하지 않은 것이므로 동적할당된 NPC를 리턴함
function local_class:get_enabled_npc(name)
	if self.optimized_npcs ~= nil and self.optimized_npcs[name] ~= nil then
		return self.optimized_npcs[name]
	end

	return get_character(name)
end

function local_class:renew_safe_house_info(info)

function local_class:set_npcs_sorting_layer(npcs, layer_name, order)

	end

	for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		local origin_dir = npc.Direction

		npc.SpineController:SetSortingLayer(layer_name, order)

	end

	end

function local_class:reset_npcs_material(npcs)

		npc.SpineController.MaterialOverride = nil
	end

function local_class:npcs_dissolve(from, to, duration, npcs)
	for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		npc.SpineController.MaterialOverride:SetFloat('_DissolveProgress', from)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 1 - to, duration * 0.8)
	end

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local current_value = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(from * (1 - progress) + to * progress)
		for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
			npc.SpineController.MaterialOverride:SetFloat('_DissolveProgress', current_value)
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		npc.SpineController.MaterialOverride:SetFloat('_DissolveProgress', to)
	end
end

function local_class:pop_up_npcs(npcs, delay_weight)
	delay_weight = lua_helper.get_or_default(delay_weight, 0.05)
	local shake_dur = 0.5
	local jump_dur = 0.3
	local state = {
		prostrate = 0,
		shake = 1,
		mario_jump = 2,
		done = 3,
	}
	local npcs_infos = {}
	local done_left = #npcs

	for index, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		table.insert(npcs_infos, {
			fo = npc,
			start_delay = (index - 1) * delay_weight,
			state = state.prostrate,
			time_passed = 0,
		})
	end

	while done_left > 0 do
		for index, _ in pairs(npcs_infos) do
			local info = npcs_infos[index]

			if info.state == state.prostrate then
				if info.time_passed >= info.start_delay then
					character_util.shake(info.fo, 0.03, shake_dur)
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
					info.state = state.shake
					info.time_passed = 0
				end
			elseif info.state == state.shake then
				if info.time_passed >= shake_dur then
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(info.fo)
					character_util.set_anim(info.fo, {name = 'get'})
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
					character_util.jump(info.fo, 0.4, jump_dur)

					info.state = state.mario_jump
					info.time_passed = 0
				end
			elseif info.state == state.mario_jump then
				if info.time_passed >= jump_dur then
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(info.fo)
					if lua_helper.reference_equals(info.fo, self.get_lilith()) then
						character_util.set_emotion(info.fo, {name = 'tired'})
					end
					info.state = state.done
					done_left = done_left - 1
				end
			end

			if info.state ~= state.done then
				info.time_passed = info.time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

							if i == 1 then

							end
						else
						end
					end

					character_util.set_position(head.npc, current_pos, not on_ground)
					head.r_angle = head.r_angle + 180 * head.m_speed * dt * (head.ccw and -1 or 1)
					character_util.spine_rotate(head.npc, head.r_angle, 0)
					head.m_speed = head.m_speed - dt
					head.y_speed = head.y_speed - dt * 9.8
				end
			end

			coroutine.yield()
		end

function local_class:get_bullet()
	for i = 1, #self.pooled_bullet do
		local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet[i].transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		if bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition == unity_class.vector3.one * 999 then
			return self.pooled_bullet[i]
		end
	end
end

function local_class:fire_bullet_effect(bullet_sprite, sniper_pos, target_pos, speed)
	bullet_sprite.position = sniper_pos
	local diff = target_pos - sniper_pos
	local look_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(diff)
	bullet_sprite.localRotation = look_rotation * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	--yield_return_func(self.bullet_move_to, self, bullet_sprite,
	--		bullet_sprite.localPosition, target_pos + diff * 0.3, -1, speed)

	local origin_pos = sniper_pos
	local end_pos = target_pos + diff * 0.5

	diff = end_pos - origin_pos;
	local timer = 0
	local duration = diff.magnitude / speed;

	--CS.Debug.LogError('for time of ' .. duration .. ', move to v(' .. end_pos.x .. ', ' .. end_pos.y .. ', ' .. end_pos.z .. ')')

	while timer < duration do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(timer / duration)
		local currentPos = vector_util.get_x0z(origin_pos * (1 - progress) + end_pos * progress, 0.3);
		bullet_sprite.position = currentPos

		if not self.is_paused then
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		else
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime * 0.01
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	bullet_sprite.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
end


return local_class

	self.get_hit_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit') end

	self.get_lobby = function(num) return field:GetMarker('epilogue_lobby_pos_' .. num).position end

	self.resource_holder = nil
	self.typing_text = nil

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'lilithtower_1_5'

end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_hit_effect()

	self.resource_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
		self.resource_holder, 'ui/prologue', 'typing_text', function(prefab)
			self.typing_text = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UITypingText))

			self.typing_text.Widget:SetAnchor(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, 1, 0, 1, 100)
			self.typing_text.Widget.topAnchor.relative = 0.5
			self.typing_text.Widget.bottomAnchor.relative = 0.5
			self.typing_text.Widget:UpdateAnchors()
			self.typing_text.Label.fontSize = 32
			self.typing_text.Label.alignment = CS.NGUIText.Alignment.Center
		end)
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.SetBackgroundColorEvent.Create(CS.UnityEngine.Color32(0, 0, 0, 0), 0))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_event, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.loop_sfx then
		self.loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.loop_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.typing_text then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.typing_text)
		self.typing_text = nil
	end

	if self.resource_holder then
		self.resource_holder:Dispose()
		self.resource_holder = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(_)
	return false
end

function local_class:show_event()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 에필로그 시작 타이핑 텍스트
	camera_util.move_async(vector(3000, 0, 0), 0)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress > 19 then
		-- 현재 섹션에서 시작 시
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
	else
		-- 이전 섹션에서 넘어왔을 때
		wait_for_sec(2)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('ondemand/v2_22_lilithtower/audio:01_event_lt_14')

	for i = 1, 5 do
		local dialogue_key = 'lilithtower_epilogue_typing_text_' .. i
		-- 스크린 전체가 FadeIn 되기에 Duration -1로 설정
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			self.typing_text:SetTypedText(
				game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords(dialogue_key), 1000, 0, -1))
		-- 보이스 출력
		local dialogue_holder = music_player:PlayDialogue(dialogue_key)

		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		wait_all({
			-- 최소 3초는 기다림 (기존 스펙)
			util.cs_generator(wait_for_sec, 3),
			-- 동작중인 보이스가 있다면 끝날때까지 대기함
			util.cs_generator(function()
				if dialogue_holder and dialogue_holder.IsUsing then
					repeat
						coroutine.yield()
					until not dialogue_holder.IsUsing
				end
			end)
		})

		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		-- 스크린 전체가 FadeOut 되기에 ForceFinish로 처리
		self.typing_text:ForceFinish()

		wait_for_sec(0.3)
	end

	wait_for_sec(2)

	if self.typing_text then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.typing_text)
		self.typing_text = nil
	end

	if self.resource_holder then
		self.resource_holder:Dispose()
		self.resource_holder = nil
	end

	-- 퍼플 코인 잠시 안 보이도록 처리
	local purple_coin_index = { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 27, 28 }
	local purple_coin_origin_pos = {}
	for _, index in pairs(purple_coin_index) do
		local purple_coin = get_field_object('purple_coin_' .. index)
		if purple_coin then
			purple_coin_origin_pos[purple_coin] = purple_coin.Position
			purple_coin.Position = vector(888, 0, 888)
		end
	end

	-- 스타피스도 비활성화 처리
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local star_piece = get_field_object('star_piece_'..i)
		star_piece.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	-- 에필로그 시작 이벤트
	self:start_epilogue()

	-- 퍼플 코인 원래 위치로
	for purple_coin, pos in pairs(purple_coin_origin_pos) do
		purple_coin.Position = pos
	end

	local event_list = {}

	-- 비서 이벤트
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(258)
	if quest_progress ~= nil and quest_util.get_custom_state(quest_progress, 'safe_house_secretary') ~= 1 then
		table.insert(event_list, {
			event_func = self.secretary_event,
			camera_pos = field:GetMarker('epilogue_secretary_camera').position,
			setting = self.secretary_event_setting
		})
	end

	-- 경관 이벤트
	quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(259)
	if quest_progress ~= nil and quest_progress.IsComplete and quest_progress.Grade == 0 then
		table.insert(event_list, {
			event_func = self.police_officer_event,
			camera_pos = field:GetMarker('epilogue_police_officer_camera').position,
			setting = self.police_officer_event_setting
		})
	end

	-- 생애 마지막 티타임 이벤트
	quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(262)
	if quest_progress ~= nil and quest_progress.IsComplete and quest_progress.Grade == 1 then
		table.insert(event_list, {
			event_func = self.last_teatime_event,
			camera_pos = field:GetMarker('epilogue_last_teatime_camera').position,
			setting = self.last_teatime_event_setting
		})
	end

	-- 인생은 아름다워 이벤트
	quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(265)
	if quest_progress ~= nil and (quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 1 or quest_progress.IsComplete) then
		table.insert(event_list, {
			event_func = self.life_is_beautiful_event,
			camera_pos = field:GetMarker('epilogue_life_is_beautiful_camera').position,
			setting = self.life_is_beautiful_event_setting
		})
	end

	-- 안드로이드 기술자 이벤트
	quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(260)
	if quest_progress ~= nil and quest_progress.IsComplete then
		table.insert(event_list, {
			event_func = self.android_engineer_event,
			camera_pos = field:GetMarker('epilogue_android_camera').position,
			setting = self.android_engineer_event_setting
		})
	end

	-- 소매치기 소녀 이벤트
	quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(261)
	if quest_progress ~= nil and quest_progress.IsComplete then
		table.insert(event_list, {
			event_func = self.pickpocket_girl_event,
			camera_pos = field:GetMarker('epilogue_pickpocket_girl_camera').position,
			setting = self.pickpocket_girl_event_setting
		})
	end

	-- 베스 이벤트
	quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(264)
	if quest_progress ~= nil and quest_progress.IsComplete and quest_progress.Grade == 0 then
		table.insert(event_list, {
			event_func = self.beth_event,
			camera_pos = field:GetMarker('epilogue_beth_camera').position,
			setting = self.beth_event_setting
		})
	end

	for i = 1, #event_list do
		camera_util.move_async(event_list[i].camera_pos, 0)

		camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

		event_list[i].setting(self)

		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		event_list[i].event_func(self)

		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		if self.optimized_npcs then
			load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npcs)
			self.optimized_npcs = nil
		end
	end

	-- bgm_transition: Event(bgm_lilith_epilogue) -> Muted 2
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local plasticboard = get_field_object('epilogue_plasticboard_' .. i)
		plasticboard.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end

	-- 스타피스 다시 활성화
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local star_piece = get_field_object('star_piece_'..i)
		star_piece.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
end

--- 에필로그 시작 이벤트
function local_class:start_epilogue()
	local trash_z_pos = 40
	local lobby_npcs = {
		get_character('lobby_business_male_1'),
		get_character('lobby_business_female_1'),
		get_character('lobby_business_male_2')
	}

	camera_util.move(vector(-300, 0, -300), 0)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0)

	local new_obj = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject()
	-- 에셋 번들 가져오기
	local bg_asset_bundle
	local load_asset_bundle_cb = function(res)
		bg_asset_bundle = res
	end

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.AssetBundleManager.Instance.LoadAssetBundleAsync,
			CS.Foundations.AssetBundleManager.Instance, 'ondemand/v2_22_lilithtower/theatres/epilogue', load_asset_bundle_cb)

	local bg_name = 'lilithtower_epilogue_theater.jpg'

	local load_asset_cb = function(texture_bytes)
		if texture_bytes then
			local texture = CS.UnityEngine.Texture2D(2, 2, CS.UnityEngine.TextureFormat.RGBA32, false)
			if CS.UnityEngine.ImageConversion.LoadImage(texture, texture_bytes.bytes, true) then
				local rect = CS.UnityEngine.Rect(0, 0, texture.width, texture.height)
				-- 텍스쳐를 스프라이트로 생성
				local sprite = CS.UnityEngine.Sprite.Create(texture,
						rect,
						vector(0.5, 0.5),
						100,
						0,
						CS.UnityEngine.SpriteMeshType.Tight,
						unity_class.vector4.zero,
						false)

				-- 새 오브젝트를 만들어서 SpriteRenderer를 붙여줌
				new_obj.transform.position = vector(-300, 0, -300)
				new_obj.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(90, 0, 0))
				local sprite_renderer = CS.GameObjectExtensions.GetOrAddComponent(new_obj,
						typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer))

				if sprite_renderer then
					sprite_renderer.sprite = sprite
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- 바이트를 이미지로 변경
	coroutine.yield(bg_asset_bundle:LoadAssetAsync(bg_name, load_asset_cb))

	-- bgm_transition: Field(bgm_lilith_tower) -> Event(bgm_lilith_epilogue), 2
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
		{ name = 'ondemand/v2_22_lilithtower/audio:bgm_lilith_epilogue', state = 'event', mix = 2 })

	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function ()
			camera_util.move_async(vector(-300, 0, -301), 5)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function ()
			wait_for_sec(4)
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		end)
	})

	new_obj:SetActive(false)
	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(new_obj)

	camera_util.move(self.get_lobby(1), 0)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

	-- 로비 동적 npc 생성 및 세팅
	self.optimized_npcs = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async({
		business_1 = 'lilithtower_business_female',
		business_2 = 'lilithtower_business_male'
	})
	character_util.set_direction(self.optimized_npcs['business_1'], 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(self.optimized_npcs['business_2'], 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(self.optimized_npcs['business_1'], { name = 'eat' })
	character_util.set_anim(self.optimized_npcs['business_2'], { name = 'eat' })
	self.optimized_npcs['business_1'].Position = self.get_lobby(3) + vector(4, 0, -2)
	self.optimized_npcs['business_2'].Position = self.get_lobby(3) + vector(3, 0, -4)

	-- 쓰레기 배치
	for i = 1, 11 do
		local trash = get_field_object('epilogue_lobby_trash_' .. i)
		trash.Position = trash.Position + vector(0,0,-trash_z_pos)
	end

	-- npc 배치
	for i = 1, 3 do
		lobby_npcs[i].Position = self.get_lobby(i)
		character_util.set_anim(lobby_npcs[i], { name = 'eat' })
	end

	character_util.set_direction(lobby_npcs[3], 'right')

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.hold_trash_and_move, self, lobby_npcs[2], get_field_object('epilogue_lobby_trash_4'),
					2, { lobby_npcs[2].Position + vector(1,0,0), lobby_npcs[2].Position + vector(1,0,-9) }))

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function ()
			camera_util.move_async(self.get_lobby(1) + vector(8,0,0), 5)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function ()
			wait_for_sec(4)
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		end)
	})

	-- 쓰레기 숨기기
	for i = 1, 11 do
		local trash = get_field_object('epilogue_lobby_trash_' .. i)
		trash.Position = vector(999,0,999)
	end

	if self.optimized_npcs then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npcs)
		self.optimized_npcs = nil
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(lobby_npcs[1])
	character_util.remove_anim(lobby_npcs[3])

	lobby_npcs[1].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	lobby_npcs[3].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

end

function local_class:hold_trash_and_move(npc, trash, wait_sec, waypoint)
	wait_for_sec(wait_sec)
	command_util.execute_holdup(npc, trash, npc.Position, nil,false)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_direction(npc, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'walk' })
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(npc, waypoint, 4, false, nil, nil, 'down')
	character_util.clear_holdup_state(npc, trash)
	npc.Position = vector(999,0,999)
	trash.Position = vector(999,0,999)
end

--- 인생은 아름다워 이벤트
function local_class:life_is_beautiful_event()
	local siblings_boy = self.optimized_npcs.siblings_boy
	local siblings_girl_1 = self.optimized_npcs.siblings_girl_1
	local siblings_girl_2 = self.optimized_npcs.siblings_girl_2
	local siblings_girl_3 = self.optimized_npcs.siblings_girl_3

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.survivors_routine, self))

	while not self.wait_survivor do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.wait_survivor = false

	character_util.set_direction(siblings_girl_1, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(siblings_girl_2, 'down')
	-- 남동생(right, tired) : 누나들, 셋째 누나는 언제 와?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(siblings_boy, { key = 'lilithtower_main_s21_31', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	-- 남동생(right, tired,cast) : 누나한테 1000점 다 모았다고 자랑하고 싶은데…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(siblings_boy, { key = 'lilithtower_main_s21_32', skip = true })

	if self.loop_sfx then
		self.loop_sfx:FadeOut(2)
		self.loop_sfx = nil
	end

	-- 누나2(tired) : …조금만 더 기다리면 나올 거야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(siblings_girl_2, { key = 'lilithtower_main_s21_32_1', skip = true })

	character_util.set_direction(siblings_girl_1, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(siblings_girl_2, 'up')

	self.wait_event = true

	while not self.wait_survivor do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.wait_survivor = false

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(siblings_girl_1, nil, 'silence')

	character_util.set_direction(siblings_girl_1, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(siblings_girl_2, 'down')

	-- 누나1 (tired) : 막내야…셋째는 돌아오는 게 좀 늦을 수도…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(siblings_girl_1, { key = 'lilithtower_main_s21_33', skip = true })

	-- 남동생 제자리에서 2번 점프
	character_util.normal_double_jump(siblings_boy, '01_small_jump_01')

	-- 보이스가 존재할 경우 해당 효과음은 생략한다.
	if not CS.Oak.ResourceSelector.Instance:HasScenarioDialogue(music_player.CurrentVoiceBundleCode) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_kid_boy_shout_01')
	end
	-- 남동생(tired, release) : 아니야! 셋째 누나 금방 돌아온다고 했어!
	character_util.set_anim(siblings_boy, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(siblings_boy, { key = 'lilithtower_main_s21_34', skip = true })

	-- 남동생(tired,release) : 같이 탱크 받으러 가기로 했단 말이야…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(siblings_boy, { key = 'lilithtower_main_s21_35', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(siblings_boy)

	character_util.set_locked_dir(siblings_girl_1, 'down')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(siblings_girl_2, 'down')

	-- 누나들 남자아이에게 더 다가간다.
	character_util.move_waypoint(
		siblings_girl_1, siblings_boy.Position + vector(-0.4, 0, 0.5), 1)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(
		siblings_girl_2, siblings_boy.Position + vector(0.4, 0, 0.5), 1)

	character_util.set_direction(siblings_girl_1, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(siblings_girl_2, 'down')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(siblings_girl_1, 'none')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(siblings_girl_2, 'none')

	-- 누나1(tired) : 미안해, 미안해 막내야…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(siblings_girl_1, { key = 'lilithtower_main_s21_36', skip = true })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 어…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(siblings_boy, { key = 'lilithtower_main_s21_37', skip = true })

	camera_util.move_async(siblings_girl_3.Position + vector(0, 0, -5), 2)

	wait_for_sec(1.7)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(siblings_girl_3,
		siblings_girl_3.Position + vector(0, 0, -4), 1)

	character_util.set_emotion(self.optimized_npcs.siblings_girl_3, { name = 'smile' })

	wait_for_sec(0.7)
end

--- 생존자들 행동 루틴
function local_class:survivors_routine()
	-- 문 밖으로 나가서 짝을 찾아가는 연출
	local out_door = function(target, couple, speed)
		local door_center = field:GetMarker('epilogue_door_center').position

		local waypoint = {
			vector(target.Position.x, 0, door_center.z),
			door_center,
			door_center + vector(0, 0, -2)
		}

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(target, waypoint, speed)

		character_util.set_anim(couple, { name = 'cast2' })
		character_util.normal_double_jump(couple, '01_small_jump_01')

		character_util.remove_anim(couple)

		local dir = vector_util.to_side_dir((couple.Position - target.Position).normalized)
		local dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(dir)
		local meeting_pos = target.Position + vector(0, 0, -2)

		wait_all({
			util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, target, meeting_pos, speed, false, nil, nil, dir),
			util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
				couple, meeting_pos + dir_vector, speed, false, nil, nil, direction_util.get_opposite(dir))
		})
	end

	-- 짝을 만난 후 나가는 연출
	local couple_out_building = function(target, couple, speed, direction)
		local dir = direction == 'right' and 1 or -1

		local target_waypoint = {
			target.Position + vector(1.5 * dir, 0, 0),
			target.Position + vector(1.5 * dir, 0, -6)
		}

		local couple_waypoint = {
			couple.Position + vector(1.5 * dir, 0, 0),
			couple.Position + vector(1.5 * dir, 0, -6)
		}

		character_util.move_waypoint(target, target_waypoint, speed)
		character_util.move_waypoint(couple, couple_waypoint, speed)
	end

	-- 그냥 밖으로 나가는 연출
	local out_building = function(target, speed, direction)
		local dir = direction == 'right' and 1 or -1
		local door_center = field:GetMarker('epilogue_door_center').position + vector(0.5 * dir, 0, 0)

		local waypoint = {
			vector(target.Position.x, 0, door_center.z),
			door_center,
			door_center + vector(0, 0, -4),
			door_center + vector(1.5 * dir, 0, -4),
			door_center + vector(1.5 * dir, 0, -10.5)
		}

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(target, waypoint, speed)
	end

	-- 1번 2번 만남
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local survivor_1 = self.optimized_npcs.survivor_1
		local survivor_2 = self.optimized_npcs.survivor_2

		out_door(survivor_2, survivor_1, 3)

		character_util.set_emotion(survivor_2, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_anim(survivor_2, { name = 'push' })
		character_util.move_waypoint(survivor_2,
			survivor_2.Position + vector(-0.25, 0, 0), 1)

		character_util.set_emotion(survivor_1, { name = 'cry' })
		character_util.set_anim(survivor_1, { name = 'push' })
		character_util.move_waypoint(survivor_1,
			survivor_1.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0), 1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_female_cry_01')
		-- 살아있을 줄 알았어…!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(survivor_1, { key = 'lilithtower_main_s21_24_5' })

		character_util.remove_anim(survivor_1)
		character_util.remove_anim(survivor_2)

		couple_out_building(survivor_1, survivor_2, 2, 'left')
	end))

	-- 11번 나감
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
		util.cs_generator(out_building, self.optimized_npcs.survivor_11, 2, 'right'))

	wait_for_sec(3)

	-- 12번 나감
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
		util.cs_generator(out_building, self.optimized_npcs.survivor_12, 2, 'left'))
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 13번 나감
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
		util.cs_generator(out_building, self.optimized_npcs.survivor_13, 2, 'left'))

	local survivor_3_speech_end = false

	-- 3번 4번 만남
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local survivor_3 = self.optimized_npcs.survivor_3
		local survivor_4 = self.optimized_npcs.survivor_4

		out_door(survivor_4, survivor_3, 2.5)

		character_util.set_emotion(survivor_3, { name = 'cry' })
		character_util.set_anim(survivor_3, { name = 'push' })
		character_util.move_waypoint(survivor_3,
			survivor_3.Position + vector(-0.25, 0, 0), 1)

		character_util.set_emotion(survivor_4, { name = 'cry' })
		character_util.set_anim(survivor_4, { name = 'push' })
		character_util.move_waypoint(survivor_4,
			survivor_4.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0), 1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		-- 무사해서 다행이야…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(survivor_3, { key = 'lilithtower_main_s21_24_3' })

		survivor_3_speech_end = true

		character_util.remove_anim(survivor_3)
		character_util.remove_anim(survivor_4)

		couple_out_building(survivor_3, survivor_4, 2, 'right')
	end))

	wait_for_sec(3)

	-- 14번 나감
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
		util.cs_generator(out_building, self.optimized_npcs.survivor_14, 2, 'left'))
	wait_for_sec(4)

	while not survivor_3_speech_end do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	self.wait_survivor = true

	-- 15번 나감
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
		util.cs_generator(out_building, self.optimized_npcs.survivor_15, 2.5, 'right'))

	while not self.wait_event do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.wait_event = false

	-- 5번 6번 만남
	local survivor_5 = self.optimized_npcs.survivor_5
	local survivor_6 = self.optimized_npcs.survivor_6

	out_door(survivor_6, survivor_5, 3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	character_util.set_emotion(survivor_5, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(survivor_5, { name = 'push' })
	character_util.move_waypoint(survivor_5,
		survivor_5.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0), 1)

	character_util.set_emotion(survivor_6, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(survivor_6, { name = 'push' })
	character_util.move_waypoint(survivor_6,
		survivor_6.Position + vector(-0.25, 0, 0), 1)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.remove_anim(survivor_5)
	character_util.remove_anim(survivor_6)

	couple_out_building(survivor_5, survivor_6, 2, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(4)

	self.wait_survivor = true
end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_victim_scream_01')
	-- 도…도둑이야!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(pickpocket_civilian,
		{ key = 'lilithtower_main_s21_70', bubble_type = 'shout', scale = 1.4,
		  world_pos = pickpocket_civilian.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 1), type_speed = 0 })

	character_util.set_direction(self.optimized_npcs.civilian_2, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.optimized_npcs.civilian_2, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_anim(self.optimized_npcs.civilian_2, { name = 'cast' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	-- 시민1(surprise, cast) : 도둑? 어디?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.optimized_npcs.civilian_2,
		{ key = 'lilithtower_main_s21_108', type_speed = 0 })

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(
		pickpocket_girl, pickpocket_girl.Position + vector(13, 0, 0), 6,
		true, nil, nil, nil, true)

	-- 시간 이동 move_waypoint
	local move_waypoint_duration = function(target, pos, duration, sfx)
		local speed = (pos - target.Position).magnitude / duration
		character_util.move_waypoint(target, pos, speed,
			true, nil, nil, nil, sfx)
		return speed
	end

	local catching_pos = pickpocket_man.Position + vector(12, 0, 0)
	local move_duration = 2.5

	-- 카메라 이동 + 달려가는 소매치기 소녀, 범인

	local pickpocket_man_speed = move_waypoint_duration(pickpocket_man, catching_pos, move_duration, false)
	camera_util.move(catching_pos, move_duration)
	wait_for_sec(move_duration - 0.5)

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_female_shout_01')
	-- 야 이 도둑놈아!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(pickpocket_girl,
		{ key = 'lilithtower_main_s21_71', bubble_type = 'shout', scale = 1.4, type_speed = 0, life_time = 1.3 })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.stop(pickpocket_man)
	character_util.move_waypoint(pickpocket_man,
		pickpocket_man.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), pickpocket_man_speed, true)

	-- 시민 반응

	character_util.set_direction(self.optimized_npcs.civilian_11, 'up')

	character_util.set_emotion(self.optimized_npcs.civilian_4, { name = 'surprise' })

	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_03')
	self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(pickpocket_girl.Position + vector(0.5, 0.2, 0.1))

	-- 쓰러지는 범인

	character_util.remove_emotion(pickpocket_man)
	character_util.set_emotion(pickpocket_man, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(pickpocket_man, { name = 'prostrate' })

		pickpocket_girl.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0), 5, true,

function local_class:beth_event()
	local beth = self.optimized_npcs.beth
	local cleaner_1 = self.optimized_npcs.cleaner_1
	local cleaner_2 = self.optimized_npcs.cleaner_2

	local beth_trash = get_field_object('epilogue_trash_1')

	-- 베스 청소 루틴

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_grass_slide_02')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		local waypoint = {
			beth.Position + vector(2, 0, 0),
			beth.Position + vector(2, 0, 1)
		}

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(beth,
				waypoint, 1.5, false, nil, nil, 'right')

		self.loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
		character_util.set_anim(beth, { name = 'eat' })
	end

	-- 미화원1 청소 루틴
	local cleaner_1_routine = function()
		local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(cleaner_1)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.set_anim(cleaner_1, { name = 'eat' })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim(cleaner_1)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.set_direction(cleaner_1, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(cleaner_1, { name = 'eat' })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		eat_sfx:Stop()
		character_util.remove_anim(cleaner_1)
	end

	-- 미화원2 청소 루틴
	local cleaner_2_routine = function()

			cleaner_2.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),

		}

		character_util.set_direction(cleaner_2, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(cleaner_2, { name = 'eat' })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim(cleaner_2)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(beth_routine),
		util.cs_generator(cleaner_1_routine),
		util.cs_generator(cleaner_2_routine)
	})

	character_util.set_direction(cleaner_2, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(cleaner_1, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(cleaner_1, { name = 'tired' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	-- 미화원1 : 아이고, 테러범 놈들이 난리를 쳐놓고 가서 그런지 오늘따라 청소할게 더 많네…

end

--[[QuestAttribute

]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.optimized_npcs = nil

	self.trouble_shooter = nil
	self.mad_scientist = nil
	self.secretary = nil
	self.troll = nil

	self.gate_civil_1 = nil
	self.gate_civil_2 = nil
	self.gate_civil_3 = nil
	self.guard = nil

	self.technician_item = nil

	self.cloth_complete = false
	self.perfume_complete = false
	self.cookie_complete = false

	self.get_costume = function(num) return get_field_object('costume_'..num) end

	self.perfume_man = nil
	self.perfume_man_2 = nil
	self.get_perfume_interact = function() return get_field_object('perfume_interact') end

	self.cookie_man = nil

	self.police = nil
	self.police_event = false
	self.police_event_ing = false

	self.swipe_type = ''

	self.get_smell_2_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Char_Debuff_green') end
	self.get_smell_3_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_BuffMagic_Target') end
	self.get_hit_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit') end
	self.get_get_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_get') end
	self.get_siren_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lobby_check_siren_alert') end
	self.get_custom_sprite = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite') end

	-- 이벤트 상태값
	self.event_state = {
		none = 0,
		before_talk = 1,
		talk_1 = 2,
		task_1_before = 3,
		task_1_ing = 4,
		task_1_cleared = 5,
		task_2_before = 6,
		task_2_ing = 7,
		task_2_cleared = 8,
		task_3_before = 9,
		task_3_ing = 10,
		task_3_cleared = 11,
		talk_2 = 12
	}

	-- 현재 이벤트 상태
	self.current_state = self.event_state.none
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_char_debuff_destruction')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Char_Debuff_green')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_BuffMagic_Target')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_get')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lobby_check_siren_alert')

	self.get_smell_1_effect()
	self.get_smell_2_effect()
	self.get_smell_3_effect()
	self.get_hit_effect()
	self.get_get_effect()
	self.get_siren_effect()
	self.get_custom_sprite()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	-- 총알 프리로드
	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local custom_atlas
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
				custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)

	self.pooled_bullet = {}
	for i = 1, 50 do
		self.pooled_bullet[i] = self.get_custom_sprite():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)
		local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet[i].transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
		bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
		bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
		bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
		bullet_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas

		bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'virus_bullet_1.png'
		bullet_sprite:Rebuild()
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	self.trouble_shooter = get_character('trouble_shooter')
	self.mad_scientist = get_character('mad_scientist')
	self.secretary = get_character('secretary')
	self.troll = get_character('troll')

	get_field_object('runaway_route_block').Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(4, 1, 4))
	get_field_object('runaway_route_block').Position = vector(-12.5, 0, 52.5)

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.opening_routine, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	self.troll.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	self.cookie_buyer[6].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self.gate_civil_1 = nil
	self.gate_civil_2 = nil
	self.gate_civil_3 = nil
	self.guard = nil
	self.cookie_buyer = nil

	self.swipe_type = nil

	function clean_up_npcs(targets)
		local char_count = 0
		for _, character in pairs(targets) do
			character.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			char_count = char_count + 1
		end

		while true do
			local cleaned_count = 0
			for _, character in pairs(targets) do
				if character.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped then
					cleaned_count = cleaned_count + 1
				end
			end

			if char_count == cleaned_count then
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(targets)
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(clean_up_npcs, self.optimized_npcs))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.secretary) then
			if self.current_state == self.event_state.before_talk then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.talk_1
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.secretary_talk_1, self))
				return true
			end
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_perfume_interact()) then
			if self.current_state ~= self.event_state.before_talk and self.current_state % 3 == 1 and self.perfume_complete == false then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.perfume_store_event_ing, self))
				return true
			end
		end
		for i = 1, 4 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_costume(i)) then
				if self.current_state ~= self.event_state.before_talk and self.current_state % 3 == 1 and self.cloth_complete == false then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.cloth_store_event_ing, self, i))
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'cloth_store_enter' and self.cloth_complete == false then
				if self.current_state % 3 == 0 then
					self.current_state = self.current_state + 1
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.cloth_store_event_start, self))
					return true
				end
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'cloth_store_exit' and self.cloth_complete == false then
				if self.current_state ~= self.event_state.before_talk and self.current_state % 3 == 1 then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.cloth_store_event_block, self))
					return true
				end
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'perfume_store_enter' and self.perfume_complete == false then
				if self.current_state % 3 == 0 then
					self.current_state = self.current_state + 1
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.perfume_store_event_start, self))
					return true
				end
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'perfume_store_exit' and self.perfume_complete == false then
				if self.current_state ~= self.event_state.before_talk and self.current_state % 3 == 1 then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.perfume_store_event_block, self))
					return true
				end
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'cookie_store_event' and self.cookie_complete == false then
				if self.current_state % 3 == 0 then
					self.current_state = self.current_state + 1
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.cookie_buy_event, self))
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		return self:on_touch_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'main_lobby_grid') then
		self.center_grid_in = true
		if self.current_state == self.event_state.task_3_before and self.police_event == false then
			self.police_event = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.police_meet_event, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'main_lobby_grid') then
		self.center_grid_in = false
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
		self.swipe_type = 'left'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
		self.swipe_type = 'right'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
		self.swipe_type = 'up'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
		self.swipe_type = 'down'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		if self.tap_sfx_name then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.tap_sfx_name)
		end
		self.swipe_type = 'tap'
		self.turbo_tap_count = self.turbo_tap_count + 1
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.1)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

end

-- region cloth
function local_class:cloth_store_event_start()
	quest_marker_util.remove('cloth')
	quest_marker_util.remove('perfume')
	quest_marker_util.remove('cookie')
	for i = 1, 4 do
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, ('costume_'..i), self.get_costume(i))
		self.get_costume(i).Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	-- 최대한 각하와의 만남에 어울리는 옷으로 골라주세요!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.secretary, { key = 'lilithtower_s3_cloth_1', skip = false })
end

function local_class:cloth_store_event_block()
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	for i = 0, 2 do
		character_util.normal_jump(user_party[i])
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], { name = 'embarrassed' })
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'scared' })
	end

	-- 옷을 골라주세요! 당신은 마계 통수권자를 만나 뵙는 거지 사자와 싸우러 가는 것이 아니라고요!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)
	character_util.set_anim(self.secretary, { name = 'release' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.secretary, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.secretary, { key = 'lilithtower_s3_cloth_2', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout', scale = 1.2 })

	for i = 0, 2 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
		character_util.move_to(user_party[i], user_party[i].Position + vector(2, 0, 0), 0.5, nil, true, true)
	end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.secretary)
	character_util.move_to(self.secretary, self.secretary.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), 0.5, nil, true, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:cloth_store_event_ing(num)
	local costume = nil

	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.secretary)

	party_util.align_party(self.get_costume(num).Position, 'down', 0.5, 'arc')

	if num == 1 then
		-- 중후한 멋이 느껴지는 강철로 만들어진 갑옷.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lilithtower_s3_cloth_heavy_1' })

		-- 주의 : 아무리 다쳐도 살짝 긁혔을 뿐인 느낌이들 수 있음.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lilithtower_s3_cloth_heavy_2' })
	elseif num == 2 then
		-- 어깨의 각이 날카롭게 떨어지는 멋스러운 핏의 세련된 정장.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lilithtower_s3_cloth_suit_1' })

		-- 트랜디함 또한 놓치지 않았는지 마계 최신 유행의 자수가 놓여있다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lilithtower_s3_cloth_suit_2' })

		-- 마치 맞춤정장을 입은 듯한 편안함을 느낄 수 있을 것 같다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lilithtower_s3_cloth_suit_3' })
	elseif num == 3 then
		-- 이국에서 어렵게 공수해온 신상!
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lilithtower_s3_cloth_mouse_1' })

		-- 주의 : 쥐구멍에 들어가지 마시오.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lilithtower_s3_cloth_mouse_2' })
	else
		-- 102번 밖에 입지 않은 새것같은 중고!
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lilithtower_s3_cloth_magician_1' })

		-- 주의 : 알콜냄새로 인한 반품은 불가합니다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lilithtower_s3_cloth_magician_2' })
	end

	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.secretary)

	-- 이 옷으로 갈아입는다. / 그만둔다.
	local choose = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'lilithtower_s3_cloth_choice_1', 'mercy' }, { 'lilithtower_s3_cloth_choice_2', 'normal' } })

	if choose == 2 then
		self.secretary.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		character_util.convert_to_following_npc(self.secretary, user_party, false, CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.OutBattleZone, 0)

		stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()

		return
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_equipping_01')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'eat' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local pos = user_party.Leader.Position

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
	camera_util.move_async(pos, 0)

	if num == 1 then
		costume = get_character('heavy_costume')
	elseif num == 2 then
		if user_util.has_knight_male() then
			costume = get_character('knight_male_suit')
		else
			costume = get_character('knight_female_suit')
		end
	elseif num == 3 then
		costume = get_character('mouse_costume')
	else
		costume = get_character('magician_costume')
	end

	self.costume_num = num

	character_util.set_active_state(costume, "enabled")
	costume.Position = pos
	user_party.Leader.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.trouble_shooter)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.mad_scientist)

	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(costume)

	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')

	character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.trouble_shooter, user_party, true)
	character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.mad_scientist, user_party, true)

	party_util.align_party(vector(39, 0, 33.5), 'right', 0, 'arc')

	self.secretary.Position = vector(37, 0, 33.5)
	character_util.set_direction(self.secretary, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.secretary)

	camera_util.move_async(vector(38, 0, 34), 0, { ignoregrids = true })

	for i = 1, 4 do
		quest_marker_util.remove(('costume_'..i))
		self.get_costume(i).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	self.current_state = self.current_state + 1

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.cloth_store_event_end, self))
end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.current_state = self.current_state + 1

	if self.costume_num ~= 2 then
		character_util.set_emotion(self.secretary, { name = 'tired' })
		if self.costume_num == 1 then
			character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_equip_finish_01')
			screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_iron_teatan_head_shake_01')
			character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'sword_attack_stab', loop = false })
			wait_for_sec(0.4)
			character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
			wait_for_sec(0.1)
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_iron_teatan_head_shake_01')

			character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			-- ...어디 눈밭에 있는 토끼와 결투라도 하시게요?

			character_util.remove_anim(self.secretary)

		elseif self.costume_num == 3 then

			screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')

			wait_all({
				util.cs_generator(function ()
					wait_for_sec(1.5)
					music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_cat_meow_01')
				end),
				util.cs_generator(function ()
					character_util.move_to_async(self.optimized_npcs['cat'], vector(33, 0, 34), nil, 4, true, true)
					character_util.move_to_async(self.optimized_npcs['cat'], vector(33, 0, 33), nil, 4, true, true)
					character_util.move_to_async(self.optimized_npcs['cat'], vector(35, 0, 33), nil, 4, true, true)
				end)
			})

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_runaway_01')
			camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
			character_util.normal_jump(user_party.Leader)
			character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })
			character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'damaged' })
			character_util.set_anim(self.optimized_npcs['cat'], { name = 'hissing' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.optimized_npcs['cat'], { name = 'mad' })
			wait_for_sec(1.5)

			character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
			character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'tired' })
			character_util.remove_emotion(self.optimized_npcs['cat'])
			character_util.set_anim(self.optimized_npcs['cat'], { name = 'scratch', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			-- 고양이 먹이가 될 생각이 아니라면 그 복장은 포기하는게 어때요?
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
			character_util.set_anim(self.secretary, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.secretary, { key = 'lilithtower_s3_cloth_mouse_3', skip = true })
			character_util.remove_anim(self.secretary)

		elseif self.costume_num == 4 then

			local smell_effect = self.get_smell_2_effect():Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_equip_finish_01')
			screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			wait_for_sec(1.5)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			-- ...아니 왜 이리 술 냄새가...
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
			character_util.set_emotion(self.secretary, { name = 'tired' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.secretary, { key = 'lilithtower_s3_cloth_magician_3', skip = true })

			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_swing_01')
			character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'tired' })
			character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_swing_01')
			character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			-- 혹시 각하를 만나뵙기 싫으신거면 솔직하게 말씀해 주시겠어요?
			character_util.stop_shake(self.secretary)
			character_util.set_anim(self.secretary, { name = 'release' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.secretary, { name = 'tired' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.secretary, { key = 'lilithtower_s3_cloth_magician_4', skip = true })

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.smell_dispose, self, smell_effect))
		end

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'frustration', loop = false})

		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		-- ...옷 고르는 안목이 이렇게 최악일 줄이야.
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_anim(self.secretary, { name = 'question', loop = false })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.secretary, { key = 'lilithtower_s3_cloth_fail_1', skip = true })

		-- 그냥 제가 골라 드리는대로 입는 게 낫겠네요.
		character_util.set_anim(self.secretary, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.secretary, { name = 'attack' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.secretary, { key = 'lilithtower_s3_cloth_fail_2', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(self.secretary)

		character_util.move_to_async(self.secretary, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), nil, 2, true, true)

		local equip_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop' })
		character_util.set_anim(self.secretary, { name = 'eat' })

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		self.optimized_npcs['cat'].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

		else
			costume = get_character('knight_female_suit')
		end

		costume.Position = vector(40, 0, 33.5)
		user_party.Leader.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

		character_util.convert_to_npc(self.trouble_shooter)
		character_util.convert_to_npc(self.mad_scientist)

		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')

		character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.mad_scientist, user_party, true)

		character_util.remove_emotion(self.secretary)

		equip_sfx:FadeOut(0)

	character_util.move_to_async(self.secretary, vector(37, 0, 33.5), nil, 2, false, true)

	character_util.set_emotion(self.secretary, { name = 'doyagao' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.secretary, { key = 'lilithtower_s3_cloth_end_1', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'throw' })

			character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

		util.cs_generator(function ()
			character_util.move_to_async(self.optimized_npcs['cloth_1'], vector(38.5, 0, 34), nil, 3, true, true)

function local_class:smell_dispose(target)
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed <= 0.5 do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		target.transform.localScale = (1 - time_passed) * unity_class.vector3.one

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	target:Dispose()
end

function local_class:cookie_buy_event()
	local rand_jump = function(fo)
		local rand = random_util.get_random_int(1, 200)

		wait_for_sec(rand/1000)
		character_util.normal_jump(fo)
		character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	end

	local rand_anim = function(fo)
		local rand = random_util.get_random_int(1, 100)

		if rand%4 == 1 then
			character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'embarrassed'})
		elseif rand%4 == 2 then
			character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'cast2' })
		elseif rand%4 == 3 then
			character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'release' })
		else
			character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'success' })
		end
	end

	local slide = function(fo, dir)
		local knock_back_dir = nil

		if dir == 'left' then
			knock_back_dir = vector(-1, 0, 0)
		else
			knock_back_dir = vector(1, 0, 0)
		end

		character_util.normal_jump(fo)
		character_util.set_direction(fo, dir)
		character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'prostrate' })
		character_util.set_emotion(fo, { name = 'damaged' })

		local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
			'physics', true, knock_back_dir, 12000, 0.05,
			CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient, false, true)

		local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(fo, knock_back_info)
		fo.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))
	end

-- QTE 함수
function local_class:qte_swipe(type)

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(type)

	self.swipe_type = ''
	self.is_qte_start = true

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')

	while self.is_qte_start and self.swipe_type ~= type or self.swipe_type == '' do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	self.is_qte_start = false

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
end

-- 터치 연타 함수
function local_class:turbo_tap(count)
	local animation_time_scale = 1

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(animation_time_scale)

	local time_passed = 0

	self.turbo_tap_count = 0
	self.is_qte_start = true

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')

	while self.is_qte_start and self.turbo_tap_count < count do
		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.is_qte_start = false

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
end

function local_class:load_theatre()

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.resholder, "ondemand/v2_22_lilithtower/theatres/fake_guardian_tv", "fake_guardian_tv", function(prefab)

				self.news_theatre:SetActive(false)
			end)

	self:load_news_texture()

	self.dialogue = self.news_theatre.gameObject:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.UISubtitle))
	local background = self.news_theatre.transform:Find('female_tv/idle/fakenews_female_idle/fakenews_female_idle'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer))
	local camera = self.news_theatre.transform:Find('Camera pivot'):GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))

	local bgUnitWidth = background.size.x * background.transform.localScale.x
	local viewUnitHeight = bgUnitWidth / camera.aspect -- 현재 해상도에서 배경이 보이는 높이
	camera.orthographicSize = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Clamp(viewUnitHeight * 0.35, 3.5, 4.7) -- 현재 해상도에 맞춰 카메라 높이를 클램핑해준다
end

-- 대사 출력
function local_class:talk(key, skip, deactivate_dialogue, play_dialogue)
	skip = lua_helper.get_or_default(skip, true)
	deactivate_dialogue = lua_helper.get_or_default(deactivate_dialogue, true)
	play_dialogue = lua_helper.get_or_default(play_dialogue, true)

	self.is_dialogue_on = true

	self.dialogue.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	-- 보이스가 존재할 경우 다이얼로그 효과음은 생략한다.
	if not (play_dialogue and CS.Oak.ResourceSelector.Instance:HasScenarioDialogue(music_player.CurrentVoiceBundleCode)) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.play_dialogue_sound, self))
	end

	-- 성별에 따라 추가로 보이스 키를 지정한다.
	if user_util.has_knight_male() then
		yield_return_func(self.dialogue.Show, self.dialogue, 'nil', key, skip, play_dialogue)
	else
		yield_return_func(self.dialogue.Show, self.dialogue, 'nil', key, key .. '_alt', skip, play_dialogue)
	end

	self.is_dialogue_on = false

	if deactivate_dialogue then
		self.dialogue.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end
end

-- 다일로그 소리 출력
function local_class:play_dialogue_sound()
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	local dialogue_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	while self.dialogue.IsTalking do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	dialogue_sfx:Stop()
end

function local_class:get_bullet()
	for i = 1, #self.pooled_bullet do
		local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet[i].transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		if bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition == unity_class.vector3.one * 999 then
			return self.pooled_bullet[i]
		end
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	self.secretary = get_character('secretary')
	self.troll = get_character('troll')
	self.child = get_character('bridge_child')

	for i = 6, 37 do
		self.get_bridge(i).CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.bridge_animator[i] = self.get_bridge(i).transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	end
	self.get_bridge(1).CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self.bridge_animator[1] = self.get_bridge(1).transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	get_field_object('runaway_route_block').Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(4, 1, 4))
	get_field_object('runaway_route_block').Position = vector(-12.5, 0, 52.5)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stage_start, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	self:stop_timer()

	if self.resholder ~= nil then
		self.resholder:Dispose()
		self.resholder = nil
	end

	if self.news_theatre ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.news_theatre)
		self.news_theatre = nil
	end

	self.dialogue = nil

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_first_exit()) then
			-- 도망치는 도중에는 한번 도주하면 인터렉트 불가능하도록 변경
			self.get_first_exit().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.first_exit_interact, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('2F_stair')) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.second_stair_interact, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_second_exit()) then
			-- 도망치는 도중에는 한번 도주하면 인터렉트 불가능하도록 변경
			self.get_second_exit().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.second_exit_interact, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('s4_office_elevator')) then
			self.current_state = self.event_state.office_event
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.elevator_enter_event, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('s4_office_vent')) then
			if self.current_state == self.event_state.office_event_2 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.office_object_interact, self, e.Target))
			else
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.office_barricade_end_event_2, self))
			end
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('s4_office_tv')) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.office_object_interact, self, e.Target))
		end
		for i = 3 , 6 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_office_obj(i)) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.office_object_interact, self, e.Target))
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			self:quest_marker_setting(e)

			if e.Zone.Name == 's3_ending' then
				if self.current_state == self.event_state.none then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.terror_begin, self))
					return true
				end
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'lobby_terror_1' and self.current_state == self.event_state.terror_begin then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.terror_1
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lobby_terror_1_1, self))
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lobby_terror_1_2, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'lobby_terror_2' and self.current_state == self.event_state.terror_1 then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.terror_2
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lobby_terror_2, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'lobby_terror_3' and self.current_state == self.event_state.terror_2 then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.terror_3
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lobby_terror_3, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'lobby_terror_4' and self.current_state == self.event_state.terror_3 then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.terror_4
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lobby_terror_4, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'back_door_event' and self.current_state == self.event_state.before_backdoor_event then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.backdoor_event
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.backdoor_breach, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'back_door_chase' then
				if self.current_state == self.event_state.before_backdoor_event or self.current_state == self.event_state.backdoor_event then
					self.current_state = self.event_state.backdoor_chase
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.backdoor_chase, self))
					return true
				end
			elseif e.Zone.Name == '1F_reset' and self.current_state == self.event_state.before_chase_1 then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.before_chase_2
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.civil_over_door, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == '1F_down_game_over' and self.current_state ~= self.event_state.backdoor_chase then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.down_game_over, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == '2F_chase_start' and self.current_state == self.event_state.before_chase_2 then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.chase_start
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.second_chase_start, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == '2F_chase_1' then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.chase_hit_1, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == '2F_chase_2' then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.chase_hit_2, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == '2F_chase_3' then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.chase_hit_3, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == '2F_chase_4' then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.chase_hit_4, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == '2F_chase_5' then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.chase_hit_5, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'bridge_enter' and self.current_state == self.event_state.chase_start then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.bridge
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bridge_setting, self))
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.before_collaps_routine, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'bridge_kid_bg_event' and self.current_state == self.event_state.bridge and self.child_cry == false then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.bridge_child
				self.child_cry = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.child_bg_event, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'bridge_hit_end' and self.current_state == self.event_state.bridge_child then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.bridge_collaps
				if self.child.Position.y ~= 0 then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.child_save_success, self))
				else
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.child_save_fail, self))
				end
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 's4_elevator_zone' and self.current_state == self.event_state.office_event then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.office_event_2
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.office_elevator_success, self))
				return true
			end
		end
		for i = 1, 16 do
			if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_terror(i)) then
				if e.Zone.Name == 'terror_stop' then
					if self.current_state < self.event_state.terror_4 then
						if i >= 1 and i <= 4 then
							coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.guard_stop, self, self.get_terror(i), "lobby_detected", 120))
						else
							coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.guard_stop, self, self.get_terror(i), "lobby_detected"))
						end
					else
						if i >= 1 and i <= 5 then
							coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.guard_stop, self, self.get_terror(i), "bridge_detected"))
						elseif i >= 13 and i <= 16 then
							coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.guard_stop, self, self.get_terror(i), "backdoor_detected", 120, 3))
						end
					end
				elseif e.Zone.Name == 's4_terror_stop' then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.office_guard_end, self))
				elseif e.Zone.Name == 'terror_stop_special' then
					if i == 14 or i == 15 then
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.guard_stop, self, self.get_terror(i), "lobby_detected"))
					end
				end
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent) then
		return self:on_hold_up_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		--return self:on_touch_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent) then
		for i = 5, 8 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_office_obj(i)) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.office_throw_event, self, e.Target))
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent) then
		return self:on_timer_alarm_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

-- region event
function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'backdoor_grid') and self.current_state == self.event_state.terror_4 then
		self.current_state = self.event_state.before_backdoor_event
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.backdoor_runaway, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_hold_up_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.child) then

		local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
		manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Interact | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Throw)

		local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
		message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

		return true
	end

	for i = 5, 8 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_office_obj(i)) then
			start_coroutine(function()
				for j = 5, 8 do
					quest_marker_util.remove(('obj_'..j))
				end
				coroutine.yield()
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'barricade', vector(57, 0, 108.5))
			end)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:office_throw_event(target)
	target.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
	while target.Position.y > 0 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_dummy_02')

	quest_marker_util.remove('barricade')
	for j = 5, 8 do
		if lua_helper.type_compare(self.get_office_obj(j).Holdable, typeof(CS.Oak.Holdable)) then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'obj_'..j, self.get_office_obj(j))
		end
	end

	if target.Position.x > 55.5 and
		target.Position.x < 58.5 and
		target.Position.z > 107.5 and
		target.Position.z < 109.5 then
		self.barricade_count = self.barricade_count + 1

		if self.barricade_count == 4 then
			start_coroutine(self.office_barricade_end_event, self)
			return
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)

		target.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	else
		target.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()

		for j = 5, 8 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.get_office_obj(j), target) then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'obj_'..j, target)
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == "lobby_detected" and self.detected_event_ing == false then
		if self.current_state < self.event_state.terror_4 then
			self.detected_event_ing = true
			self.bg_event_dispose = true
			self.current_state = self.event_state.terror_begin
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lobby_detected, self, e.Sender))
			return true
		else
			self.detected_event_ing = true
			self.bg_event_dispose = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lobby_detected_2, self, e.Sender))
			return true
		end
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == "backdoor_detected" and self.detected_event_ing == false then
		if self.current_state <= self.event_state.backdoor_chase then
			self.detected_event_ing = true
			self.bg_event_dispose = true
			self.current_state = self.event_state.before_backdoor_event
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.backdoor_detected, self, e.Sender))
			return true
		elseif self.current_state > self.event_state.backdoor_chase then
			self.detected_event_ing = true
			self.bg_event_dispose = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.down_detected, self, e.Sender))
			return true
		end
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == "chase_detected" and self.detected_event_ing == false then
		self.detected_event_ing = true
		self.bg_event_dispose = true
		self.current_state = self.event_state.before_chase_2
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.chase_detected, self, e.Sender))
		return true
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == "bridge_detected" and self.detected_event_ing == false then
		self.current_state = self.event_state.bridge_child
		self.detected_event_ing = true
		self.bg_event_dispose = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bridge_detected_1, self, e.Sender))
		return true
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == "office_detected" then
		self.detected_event_ing = true
		self.bg_event_dispose = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.office_detected, self, e.Sender))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_timer_alarm_event(e)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.office_elevator_fail, self))
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.event_state.bridge_collaps then
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown then
			self.swipe_type = 'action1'
			return true
		elseif CS.Oak.InputManager.IsPC and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
			self.swipe_type = 'action1'
			return true
		end
	elseif self.current_state < self.event_state.bridge_end then
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
			self.swipe_type = 'left'
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
			self.swipe_type = 'right'
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
			self.swipe_type = 'up'
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
			self.swipe_type = 'down'
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
			if self.tap_sfx_name then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.tap_sfx_name)
			end
			self.swipe_type = 'tap'
			self.turbo_tap_count = self.turbo_tap_count + 1
			return true
		end
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_click_party_preset_01')
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_gamepad_event(e)
	if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown or
		e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.BButtonDown or
		e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.XButtonDown or
		e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.YButtonDown then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchEvent.Create(CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown, unity_class.vector2.zero))
		return true
	elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonUp or
		e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.BButtonUp or
		e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.XButtonUp or
		e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.YButtonUp then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchEvent.Create(CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchUp, unity_class.vector2.zero))
		return true
	end

	return false
end
