function local_class:pillar_rotate(num)
	local target_x0z_pos

	if num == 1 then
		self.get_hitbox(num).Position = vector(-4.5, 0, 43)
		self.get_hitbox(num).Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(2, 1, 6))
		target_x0z_pos = vector(-4.75, 0, 45)
	elseif num == 2 then
		self.get_hitbox(num).Position = vector(8.5, 0, 40.5)
		self.get_hitbox(num).Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(8, 1, 2))
		target_x0z_pos = vector(9.75, 0, 40.25)
	elseif num == 3 then
		self.get_hitbox(num).Position = vector(-7.5, 0, 50)
		self.get_hitbox(num).Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(7, 1, 2))
		target_x0z_pos = vector(-9.75, 0, 50)
	else
		self.get_hitbox(num).Position = vector(5.5, 0, 48)
		self.get_hitbox(num).Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(2, 1, 6))
		target_x0z_pos = vector(4.75, 0, 45.5)
	end


	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_explosion_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
	self.get_pillar(num).transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)):Play('open')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	local fall_object = self.get_piece(num)
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_height = 8
	local duration = 0.5
	local height_func = function(progress)
		return start_height * math.cos(math.pi / 2 * progress)
	end

	fall_object.Position = target_x0z_pos + vector(0, 1, 0) * start_height

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		fall_object.Position = target_x0z_pos + vector(0, height_func(progress), 0)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	fall_object.Position = target_x0z_pos
	self.get_smoke_effect():Instantiate(target_x0z_pos)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_stomp_fire_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.75)
	camera_util.shake(0.5, 0.4)
end

function local_class:backdoor_detected(shooter)
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local dir = vector_util.to_direction(shooter.Position - user_party.Leader.Position)

	for i = 11, 16 do
		self.get_terror(i).FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
		character_util.stop(self.get_terror(i))
		character_util.remove_anim(self.get_terror(i))
	end

	character_util.set_direction(self.secretary, dir)
	character_util.set_anim(self.secretary, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.secretary, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.normal_jump(self.secretary)
	for i = 0, 2 do
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], dir)
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], { name = 'embarrassed' })
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'scared' })

	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	coroutine.yield(self:backdoor_reset())

function local_class:backdoor_reset()

	quest_marker_util.remove('main')
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'main', vector(-40.5, 1, 54.5))

	for i = 11, 16 do
		self.get_terror(i).FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()

	end

	if self.loop_sound ~= nil then self.loop_sound:Stop() end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.backdoor[0].Position = vector(-40.5, 0, 54)

	self.backdoor[2].Position = vector(-39, 0, 53)
	self.backdoor[3].Position = vector(-38.5, 0, 51)
	self.backdoor[4].Position = vector(-38, 0, 54)
	self.backdoor[5].Position = vector(-21, 0, 52)
	self.backdoor[6].Position = vector(-19.5, 0, 53.5)
	self.backdoor[7].Position = vector(-17, 0, 51)
	self.backdoor[8].Position = vector(-15.5, 0, 54)
	for i = 0, 8 do
		character_util.stop(self.backdoor[i])
		character_util.stop_shake(self.backdoor[i])
		character_util.set_active_shadow(self.backdoor[i], true)
		self.backdoor[i].SpineController:RemoveColor(self.backdoor[i].Name, 0)
		self.backdoor[i].SpineController:RemoveFadeColor(self.backdoor[i].Name, 0)
		self.backdoor[i].SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.one * 1, 0)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.backdoor[i])
		character_util.set_direction(self.backdoor[i], 'left')
		if i%4 == 1 then
			character_util.set_anim(self.backdoor[i], { name = 'embarrassed'})
			character_util.set_emotion(self.backdoor[i], { name = 'damaged'})
		elseif i%4 == 2 then
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.backdoor[i])
			character_util.set_anim(self.backdoor[i], { name = 'embarrassed' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.backdoor[i], { name = 'scared'})
		elseif i%4 == 3 then
			character_util.set_anim(self.backdoor[i], { name = 'cast2' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.backdoor[i], { name = 'attack'})
		else
			character_util.set_anim(self.backdoor[i], { name = 'success' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.backdoor[i], { name = 'damaged'})
		end
	end
	character_util.set_anim(self.backdoor[5], { name = 'run' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.backdoor[5], { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(self.backdoor[6], { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.backdoor[6], { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.set_anim(self.backdoor[7], { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.backdoor[7], { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(self.backdoor[8], { name = 'run' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.backdoor[8], { name = 'scared' })

	character_util.set_direction(self.backdoor[0], 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(self.backdoor[0], { name = 'eat' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.backdoor[0], { name = 'attack'})

	get_field_object('runaway_route_block').Position = vector(-38.5, 0, 52.5)
end

function local_class:chase_detected(shooter)
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local dir = vector_util.to_direction(shooter.Position - user_party.Leader.Position)

	for i = 6, 10 do
		self.get_terror(i).FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
		character_util.stop(self.get_terror(i))
		character_util.remove_anim(self.get_terror(i))
	end

	character_util.set_direction(self.secretary, dir)
	character_util.set_anim(self.secretary, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.secretary, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.normal_jump(self.secretary)
	for i = 0, 2 do
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], dir)
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], { name = 'embarrassed' })
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'scared' })
		character_util.normal_jump(user_party[i])
	end
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_gun_reload_02')
	character_util.set_anim(shooter, { name = 'rifle_reload', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	coroutine.yield(self:simple_shoot(shooter, user_party.Leader, dir))


	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	coroutine.yield(self:chase_reset())

	self.optimized_npcs['door_1'].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	self.optimized_npcs['door_2'].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_active_shadow(user_party.Leader, true)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	self.detected_event_ing = false
	self.bg_event_dispose = false
end

function local_class:chase_reset()

		self.get_terror(i).FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
		character_util.stop(self.get_terror(i))
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.get_terror(i))
		self.get_terror(i).Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.get_terror(i), 0, 0)
	end

	for i = 1, 7 do
		character_util.stop(self.optimized_npcs['chase_'..i])
		self.optimized_npcs['chase_'..i].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.secretary)
	for i = 0, 2 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
	end
	party_util.align_party(vector(-46.5, 0, 131.5), 'up', 0, 'linear')

	if self.loop_sound ~= nil then self.loop_sound:Stop() end

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

end

function local_class:gunshot_effect_rifle(pos, duration)
	local effect_term = 0.05
	local time_passed = 0
	local effect_time_passed = 0

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_08', play_pos = pos, type_priority = 'event', max_distance = 40, min_distance = 25 })

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		effect_time_passed = effect_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if effect_term <= effect_time_passed then
			local rad = math.pi * CS.UnityEngine.Random.value * 2
			local target_x = math.cos(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.3, 0.6)
			local target_z = math.sin(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.3, 0.6)
			self.get_gunshot_groundhit():Instantiate(pos + vector(target_x, 0, target_z))

			effect_time_passed = 0
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:bridge_collaps()
	local trouble_shooter = get_character('trouble_shooter')
	local mad_scientist = get_character('mad_scientist')
	local terror = { }
	for i = 1, 5 do
		terror[i] = self.get_terror(i)
	end

	-- 액션 버튼만을 띄워놓기 위해 미리 캐릭터를 CharacterControllerManualTouchState 로 바꿔줌
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')

function local_class:bridge_rotate()
	local time = 0
	while time < 10 do
		time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		self.get_bridge(35).transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, -(time * 9))

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

	end

	quest_marker_util.remove('main')

	stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:start_timer(duration)
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAddEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer,
			CS.Oak.InGameTimer.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer, duration)))

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.EventTimerStartEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer))

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
end

function local_class:stop_timer()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.EventTimerStopEvent.Instance)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerRemoveEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer))
end

function local_class:office_object_interact(target)
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	if target == self.get_office_obj(3) or target == self.get_office_obj(4) then

		-- 평범한 책상이다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lilithtower_s4_office_obj_1' })

		quest_marker_util.remove('obj_3')
		quest_marker_util.remove('obj_4')

		self.get_office_obj(3).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		self.get_office_obj(4).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		self.office_obj_checked = self.office_obj_checked + 1

	elseif target == self.get_office_obj(5) or target == self.get_office_obj(6) then

		-- 평범한 의자다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lilithtower_s4_office_obj_2' })

		quest_marker_util.remove('obj_5')
		quest_marker_util.remove('obj_6')

		self.get_office_obj(5).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		self.get_office_obj(6).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		self.office_obj_checked = self.office_obj_checked + 1

	elseif target == get_field_object('s4_office_vent') then

		-- 환풍구다. 안쪽에서 잠겨있다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lilithtower_s4_office_obj_3' })

		quest_marker_util.remove('vent')

		 get_field_object('s4_office_vent').Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		self.office_obj_checked = self.office_obj_checked + 1

	elseif target == get_field_object('s4_office_tv') then

		-- 벽걸이 TV이다. 켜지지 않는다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lilithtower_s4_office_obj_4' })

		quest_marker_util.remove('tv')

		get_field_object('s4_office_tv').Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		self.office_obj_checked = self.office_obj_checked + 1

	end

	if self.office_obj_checked == 4 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.office_breach_event, self))
	else
		stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	end
end

function local_class:office_detected(shooter)
	local trouble_shooter = get_character('trouble_shooter')
	local mad_scientist = get_character('mad_scientist')

	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local scared = function(fo, dir)
		character_util.stop(fo)
		character_util.set_direction(fo, dir)
		character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'embarrassed' })
		character_util.set_emotion(fo, { name = 'scared' })
		character_util.normal_jump(fo)
	end

	local dir = vector_util.to_direction(shooter.Position - user_party.Leader.Position)

	self.get_terror(2).FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
	character_util.stop(self.get_terror(2))
	character_util.remove_anim(self.get_terror(2))

	if self.loop_sound ~= nil then self.loop_sound:Stop() end
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	scared(user_party.Leader, dir)
	scared(trouble_shooter, dir)
	scared(mad_scientist, dir)
	scared(self.troll, dir)
	if self.is_secretary_alive then
		scared(self.secretary, dir)
	end

	character_util.set_anim(shooter, { name = 'rifle_reload', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	coroutine.yield(self:simple_shoot(shooter, user_party.Leader, dir))

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(trouble_shooter)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mad_scientist)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.troll)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.secretary)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 0, { end_target = user_party.Leader })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	coroutine.yield(self:office_guard_setting())

	self.detected_event_ing = false
	self.bg_event_dispose = false

	character_util.set_active_shadow(user_party.Leader, true)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	local player_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	player_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack)
	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(player_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)
end

function local_class:office_door_breach_routine()
	local rand_x
	local rand_z

	local speech_ing = false

	local shoot = function(fo)
		character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'rifle_shoot2' })
		while speech_ing do
			rand_x = random_util.get_random_int(-50, 50)
			rand_z = random_util.get_random_int(-50, 50)

			self:fire_bullet_and_bomb(fo, self:get_bullet().transform, fo.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.2), vector(54.5, 0, 108.5) + vector(rand_x/100, 0, rand_z/100), 25)
		end
	end

	local routine = {
		function()
			speech_ing = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(shoot, self.get_terror(2)))
			character_util.set_anim(self.get_terror(1), { name = 'shoot' })
			wait_for_sec(3)
		end,
		function()
			speech_ing = false
			character_util.remove_anim(self.get_terror(1))
			character_util.remove_anim(self.get_terror(2))
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end,
		function()
			speech_ing = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(shoot, self.get_terror(1)))
			character_util.set_anim(self.get_terror(2), { name = 'attack' })
			wait_for_sec(3)
		end,
		function()
			speech_ing = false
			character_util.remove_anim(self.get_terror(1))
			character_util.remove_anim(self.get_terror(2))
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end
	}

	while self.stage_end == false do
		for i = 1, #routine do
			routine[i]()
			if self.stage_end then
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:simple_shoot(shooter, target, dir, blacked)
	local vtr
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		vtr = vector(1, 0, 0)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		vtr = vector(-1, 0, 0)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		vtr = vector(0, 0, 1)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		vtr = vector(0, 0, -1)
	end

	local is_black = lua_helper.get_or_default(blacked, false)

	character_util.stop(target)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_gun_shoot_09')
	character_util.set_anim(shooter, { name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false, next_anim = 'rifle_idle', scale = 0.5 })
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	self:fire_bullet_effect(self:get_bullet().transform, shooter.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.2), target.Position, 25)

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.2)
	self.get_fx_critical_hit_blood():Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_01', play_pos = target.Position, type_priority = 'event', max_distance = 40, min_distance = 25 })
	character_util.set_direction(target, dir)
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'dead3', loop = false })
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'walk4legs', loop = false })
	else
		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'dead2', loop = false, scale = 3 })
	end
	character_util.set_emotion(target, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_active_shadow(target, false)

	local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
		'physics', true, vtr, 15000, 0.05,
		CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

	local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(target, knock_back_info)
	target.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))

	if is_black then
		target.SpineController:AddColor(target.Name, unity_color({0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1}), 1, 0.5)
	end
end

		self.volume = (1.4 - time_passed) * 0.5

		coroutine.yield()
	end
	self.volume = 0
end

--region hook_shot
function local_class:launch_hook_shot(character, transform, speed)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.launch_hook_shot_routine, self, character, transform, speed))
end

function local_class:launch_hook_shot_routine(character, transform, speed)
	self:stop_hook_shot(character)

	local req_id = self.hook_shot_req_id[character]
	speed = lua_helper.get_or_default(speed, 18)

	local pooled_hook_shot = self.get_hook_shot():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	local hook_shot = pooled_hook_shot:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.HookShot))
	local length = 0
	local is_launch = true

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hookshot_pull_02')

	while req_id == self.hook_shot_req_id[character] do
		if is_launch then
			length = length + (unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed)
		end

		local hook_shot_position = transform
		local character_position = character.Transform.position

		local diff = (hook_shot_position - character_position)
		local distance = diff.magnitude + 0.5
		local direction = diff.normalized

		if length >= distance or not is_launch then
			if is_launch then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bridge_01')
			end

			is_launch = false
			length = distance
		end

		local bounds = character.Hitbox:ToWorldBounds(character.Transform.position)
		hook_shot:SetFromTo(bounds.center + direction * CS.Oak.HookShot.MinLength, bounds.center + direction * length)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	pooled_hook_shot:Dispose()
end

function local_class:stop_hook_shot(character)
	if not self.hook_shot_req_id[character] then
		self.hook_shot_req_id[character] = 0
	end

	self.hook_shot_req_id[character] = self.hook_shot_req_id[character] + 1
end
--endregion

function local_class:free_fall_func(object, start_pos, end_pos, duration)
	local time = 0
	local free_fall_fire = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(0, 19.6, 0, 0)
	while time < duration do
		time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		free_fall_fire:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall_fire:GetDistance()
		local move_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, time / duration)
		object.transform.position = move_pos + vector(0, 1, 0) * dist_y
		if self.current_state ~= self.event_state.bridge_collaps and self.current_state ~= self.event_state.bridge_qte_3 then
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

	self.lilith = get_character(self.lilith_name)
	character_util.add_listener(self.lilith, self.controller)

	self.odile = get_character(self.odile_name)

	self.gremory = get_character(self.gremory_name)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.gremory)

	self.princess = get_character(self.princess_name)

	self.safe_house_npcs = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.safe_house_npc_num do
		self.safe_house_npcs:Add(get_character(self.safe_house_npc_name .. i))
	end

	local main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(258)
	if main_quest ~= nil and main_quest:GetCustomState(self.secretary_state_key) ~= 1 then
		self.secretary = get_character(self.secretary_name)
	end

	self.food_box = get_field_object('safe_house_food_box')
	self.food_box.Position = field:GetMarker('safe_house_princess_food_box_pos').position
 end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	if self.secretary ~= nil then
		character_util.convert_to_following_npc(self.secretary, user_party, false,
				CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.OutBattleZone, 0)
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ActivateExitInteractableEvent.Create(false))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_event, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.lilith, self.controller)

	self.lilith = nil
	self.odile = nil
	self.gremory = nil
	self.princess = nil
	self.secretary = nil

	self.safe_house_npcs = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end --	방어코드

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.princess) and
			self.cur_progress == self.progress.none then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_princess_event, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.lilith) and
			self.cur_progress == self.progress.met_princess then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_lilith_event, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.center_room_entered and self.cur_progress == self.progress.none then
		local leader_pos = user_party.Leader.Position
		local princess_pos = self.princess.Position
		local bubble_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.center_right_exit_name) then
			bubble_pos = vector(leader_pos.x - 3.5, 0, princess_pos.z - 1)
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.princess_call_player_routine, self, bubble_pos, 'left')
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.center_bottom_exit_name) then
			bubble_pos = vector(princess_pos.x - 1, 0, leader_pos.z + 1)
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.princess_call_player_routine, self, bubble_pos, 'up')
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.center_top_exit_name) then
			bubble_pos = vector(princess_pos.x - 1, 0, leader_pos.z - 3)
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.princess_call_player_routine, self, bubble_pos, 'down')
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, self.lilith_room_name) and
			self.cur_progress == self.progress.talked_lilith then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.end_event, self)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, self.center_left_exit_name) and
			not self.center_room_entered then
		self.center_room_entered = true
	end
end

function local_class:princess_call_player_routine(bubble_world_pos, move_back_dir)
	self.cur_progress = self.progress.call_player

	character_util.set_group_direction(self.npc_list, move_back_dir)
	local target_pos = user_party.Leader.Position + direction_util.to_vector3(user_party.Leader.Direction) * 1.25

	-- 여기야 여기!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lilith,
			{ key = self.main_script .. 128,
			  world_pos = bubble_world_pos, bubble_type = 'shout', scale = 1.1, skip = true })

	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, target_pos, 0.75, nil, true, true)

	self.cur_progress = self.progress.none
end

-- 세이프 하우스 시작 이벤트
function local_class:start_event()

	user_party.Leader.Position = vector(20, 0, 166)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_intro_vent_01')

	self.intro_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_event_dw_11', loop = true })

	local start_pos = field:GetMarker(self.start_point_marker_name).position
	local center_pos = field:GetMarker(self.safe_house_center_marker_name).position
	local lilith_chair_pos = field:GetMarker(self.safe_house_lilith_marker_name).position

	character_util.set_emotion(self.lilith, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_direction(self.lilith, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(self.lilith, { name = 'unique/limp_seat' })
	character_util.set_position(self.lilith, lilith_chair_pos)

	local offset_x = {
		1, 0.4, -0.2, -0.8
	}

	character_util.set_position(self.lilith, center_pos + vector(999, 0, 999))

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	table.insert(self.npc_list, user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, start_pos + vector(0,15,0))

	table.insert(self.npc_list, self.odile)
	character_util.set_position(self.odile, start_pos + vector(0,15,0))

	table.insert(self.npc_list, self.gremory)
	character_util.set_position(self.gremory, start_pos + vector(0,15,0))

	if self.secretary ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.npc_list, self.secretary)
		character_util.set_position(self.secretary, start_pos + vector(0,15,0))
	end

	camera_util.move_async(start_pos + vector(offset_x[1], 0, 0), 0.1)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self:princess_appear(start_pos)
	self:party_appear(start_pos, offset_x)

	local dir = { 'left', 'right' }
	for i = 1, 2 do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, dir[i])
		character_util.set_direction(self.gremory, dir[i])
		character_util.set_direction(self.odile, dir[i])
		if self.secretary ~= nil then
			character_util.set_direction(self.secretary, dir[i])
		end
		wait_for_sec(0.75)
	end

	-- 오딜 (여)	: 여기는…?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(self.odile, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.odile, { key = self.main_script .. 1 })
	character_util.remove_anim(self.odile)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

function local_class:princess_appear(out_point)
	local side_vent = get_field_object(self.side_vent_name)
	local animator = side_vent:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	local appear_pos = field:GetMarker(self.safe_house_vent_door_name).position
	character_util.set_position(self.princess, appear_pos + vector(0, 0.35, 0))
	character_util.spine_scale(self.princess, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
	character_util.set_anim(self.princess, { name = 'get', loop = false})
	character_util.set_direction(self.princess, 'right')
	self.princess.SpineController:AddColor(self.princess.Name, unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 }), 1, 0)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	for i = 1, 2 do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
		side_vent:Shake(0.04, 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(1)

	end

	animator:Play('lilithtower_vent_open')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_iron_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')

	local time = 0.75
	local dis = (self.princess.Position - out_point).magnitude
	local speed = dis / time
	local center_pos = field:GetMarker(self.safe_house_center_marker_name).position

	character_util.jump_move(self.princess, out_point, speed, 0.7, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.princess)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.princess, center_pos, speed, true,
			'stop', 'floor', 'left', true)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.princess)
	character_util.add_listener(self.princess, self.controller)

	wait_for_sec(1)
end

function local_class:party_appear(out_point, offset_x)
	local side_vent = get_field_object(self.side_vent_name)
	local animator = side_vent:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	local appear_pos = field:GetMarker(self.safe_house_vent_door_name).position

	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.npc_list) do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.npc_list[i], 0, 0)
	end

	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.npc_list) do
		local character = self.npc_list[i]
		character_util.spine_scale(character, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
		character_util.set_position(character, appear_pos + vector(0, 0.35, 0))
		character_util.set_anim(character, { name = 'get', loop = false})
		character_util.set_direction(character, 'right')
		character_util.set_active_shadow(character, true)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character, 1, 0.2)

		local dest_pos = out_point + vector(offset_x[i], 0, 0)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			if i == 1 then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
			end

			local time = 0.75
			local dis = (character.Position - dest_pos).magnitude
			local speed = dis / time

			character_util.jump_move(character, dest_pos, speed, 0.7, true)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(character)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(character)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
		end))

		wait_for_sec(0.25)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	animator:Play('lilithtower_vent_close')
	wait_for_sec(1.25)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.stage_name = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
end

function local_class:start()

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 6 then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-2, 0, 73))

	end

	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.stage_name = nil

function local_class:pull_lever()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

	local lever = self.get_lever()
	lever.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gear_02')
	local animator = lever:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	animator:Play('pull')

	self.lever_pulled = true

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	camera_util.move_async(vector(-30.5, 0, 19.5), 0)

	local light_transform_list = create_generic_list(CS.UnityEngine.Transform)
	for i = 1, self.cctv_num do
		local cur_cctv = get_field_object(self.cctv_name..i)

		light_transform_list:Add(cur_cctv.Transform:GetChild(0):GetChild(0))
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_die_robot_02' )

	local timer = 0
	local duration = 2

	while timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = (duration - timer) / duration
		local cur_scale = 1 * progress

		for i = 0, light_transform_list.Count - 1 do
			light_transform_list[i].localScale = vector(cur_scale, cur_scale, 0.63)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 0, light_transform_list.Count - 1 do
		light_transform_list[i].localScale = vector(0, 0, 0.63)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	stage_camera:SetTarget(get_party_leader())

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
end

return local_class

-- 테러리스트가 설계자 마구 때림
function local_class:lynch_event()
	local hit_cycle = {
		idle = 0,
		hit = 1,
		damaged = 2
	}

	local cur_cycle = hit_cycle.idle
	local timer = 0

	local mod = 0
	local cur_terrorist = nil

	local durations = { 0.3, 0.2, 0.5 }

	while self.is_lynch_event do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if cur_cycle == hit_cycle.idle and timer > durations[cur_cycle + 1] then
			timer = 0
			cur_cycle = hit_cycle.hit

			if mod == 0 then
				mod = 1
				cur_terrorist = self.architect_terrorist_list[1]
			elseif mod == 1 then
				mod = 0
				cur_terrorist = self.architect_terrorist_list[3]
			end

			character_util.spine_deviate_local(cur_terrorist,
					(self.architect.Position - cur_terrorist.Position).normalized * 0.5,
					0.3, 0.2)
			character_util.set_anim(cur_terrorist, { name = 'attack', loop = false, next_anim = 'rifle_idle' })
		elseif cur_cycle == hit_cycle.hit and timer > durations[cur_cycle + 1] then
			timer = 0
			cur_cycle = hit_cycle.damaged

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')

			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(
					self.architect.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(
					self.architect.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

			character_util.look_at(self.architect, cur_terrorist)
			character_util.spine_deviate_local(self.architect,
					(self.architect.Position - cur_terrorist.Position).normalized * 0.5,
					0.3, 0.2)
			character_util.spine_pulse_color(self.architect, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish(self.architect, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
			character_util.set_anim(self.architect, { name = 'damaged' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.architect, { name = 'damaged' })
		elseif cur_cycle == hit_cycle.damaged and timer > durations[cur_cycle + 1] then
			timer = 0
			cur_cycle = hit_cycle.idle

			character_util.remove_anim(self.architect)
			character_util.set_emotion(self.architect, { name = 'attack' })
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(cur_terrorist)

	character_util.remove_anim(self.architect)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.architect, { name = 'attack' })
end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.stage_name = nil
end

		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)

		self:on_tesla_coil_on_off_event(e)
	end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then return end
	if not e.FullEnter then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.vent_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-140,0 ,133))
	elseif zone_name == self.first_floor_zone_name and self.is_game_start then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-39.5,0 ,1))
	elseif zone_name == self.second_floor_outer_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-10.5,0 ,128.5))
	elseif zone_name == self.second_floor_inner_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-82.5,0 ,129))
	elseif not self.is_machinery_tint and zone_name == self.machinery_android_zone_name then
		self.is_machinery_tint = true

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)

	if not e.FullLeave then return end

	if self.is_machinery_tint and zone_name == self.machinery_android_zone_name then
		self.is_machinery_tint = false

		field:RemoveTint(self.machinery_tint_key, 0.5)
	end

function local_class:on_tesla_coil_on_off_event(e)
	if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.electric_on and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(self.machinery_main_light, e.CoilObject)then
		if e.IsTurningOn then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.electric_on

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.electric_on_event, self))

	end

function local_class:on_shutter(name, num)

	for i = 1, num do
		local cur_shutter = get_field_object(name..i)
		local cur_animator = cur_shutter.Transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

		shutter_list:Add(cur_shutter)
		animator_list:Add(cur_animator)
	end

	for i = 0, shutter_list.Count - 1 do
		shutter_list[i].ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end

	for i = 0, animator_list.Count - 1 do
		animator_list[i]:Play('start')
	end

		animator_list:Add(cur_animator)

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

			CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(get_party_leader(), { "deactivate_android", 'fix_camera' }))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_quest_complete_a_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_energy_charge_02')

	stage_camera:CancelMove()

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	camera_util.move(
			self.machinery_main_light.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), 1.5)

	wait_for_sec(2)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reset_tint_color, self))

		field:RemoveTint(self.stage_3_tint_key, 0.1)

		field:Tint(self.stage_3_tint_key, unity_color({0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1}), 0.1)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	field:RemoveTint(self.stage_3_tint_key, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self:off_shutter(self.hole_entry_shutter_name, self.hole_entry_shutter_num)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

-- 전원 틴트 컬러 돌아옴
function local_class:reset_tint_color()
	local renderers = self.machinery_main_light.Transform:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local tint_duration = 1

	local start_color = unity_color({ 0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 1 })

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < tint_duration do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / tint_duration

		for i = 0, self.machinery_main_light_color_list.Count - 1 do
			if self.machinery_main_light_color_list[i] ~= nil then
				local current_color = unity_class.color.Lerp(
						start_color, self.machinery_main_light_color_list[i], normalized)

				renderers[i].material.color = current_color
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 0, self.machinery_main_light_color_list.Count - 1 do
		renderers[i].material.color = self.machinery_main_light_color_list[i]
	end
end

	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.stage_name = nil
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)

	end

	end

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 2), 4, false, nil, nil, 'left')

	self.stage_name = 'lilithtower_1_3'

	self.mugger_finish_door_name = 'mugger_finish_door_'
	self.mugger_finish_door_num = 2

	-- 셔터
	self.end_block_shutter_name = 'mugger_end_shutter_block_'
	self.shutter_end_block_num = 4

	self.start_block_shutter_name = 'mugger_start_shutter_block_'
	self.shutter_start_block_num = 2
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	-- 문 열어주기 (이전 섹션에서 문 열어지는 도중에 나가면 안 열릴 가능성 있음)
	for i = 1, self.mugger_finish_door_num do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.mugger_finish_door_name..i))
	end

	-- 셔터 열어주기
	self:off_shutter(self.end_block_shutter_name, self.shutter_end_block_num)
	self:off_shutter(self.start_block_shutter_name, self.shutter_start_block_num)
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

-- 셔터 끄기
function local_class:off_shutter(name, num)
	local shutter_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.FieldObject)
	local animator_list = create_generic_list(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)

	for i = 1, num do
		local cur_shutter = get_field_object(name..i)
		local cur_animator = cur_shutter.Transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

		shutter_list:Add(cur_shutter)
		animator_list:Add(cur_animator)
	end

	for i = 0, shutter_list.Count - 1 do
		shutter_list[i].ActiveState = active_state('visible')
	end

	for i = 0, animator_list.Count - 1 do
		animator_list[i]:Play('end')
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ConvertWallChangedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GameOverEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent), 'on_event')

	self.mugger = get_character(self.mugger_name)
	self.mugger.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.set_position(self.mugger, vector(25, 0, 129))
	character_util.set_direction(self.mugger, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.mugger, { name = 'tired' })

	self.mugger_survivor_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.mugger_survivor_num do
		local cur_survivor = get_character(self.mugger_survivor_name..i)

		local val = math.floor((i - 1) / 2)
		local mod = (i - 1) % 2

		if i ~= 5 then
			character_util.set_position(cur_survivor, vector(23 + val, 0, 129 - mod))
			character_util.set_direction(cur_survivor, 'left')
		else
			character_util.set_position(cur_survivor, vector(23 + val, 0, 128))
			character_util.set_direction(cur_survivor, 'left')
		end

		character_util.set_emotion(cur_survivor, { name = 'tired' })
		cur_survivor.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance

		self.mugger_survivor_list:Add(cur_survivor)
	end

	self.event_terrorist_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.event_terrorist_num do
		local cur_terrorist = get_character(self.event_terrorist_name..i)

		local val = math.floor((i - 1) / 2)
		local mod = (i - 1) % 2

		if val < 1 then
			character_util.set_position(cur_terrorist, vector(22, 0, 129 - mod))
			character_util.set_direction(cur_terrorist, 'left')
		else
			character_util.set_position(cur_terrorist, vector(26, 0, 129 - mod))
			character_util.set_direction(cur_terrorist, 'left')
		end

		cur_terrorist.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance

		self.event_terrorist_list:Add(cur_terrorist)
	end

	self.mugger_stalker = get_character(self.mugger_stalker_name)

	coroutine.yield(self:load_bullet())

	-- 미니게임 진행 중에 셔터가 닫혔지만 2층에서 1층으로 뛰어 내리기가 가능해서 셔터 히트박스 크기 증가
	for index = 1, self.shutter_start_block_num do
		local start_block_shutter = get_field_object(self.start_block_shutter_name .. index)
		start_block_shutter.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(3, 1, 1))
	end
end

function local_class:load_bullet()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.custom_sprite_preset)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_projectile_preset)

	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	-- 총알 프리로드
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
	self.res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
				self.custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				self.custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)

	self.pooled_bullet = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite'):Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)

	local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
	bullet_sprite.Atlas = self.custom_atlas
	bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'virus_bullet_1.png'
	bullet_sprite:Rebuild()
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	self.is_game_start = true

	-- 셔터 닫힘
	self:off_shutter_only_graphic(self.start_shutter_name, self.shutter_num)

	self:off_shutter(self.start_block_shutter_name, self.shutter_start_block_num, false)
	self:off_shutter(self.end_path_shutter_name, self.shutter_num, false)
	self:on_shutter(self.end_block_shutter_name, self.shutter_end_block_num, false)

	self.default_party_leader = get_party_leader()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ConvertWallChangedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GameOverEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent))

	self.is_event_paused = false

	self.mugger = nil
	self.mugger_survivor_list = nil

	self.mugger_stalker = nil
	self.event_terrorist_list = nil

	self.default_party_leader = nil

	self.res_holder = nil
	self.custom_atlas = nil
	self.pooled_bullet = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ConvertWallChangedEvent) then
		self:on_convert_wall_changed_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then
		self:on_damage_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestStartEvent) then
		self:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestEndEvent) then
		self:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GameOverEvent) then
		self:on_game_over_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent) then
		self:on_field_object_revived_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then return end
	if not e.FullEnter then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.idle then
		if zone_name == self.mugger_intro_event_zone_name then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.see_intro_event

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.intro_event, self)
		end
	else
		if zone_name == self.mugger_game_start_event_zone_name and
				self.current_progress == self.progress_state.runaway_mugger then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.mugger_game_start

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.mugger_game_prologue, self, true)
		elseif zone_name == self.mugger_game_event_zone_name and
				self.current_progress == self.progress_state.mugger_game_start then
			-- 소매치기 소녀 액티비티 시작
			self.is_player_mugger_game = true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then return end
	if not e.FullLeave then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.mugger_game_event_zone_name and
			self.current_progress == self.progress_state.mugger_game_start then
		if get_party_leader().Position.x < 37 then
			-- 소매치기 소녀 액티비티 일시중지
			self.is_player_mugger_game = false
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.mugger) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_mugger_event, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_convert_wall_changed_event(e)
	if self.is_convert_wall_blue_down then
		self.is_convert_wall_blue_down = false
	else
		self.is_convert_wall_blue_down = true
	end

	if not self.stalker_move then
		self.stalker_move = true

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.control_terrorist, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.mugger_stalker) then
		-- 테러리스트 암살 시 한 방에 죽음
		local require_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Assassinate | CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		local require_damage_type_2 = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap

		if e.Info.type & require_damage_type == require_damage_type then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.save_mugger

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
			damage_info.sender = get_party_leader()
			damage_info.target = self.mugger_stalker
			damage_info.damage = math.floor(self.mugger_stalker.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10)

			command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
		elseif not (e.Info.type & require_damage_type_2 == require_damage_type) then
			-- 암살 아니면 플레이어 죽는 연출
			if not self.is_detected_player and self.current_progress < self.progress_state.save_mugger then

				if not self.is_detected_player and not self.is_mugger_dead then
					self.is_detected_player = true
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.player_detected_by_terrorist, self))
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 1 })

		self:off_shutter(self.end_block_shutter_name, self.shutter_end_block_num)

		self.mugger.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
		quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(self.mugger)
		character_util.add_listener(self.mugger, self.controller)
		character_util.stop_shake(self.mugger)
		character_util.set_direction(self.mugger, 'up')
		character_util.set_anim(self.mugger, { name = 'idle' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.mugger, { name = 'smile' })
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	local event_key = e.Key
	local screen_fade = e.Fade

	if not self.is_exclusive_quest then
		self.is_exclusive_quest = true

		self.past_progress = self.current_progress
		self.current_progress = self.progress_state.deactivate

		-- 배틀게이트 닫힘
		for i = 1, self.exclusive_battlegate_num do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.exclusive_battlegate_name..i, false))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	local event_key = e.Key
	local screen_fade = e.Fade

	if self.is_exclusive_quest then
		self.is_exclusive_quest = false

		self.current_progress = self.past_progress

		-- 배틀게이트 열림
		for i = 1, self.exclusive_battlegate_num do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.exclusive_battlegate_name..i, false))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_game_over_event(e)
	self.is_event_paused = self.is_player_mugger_game
	self.is_player_mugger_game = false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_revived_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.default_party_leader) then
		self.is_player_mugger_game = self.is_event_paused
		self.is_event_paused = false
	end
end


-- 셔터 켜기
function local_class:on_shutter(name, num, sound)
	local is_sound = lua_helper.get_or_default(sound, true)

	if is_sound then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_up_03')
	end

	local shutter_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.FieldObject)
	local animator_list = create_generic_list(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)

	for i = 1, num do
		local cur_shutter = get_field_object(name..i)
		local cur_animator = cur_shutter.Transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

		shutter_list:Add(cur_shutter)
		animator_list:Add(cur_animator)
	end

	for i = 0, shutter_list.Count - 1 do
		shutter_list[i].ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end

	for i = 0, animator_list.Count - 1 do
		animator_list[i]:Play('start')
	end
end

-- 셔터 끄기
function local_class:off_shutter(name, num, sound)
	local is_sound = lua_helper.get_or_default(sound, true)

	if is_sound then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_down_03')
	end

	local shutter_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.FieldObject)
	local animator_list = create_generic_list(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)

	for i = 1, num do
		local cur_shutter = get_field_object(name..i)
		local cur_animator = cur_shutter.Transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

		shutter_list:Add(cur_shutter)
		animator_list:Add(cur_animator)
	end

	for i = 0, shutter_list.Count - 1 do
		shutter_list[i].ActiveState = active_state('visible')
	end

	for i = 0, animator_list.Count - 1 do
		animator_list[i]:Play('end')
	end
end

-- 셔터 끄기, 실제로 꺼지진 않고 그래픽만
function local_class:off_shutter_only_graphic(name, num)
	local shutter_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.FieldObject)
	local animator_list = create_generic_list(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)

	for i = 1, num do
		local cur_shutter = get_field_object(name..i)
		local cur_animator = cur_shutter.Transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

		shutter_list:Add(cur_shutter)
		animator_list:Add(cur_animator)
	end

	for i = 0, animator_list.Count - 1 do
		animator_list[i]:Play('end')
	end
end

-- 인트로 이벤트
function local_class:intro_event()
	for i = 0, self.event_terrorist_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.move_to(self.event_terrorist_list[i],
				self.event_terrorist_list[i].Position + vector(-4, 0, 0),
				2, nil, true, true)
	end

	for i = 0, self.mugger_survivor_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.move_to(self.mugger_survivor_list[i],
				self.mugger_survivor_list[i].Position + vector(-4, 0, 0),
				2, nil, true, true)
	end

	character_util.move_to(self.mugger, self.mugger.Position + vector(-4, 0, 0),
			2, nil, true, true)

	camera_util.move_async(vector(20, 0, 128.5), 1.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	local patient = self.mugger_survivor_list[1]

	character_util.shake(patient, 0.04, 2)
	character_util.set_emotion(patient, { name = 'damaged' })

	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

	for i = 0, self.event_terrorist_list.Count - 1 do
		if i < 2 then
			character_util.set_direction(self.event_terrorist_list[i], 'right')
		end

		character_util.set_emotion(self.event_terrorist_list[i], { name = 'attack' })
	end

	character_util.set_anim(self.event_terrorist_list[0], { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.event_terrorist_list[0], { key = self.main_script..1, skip = true })

	for i = 0, self.mugger_survivor_list.Count - 1 do
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.mugger_survivor_list[i], patient) then
			character_util.look_at(self.mugger_survivor_list[i], patient)
			character_util.set_anim(self.mugger_survivor_list[i], { name = 'cast' })
		end
	end

	character_util.set_anim(self.event_terrorist_list[0], { name = 'rifle_idle' })

	character_util.set_anim(patient, { name = 'cast' })
	character_util.set_emotion(patient, { name = 'attack' })

-- 테러리스트들과 생존자들 좌측으로 계속 이동해서 사라짐
function local_class:terrorist_and_survivor_walk()
	local patient = self.mugger_survivor_list[1]

	for i = 0, self.event_terrorist_list.Count - 1 do
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.event_terrorist_list[i], self.mugger_stalker) then
			character_util.move_to(self.event_terrorist_list[i],
					self.event_terrorist_list[i].Position + vector(-6, 0, 0),
					3, nil, true, true)
		end
	end

	for i = 0, self.mugger_survivor_list.Count - 1 do
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.mugger_survivor_list[i], patient) then
			character_util.move_to(self.mugger_survivor_list[i],
					self.mugger_survivor_list[i].Position + vector(-6, 0, 0),
					3, nil, true, true)
		else
			character_util.set_anim(self.mugger_survivor_list[i], { name = 'walk4legs' })
			character_util.move_to(self.mugger_survivor_list[i],
					self.mugger_survivor_list[i].Position + vector(-6, 0, 0),
					3, nil, true, false)
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(3)

	for i = 0, self.event_terrorist_list.Count - 1 do
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.event_terrorist_list[i], self.mugger_stalker) then
			character_util.set_active_state(self.event_terrorist_list[i], 'disabled')
		end
	end

	for i = 0, self.mugger_survivor_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_active_state(self.mugger_survivor_list[i], 'disabled')
	end
end

-- 소매치기 소녀 이동
function local_class:control_mugger()
	self.mugger_move = true

	while (not self.is_mugger_dead and not self.is_convert_wall_blue_down) or not self.is_player_mugger_game do
		if self.is_detected_player then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_mugger_dead or self.is_detected_player then
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

	local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	waypoint_list:Add(self.mugger.Position + vector(0, 0, 3))

	character_util.stop_shake(self.mugger)
	character_util.set_anim(self.mugger, { name = 'run' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.mugger, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.mugger, waypoint_list,
			6, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'up', true)

	character_util.remove_anim(self.mugger)

	if not self.is_convert_wall_blue_down then
		character_util.set_direction(self.mugger, 'down')
		character_util.remove_anim(self.mugger)
	end

	while (not self.is_mugger_dead and self.is_convert_wall_blue_down) or not self.is_player_mugger_game do
		if self.is_detected_player then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_mugger_dead or self.is_detected_player then
		return
	end

	waypoint_list:Clear()
	waypoint_list:Add(self.mugger.Position + vector(0, 0, 2.5))

	character_util.set_anim(self.mugger, { name = 'run' })
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.mugger, waypoint_list,
			6, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', true)

	waypoint_list:Clear()
	waypoint_list:Add(self.mugger.Position + vector(6.5, 0, 0))

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.mugger, waypoint_list,
			6, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', true)

	character_util.remove_anim(self.mugger)

	local rock1 = get_field_object(self.rock_1_name)

	if rock1.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') then
		character_util.remove_anim(self.mugger)
	end

	while (not self.is_mugger_dead and rock1.ActiveState == active_state('enabled'))
			or not self.is_player_mugger_game do
		if self.is_detected_player then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_mugger_dead or self.is_detected_player then
		return
	end

	waypoint_list:Clear()
	waypoint_list:Add(self.mugger.Position + vector(7, 0, 0))

	character_util.set_anim(self.mugger, { name = 'run' })
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.mugger, waypoint_list,
			6, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', true)

	character_util.remove_anim(self.mugger)

	local rock2 = get_field_object(self.rock_2_name)

	if rock2.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') then
		character_util.remove_anim(self.mugger)
	end

	while (not self.is_mugger_dead and rock2.ActiveState == active_state('enabled'))
			or not self.is_player_mugger_game do
		if self.is_detected_player then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_mugger_dead or self.is_detected_player then
		return
	end

	waypoint_list:Clear()
	waypoint_list:Add(self.mugger.Position + vector(9, 0, 0))

	character_util.set_anim(self.mugger, { name = 'run' })
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.mugger, waypoint_list,
			6, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', true)

	character_util.remove_anim(self.mugger)

	local signboard_1 = get_field_object(self.signboard_name_1)
	local signboard_2 = get_field_object(self.signboard_name_2)

	if signboard_1.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') and
			signboard_2.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
		character_util.remove_anim(self.mugger)
	end

	while (not self.is_mugger_dead and (signboard_1.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') or
			signboard_2.ActiveState == active_state('enabled'))) or not self.is_player_mugger_game do
		if self.is_detected_player then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_mugger_dead or self.is_detected_player then
		return
	end

	waypoint_list:Clear()
	waypoint_list:Add(self.mugger.Position + vector(5.5, 0, 0))

	character_util.set_anim(self.mugger, { name = 'run' })
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.mugger, waypoint_list,
			6, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'down', true)

	character_util.remove_anim(self.mugger)

	waypoint_list:Clear()
	waypoint_list:Add(self.mugger.Position + vector(0, 0, -5.5))

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.mugger, waypoint_list,
			6, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'down', true)

	character_util.remove_anim(self.mugger)

	local upper_door = get_field_object(self.path_upper_door_name)

	if not upper_door.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpen then
		character_util.remove_anim(self.mugger)
	end

	while (not self.is_mugger_dead and not upper_door.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpen)
			or not self.is_player_mugger_game do
		if self.is_detected_player then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_mugger_dead or self.is_detected_player then
		return
	end


	local timer = 0
	local door_open_duration = 1.5

	while (not self.is_mugger_dead and timer < door_open_duration)
			or not self.is_player_mugger_game do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_mugger_dead or self.is_detected_player then
		return
	end

	waypoint_list:Clear()
	waypoint_list:Add(self.mugger.Position + vector(0, 0, -7))

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.mugger, waypoint_list,
			6, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'down', true)

	character_util.remove_anim(self.mugger)

	local lower_door = get_field_object(self.path_lower_door_name)

	if not lower_door.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpen then
		character_util.remove_anim(self.mugger)
	end

-- 소매치기 소녀 총 맞고 사망하는 연출
function local_class:mugger_dead_event(bullet_sprite, sniper_pos, target_pos)
	if self.is_detected_player then
		return
	end

	self.is_mugger_dead = true

	character_util.stop_shake(self.mugger)
	character_util.stop(self.mugger)

	character_util.stop(self.mugger_stalker)
	character_util.set_anim(self.mugger_stalker, { name = 'rifle_idle' })

	local cached_leader = self.default_party_leader
	if cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
		cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(
				stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
	end

	-- 안드로이드 조작 때문에 파티 리더가 바뀐 경우 조작 끝날 때까지 대기
	-- TODO: 시간 대기가 하드코딩되어 있어서 수정해야 함
	local wait_for_android = false

	if lua_helper.type_compare(self.default_party_leader.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController) then
		wait_for_android = true
	end

	while lua_helper.type_compare(self.default_party_leader.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 안드로이드 조작 불가능 하게 만듬
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'disable_android_control' }))

	if wait_for_android then
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	stage_camera:CancelMove()

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	camera_util.move_async(self.mugger.Position, 1)

	character_util.set_anim(self.mugger_stalker,
			{ name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false, next_anim = 'rifle_idle' })

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_02')

	bullet_sprite.transform.position = sniper_pos

	local look_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(target_pos - sniper_pos)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = look_rotation * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

	local move_distance = (sniper_pos - target_pos).magnitude
	local speed = 12

	local timer = 0
	local duration = move_distance / speed

	while timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local current_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(sniper_pos, target_pos, 1 - ((duration - timer) / duration))

		bullet_sprite.transform.position = current_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 피격
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_projectile_preset):Instantiate(
			self.mugger.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	bullet_sprite.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(self.mugger, 999999, unity_class.color.red, self.mugger.Position)

	self.mugger.SpineController:AddColor(self.mugger.Name, unity_color({0, 0, 0, 1}), 1, 3)
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(
			self.mugger, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(self.mugger_stalker.Direction).normalized * 0.3,
			0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(
			self.mugger, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(
			self.mugger, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
	character_util.set_direction(
			self.mugger, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(self.mugger.Direction))
	character_util.set_anim(self.mugger, { name = "dead", loop = false })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.mugger, { name = "damaged" })

	wait_for_sec(3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	-- 리셋
	self.mugger.SpineController:RemoveColor(self.mugger.Name, 0)
	character_util.set_position(self.mugger, vector(21.5, 0, 142))
	character_util.set_direction(self.mugger, 'down')
	character_util.remove_anim(self.mugger)

	character_util.set_position(self.mugger_stalker, vector(21.5, 0, 140))
	character_util.set_direction(self.mugger_stalker, 'up')

	local reset_marker = field:GetMarker(self.reset_detected_game_start_marker_name)

	character_util.set_position(get_party_leader(), reset_marker.position)
	character_util.set_direction(get_party_leader(), reset_marker.direction)

	stage_camera:SetTarget(get_party_leader())

	-- 오브젝트 리셋
	local portable_brazier = get_field_object(self.portable_brazier_name)
	portable_brazier.Position = vector(40, 1, 145)

	local rock_1 = get_field_object(self.rock_1_name)
	local rock_2 = get_field_object(self.rock_2_name)
	local signboard_1 = get_field_object(self.signboard_name_1)
	local signboard_2 = get_field_object(self.signboard_name_2)

	self:revive_object(rock_1)
	self:revive_object(rock_2)
	self:revive_object(signboard_1)
	self:revive_object(signboard_2)

	character_util.remove_color(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Name, 0)
	character_util.set_position(get_party_leader(), reset_marker.position)
	character_util.set_direction(get_party_leader(), reset_marker.direction)
	character_util.remove_anim(get_party_leader())
	character_util.remove_emotion(get_party_leader())

	self:reset_maunal_android()

	--PS-10802 안드로이드 조종 영역이 남아있는 타이밍 이슈 때문에 AndroidController에 접근해서 꺼줌
	local android = get_field_object(self.android_name)
	local android_controller = android.FieldObjectBehaviour:GetLuaTable()
	android_controller:hide_range()
	android_controller:hide_virtual_field_object()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.path_upper_door_name))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.path_lower_door_name))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	self.is_mugger_dead = false

	-- 안드로이드 조작 가능하게 만듬
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'enable_android_control'}))

	coroutine.yield(self:mugger_game_prologue(false))

	if cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
		cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(
				stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
	end

	field_ui_manager:Show()

	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

-- 매 프레임 상태 체크해서 이벤트 진행 중단할지 확인하는 WaitForSeconds
function local_class:wait_for_sec_with_wait(sec)
	local timer = 0

	-- 플레이어가 미니게임 위치 벗어난 경우에는 카운트 오르지 않음
	while timer < sec do
		if self.is_player_mugger_game then
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		elseif self.is_mugger_dead then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 오브젝트 복구
function local_class:revive_object(obj)
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.sender = nil
	heal_info.target = obj
	heal_info.heal = obj.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.isRevive = true

	command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)

-- 소매치기 구출 이벤트 종료
function local_class:mugger_game_end_event()
	self:off_shutter(self.start_block_shutter_name, self.shutter_start_block_num, false)
	self:on_shutter(self.end_path_shutter_name, self.shutter_num)

	-- 플레이어 무적으로 변경
	character_util.set_immortal(get_party_leader(), true)

	self.mugger.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	character_util.convert_to_monster(self.mugger_stalker, self.battle_group_name)
	self.mugger_stalker.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true

	local waypoint_list_stalker = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	waypoint_list_stalker:Add(self.mugger_stalker.Position + vector(0, 0, -2))

	character_util.move_waypoint(self.mugger_stalker, waypoint_list_stalker, 1,
			false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down')

	while not self.is_detected_player and self.current_progress ~= self.progress_state.save_mugger and
			self.mugger_stalker.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped do
		if self:is_in_sight(self.mugger_stalker, get_party_leader(), 4, 60) then
			self.is_detected_player = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.player_detected_by_terrorist, self))
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 보이스가 존재할 경우 lilith_tower_mugger_18 보이스가 끊기지 않도록 대기한다.
	local wait_for_dialogue = CS.Oak.ResourceSelector.Instance:HasScenarioDialogue(music_player.CurrentVoiceBundleCode)
	if self.is_detected_player or self.current_progress == self.progress_state.save_mugger then
		character_util.stop(self.mugger_stalker)
		character_util.stop(self.mugger)
		character_util.remove_anim(self.mugger_stalker)

		return
	else
		character_util.set_anim(self.mugger_stalker, { name = 'rifle_idle' })

		start_coroutine(function()
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(
				self.mugger_stalker, { key = self.main_script..18, skip = false })

			wait_for_dialogue = false
		end)
	end

	if self.is_detected_player then
		return
	end

	local waypoint_list_mugger = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	waypoint_list_mugger:Add(self.mugger.Position + vector(0, 0, -1))

	character_util.move_waypoint(self.mugger, waypoint_list_mugger, 1,
			false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')

	waypoint_list_stalker:Clear()
	waypoint_list_stalker:Add(self.mugger_stalker.Position + vector(0, 0, -1))

	character_util.move_waypoint(self.mugger_stalker, waypoint_list_stalker, 1,
			false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down')

	while not self.is_detected_player and self.current_progress ~= self.progress_state.save_mugger and
			((self.mugger_stalker.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped and
					self.mugger.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped) or
					wait_for_dialogue) do
		if self:is_in_sight(self.mugger_stalker, get_party_leader(), 4, 60) then
			self.is_detected_player = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.player_detected_by_terrorist, self))
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_detected_player or self.current_progress == self.progress_state.save_mugger then
		character_util.stop(self.mugger_stalker)
		character_util.stop(self.mugger)
		character_util.remove_anim(self.mugger_stalker)
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')

		character_util.set_anim(self.mugger_stalker, { name = 'rifle_idle' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(
				self.mugger, { key = self.main_script..19, skip = false })
	end

	if self.is_detected_player then
		return
	end

	while not self.is_detected_player and self.current_progress ~= self.progress_state.save_mugger do
		if self:is_in_sight(self.mugger_stalker, get_party_leader(), 4, 60) then
			self.is_detected_player = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.player_detected_by_terrorist, self))
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- A의 시야에 B가 들어왔는지 확인, y축은 무시함
function local_class:is_in_sight(fo, target, distance, angle)
	local full_diff = target.Bounds.center - fo.Bounds.center
	local diff = target.Bounds.center - fo.Bounds.center

	if diff.magnitude > distance then
		return false
	end

	diff.y = 0

	if unity_class.vector3.Angle(diff.normalized, direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)) > angle / 2 then
		return false
	end

	if field:IsAnythingBlockingWithoutBounds(
			CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(fo.Bounds.center, vector(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)),
			CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, vector_util.get_x0z(full_diff)) then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

local local_class = newclass('LilithTowerNobodyPreSection')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_old_man = function() return get_character('nobody_old_man') end
	self.get_man = function() return get_character('nobody_man') end
	self.get_woman = function() return get_character('nobody_woman') end

	self.event_state = {
		before_latte_1 = 0,
		latte_1 = 1,
		before_latte_2 = 2,
		latte_2 = 3,
		before_accept = 4,
		accept = 5
	}
	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.before_latte_1

	self.scene_on = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_3_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	--방 한 군데 들어가면 가운데 휠체어에 앉은 빼빼마른 레드넥 할아버지와 젊은 남녀 2 명이 있다. (할아버지가 방 한가운데)
	--젊은 남녀 2 명은 시무룩한 표정으로 할아버지 앞에 앉아 있음.
	character_util.set_emotion(self.get_man(), {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.get_woman(), {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.get_old_man(), {name = 'attack'})

	character_util.set_anim(self.get_man(), {name = 'seat'})
	character_util.set_anim(self.get_woman(), {name = 'seat'})

	character_util.add_listener(self.get_man(), self.controller)
	character_util.add_listener(self.get_woman(), self.controller)
	character_util.add_listener(self.get_old_man(), self.controller)
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_3_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_old_man(), self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_man(), self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_woman(), self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_3_name then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if table_util.contain_value({ self.get_old_man(), self.get_man(), self.get_woman() }, e.Target)
				and (self.current_event_state == self.event_state.latte_1
				or self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_latte_2) and self.scene_on == false then
			self.scene_on = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.scene_latte_2, self)
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_old_man())
				and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_accept then
			self.current_event_state = self.event_state.accept
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.scene_accept_quest, self)
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestStartEvent) then
		if self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_accept then
			quest_icon_util.remove(self.get_old_man())
			character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_old_man(), self.controller)
			return true
		else
			character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_man(), self.controller)
			character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_woman(), self.controller)
			character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_old_man(), self.controller)
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestEndEvent) then
		if self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_accept then
			quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(self.get_old_man())
			character_util.add_listener(self.get_old_man(), self.controller)
			return true
		else
			character_util.add_listener(self.get_man(), self.controller)
			character_util.add_listener(self.get_woman(), self.controller)
			character_util.add_listener(self.get_old_man(), self.controller)

			if self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_latte_1
					and field:GetZone('nobody_old_man_latteing'):Contains(user_party.Leader.Position) then
				self.current_event_state = self.event_state.latte_1
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.old_man_latte_1, self))
			end

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'nobody_old_man_latteing')
			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_latte_1
			and self.controller.exclusive_on == false then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.latte_1
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.old_man_latte_1, self))
	end

	return false
end
