local local_class = newclass('LilithTowerNobodySection1')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_old_man = function() return get_character('nobody_old_man') end
	self.get_man = function() return get_character('nobody_man') end
	self.get_woman = function() return get_character('nobody_woman') end

	self.get_gum_fo = function() return get_field_object('nobody_grocery_gum') end
	self.get_coffee_fo = function() return get_field_object('nobody_grocery_coffee') end

	self.got_gum = false
	self.got_coffee = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_1_name then
		return
	end

	--1 층 식당을 조사하면 풍선껌과 커피를 얻을 수 있다.
	--적당한 타일에 상호작용 포인트 4-5 개를 만들고 커피/풍선깜을 얻도록 그 중 2 개에서 커피/풍선껌을 얻도록.
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_1_name then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent)) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_gum_fo()) then
		if self.got_gum == false then
			self.got_gum = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_gum, self)
			return true
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.controller.interact_grocery, self.controller, 3)
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_coffee_fo()) then
		if self.got_coffee == false then
			self.got_coffee = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_coffee, self)
			return true
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.controller.interact_grocery, self.controller, 4)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:interact_gum()
	local gum_fo = self.get_gum_fo()
	user_party.Leader.Direction = user_party.Leader.Position.x < gum_fo.Position.x
			and CS.Oak.Direction.Right or CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true,
													  type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player'})
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'eat'})

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	local item = self.controller.grocery_items[3]
	item.State = CS.Oak.DropItem.LootState.FixLooter
	item.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
	item:Fly()

	self.controller.grocery_items[3] = nil
	gum_fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	equipping_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'lilith_tower_nobody_grocery_gum'})

	if self.got_coffee then
		quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
	end

	end

function local_class:aim_to_target(fo, target)
	local fo_center = fo.Position + fo.SpineController.SpineTotalOffset
	local target_pos = target.Bounds.center
	local rifle_dir = (target_pos - fo.Bounds.center).normalized
	local rifle_pos = fo_center + rifle_dir * self.dist_btw_muzzle_fo

	fo.SpineController.AimPoint = CS.Oak.IKSupportUtil.GetAimPointInSpineSpace(rifle_pos, fo_center)
end

function local_class:shoot_bullet(start_pos, target_pos, bullet)
	local shoot_dir = (target_pos - start_pos).normalized
	bullet.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(shoot_dir)
			* unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	bullet.transform.position = start_pos
	table.insert(self.moving_bullet_infos, {
		transform = bullet.transform,
		start_pos = start_pos,
		target_pos = target_pos,
		time_passed = 0,
	})
end

function local_class:bullet_routine()
	self.bullets_moving = true
	while self.bullets_moving do
		local done_index_list = {}
		for index, info in pairs(self.moving_bullet_infos) do
			local progress = info.time_passed / self.bullet_move_dur
			info.transform.position = info.start_pos * (1 - progress) + info.target_pos * progress

			self.moving_bullet_infos[index].time_passed = info.time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if self.moving_bullet_infos[index].time_passed > self.bullet_move_dur then
				local terrorist = self.get_terrorist(2)
				character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(terrorist)
				character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(terrorist)
				character_util.remove_anim(terrorist)
				character_util.set_anim(terrorist, {name = 'damaged'})

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
				self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(info.transform.position)
				info.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)

				table.insert(done_index_list, index)
			end
		end

		for i = #done_index_list, 1, -1 do
			table.remove(self.moving_bullet_infos, i)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('LilithTowerPoliceOfficerPostSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = post @
		QuestName = LilithTowerPoliceOfficer @
		Comment = 리리스 타워 경찰관 퀘스트 후처리 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 경관과 관련된 문
	self.door_name = 'police_officer_door_'
	self.door_num = 8

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'lilithtower_1_2'

	-- 액팅 그리드 이름
	self.grid_name = 'police_officer_acting_grid'
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	if self.controller.starting_grade <= 0 then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
	end

	for i = 1, self.door_num do
		local door = get_field_object(self.door_name .. i)
		local animator = door:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		if i <= 4 then
			animator:Play('open', -1)
			door.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		else
			animator:Play('close', -1)
			door.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	if self.controller.starting_grade <= 0 then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	end

	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.grid_name) then
		self.controller.is_directing_terrorist = false
		return
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()

	self.controller.get_fx_hit()
	self.get_fx_last_hit()
	self.get_custom_sprite()
	self.get_fx_gun_fire()
	self.get_move_icon()
	self.get_gunshot_groundhit()
	self.get_fx_virus_hit()
	self.get_fx_virus_target_hit()
	self.get_fx_window_break()

	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	-- 연출용 총알 프리로드
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	self.custom_atlas = nil
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
				self.custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				self.custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)
	self.pooled_bullet = self:get_custom_sprite():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)

	local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
	bullet_sprite.Atlas = self.custom_atlas
	bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'virus_bullet_1.png'
	bullet_sprite:Rebuild()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

	-- 경찰 및 생존자 세팅
	self.police_officer = get_character(self.police_officer_name)
	self.police_officer.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'basic_handgun')

	self.npc_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.npc_count do
		table.insert(self.npc_list, get_character(self.npc_first_name .. i))
	end

	-- 사용할 테러리스트 세팅
	self.terrorist_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.terrorist_count do
		table.insert(self.terrorist_list, get_character(self.terrorist_name .. i))
	end

	-- 테러리스트의 슈터 및 어택 레인지 세팅
	self:set_shoot_helper()
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	-- 테러리스트 및 생존자, 경관 세팅
	local default_pos = field:GetMarker(self.terrorist_list_marker_name).position
	local pos_list = {
		default_pos + unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.5,
		default_pos + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.5,
		default_pos + vector(1, 0, 1),
		default_pos + vector(1, 0, -1),
	}

	for i = 1, self.chase_terrorist_count + 1 do
		local terrorist = self.terrorist_list[i]
		character_util.set_direction(terrorist, 'left')
		character_util.set_position(terrorist, pos_list[i])
		character_util.set_active_state(terrorist, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(terrorist,
				{ name = 'rifle_idle' }, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_immortal(terrorist, true)
	end

	-- 경관 세팅
	local officer_pos = field:GetMarker(self.police_officer_marker_name).position
	character_util.set_direction(self.police_officer, 'right')
	character_util.set_position(self.police_officer, officer_pos)
	character_util.set_active_state(self.police_officer, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.police_officer,
			{ name = 'handgun_idle' }, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.add_listener(self.police_officer, self.controller)

	-- 생존자들 세팅
	local npc_pos = field:GetMarker('police_officer_npc').position
	pos_list = { npc_pos, npc_pos - vector(0.3, 0, 0.1), npc_pos + vector(0.3, 0, 0.1) }
	for i = 1, #self.npc_list do
		local officer_npc = self.npc_list[i]
		character_util.set_active_state(officer_npc, 'enabled')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(officer_npc)
		character_util.set_direction(officer_npc, i == #self.npc_list and 'left' or 'right')
		if i > 1 then
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_list[i], { name = 'katana_idle' }, { name = 'scared' })
		else
			character_util.spine_rotate(self.npc_list[i], -10, 0)
			character_util.set_emotion(self.npc_list[i], { name = 'damaged' })
		end
		character_util.set_position(officer_npc, pos_list[i])
	end

	-- 바리게이트 문열어줌
	self:set_barricade(false)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	self.is_acting = false
	self.is_terrorist_shot = false

	-- 경관 및 생존자들 리스너 구독 해지
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.police_officer, self.controller)

	self.leader = nil
	self.police_officer = nil
	self.npc_list = nil
	self.terrorist_list = nil

	self.is_police_shot = false
	self.is_terrorist_shot = false
	self.is_interact_lever = false

	self.pooled_bullet = nil

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	self.shoot_helper_list:Clear()
	self.shoot_helper_list = nil
	self.custom_atlas = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.event_start then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'police_officer_terrorist_directing') then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_terrorist_event, self))
			return true
		end
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_state.meet_police_officer then
		for i = 1, 2 do
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'police_officer_acting_start_' .. i) then
				self.current_progress = self.progress_state.acting_event
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_acting_zone, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, 'police_officer_terrorist_directing') and
			self.current_progress == self.progress_state.event_start then
		self.is_terrorist_shot = false
		self.is_police_shot = false
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 처음에 경관에게 말걸었을 때
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.police_officer) then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.event_start then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.acting_event
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_police_officer, self)
			return true
		elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_state.meet_police_officer then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.acting_event
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_police_acting, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	-- 액팅 이후 레버를 닫을지 선택할 때
	local lever = self.get_lever()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, lever)
			and self.current_progress >= self.progress_state.choose_police
			and self.current_progress ~= self.progress_state.directing_police_run then
		lever.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		if not self.is_save_police_officer then
			-- 경관이 도착하지 않았다면 레버에 상호작용 했다는 것만 알림
			self.is_interact_lever = true
		else
			-- 경관이 도착했다면 바로 액팅 종료
			self.is_close_shutter = true
			self.is_acting = false
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.acting_event
			or self.current_progress >= self.progress_state.ending then
		return false
	end

	if self.act_terrorist_list == nil then
		return false
	end

	-- 테러리스트들이 유저의 총알에 맞았을 때 스턴 상태로 변경
	for i = 1, #self.act_terrorist_list do
		local terrorist = self.act_terrorist_list[i].terrorist
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, terrorist)
				and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, user_party.Leader)
				and self.act_terrorist_status.jump > self.act_terrorist_list[i].state then
			self.act_terrorist_list[i].delay = 0
			self.act_terrorist_list[i].state = self.act_terrorist_status.stun

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(terrorist, { name = 'seat' }, { name = 'damaged' })
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- 테러리스트가 경관과 생존자들 위협하는 부분
function local_class:show_terrorist_event()
	-- 총 쏘는 연출 루틴 시작
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.directing_terrorist_shot, self))
	if self.is_show_terrorist_event then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.directing_police_shot, self))
		return
	end
	self.is_show_terrorist_event = true

	-- 버러지 같은 놈들이... 버텨봤자 시간문제라고!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	--music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01', loop = false, play_pos = self.terrorist_list[1].Position })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.terrorist_list[1], { key = self.main_script .. 1
	, bubble_type = 'shout' })
	if self.current_progress ~= self.progress_state.event_start or self.is_terrorist_shot == false then
		return
	end

	-- 너희들의 시대는 끝났어!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.terrorist_list[2], { key = self.main_script .. 2 })
	if self.current_progress ~= self.progress_state.event_start or self.is_terrorist_shot == false then
		return
	end

	-- 총 두번 발사
	for _ = 1, 2 do
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_01', loop = false, play_pos = self.police_officer.Position })
		self:get_fx_gun_fire():Instantiate(self.police_officer.Position + vector(0.6, 1, -0.5),
				unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.police_officer.Transform)
		character_util.remove_anim(self.police_officer)
		character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'handgun_attack', loop = false })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end
	character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'handgun_idle' })
	wait_for_sec(1)
	if self.current_progress ~= self.progress_state.event_start or self.is_terrorist_shot == false then
		return
	end

	-- 이대로는…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', loop = false, play_pos = self.police_officer.Position })
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.police_officer, { name = 'seat' }, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.police_officer, { key = self.main_script .. 3 })
	if self.current_progress ~= self.progress_state.event_start
			or self.is_terrorist_shot == false then return end

	character_util.remove_emotion(self.police_officer)
	character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'handgun_idle' })
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.directing_police_shot, self))
end

-- 위협중인 테러리스트들이 총을 발사한다.
function local_class:directing_terrorist_shot()
	if self.is_terrorist_shot then
		return
	end
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.is_terrorist_shot = true
	while self.is_terrorist_shot do
		local rnd = random_util.get_random_int(1, 4)
		local terrorist = self.terrorist_list[rnd]
		character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'rifle_shoot', scale = 0.9 })
		local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		for _ = 1, 3 do
			local target_pos = vector(-77, 0.5, terrorist.Bounds.center.z)
			self:fire_bullet_effect(bullet_sprite, terrorist.Bounds.center + vector(-0.6, 0.1, 0)
			, target_pos)
			self.get_fx_virus_hit():Instantiate(target_pos)
			wait_for_sec(0.2)
		end
		character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'rifle_idle' })

		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < 0.5 do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			if not self.is_terrorist_shot then
				break
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 경관이 총쏘고 있는 연출
function local_class:directing_police_shot()
	if self.is_police_shot then
		return
	end
	self.is_police_shot = false
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	local wait_police_action = function(duration)
		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			if not self.is_terrorist_shot then
				break
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	self.is_police_shot = true
	character_util.set_emotion(self.police_officer, { name = 'attack' })
	while self.is_police_shot do
		-- 총 두번 발사
		for _ = 1, 2 do
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_01', loop = false, play_pos = self.police_officer.Position })
			self:get_fx_gun_fire():Instantiate(self.police_officer.Position + vector(0.6, 1, -0.5),
					unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.police_officer.Transform)
			character_util.remove_anim(self.police_officer)
			character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'handgun_attack', loop = false })
			wait_police_action(0.5)
		end
		character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'handgun_idle' })
		wait_police_action(2)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 헐크 테러리스트가 벽을 치는 연출
function local_class:directing_terrorist_golem()
	if self.is_terrorist_shot then
		return
	end
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.is_terrorist_shot = true
	local terrorist_golem = get_character('police_officer_terrorist_golem')
	while self.is_terrorist_shot do
		character_util.set_anim(terrorist_golem, { name = 'attack', loop = false })
		wait_for_sec(0.25)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_stomp_furniture_01', loop = false, play_pos = terrorist_golem.Position })
		for i = 1, 6 do
			local shake_barricade = get_field_object('police_officer_shake_' .. i)
			shake_barricade:Shake(0.15, 0.3)
		end
		self.controller.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(vector(-77, 0.2, 15))
		self.get_fx_last_hit():Instantiate(vector(-77, 0.2, 15))
		wait_for_sec(0.25)
		character_util.remove_anim(terrorist_golem)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end
end

-- 대치중인 경관과 만났을 때
function local_class:meet_police_officer()
	-- 대화중일 수도 있으니 스피치 버블 삭제
	for i = 1, #self.terrorist_list do
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.terrorist_list[i])
	end
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.police_officer)
	self.is_police_shot = false

	-- 아래 환풍구 잠시 사용 못하게 NonInteractable
	local vent_entry = self.get_vent_entry()
	vent_entry.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	-- 경관 앞으로 정렬
	party_util.align_party(self.police_officer.Position, 'left', 1, 'linear')
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.police_officer, self.controller)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.police_officer, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.police_officer)
	character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'handgun_idle' })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.police_officer, nil, 'notice')

	-- 넌...!
	character_util.set_emotion(self.police_officer, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.police_officer, { key = self.main_script .. 4, skip = true })

	self.is_terrorist_shot = false
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

		character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'handgun_idle' })

	-- 어서 뒤로 숨어!
	character_util.set_direction(self.police_officer, 'left')

	character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'handgun_idle' })

	--TODO: 소리 묻힘

	local start_pos = terrorist_golem.Position

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		if start_pos.y + dist_y > 0 then
			character_util.set_position(terrorist_golem, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0), true)
		else
			character_util.set_position(terrorist_golem, golem_pos)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', state = 'event' })
	character_util.set_position(terrorist_golem, golem_pos)
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	character_util.set_anim(terrorist_golem, { name = 'walk', scale = 0.5 })
	character_util.move_waypoint(terrorist_golem, vector(-75, 0, 14.5), 1.55, false, nil, nil, 'left')
	for i = 1, 6 do
		if i == 2 then
			for j = 1, 2 do
				local terrorist = self.terrorist_list[j]
				local add_pos = j == 1 and unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.5 or unity_class.vector3.back * 0.5
				character_util.move_waypoint(terrorist, terrorist.Position + add_pos

							character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
						end)
			end
		end
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.2)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_02')

		if i == 6 then
			character_util.remove_anim(terrorist_golem)
		end
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 1, 3 do
		-- 테러리스트가 주먹질 쾅!
		character_util.set_anim(terrorist_golem, { name = 'attack', loop = false })
		wait_for_sec(0.25)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_furniture_01')
		for i = 1, 6 do

		self.get_fx_last_hit():Instantiate(vector(-77, 0.2, 15))
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.25)
		if i == 1 then
			-- 아군 다 놀라서 점프
			character_util.set_direction(self.police_officer, 'right')
			character_util.set_emotion(self.police_officer, { name = 'surprise' })
			character_util.normal_jump(self.police_officer)

			character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'surprise' })
			character_util.normal_jump(user_party.Leader)

			for i = 1, #self.npc_list do
				character_util.remove_emotion(self.npc_list[i])
				character_util.set_emotion(self.npc_list[i], { name = 'surprise' })
				character_util.normal_jump(self.npc_list[i])
			end
		end
		wait_for_sec(0.25)
		character_util.remove_anim(terrorist_golem)
		wait_for_sec(0.1)
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)
	character_util.set_anim(terrorist_golem, { name = 'stomp', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(0.6)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.25)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_minotaurs_stomp_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.8)
	character_util.remove_anim(terrorist_golem)

	-- 헐크 테러리스트 공격 연출 루틴 시작
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.directing_terrorist_golem, self))

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 서로 마주보고 silence
	character_util.set_direction(self.police_officer, 'left')
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.police_officer)
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	-- 이것저것 가릴 수 있는 상황이 아니군.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.police_officer, { key = self.main_script .. 12
	, skip = true })

	-- 좋아. 할 수 있는 데까지 해보자고.
	character_util.set_emotion(self.police_officer, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.police_officer, { key = self.main_script .. 13
	, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.police_officer)

	character_util.set_direction(self.police_officer, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'handgun_walk' })
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.police_officer, {
		self.police_officer.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 1.5,
		self.police_officer.Position + vector(-3, 0, 1.5),
	}, 4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'handgun_idle' })
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	-- 여러분! 지금부터 안전한 장소로 이동합니다!
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(self.police_officer, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.police_officer, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }
	, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.police_officer, { key = self.main_script .. 14
	, skip = true })

	-- 당황하지 마시고 침착하게 저를 따라와 주세요!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.police_officer, { key = self.main_script .. 15
	, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.police_officer)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		-- 경관과 부상자들 이더리얼로
		self.police_officer.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		for i = 1, #self.npc_list do
			self.npc_list[i].OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end

		local add_count = 0
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local rock = get_field_object(self.rock_name .. i)
			if rock.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
				break
			end
			add_count = add_count + 1
		end

		for i = 1, #self.npc_list do
			if i > 1 then
				character_util.set_anim(self.npc_list[i], { name = 'katana_walk' })
			end
			character_util.set_emotion(self.npc_list[i], { name = i > 1 and 'tired' or 'damaged' })
		end
		character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'handgun_walk' })

		-- 바위 부셔진거에 따라 위로 미리 올라간다.
		local add_pos_z = 1.5 * add_count
		local pos_list = { vector(0, 0, add_pos_z), vector(-6.5, 0, 0), vector(0, 0, 3 - add_pos_z) }
		for i = 1, 3 do
			if pos_list[i] ~= unity_class.vector3.zero then
				for j = 1, #self.npc_list do
					character_util.move_to(self.npc_list[j], self.npc_list[j].Position + pos_list[i]
					, nil, 2.5, false, false)
				end
				character_util.move_to_async(self.police_officer, self.police_officer.Position + pos_list[i]
				, nil, 2.5, true, false)
			end
		end

		for i = 2, #self.npc_list do
			character_util.set_anim(self.npc_list[i], { name = 'katana_idle' })
		end
		character_util.set_direction(self.police_officer, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'handgun_idle' })
		character_util.add_listener(self.police_officer, self.controller)

		self.police_officer.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
		self.current_progress = self.progress_state.meet_police_officer
	end))
end

-- 경관이 카드키를 통해 문을 열고 액팅게임 시작
function local_class:start_police_acting()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.police_officer, self.controller)
	party_util.align_party(self.police_officer.Position, 'right', 0.5, 'arc')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 이 문은 내게 맡겨. 전용 카드키가 있으면...
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.police_officer, { key = self.main_script .. 16, skip = true })

	-- 경관이 문을 연다.
	character_util.set_direction(self.police_officer, 'left')
	local equip_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'eat' })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)
	equip_sfx:Stop(0)

	self:open_door(1, 2)
	character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'handgun_idle' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_itemdoor_open_03')
	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	for i = 2, #self.npc_list do
		local officer_npc = self.npc_list[i]
		character_util.set_anim(officer_npc, { name = 'katana_walk' })
	end

	-- 생존자들 위로 이동
	local add_pos_list = { unity_class.vector3.left, vector(0, 0, 8) }
	for i = 1, 2 do
		if i == 2 then
			character_util.set_direction(self.police_officer, 'left')
		end

		for j = 1, #self.npc_list do
			local officer_npc = self.npc_list[j]
			if j < #self.npc_list then
				character_util.move_to(officer_npc, officer_npc.Position + add_pos_list[i]
				, nil, 2.5, false, false)
			else
				character_util.move_to_async(officer_npc, officer_npc.Position + add_pos_list[i]
				, nil, 2.5, false, false)
			end
		end
	end

	-- 경관도 뒤따라서 이동
	character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'handgun_walk' })
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.police_officer
	, { self.police_officer.Position + unity_class.vector3.left
			, self.police_officer.Position + vector(-1, 0, 8) }
	, 5, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', true)

	-- 경관 위치 세팅
	character_util.set_direction(self.police_officer, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.police_officer)
	character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'handgun_idle' })
	character_util.set_position(self.police_officer, vector(-89, 0, 33.5))

	-- 생존자 세팅
	local center_pos = vector(-83, 0, 33.5)
	local pos_list = { center_pos, center_pos - vector(0.3, 0, 0.1), center_pos + vector(0.3, 0, 0.1) }
	for i = 1, #self.npc_list do
		if i > 1 then
			character_util.set_anim(self.npc_list[i], { name = 'katana_idle' })
		end
		character_util.set_position(self.npc_list[i], pos_list[i])
	end

	self.current_progress = self.progress_state.meet_police_officer
end

function local_class:enter_acting_zone()
	-- 헐크 테러리스트 주먹질 stop 왼쪽에 테러리스트 세팅
	self.is_terrorist_shot = false
	local terrorist_pos = field:GetMarker('police_officer_act_terrorist').position
	local terrorist_pos_list = { terrorist_pos, terrorist_pos + vector(-1, 0, 1)
	, terrorist_pos + vector(-1, 0, -1), }
	for i = 1, self.chase_terrorist_count do
		character_util.set_position(self.terrorist_list[i], terrorist_pos_list[i])
		character_util.set_direction(self.terrorist_list[i], 'right')
	end

	-- 폭탄들고 있을 수도 있으니 하단 폭탄 리셋

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.police_officer, { key = self.main_script .. 20, skip = true })

	, bubble_type = 'shout', scale = 1.25, screen_pos = vector(-350, 100) })

	-- 테러리스트 등장
	for i = 1, self.chase_terrorist_count do
		local terrorist = self.terrorist_list[i]
		character_util.remove_anim(terrorist)
		character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'rifle_walk' })
		character_util.move_waypoint(terrorist, terrorist.Position + vector(5, 0, 0)
		, 4, false, nil, nil, 'right', false, 1,
				function() character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'rifle_idle' }) end)
	end
	camera_util.move_async(vector(-96.5, 0, 34), 1)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	for i = 1, self.chase_terrorist_count do
		local terrorist = self.terrorist_list[i]
		character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'rifle_reload', sfx_name = '02_gun_reload_02', loop = false
		, next_anim = 'rifle_idle' })
	end
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(self.police_officer, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(1.5)
	camera_util.move_async(vector(-89.5, 0, 34), 1)

	-- 이런 망할... 바퀴벌레들처럼…!
	character_util.set_emotion(self.police_officer, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.police_officer, { key = self.main_script .. 22, skip = true })

	-- ... 이모티콘

	-- 젠장 이건 내 생애에서 가장 바보같은 선택일거야.

	character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'throw', loop = false, next_anim = 'handgun_idle' })
	local hand_gun = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = self.police_officer.Position,

	, itemid = 20360, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', spr_scale = 0.5 })

-- 액팅 연출용 함수
function local_class:start_directing()
	-- 액팅용 테러리스트 세팅
	self.act_terrorist_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.chase_terrorist_count do
		local terrorist_data = {}

		-- 엔티티그룹만 적으로 바꾸고 암살 불가능하도록
		self.terrorist_list[i].EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy
		stage.BattleManager:AddToNoAssassination(self.terrorist_list[i])

		-- 액트용 테러리스트 정보 세팅
		terrorist_data.terrorist = self.terrorist_list[i]
		terrorist_data.state = self.act_terrorist_status.move
		terrorist_data.delay = 0
		terrorist_data.is_active = true
		terrorist_data.duration = self:get_terrorist_duration()

		table.insert(self.act_terrorist_list, terrorist_data)
	end

	-- 하단에 투명벽 설치
	local wall_obj = self.get_wall_object(2)
	wall_obj.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(80, 0.75, 1))
	wall_obj.Position = vector(-60, 0, 30)

	-- 투명벽
	local move_wall_obj = self.get_wall_object(1)

	-- 플레이어 방향 고정
	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party.Leader, 'left')

	-- 마지막으로 클리어한 액트 카운트 리셋
	self.last_clear_act_num = 1
	self.directing_police_index = 1
	self.directing_survivor_index = 1
	self.cur_stage_bgm = ''

	-- 플레이어 hp 리셋
	self.cur_hp = self.max_hp

	-- 액팅 시작
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/audio:bgm_demonworld_hideout'
	, state = 'event', mix = 0.25 })

	self.is_acting = true
	while self.is_acting do
		self.current_progress = self.progress_state.acting_event
		move_wall_obj.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		move_wall_obj.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(0.5, 0.75, 10))

		-- 실패하지 않았을 때만 돈다.
		if self.cur_act_state ~= self.act_state.fail then
			-- 엑트 1일 때
			if self.last_clear_act_num <= 1 then
				-- 준비해! 온다!
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
				character_util.set_emotion(self.police_officer, { name = 'attack' })
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.police_officer, { key = self.main_script .. 29
				, bubble_type = 'shout', life_time = 1 })
				wait_for_sec(0.25)
				self:first_acting(move_wall_obj)
			end

			-- 액팅 중간 연출
			if self.last_clear_act_num <= 1
					and self.cur_act_state ~= self.act_state.fail then
				self:directing_acting_side()
				self.last_clear_act_num = 2
			end

			-- 엑트 2로 정상적으로 넘어 왔으면 액트2 시작
			if self.last_clear_act_num == 2 then
				self:second_acting(move_wall_obj)
			end

			if self.cur_act_state ~= self.act_state.fail then
				self:last_act(move_wall_obj)
			end

			-- 끝까지 실패하지 않았다면 액팅 종료
			if self.cur_act_state ~= self.act_state.fail then
				self.is_acting = false
				break
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 벽 다 비활성화
	wall_obj.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	move_wall_obj.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	self:ending()
end

-- 액팅에 사용할 테러리스트들 프로젝타일 세팅
function local_class:set_shoot_helper()
	self.shoot_helper_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.ShootHelper)

	-- 프로젝타일 스팩 세팅
	local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ProjectileData'):GetSpec('projectile_virus_bullet')
	local pattern_Info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo()
	pattern_Info.columns = 1
	pattern_Info.spreadDistance = 1
	pattern_Info.parallel = true

	-- ShootHelper 설정
	for i = 1, self.chase_terrorist_count do
		local terrorist = get_character(self.terrorist_name .. i)
		local shooter = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, terrorist)
		self.shoot_helper_list:Add(CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
				shooter, spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot, 0.8))
	end

	-- attack_range 세팅
	self.attack_ranges = {}
	for _ = 1, self.chase_terrorist_count do
		local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector2(30, 0))
		attack_range:Hide()
		table.insert(self.attack_ranges, attack_range)
	end
end

-- 액팅 1 연출 함수
function local_class:first_acting(wall_obj)
	local duration = self.act_data[self.last_clear_act_num].duration
	local start_pos = self.act_data[self.last_clear_act_num].start_pos
	local end_pos = self.act_data[self.last_clear_act_num].end_pos
	local move_speed = (end_pos.x - start_pos.x) / duration

	-- 테러리스트들 걷는 애니메이션으로 세팅
	for i = 1, #self.act_terrorist_list do
		local terrorist = self.act_terrorist_list[i].terrorist
		character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'rifle_walk' })
	end

	-- 플레이어 달리기 금지
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash)
	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	-- 엑팅 1 루틴 시작
	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		-- 진행 중 실패시 탈출
		if self.cur_act_state == self.act_state.fail then
			break
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 카메라 연출
		self:move_camera(wall_obj, time_passed, duration, start_pos, end_pos)

		-- 테러리스트 움직임 관리
		self:terrorist_routine(move_speed, nil, true)

		-- 생존자 움직임 관리
		self:act_npc_move_routine(5, move_speed)

		-- 4. 경관 로직
		self:directing_police_officer()

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 엑팅 2 연출 함수
function local_class:second_acting(wall_obj)
	self.directing_survivor_index = 7
	local duration = self.act_data[self.last_clear_act_num].duration
	local start_pos = self.act_data[self.last_clear_act_num].start_pos
	local end_pos = self.act_data[self.last_clear_act_num].end_pos
	local move_speed = (end_pos.x - start_pos.x) / duration

	-- 테러리스트들 걷는 애니메이션으로 세팅
	for i = 1, #self.act_terrorist_list do
		self.act_terrorist_list[i].is_active = true
		self.act_terrorist_list[i].delay = 0
		self.act_terrorist_list[i].state = self.act_terrorist_status.move
		local terrorist = self.act_terrorist_list[i].terrorist
		character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'rifle_walk' })
	end

	-- 플레이어 달리기 금지
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash)
	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		-- 진행 중 실패시 탈출
		if self.cur_act_state == self.act_state.fail then
			break
		end

		if time_passed < duration then
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			-- 카메라 연출
			self:move_camera(wall_obj, time_passed, duration, start_pos, end_pos)
		end

		-- 테러리스트 움직임 관리
		self:terrorist_routine(move_speed, -37, false)

		-- 생존자 움직임 관리
		self:act_npc_move_routine(9, move_speed)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 실패해서 내려온게 아니면 생존자 마지막 위치로 이동
	if self.cur_act_state ~= self.act_state.fail then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			-- 생존자 마지막 이동 다될 때까지 기다림
			while self.cur_act_survivor_state == self.act_npc_state.directing do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			self.cur_act_survivor_state = self.act_npc_state.directing
			self.directing_survivor_index = 10
			self:survivor_move_logic(2)
		end))
	end

	-- 존안에 들어올 때까지 대기
	local zone = field:GetZone('police_offcer_ending_zone')
	while true do
		if CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(zone.Bounds, user_party.Leader.Position)
				or self.cur_act_state == self.act_state.fail
				or not self.is_acting then
			break
		end
		self:terrorist_routine(move_speed, -37, false)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 카메라 움직임 함수
function local_class:move_camera(wall_obj, time_passed, duration, start_pos, end_pos)
	local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
	local move_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
	move_pos.y = 0

	camera_util.move(move_pos, 0)
	wall_obj.Position = move_pos + vector(self.wall_distance, 0, 0)
end

-- 테러리스트 로직
function local_class:terrorist_routine(move_speed, max_x, is_police_hit)
	local terrorist_move_speed = move_speed * 1.35
	for i = 1, #self.act_terrorist_list do
		local terrorist = self.act_terrorist_list[i].terrorist
		-- 테러리스트가 걷는 상태면서 일정 거리 가까워지면 게임 오버 연출
		if self.act_terrorist_list[i].state == self.act_terrorist_status.move
				and math.abs(user_party.Leader.Position.x - terrorist.Position.x) < 1.5 then
			self.cur_act_state = self.act_state.fail
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.directing_near_game_over, self
			, i, true))
			break
		end

		-- 경관 히트를 체크 할 거라면 경관이 가까워졌을 때는 경관 게임 오버 연출 추가
		if is_police_hit then
			if self.act_terrorist_list[i].state == self.act_terrorist_status.move
					and math.abs(self.police_officer.Position.x - terrorist.Position.x) < 1.5 then
				self.cur_act_state = self.act_state.fail
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.directing_near_game_over, self
				, i, false))
				break
			end
		end

		-- 움직이는 상태일 때
		self.act_terrorist_list[i].delay = self.act_terrorist_list[i].delay + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if self.act_terrorist_list[i].state == self.act_terrorist_status.move then
			if field:IsAnythingBlocking(CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(terrorist.Position
			, vector(0.01, 0.01, 0.01)), CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, unity_class.vector3.right) then
				-- 점프 스테이트로 변경(끝나면 다시 무브 스테이트)
				self.act_terrorist_list[i].state = self.act_terrorist_status.jump

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
					character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
					self.terrorist_list[i].EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral0
					music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_jump_01', loop = false, play_pos = terrorist.Position })
					character_util.jump_move(terrorist, terrorist.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 3.35
					, 3, 1.25, true, 'right')
					self.terrorist_list[i].EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy
					if self.cur_act_state == self.act_state.fail
							or self.act_terrorist_list[i].state == self.act_terrorist_status.move then
						character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
						return
					end
					character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = self.act_terrorist_list[i].is_active and
							'rifle_walk' or 'rifle_idle' })
					self.act_terrorist_list[i].state = self.act_terrorist_status.move
				end))
			else
				-- 앞에 장애물이 없으면서 스크린 안에 있을 때는 공격
				local is_in_screen = screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(terrorist.Position)
				if self.act_terrorist_list[i].delay > self.act_terrorist_list[i].duration and is_in_screen then
					-- 공격 딜레이가 다되었다면 록온 및 총알 쏘는 루틴 실행
					self.act_terrorist_list[i].state = self.act_terrorist_status.lock_on
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lock_on_routine, self, i))
				else
					-- 맥스 x가 정해져 있다면  그 위치 까지 이동 후에는 움직이지 않는다.
					if max_x ~= nil then
						local limit_x = i == 1 and max_x + 1 or max_x
						if self.act_terrorist_list[i].is_active and terrorist.Position.x >= limit_x then
							self.act_terrorist_list[i].is_active = false
							character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
						end
					end

					-- 움직이는 상태일 때는 앞으로 이동
					if self.act_terrorist_list[i].is_active then
						CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(terrorist, unity_class.vector3.right
						, terrorist_move_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime)
					end
				end
			end
		elseif self.act_terrorist_list[i].state == self.act_terrorist_status.stun then
			-- 화면 밖에 있으면서 0.2초 지났으면 바로 스턴 풀어준다.
			local is_immediately_release_stun = self.act_terrorist_list[i].delay > 0.2
					and not self:is_pos_x_in_camera(terrorist.Position)

			-- 스턴 시간 끝나면 move 상태로 변경한다.
			if self.act_terrorist_list[i].delay > self.stun_time or is_immediately_release_stun then
				self.act_terrorist_list[i].delay = 0
				self.act_terrorist_list[i].state = self.act_terrorist_status.move
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(terrorist)
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(terrorist, { name = self.act_terrorist_list[i].is_active and
						'rifle_walk' or 'rifle_idle' }, { name = 'attack' })
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 테러리스트가 록온 하는 루틴
function local_class:lock_on_routine(index)
	local terrorist = self.act_terrorist_list[index].terrorist

	-- 어택 레인지 세팅
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_targeted_03')
	character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false })
	local attack_range = self.attack_ranges[index]
	attack_range:Show(0)
	attack_range:SetAlpha(0.5)

	-- n초간 플레이어를 조준하고 있는다.
	local target_direction = nil
	local attack_time_passed = 0
	while attack_time_passed < self.lock_on_time do
		if self.act_terrorist_list[index].state == self.act_terrorist_status.stun
				or self.cur_act_state == self.act_state.fail
				or not self.is_acting then
			break
		end

		-- 레버 상호작용 안했을때만 로직 작동
		if not self.is_interact_lever then
			attack_time_passed = attack_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			target_direction = vector_util.get_x0z(user_party.Leader.Bounds.center - terrorist.Bounds.center).normalized

			attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(attack_range, terrorist.Bounds.center, target_direction, 0.05)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	attack_range:Hide()

	-- 엑트 실패거나 테러리스트의 스턴 상태일 경우 그냥 탈출
	if self.cur_act_state == self.act_state.fail or not self.is_acting
			or self.act_terrorist_list[index].state == self.act_terrorist_status.stun then
		return
	end

	-- ShootHelper 통해 프로젝타일 발사
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_09')
	self.shoot_helper_list[index - 1]:ShootDirectionAtPosition(
			terrorist.Bounds.center, target_direction, 999, -1, nil, false, 0)

	-- 쏘고 난 뒤 스테이트 변경
	self.act_terrorist_list[index].delay = 0
	self.act_terrorist_list[index].duration = self:get_terrorist_duration()

	if self.act_terrorist_list[index].state == self.act_terrorist_status.move then
		character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
	else
		character_util.set_anim(self.act_terrorist_list[index].terrorist, {
			name = self.act_terrorist_list[index].is_active and 'rifle_walk' or 'rifle_idle' })
		self.act_terrorist_list[index].state = self.act_terrorist_status.move
	end
end

-- 테러리스트 총알 처리
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	-- 이미 액트 실패일 때는 체크 할 필요 없음
	if self.cur_act_state == self.act_state.fail then
		return true
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, user_party.Leader) then
		-- 게임오버 연출
		if not lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
				CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) then

			self:get_fx_virus_target_hit():Instantiate(move_info.position + vector(0, 0.2, 0))
			if self.cur_hp <= 1 then
				self.cur_act_state = self.act_state.fail
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.directing_game_over
				, self, user_party.Leader))
			else
				-- 체력 깎고 맞는 연출
				self.cur_hp = self.cur_hp - 1
				character_util.spine_deviate_local(user_party.Leader, vector(0.15, 0, 0)
				, 0.15, 0.1)
				character_util.spine_pulse_color(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor
				, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
				character_util.spine_damage_squish(user_party.Leader, 1.3
				, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
			end
		end
	else
		local add_pos = lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, self.get_wall_object(1)) and -0.5 or 0
		self.get_fx_virus_hit():Instantiate(move_info.position + vector(add_pos, 0.2, 0))
	end
	return true
end

-- 총알 발사 연출
function local_class:fire_bullet_effect(bullet_sprite, sniper_pos, target_pos, speed)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_09', loop = false, play_pos = sniper_pos })

	bullet_sprite.transform.position = sniper_pos

	local look_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(target_pos - sniper_pos)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = look_rotation * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

	speed = lua_helper.get_or_default(speed, 30)
	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.MoveTo, bullet_sprite.transform,
			bullet_sprite.transform.position, target_pos, -1, nil, speed, false)

	bullet_sprite.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
end

-- 테러리스트와 가까워져서 죽는 연출
function local_class:directing_near_game_over(index, is_player)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 타겟팅 한 테러리스트가 총 쏘는 모션
	local target = is_player and user_party.Leader or self.police_officer

	local terrorist = self.act_terrorist_list[index].terrorist
	character_util.look_at(terrorist, target)

	local attack_range = self.attack_ranges[index]
	local target_direction = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Bounds.center - terrorist.Bounds.center).normalized
	attack_range:Show(0)
	attack_range:SetAlpha(0.5)

	attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(attack_range, terrorist.Bounds.center, target_direction, 0.05)

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(terrorist, { name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false }, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	attack_range:Hide()

	-- 총알 발사
	local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	self:fire_bullet_effect(bullet_sprite, terrorist.Bounds.center, target.Bounds.center)
	self.get_fx_virus_hit():Instantiate(target.Bounds.center + vector(0, 0.2, 0))

	self:directing_game_over(target)
end

-- 죽는 연출
function local_class:directing_game_over(target)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	self.cur_act_police_state = self.act_npc_state.none
	self.directing_police_index = 1
	self.cur_act_survivor_state = self.act_npc_state.none
	self.directing_survivor_index = 1

	-- 다른 테러리스트들 idle 애니메이션
	for i = 1, #self.act_terrorist_list do
		local terrorist = self.act_terrorist_list[i].terrorist
		character_util.set_anim(terrorist, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
	end

	-- 생존자들 걷는 애니메이션 취소
	for i = 2, #self.npc_list do
		character_util.set_anim(self.npc_list[i], { name = 'katana_idle' })
	end

	-- 경관 애니메이션 취소
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.police_officer)
	character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'handgun_idle' })

	-- 타겟이 죽는 연출
	CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(target, 999999, unity_class.color.red, target.Position)
	target.SpineController:AddColor(target.Name, unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 }), 1, 3)
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(target, vector(0.3, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(target, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(target, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(target, { name = 'dead', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01' }
	, { name = "damaged" })
	camera_util.move_async(vector(target.Position.x, 0, 34), 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	local act_data = self.act_data[self.last_clear_act_num]
	camera_util.move(act_data.start_pos, 0)
	target.SpineController:RemoveColor(target.Name, 0)

	-- 리더 리셋
	self.cur_hp = self.max_hp
	local pos = field:GetMarker(act_data.marker_first_name .. 1).position
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, pos)

	-- 생존자들 좌표 세팅
	pos = field:GetMarker(act_data.marker_first_name .. 3).position
	local pos_list = { pos, pos - vector(0.3, 0, 0.1), pos + vector(0.3, 0, 0.1) }
	for i = 1, #self.npc_list do
		local officer_npc = self.npc_list[i]
		character_util.set_position(officer_npc, pos_list[i])
	end

	-- 테러리스트들 기본 좌표 및 상태 리셋
	pos = field:GetMarker(act_data.marker_first_name .. 2).position
	local terrorist_pos_list = { pos, pos - vector(1, 0, -1), pos - vector(1, 0, 1), }
	for i = 1, #self.act_terrorist_list do
		local terrorist_data = self.act_terrorist_list[i]
		terrorist_data.state = self.act_terrorist_status.move
		terrorist_data.delay = 0
		terrorist_data.is_active = true
		terrorist_data.duration = self:get_terrorist_duration()

		character_util.set_direction(terrorist_data.terrorist, 'right')
		character_util.remove_anim(terrorist_data.terrorist)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(terrorist_data.terrorist, { name = 'rifle_idle' }, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_position(terrorist_data.terrorist, terrorist_pos_list[i])
	end

	-- 경관 좌표 세팅
	pos = field:GetMarker(act_data.marker_first_name .. 4).position
	character_util.set_direction(self.police_officer, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.police_officer)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.police_officer, { name = 'handgun_idle' }, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_position(self.police_officer, pos)

	wait_for_sec(1)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0.5, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 게임 재개
	self.cur_act_state = self.act_state.proceeding
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

-- 생존자들 움직이는 연출
function local_class:act_npc_move_routine(max_index, move_speed)
	if self.cur_act_survivor_state == self.act_npc_state.directing then
		return
	end

	if self.directing_survivor_index <= max_index then
		self.cur_act_survivor_state = self.act_npc_state.directing
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.survivor_move_logic, self
		, move_speed))
		self.directing_survivor_index = self.directing_survivor_index + 1
	end
end

-- 생존자들 움직이는 로직
function local_class:survivor_move_logic(move_speed)
	local start_pos = self.npc_list[1].Position
	local end_pos = self.get_npc_root_marker(self.directing_survivor_index).position
	local a = math.abs(end_pos.z - start_pos.z)
	local b = end_pos.x - start_pos.x
	local distance = math.sqrt((a ^ 2) + (b ^ 2))

	if b ~= 0 and distance ~= b then
		local cur_time = b / move_speed
		move_speed = distance / cur_time
	end

	local pos_list = { end_pos, end_pos - vector(0.3, 0, 0.1), end_pos + vector(0.3, 0, 0.1) }
	for i = 1, #self.npc_list - 1 do
		local duration = (pos_list[i] - self.npc_list[i].Position).magnitude / move_speed
		if i > 1 then
			character_util.set_anim(self.npc_list[i], { name = 'katana_walk' })
		end
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_to, self
		, self.npc_list[i], pos_list[i], duration))
	end
	local duration = (pos_list[#self.npc_list] - self.npc_list[#self.npc_list].Position).magnitude / move_speed
	character_util.set_anim(self.npc_list[#self.npc_list], { name = 'katana_walk' })
	self:move_to(self.npc_list[#self.npc_list], pos_list[#self.npc_list], duration)

	self.cur_act_survivor_state = self.act_npc_state.none
	for i = 2, #self.npc_list do
		character_util.set_anim(self.npc_list[i], { name = 'katana_idle' })
	end
end

-- 끝에 도착했을 때의 마지막 액트
function local_class:last_act(move_wall_obj)
	move_wall_obj.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	-- npc들이 끝까지 도착할 때까지 대기
	while self.cur_act_survivor_state ~= self.act_npc_state.none do
		if not self.is_acting or self.cur_act_state == self.act_state.fail then
			return
		end
		self:terrorist_routine(0.8, -37, false)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 화살표로 알려줌

	local go_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_go_02', repeat_term = 0.04 })
	local arrow_icon = self:get_move_icon():Instantiate(vector(-32, 2, 31.5))
	arrow_icon.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.4
	arrow_icon.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state:SetAnimation(0, 'in', true)

	-- 레버 퍼블리시인터렉티브로 수정
	local lever = self.get_lever()
	lever.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	self.current_progress = self.progress_state.choose_police

	-- npc들 idle로수정
	for i = 1, #self.npc_list do
		character_util.set_anim(self.npc_list[i], { name = 'katana_idle' })
	end

	self.is_save_police_officer = false
	self.is_close_shutter = false

	local npc_talk_step = 0
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < 13 do
		-- 진행 중 실패 또는 문을 닫을 경우에 게임 오버
		if self.is_close_shutter
				or not self.is_acting
				or self.cur_act_state == self.act_state.fail then
			break
		end

		if self.is_interact_lever then
			field_ui_manager:Hide()
			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

			-- 록온 상태가 아니면 idle로 변경
			for i = 1, #self.act_terrorist_list do
				if self.act_terrorist_list[i].state ~= self.act_terrorist_status.lock_on then
					character_util.set_anim(self.act_terrorist_list[i].terrorist, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
				end
			end

			-- 선택지 출력
			-- 격벽을 닫으시겠습니까?
			-- 예 / 아니오
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.main_script .. 70, minTotalDuration = 1 })
			local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
					{ { self.main_script .. 71, 'forced' }, { self.main_script .. 72, 'mercy' } })

			for i = 1, #self.act_terrorist_list do
				if self.act_terrorist_list[i].state ~= self.act_terrorist_status.lock_on then
					character_util.set_anim(self.act_terrorist_list[i].terrorist,
							{ name = self.act_terrorist_list[i].is_active and 'rifle_walk' or 'rifle_idle' })
				end
			end

			party_util.reset_controllers()
			field_ui_manager:Show()

			self.is_interact_lever = false
			if choose_result == 1 then
				-- 격벽 닫은걸로 변경 하고 break
				self.is_close_shutter = true
				self.is_acting = false
				break
			else
				-- 레버를 다시 활성화 할 수 있도록
				lever.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
			end
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		-- 대사 출력
		if npc_talk_step <= 0 and time_passed > 0 then
			-- 스위치다..! 저걸 누르면 격벽이 올라올거야!
			npc_talk_step = 1
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.npc_list[3], { key = self.main_script .. 48 })
		elseif npc_talk_step == 1 and time_passed > 9 then
			-- 이대로 우린 다 죽는 걸까…
			npc_talk_step = 2
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
			character_util.shake(self.npc_list[2], 0.03, 0.5)
			character_util.set_emotion(self.npc_list[2], { name = 'scared' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.npc_list[2], { key = self.main_script .. 49 })
		end

		-- 테러리스트 움직임 관리
		self:terrorist_routine(0.8, -37, false)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if not self.is_close_shutter and self.is_acting
			and self.cur_act_state == self.act_state.proceeding then

		-- 경관 등장 연출
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.directing_police_run

			-- 난 안죽는다! 안죽는다! 안죽는다고 빌어먹을 놈들아!!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.police_officer, { key = self.main_script .. 51, auto_layout = true, life_time = 5, dialogue = false })
			-- 음성 관련 핸들링을 여기서 진행함
			local dialogue_holder = music_player:PlayDialogue(self.main_script .. 51)
			-- 음성이 있는 경우 추가 연출
			if dialogue_holder then
				-- 일단 대기
				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				-- 좀더 밖에서 이동함
				character_util.set_direction(self.police_officer, 'right')
				character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'handgun_run' })
				character_util.set_position(self.police_officer, vector(-52, 0, 31.5))
				character_util.move_to_async(self.police_officer, self.police_officer.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 5
				, 0.75, nil, false, false)
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
			character_util.set_direction(self.police_officer, 'right')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.police_officer, { name = 'get' }, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.set_position(self.police_officer, vector(-47, 0, 31.5))
			character_util.jump_move(self.police_officer, self.police_officer.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 5
			, 7, 1.5, true, 'right')

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_01')
			character_util.set_direction(self.police_officer, 'right')
			character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'handgun_run' })
			character_util.move_to_async(self.police_officer, self.police_officer.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 5
			, 0.75, nil, false, false)

			-- 경관이 점프해서 방으로 들어옴
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
			character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'get' })
			character_util.jump_move(self.police_officer, self.police_officer.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 6
			, 7, 1.5, true, 'left')
			if not self.is_acting or self.cur_act_state == self.act_state.fail then return end

			character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'handgun_run' })
			character_util.move_to_async(self.police_officer, self.police_officer.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.5
			, 0.25, nil, true, false)
			if not self.is_acting or self.cur_act_state == self.act_state.fail then return end

			-- 보이스가 출력중이면 기다림
			if dialogue_holder then
				character_util.set_direction(self.police_officer, 'left')
				character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'handgun_idle' })

				while dialogue_holder.IsUsing do
					coroutine.yield()
					if not self.is_acting or self.cur_act_state == self.act_state.fail then return end
				end
			end

			-- 문 닫아!!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			character_util.set_direction(self.police_officer, 'left')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.police_officer, { name = 'release', scale = 1.5 }
			, { name = 'attack' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.police_officer, { key = self.main_script .. 52 })
			wait_for_sec(1)
			character_util.set_anim(self.police_officer, { name = 'handgun_idle' })

			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.close_barricade
			self.is_save_police_officer = true
		end))

		while not self.is_save_police_officer or not self.is_close_shutter do
			-- 액팅이 끝나거나 실패일 때는 brack
			if not self.is_acting or self.cur_act_state == self.act_state.fail then
				break
			end

			-- 테러리스트 움직임 관리
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			self:terrorist_routine(0.8, -37, false)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	go_sfx:Stop()
	arrow_icon:Dispose()
end

-- 액팅 실패 체크해서 멈추게하는 이동 함수
function local_class:move_to(fo, position, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = fo.Position

	local is_fail = false
	while time_passed < duration do
		if self.cur_act_state == self.act_state.fail then
			is_fail = true
			break
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		fo.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, position, progress)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if not is_fail then
		fo.Position = position
	end

	return is_fail
end

-- 총알 아래 터지는 이팩트
function local_class:gunshot_effect_rifle(pos, duration)
	local effect_term = 0.05
	local time_passed = 0
	local effect_time_passed = 0

	camera_util.shake(0.1, duration * 0.3)

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		effect_time_passed = effect_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if effect_term <= effect_time_passed then
			local rad = math.pi * CS.UnityEngine.Random.value * 2
			local target_x = math.cos(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.3, 0.6)
			local target_z = math.sin(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.3, 0.6)
			self.get_gunshot_groundhit():Instantiate(pos + vector(target_x, 0, target_z))

			effect_time_passed = 0
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 카메라에 해당 위치 좌표가 보이는지 리턴
function local_class:is_pos_x_in_camera(pos)
	local cam_half_width = stage_camera.HalfWidth
	local camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition

	if math.abs(camera_pos.x - pos.x) > cam_half_width * 0.85 then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.stage_name = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	-- c 구역 돌 파괴 시
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_fo('c_area_big_rock')) then

		if self.is_mouse_bomb_move then
			self.is_mouse_bomb_move = false
		end
		character_util.stop(self.get_buddy_dog())
		character_util.remove_anim(self.get_buddy_dog())

		stage_camera:Move(vector(35.5, 0, 127), 0.2)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.put_resume, self))
		return true
	end

	-- B구역에서 브레이커블 오브젝트 파괴 시
	if string.find(e.FieldObject.Name, 'bait_obj_') then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.detected_obj_event, self, e.FieldObject, false))
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.mouse_bomb_1) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.mouse_bomb_2) then
		if self.is_mouse_bomb_move then
			self.is_mouse_bomb_move = false
		end
	end

	for i = 1, 6 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_fo('resume_b_area_small_rock_'..i)) then
			stage_progress:SetNamedData('resume_b_area_small_rock_'..i, true)
			self.c_area_small_rock_living[i] = false
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_resume_man()) then
		if self.quest_talk_skip == false then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_resume_man, self)
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.select_quest_option, self)
		end
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('resume_paper')) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_with_resume, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	local param_0 = e:GetParamAt(0)

	if param_0 == 'b_area_terrorist' then
		param_0 = e:GetParamAt(1)

		if is_detected == true or is_detected_resume_man == true then
			return false
		end
	end

	local detected_terrorist = get_character(param_0)
	if detected_terrorist ~= nil then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.detect_party_n_npc, self, detected_terrorist)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_move_field_object_event(e)
	for i = 1, 2 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_field_object('mouse_bomb_' .. i)) then
			if not self.is_mouse_bomb_move then
				self.is_mouse_bomb_move = true
			end
		end
		if self.is_mouse_bomb_move == true and self.is_mouse_bomb_start == false then
			self.is_mouse_bomb_start = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.check_mouse_bomb_pos, self, i))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	for i = 1, 2 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, get_field_object('mouse_bomb_' .. i)) then
			self.is_mouse_bomb_explode = true
			return true
		end
	end


	return false
end

function local_class:area_b_routine()
	local resume_man = self.get_resume_man()

	local check_range_x = 999
	local check_range_z = 1.2
	local item_count = 0
	local find_star_piece = false

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	while true do
		local leader_pos = leader.Position
		for i = 1, #self.b_area_item_list do
			local item = self.b_area_item_list[i]

			-- 스타피스일때만 범위 넓힘
			if item ~= nil and i == 3 then
				check_range_z = 3
			elseif item ~= nil then
				check_range_z = 1.2
			end

			if item ~= nil and leader_pos.x - check_range_x < item.Position.x and leader_pos.x + check_range_x > item.Position.x and
					leader_pos.z - check_range_z < item.Position.z and leader_pos.z + check_range_z > item.Position.z and
					self.picking_up == false and self.b_area_get_item_index_list[i] == false then
				self.picking_up = true
				character_util.convert_to_npc(resume_man)

				self:erase_item(i)

				self.picking_up = false
			end
		end
		local count = 0
		for j = 1, #self.b_area_get_item_index_list do
			if self.b_area_get_item_index_list[j] == true then
				count = count + 1
			end
		end

		if count >= #self.b_area_item_list and find_star_piece == true then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 감시하는 테러리스트에게 미끼 던지는 이벤트
function local_class:detected_obj_event(obj)
	-- 파괴된 오브젝트부터 가장 가까운 테러리스트를 찾음
	local shortest_dist = 99999
	local detected_terrorist = nil
	local terrorist_index = 0

	for i = 1, 5 do
		local terrorist = self.get_terrorist(i)
		if terrorist ~= nil then
			local cur_dist = (obj.Position - terrorist.Position).magnitude

			if shortest_dist > cur_dist then
				shortest_dist = cur_dist
				detected_terrorist = terrorist
				terrorist_index = i
			end
		end
	end

	local is_in_sight = self:is_in_sight(detected_terrorist, obj, self.terrorist_sight_distance, self.terrorist_sight_angle)

	if detected_terrorist == nil or is_in_sight == false or self.is_detected_resume_man == true or self.is_detected_party_leader == true then
		return
	end

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(detected_terrorist)

	-- 테러리스트 : 방금 뭔가 들렸는데...?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(detected_terrorist, { key = 'lilith_tower_fake_resume_39', skip = false })

	-- 방향 계산
	--local look_dir = vector_util.to_direction(obj.Position - detected_terrorist.Position)

	character_util.stop(detected_terrorist)

	self.detected_obj[terrorist_index] = true
	self.terrorist_patrol_wait[terrorist_index] = true
end

--- 브레이커블 오브젝트가 감시에 보이는지 체크
function local_class:is_in_sight(fo, target, distance, angle)
	if fo == nil then
		return
	end

	local offset = unity_class.vector3.zero
	if target.Position.y >= 1 then
		offset = vector(0, 1, -0.7)
	end

	local diff = target.Bounds.center - vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center + offset)

	if diff.magnitude > distance then
		return false
	end

	diff.y = 0

	if unity_class.vector3.Angle(diff.normalized, direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)) > angle / 2 then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:change_area(state)
	if self.cur_event_state == state then
		return
	end
	self.pre_event_state = self.cur_event_state
	self.cur_event_state = state
	local cur_event = self.progress_area_name_table[ self.cur_event_state ]

	-- 현재 이벤트 객체가 유효할때
	if cur_event ~= nil then
		local area_name = cur_event.name
		local pre_area_name = nil
		if self.pre_event_state ~= self.event_state_enum.event_before then
			pre_area_name = self.progress_area_name_table[ self.pre_event_state ].name
		end

		if area_name ~= nil then
			if pre_area_name ~= nil then
				quest_marker_util.remove(pre_area_name)
			end
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, area_name, field:GetMarker( area_name ).Position)
		end

		if self.cur_event_state == self.event_state_enum.a_area or (self.saw_b_area_enter_event == true and self.cur_event_state == self.event_state_enum.b_area) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.progress_area_name_table[ self.cur_event_state ].cb, self))
		elseif self.cur_event_state ~= self.event_state_enum.event_before and self.cur_event_state ~= self.event_state_enum.event_end then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.progress_area_name_table[ self.cur_event_state ].cb, self)
		end
	end
end

-- item 제거
function local_class:erase_item(i)
	local resume_man = self.get_resume_man()
	local item = self.b_area_item_list[i]

	if item == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.is_detected_resume_man == true or self.is_detected_party_leader == true then
		character_util.set_emotion(resume_man, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.set_anim(resume_man, { name = 'embarrassed' })
		self.picking_up = false
		return
	end

	character_util.move_to_async(resume_man, item.Position + unity_class.vector3.back, nil, 7, true, true)

	if self.is_detected_resume_man == true or self.is_detected_party_leader == true then
		character_util.set_emotion(resume_man, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.set_anim(resume_man, { name = 'embarrassed' })
		self.picking_up = false
		return
	end

	local ment_index = i + 23 -- 23 값은 string index 보정값
	-- man : 1 - 이건 제법 비싸겠는데?, 2 - 이것도 챙겨야지!, 3 - 이건 우리 버디 던져주면 좋아하겠네.

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(resume_man, { key = 'lilith_tower_fake_resume_' .. ment_index, skip = false })

	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	character_util.set_anim(resume_man, { name = 'eat', loop = true })

	character_util.set_direction(resume_man, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(
			vector_util.to_direction(item.Position - resume_man.Position)))

	local timer = 0
	local duration = 1.5

	while timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if self.is_detected_resume_man == true or self.is_detected_party_leader == true then
			eat_sfx:Stop()
			character_util.set_emotion(resume_man, { name = 'surprise' })
			character_util.set_anim(resume_man, { name = 'embarrassed' })
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(resume_man)
			self.picking_up = false
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	eat_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_anim(resume_man)

	if self.is_detected_resume_man == false then
		if i ~= 3 then
			if self.b_area_item_list[i] ~= nil then
				self.b_area_item_list[i].ConsumeTarget = resume_man
			end
		else
			if self.b_area_item_list[i] ~= nil then
				sp_util.sine_move(self.b_area_item_list[i], { from = vector(79.5, 0.5, 130), to = resume_man.Position
				, duration = 0.5, height = 1 })
				self.b_area_item_list[i].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			end
		end
		self.b_area_get_item_index_list[i] = true

		wait_for_sec(0.1)
		-- 스타피스 먹었을때 사운드 재생
		if i == 3 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_quest_complete_a_01')
		end
		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		if self.cur_event_state ~= self.event_state_enum.c_area then
			CS.Oak.ICharacterExtensions.ConvertToFollowingNpc(resume_man, user_party, true,
					CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.OutBattleZone)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:detect_party_n_npc(terrorist)

	local resume_man = self.get_resume_man()

	local terrorist_index = 0
	for i = 1, 5 do
		terrorist_index = i
		local compare_terrorist = self.get_terrorist(i)
		if compare_terrorist ~= nil and terrorist == compare_terrorist then
			break
		end
	end

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(terrorist)

	if terrorist_index ~= 0 then
		character_util.stop(terrorist)
		self.terrorist_patrol_wait[terrorist_index] = true
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_siren_oneshot_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(terrorist, { key = 'lilith_tower_fake_resume_40', bubble_type = 'shout', --[[screen_pos = vector(-50, 250),]] type_speed = 0 })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'surprise' })
	party_util.set_anim({ name = 'embarrassed' })
	party_util.jump(0.5, 0.3)

	character_util.remove_anim(resume_man)
	character_util.set_emotion(resume_man, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_anim(resume_man, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(resume_man)


	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 남자 NPC가 먹었던 장비 드랍 아이템 다시 바닥에 드랍
	self:drop_item_reset()

	-- 들고 있던 것 내려 놓기
	local breakable_obj = nil
	if user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState ~= nil and
			lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		breakable_obj = user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget
		if breakable_obj ~= nil then
			character_util.release_hold_object(user_party.Leader, breakable_obj)
		end
	end

	local marker = field:GetMarker('a_area_end')

	if self.is_detected_resume_man == true then
		coroutine.yield()
		CS.Oak.ICharacterExtensions.ConvertToFollowingNpc(resume_man, user_party, true,
				CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.OutBattleZone)
	end

	character_util.set_position(resume_man, marker.position)

	coroutine.yield()
	CS.Oak.ICharacterExtensions.ConvertToFollowingNpc(resume_man, user_party, true,
			CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.OutBattleZone)

	party_util.position_party(vector(999, 0, 999), marker.direction, 'arc')
	coroutine.yield()


	party_util.position_party(marker.position, marker.direction, 'linear')
	party_util.remove_emotion()


	party_util.remove_animation()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(resume_man)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(terrorist)

	party_util.align_party(user_party.Leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward, 'up', 0.1, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	self.is_detected_resume_man = false
	self.is_detected_party_leader = false
	if terrorist_index ~= 0 then
		self.terrorist_patrol_wait[terrorist_index] = false
	end
end

function local_class:check_mouse_bomb_pos(i)
	local buddy_dog = self.get_buddy_dog()
	self.mouse_bomb_pre_pos = get_field_object('mouse_bomb_' .. i).Transform:GetChild(0).position

	local buddy_dog_pre_pos = buddy_dog.Position

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.dog_follow_mouse_bomb, self, i))

	local speed = 11
	local first_delay = false
	local fo_pos = nil

	local fo = get_field_object('mouse_bomb_' .. i).Transform:GetChild(0)
	local invisible_wall = get_field_object('mouse_bomb_damage_checker_' .. i)
	while self.is_mouse_bomb_move do
		if first_delay == false then
			first_delay = true
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end

		if fo == nil then
			break
		end

		if fo ~= nil then
			fo_pos = fo.position
			if invisible_wall ~= nil then
				if i == 1 then
					if (math.floor(fo_pos.x) ~= 67 and math.floor(fo_pos.x) ~= 68) and math.floor(fo_pos.z) ~= 127 then
						invisible_wall.Position = vector(fo_pos.x, 1, fo_pos.z)
					end
				elseif i == 2 then
					if (math.floor(fo_pos.x) ~= 68 and math.floor(fo_pos.x) ~= 69) and math.floor(fo_pos.z) ~= 127 then
						invisible_wall.Position = vector(fo_pos.x, 1, fo_pos.z)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local compare_dog = buddy_dog
		if fo_pos ~= nil and compare_dog.Position.x - 1.0 < fo_pos.x and compare_dog.Position.x + 1.0 > fo_pos.x and
				compare_dog.Position.z + 1.0 > fo_pos.z and compare_dog.Position.z - 1.0 < fo_pos.z then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MouseBombResetEvent.Create(true))
			self.mouse_bomb_pre_pos = fo_pos
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if self.is_mouse_bomb_explode == true then
			character_util.stop(buddy_dog)
			character_util.remove_anim(buddy_dog)

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			if self.is_mouse_bomb_move == false then
				self.is_mouse_bomb_start = false
				return
			end

			self.is_mouse_bomb_move = false
			self.is_mouse_bomb_start = false

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			if buddy_dog.Position.x < 68.5 and buddy_dog.Position.z > 129 then
				character_util.set_position(buddy_dog, vector(68.5, 0, 131))
			end

			local wp = {}

			if buddy_dog.Position.z > 129 then
				table.insert(wp, vector(68.5, 0, 129))
				table.insert(wp, vector(67, 0, 129))
			else
				table.insert(wp, vector(67, 0, 129))
			end

			wp_util.move_way_points_async(buddy_dog, {waypoints = wp, speed = 9, run = true, play_sfx = false})

			character_util.set_direction(buddy_dog, 'right')

			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			self.is_mouse_bomb_explode = false
			break
		else
			self.mouse_bomb_pre_pos = fo_pos
		end


		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end
