function local_class:add_terrorist_detect()
	for i = 1, 5 do

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.change_terrorist_direction, self, i, 2.5))
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.terrorist_patrol, self, i))
	end

end

function local_class:change_terrorist_direction(terrorist_index, delay)
	local dir_index = 1
	local add_delay = 0
	local detect_direction_type = nil

	if terrorist_index == 4 then
		detect_direction_type = self.detect_direction_type_4
	elseif terrorist_index == 5 then
		detect_direction_type = self.detect_direction_type_5
	end

	--if terrorist_index ~= 4 and terrorist_index ~= 5 then
	--	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.terrorist_patrol, self, terrorist_index))
	--end

	local terrorist = self.get_terrorist(terrorist_index)
	local attack_range_renderer = CS.Oak.GhostGuardAttackRangeRenderer(terrorist, self.terrorist_sight_distance, self.terrorist_sight_angle)

	local timer = 0

	local resume_man = get_character('resume_man')
	while self.cur_event_state ~= self.event_state_enum.event_end do
		-- 이벤트 시작 전이면 아래 처리하지 않음
		if self.cur_event_state == self.event_state_enum.event_before then
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		-- 유저 감지되어 방향 전환 잠시 멈춤
		while self.is_detected_party_leader == true do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end


		if timer < delay + add_delay then
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if (self.detected_obj[terrorist_index] == true or self.is_detected_resume_man == true) and self.terrorist_patrol_wait[terrorist_index] == true then
				add_delay = 4
				self.detected_obj[terrorist_index] = false
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		elseif timer > delay + add_delay then
			if terrorist_index == 4 or terrorist_index == 5 then
				character_util.set_direction(terrorist, detect_direction_type[dir_index])
			end
			timer = 0
			add_delay = 0
		end

		local is_in_sight_party_leader_2 = self:is_in_sight(terrorist, user_party.Leader, self.terrorist_sight_distance, self.terrorist_sight_angle)
		if is_in_sight_party_leader_2 and self.is_detected_party_leader == false then
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(terrorist, { 'resume_terrorist_' .. terrorist_index, true }))
			self.is_detected_party_leader = true
		end

		local is_in_sight_resume_man_2 = self:is_in_sight(terrorist, resume_man, self.terrorist_sight_distance, self.terrorist_sight_angle)
		if is_in_sight_resume_man_2 and self.is_detected_resume_man == false and self.is_detected_party_leader == false and self.picking_up == true then
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(terrorist, { 'resume_terrorist_' .. terrorist_index, false }))
			self.is_detected_resume_man = true
		end

		attack_range_renderer.AttackRange:Show(0)
		attack_range_renderer:Update(terrorist)

		if terrorist_index == 4 or terrorist_index == 5 then
			if dir_index >= #detect_direction_type then
				dir_index = 1
			else
				dir_index = dir_index + 1
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	attack_range_renderer:Dispose()
	attack_range_renderer = nil
end

function local_class:terrorist_patrol(terrorist_index)
	local terrorist = self.get_terrorist(terrorist_index)
	local action_duration = 3
	local timer = 0
	local forward = true	-- 정방향 true, 역방향 false
	local change_direction = false

	if terrorist_index == 1 then
		action_duration = 3
	elseif terrorist_index == 2 then
		action_duration = 2
	else
		action_duration = 2
	end

	character_util.set_anim(terrorist, {name = 'walk'})
	while self.cur_event_state ~= self.event_state_enum.event_end do
		-- 이벤트 시작 전이면 아래 처리하지 않음
		if self.cur_event_state == self.event_state_enum.event_before then
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if self.terrorist_patrol_wait[terrorist_index] == false then

			if terrorist ~= nil then
				if forward == true then
					if timer < action_duration then
						if change_direction == false then
							if terrorist_index == 1 then
								terrorist.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
							elseif terrorist_index == 2 then
								terrorist.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
							else
								terrorist.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
							end
							change_direction = true
						end
						local progress = timer / action_duration
						terrorist.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.terrorist_patrol_waypoints_list[terrorist_index][1], self.terrorist_patrol_waypoints_list[terrorist_index][2], progress)
					else
						forward = false
						change_direction = false
						timer = 0
					end
				elseif forward == false then
					if timer < action_duration then
						if change_direction == false then
							if terrorist_index == 1 then
								terrorist.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
							elseif terrorist_index == 2 then
								terrorist.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
							else
								terrorist.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
							end
							change_direction = true
						end
						local progress = timer / action_duration
						terrorist.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.terrorist_patrol_waypoints_list[terrorist_index][2], self.terrorist_patrol_waypoints_list[terrorist_index][1], progress)
					else
						forward = true
						change_direction = false
						timer = 0
					end
				end
			end

		elseif self.terrorist_patrol_wait[terrorist_index] == true then

			if terrorist ~= nil then
				character_util.remove_anim(terrorist)
				wait_for_sec(5)
				self.terrorist_patrol_wait[terrorist_index] = false

				character_util.set_anim(terrorist, {name = 'walk'})
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:terrorist_setting()
	-- 테러리스트 비활성화
	for i = 1, 5 do
		local terrorist = self.get_terrorist(i)
		if terrorist ~= nil then
			character_util.set_active_state(terrorist, 'enabled')
		end
	end
end

function local_class:clean_b_area()
	-- 테러리스트 비활성화
	for i = 1, 5 do
		local terrorist = self.get_terrorist(i)
		if terrorist ~= nil then
			character_util.set_active_state(terrorist, 'disabled')
		end
	end

	-- 아이템 남아있다면 삭제
	if self.b_area_get_item_index_list[1] == false and self.b_area_item_list[1] ~= nil then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.b_area_item_list[1])
	end
	if self.b_area_get_item_index_list[2] == false and self.b_area_item_list[2] ~= nil then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.b_area_item_list[2])
	end
end

--endregion

-- 카메라 플레이어에게 돌아가는 것 방지
function local_class:stage_camera_cancel_move(duration_time)
	local timer = 0
	local duration = duration_time

	while timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		stage_camera:CancelMove()

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	self.camera_stop = false
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('LilithTowerVendingMachineSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
      Type = progress @
      QuestName = LilithTowerVendingMachine @
      Comment = 리리스타워 자판기 @
]]

-- 사용할 초기 변수의 값 또는 객체 정의
function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- field object
	self.get_vending_machine = function() return get_field_object('lilithtower_vending_machine') end
	self.get_chest = function() return get_field_object('lilith_coin_chest') end
	self.get_star_piece = function() return get_field_object('vending_machine_star_piece') end

	-- item id
	self.item_id = 20451

	-- custom key
	self.custom_key = 'lilith_coin_get'

	-- 자판기 활성화 체크
	self.vending_machine_active = false

	-- 이펙트
	self.get_star_piece_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_starpiece_in_character') end
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenScreenPlayEndEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')

	quest_util.load_pool_resource('FX_starpiece_in_character')

	local vending_machine = self.get_vending_machine()

	vending_machine.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	local main_quest_id = 258
	local main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(main_quest_id)
	if main_quest ~= nil and main_quest.InnerProgress < 9 then
		local renderer = vending_machine:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))
		local material = renderer.material

		local mesh_color = unity_color({ 0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 1.0 })
		material.color = mesh_color
	end

	local chest = self.get_chest()

	-- enter 시점에 상자가 이미 열려있으면 열린거니 커스텀스테이트를 리리스 기념 주화 얻은걸로 변경
	if chest.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpened then
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.custom_key, 1)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()

	self.star_piece_effect = self.get_star_piece_effect():Instantiate(
			self.get_vending_machine().Position + vector(0.5,0.5,0))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenScreenPlayEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))

	if self.star_piece_effect ~= nil then
		self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
		self.star_piece_effect = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_vending_machine()) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_vending_machine, self)
			return true
		end

	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TreasureOpenScreenPlayEndEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_chest()) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.get_coin, self)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if e.QuestId == 258 then
		if e.CurrentProgress == 9 then
			self.vending_machine_active = true

			local vending_machine = self.get_vending_machine()
			local renderer = vending_machine:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))
			local material = renderer.material
			local mesh_color = unity_color({0.588,0.588,0.588,1.0})
			material.color = mesh_color
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:interact_vending_machine()
	local main_quest_id = 258
	local main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(main_quest_id)
	local vending_machine = self.get_vending_machine()

	if (main_quest ~= nil and main_quest.InnerProgress < 9) and not self.vending_machine_active then
		-- 전원이 꺼져 작동하지 않는다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lilithtower_vending_machine_1' })
		return
	end

	-- 동전을 넣으시겠습니까?
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lilithtower_vending_machine_5' })

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'lilithtower_vending_machine_6', 'intellect' }, { 'lilithtower_vending_machine_7', 'normal' } })

	if choose_result == 2 then
		return
	end

	if self.controller.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.custom_key) ~= 1 then
		-- 동전이 필요합니다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lilithtower_vending_machine_2' })
		return
	else
		party_util.align_party(vending_machine.Position + vector(0.5,0,0),
				'down', 1, 'linear')

		vending_machine.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_greenland_01')
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(user_party.Leader, vector(0, 0, 0.3), 0.3, 0.3)
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(user_party.Leader, {name = 'attack', count = 1})
		wait_for_sec(0.25)
		vending_machine:Shake(0.1, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(1)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_japangi_01')
		vending_machine:Shake(0.1, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		if self.star_piece_effect ~= nil then
			self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
			self.star_piece_effect = nil
		end
		-- 스타피스 등장 및 클리어
		star_piece_util.appear(self.get_star_piece(), vending_machine.Position + vector(0.5,0.5,0),
				user_party.Leader.Position + vector(1, 0, 0))

		wait_for_sec(2)
		yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false, false)
	end
end

function local_class:get_coin()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_treasure_item_popup_01')
	local start_pos = self.get_chest().Position - vector(0.5,0,1)
	local drop_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = start_pos,
			  target = user_party.Leader.Position, itemid = self.item_id, notforinven = true })
	drop_item.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.5))

	-- 아이템 획득 연출
	local item_place_holder = CS.Oak.ItemPlaceholder()
	item_place_holder.ItemId = self.item_id
	-- 리리스 주화
	-- 한정 생산된 프리미엄 마계 주화!
	-- 소장 목적으로 발행된 리리스 통치 999주년 기념주화입니다. 한정 생산이라 값어치가 매우 높습니다.
	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ItemGetEvent(item_place_holder,
			'lilithtower_vending_machine_3', 'lilithtower_vending_machine_4'))
end

return local_class

	self.get_fx_critical_hit_blood = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_virus_bullet_proj_explosion') end
	self.get_custom_sprite = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite') end

	self.optimized_npcs = nil

	self.exclusive_name = 'vlog_exclusive'

end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_virus_bullet_proj_explosion')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_object_twinkle_single_demonworld')

	self.get_black_explosion_effect()
	self.get_fx_critical_hit_blood()
	self.get_custom_sprite()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	-- 총알 프리로드
	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local custom_atlas
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
				custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)

	self.pooled_bullet = self.get_custom_sprite():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)
	local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
	bullet_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas
	bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'virus_bullet_1.png'
	bullet_sprite:Rebuild()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	self.get_vloger().SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'selfie_stick')

	self.optimized_npcs = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async({
		civil_1 = 'lilithtower_business_male',
		civil_2 = 'lilithtower_civilian_female',
		civil_3 = 'lilithtower_civilian_male'
	})

	local fake_knight
	if user_util.has_knight_male() then
		fake_knight = get_character('knight_fake_female')
	else
		fake_knight = get_character('knight_fake_male')
	end
	fake_knight.SpineController:AddFadeColor(fake_knight.Name, unity_color({0, 0, 0, 1}), 1, 0)

	self:set_state()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.current_vlog_state < 4 then
		self:create_sd()
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	if self.optimized_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npcs)
		self.optimized_npcs = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if not self.is_qte_start then
		return false
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
		self.swipe_type = 'right'
		return true
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for i = 1, 3 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_sd(i)) then
			if self.sd_effect ~= nil then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_sd, self, true)
			else
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_sd, self, false)
			end
			return true
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_door()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_kid_zone, self)
		return true
	end

	local bed = get_field_object('vlog_bed')
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, bed) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_kid_obj, self, bed, 'lilithtower_vlog_narration_2', 'vlog_bed')
		return true
	end

	local toy = get_field_object('vlog_toy_1')
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, toy) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_kid_obj, self, toy, 'lilithtower_vlog_narration_3', 'vlog_toy')
		return true
	end

	local book = get_field_object('vlog_bookshelf')
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, book) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_kid_obj, self, book, 'lilithtower_vlog_narration_5', 'vlog_book')
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then return end
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'kid_zone' and self.kid_obj_count >= 3 and self.before_ending then
		self.before_ending = false
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.vlog_ending, self)
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	if e.Key ~= self.exclusive_name then
		self:deactivate_quest()
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	if e.Key ~= self.exclusive_name then
		self:activate_quest()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sd_sprite ~= nil then
		self.sd_sprite.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
		self.sd_sprite = nil
	end

	if self.sd_effect ~= nil then
		self.sd_effect:Dispose()
		self.sd_effect = nil
	end

	if self.selfie_stick_broken ~= nil then
		self.selfie_stick_broken:ConsumeComplete()
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestStartEvent) then
		return self:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestEndEvent) then
		return self:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:set_state()
	local state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.vlog_custom_state)
	if state == -1 then
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.vlog_custom_state, 1)
	else
		self.current_vlog_state = state
	end

	local door = self.get_door()
	if self.current_vlog_state > 4 then
		door:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)):Play('open')
		door.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		door.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end
end

-- sd카드 생성
function local_class:create_sd()
	local sd = self.get_sd(self.current_vlog_state)

	self.sd_effect = self.get_sd_effect():Instantiate(sd.Position)
	sd.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

-- sd카드 틀기
function local_class:interact_sd(is_first)
	local state = self.current_vlog_state
	local sd = self.get_sd(state)

	if is_first then
		if user_party.Leader.Position.x < sd.Position.x then
			character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
		end

		local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', fade_in_time = 0 })
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'eat' })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		self.sd_effect:Dispose()
		self.sd_effect = nil

		self.sd_sprite = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{itemid = 20438 , notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', pos = sd.Position, showoncharacter = false })

		equipping_sfx:FadeOut(0)
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'lilithtower_vlog_narration_6'})

	local wait = true
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local pass = true

	-- sd 카드의 내용을 확인한다.
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('lilithtower_vlog_choose_1'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end })
	-- 그만 둔다.
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('lilithtower_vlog_choose_2'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
			pass = false
		end })

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party.Leader, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if not pass then
		return
	end

	sd.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	if user_party.Leader.Position.x < sd.Position.x then
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	else
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'eat' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	self.sd_sprite.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
	self.sd_sprite = nil

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'idle' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_beep_02')
	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(true)
	user_party.Leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'maiden_phone')
	user_party.Leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')

	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'twohand_idle'})

	wait_for_sec(1)

	if state == 1 then
		self:play_sd_1()
	elseif state == 2 then
		self:play_sd_2()
	elseif state == 3 then
		self:play_sd_3()
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
	user_party.Leader:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, user_party.Leader.Weapon1)
	user_party.Leader:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, user_party.Leader.Weapon2)
	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(false)

	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.vlog_custom_state, state + 1)
	self.current_vlog_state = state + 1

	if self.current_vlog_state < 4 then
		self:create_sd()
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
end

-- exclusive 이벤트 발생하면 비활성화
function local_class:deactivate_quest()
	if self.current_vlog_state < 4 then
		self.get_sd(self.current_vlog_state).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	elseif self.current_vlog_state == 4 then
		self.get_door().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end
end

-- exclusive 이벤트 끝나면 다시 활성화
function local_class:activate_quest()
	if self.current_vlog_state < 4 then
		self.get_sd(self.current_vlog_state).Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	elseif self.current_vlog_state == 4 then
		self.get_door().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end
end

function local_class:enter_kid_zone()
	local door = self.get_door()

	party_util.align_party(door.Position + vector(0.5,0,0), 'down', 0.5, 'arc')

	-- 출입을 위해 비밀번호 입력이 필요합니다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'lilithtower_vlog_narration_1'})

	if self.current_vlog_state < 4 then
		return
	end

	local answer = { 2, 0, 2, 0 }
	local is_correct = true
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local choose_result = nil
		choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
				{ { 'lilithtower_vlog_choose_3', 'normal' }, { 'lilithtower_vlog_choose_4', 'normal' }, { 'lilithtower_vlog_choose_5', 'normal' }, { 'lilithtower_vlog_choose_6', 'normal' },
				  { 'lilithtower_vlog_choose_7', 'normal' }, { 'lilithtower_vlog_choose_8', 'normal' } })

		if choose_result-1 ~= answer[i] then
			is_correct = false
		end
	end

	if is_correct then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_greenland_01')
		door:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)):Play('open')
		door.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			character_util.move_to(user_party[i], user_party[i].Position + vector(0,0,2),
					0.5, nil, true, true)
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		door:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)):Play('close')
		wait_for_sec(0.3)


		local book = get_field_object('vlog_bookshelf')
		local bed = get_field_object('vlog_bed')
		local toy = get_field_object('vlog_toy_1')

		book.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		bed.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		toy.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'vlog_book', book.Position + vector(0.5,0,0))
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'vlog_bed', bed.Position + vector(1,0,0.5))
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'vlog_toy', toy.Position)
	end
end

function local_class:interact_kid_obj(fo, narration, marker)
	fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	self.kid_obj_count = self.kid_obj_count + 1
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = narration})
	quest_marker_util.remove(marker)
end

function local_class:shoot_and_bomb(shooter, target, dir, is_fade, anim, knock_back)
	local vtr
	if dir == 'left' then
		vtr = vector(1, 0, 0)
	else
		vtr = vector(-1, 0, 0)
	end

	character_util.stop(target)

	character_util.set_anim(shooter, { name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false, next_anim = 'rifle_idle', scale = 0.5 })
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	self:fire_bullet_effect(bullet_sprite, shooter.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.2), target.Position)

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.2)
	self.get_fx_critical_hit_blood():Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	character_util.set_direction(target, dir)
	character_util.set_anim(target, { name = anim, loop = false, scale = 3 })
	character_util.set_emotion(target, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_active_shadow(target, false)

	if is_fade then
		target.SpineController:AddColor(target.Name, unity_color({0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1}), 1, 0.5)
	end

	if knock_back then
		local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
				'physics', true, vtr, 12000, 0.05,
				CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

		local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(target, knock_back_info)
		target.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if is_fade then
		target.SpineController:AddFadeColor(target.Name, unity_color({0, 0, 0, 1}), 1, 1)
		character_util.shake(target, 0.08, 2.5)

		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		target.SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5, 1)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		camera_util.shake(0.5, 0.4)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fly_explosion_02')
		self.get_black_explosion_effect():Instantiate(target.Position)
		target.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end
end

function local_class:fire_bullet_effect(bullet_sprite, sniper_pos, target_pos)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_08')
	bullet_sprite.transform.position = sniper_pos
	local look_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(target_pos - sniper_pos)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = look_rotation * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.MoveTo, bullet_sprite.transform,
			bullet_sprite.transform.position, target_pos, -1, nil, 30, false)
	bullet_sprite.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
end

function local_class:qte_swipe()
	local duration = 1
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe('right')

	self.swipe_type = ''
	self.is_qte_start = true
	local time_passed = 0

	while self.is_qte_start and time_passed < duration do
		coroutine.yield()
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if self.swipe_type == 'right' then
			yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, duration - time_passed)
			break
		end
	end

	self.is_qte_start = false
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
end

function local_class:fail_qte()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.1)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit'):Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')
		local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
				'linear', true, vector(0, 0, 0), nil, nil,
				nil, false, nil, CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceTime,
				CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceDistance)

		command_util.publish_knock_back(user_party.Leader.Owner, user_party.Leader, knock_back_info, user_party.Leader.Position)
		user_party.Leader.SpineController:DamageSquish(1)
		user_party.Leader.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
	end))
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'damaged' })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	user_party.Leader.Position = self.get_kid_zone() + vector(-0.25, 0, -4.5)

local local_class = newclass('LilithTowerWorkaholicSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = LilithTowerWorkaholic @
		Comment =  2스테이지 워커홀릭 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 혹시 몰라서 반지 소지 여부 체크 분리해둠 (먼저 반지를 얻을 수도 있도록 하라는 피드백이 있을 수 있음)
	self.has_ring = false

	self.event_progress = {
		none = 1,
		entrance = 2,
		first_talk = 3,
		second_talk = 4,
		third_talk = 5,
		fourth_talk = 6,
		get_ring = 7,
		give_ring = 8,
	}

	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.none

	self.on_talk = false

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'lilithtower_1_2'

	self.default_talk_name = 'lilithtower_workaholic_default_'
	self.talk_name = 'lilithtower_workaholic_talk_'


	self.twinkle_effect_preset = 'FX_Object_Twinkle'
	self.twinkle_effect = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.twinkle_effect_preset)
	screen_util.preload_item_get_event()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어 코드
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')


	self.workers = {}

	for i = 1, 5 do
		local worker = self.controller.get_worker(i)
		local pos = self.controller.get_marker(i).position
		local chair = self.controller.get_chair(i)
		character_util.set_position(worker, pos + vector(0, 0.65, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(worker, 'up')
		character_util.set_anim(worker, {name = 'dualgun_attack'})
		if i == 3 then
			character_util.set_anim(worker, {name = 'shoot'})
		end
		chair.Position = pos + vector(0, 0, 0.2)
		table.insert(self.workers, worker)
	end
	table.insert(self.workers, self.controller.get_worker(6))

	character_util.add_listener(self.workers[4], self.controller)

	character_util.set_position(self.workers[6], self.controller.get_marker(6).position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0.5))
	--character_util.set_position(self.workers[6], self.controller.get_marker(6).position)

	self.twinkle_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.twinkle_effect_preset):Instantiate(
			self.workers[6].Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어 코드
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return false end -- 방어 코드
	if not self.controller.active_quest then return false end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if not self.controller.active_quest then return false end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.workers[4]) and not self.on_talk then
		--coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.business_talk_event, self))
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.business_talk_event, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.workers[6]) and not self.on_talk and not self.has_ring then
		--coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.dead_businessman_ring, self))
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.dead_businessman_ring, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.controller.active_quest then return false end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader)
			and e.FullEnter and e.Zone.Name == 'workaholic_zone'
			and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.auto_talk_event, self))
		return true
	end
	return false

function local_class:auto_talk_event()
	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.entrance

	local sfxs = {
		'03_dialogue_emphasize_01',
		'01_catch_fire_01',
		'03_dialogue_positive_01'
	}

	for i = 1, 5 do
		--직원들 모두 표정 smile로 통일
		--직원1 (남) : 오늘도 신나는 야근이다!
		--직원2 (여) : 업무가 늘어나니 의욕이 활활 불타는데요?
		--직원3 (남) : 리리스 타워에 취직하길 잘했어!
		--직원4 (여) : 자꾸 큰 소음이 들리는데… 일에 방해되니 귀마개라도 껴야지.
		--직원5 (남) : 이대로 평생 일만 할 수 있다면 얼마나 좋을까…
		if i < 4 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = sfxs[i],
										play_pos = self.workers[i].Position,
										loop = false, max_distance = 7, min_distance = 5})
		end
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.workers[i], {key = self.default_talk_name .. i})

		if self.on_talk or self.current_progress > self.event_progress.entrance then
			return
		end
	end
end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(worker,
			{key = self.default_talk_name .. 4, life_time = 0, type_speed = 0})
	for i = 1, 5 do
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.workers[i])
	end

	party_util.align_to_target(worker, 'left', 0.5, 'linear')

	if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.entrance then

			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(worker, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'}, {name = 'attack'})

		ring_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = vector(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)
		ring_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = vector(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'push', upper = true}, {name = 'tired'})
		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'walk'})

		local origin = user_party.Leader.Position
		local timer = 0
		local duration = 0.5
		local pos = origin + vector(0.5, 0, 0)

		while timer < duration do
			local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local proc = (timer / duration) * math.pi / 2
			local temp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(origin, pos, math.sin(proc))

			character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, temp_pos)
			ring_item.Position = temp_pos + vector(0.3, 0.4, 0)
			timer = timer + dt
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		ring_item.ConsumeTarget = worker
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, true)
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'tired'})

		timer = 0
		duration = 0.3
		pos = origin
		origin = user_party.Leader.Position

		while timer < duration do
			local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local proc = (timer / duration)
			local temp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(origin, pos, proc)

			character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, temp_pos)
			timer = timer + dt
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

		--비즈니스우먼(여) : 네? 교대 근무자가 죽었다고요?
		character_util.set_emotion(worker, {name = 'surprised'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker, {key = self.talk_name .. 18, skip = true})
		--비즈니스우먼(여) : …
		character_util.set_emotion(worker, {name = 'idle'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker, {key = self.talk_name .. 19, skip = true})
		--비즈니스우먼(여) (tired) : 에휴… 그 사람 몫까지 하려면 오늘은 꼼짝없이 밤샘 근무겠네.

		character_util.set_emotion(worker, {name = 'tired'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker, {key = self.talk_name .. 20, skip = true})
		--비즈니스우먼(여) : 뭐, 약속은 약속이니 비켜 드릴게요.

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(worker)
		character_util.set_direction(worker, 'up')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker, {key = self.talk_name .. 21, skip = true})

		local ease_slide = function(npc, chair, pos, duration)
			local npc_origin = npc.Position
			local chair_origin = chair.Position
			local timer = 0

			while timer < duration do
				local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
				local proc = (timer / duration) * math.pi / 2
				local temp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(chair_origin, pos, math.sin(proc))

				character_util.set_position(npc, vector_util.get_x0z(temp_pos, npc_origin.y) + vector(0, 0, -0.2))
				chair.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(temp_pos, 0)
				timer = timer + dt
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, vector_util.get_x0z(pos, npc_origin.y) + vector(0, 0, -0.2))
			chair.Position = pos
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_door_01')
		character_util.set_direction(worker, 'up')
		-- 임시 연출용 코드임. 나중엔 의자를 치우는 쪽으로 수정해야 함.
		yield_return_func(ease_slide,
				worker, self.controller.get_chair(4),
		self.controller.get_marker(4).position + vector(0, 0, -1), 1)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)
	else
		-- 반지 없음, 자리 비켜주기 전 반복 대사 (원라인 처리, 이 구간으로 들어오면 로직에 문제가 있는것임)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker, {key = self.talk_name .. 14})
	end
	self.on_talk = false
end

function local_class:dead_businessman_ring()
	local item_id = 20454 --임시 id, 반지 아이템 추가해서 교체해야 함
	local item_scripts = {
		title = 'workaholic_ring_title',
		subtitle = 'workaholic_ring_subtitle',
		desc = 'workaholic_ring_desc',
	}
	self.on_talk = true
	if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.fourth_talk then
		local dir = user_party.Leader.Direction
		local side = (user_party.Leader.Position.x < self.workers[6].Position.x and 'right' or 'left')
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, side)
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'eat'})

		local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_treasure_item_popup_01')
		self.twinkle_effect:Dispose()
		local ring_item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = self.workers[6].Position,
													   target = user_party.Leader.Position
															   + direction_util.to_vector3(user_party.Leader.Direction) * 0.5,
													   itemid = item_id, notforinven = true, skip_text = true,
													   lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true})
		ring_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = vector(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)
		ring_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = vector(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)
		ring_item.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
		wait_for_sec(1.7)

		-- 반지 가져움
		self.has_ring = true

		eat_sfx:Stop()
		eat_sfx = nil
		local itemHolder = create_item_placeholder({ id = item_id, not_for_inventory = true })
		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ItemGetEvent, itemHolder, item_scripts.title, item_scripts.subtitle, item_scripts.desc)

		self.workers[4].Interactable.Talk = nil
		character_util.add_listener(self.workers[4], self.controller)
		self.current_progress = self.event_progress.get_ring

		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, dir)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.workers[6], self.controller)
	end
	self.on_talk = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.twinkle_effect ~= nil then
		self.twinkle_effect:Dispose()
		self.twinkle_effect = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.stage_name = nil

	self.workers = nil
end

	self.console_interactable = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.twinkle_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle'):Instantiate(get_field_object('xlog_console').Position + vector(0.5,0.7,-0.3))
	self.twinkle_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(2, 2, 2)

	self.console_interactable = get_field_object('xlog_console').Interactable
	get_field_object('xlog_console').Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	return true

end

end

		self.twinkle_effect:Dispose()
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('xlog_console')) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_console, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- 콘솔 인터랙트
function local_class:interact_console()
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'lilith_tower_xlog_17'})

	if self.twinkle_effect ~= nil then
		self.twinkle_effect:Dispose()
		self.twinkle_effect = nil
	end

	get_field_object('xlog_console').Interactable = self.console_interactable

	yield_return_func(self.get_x_log, self)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)
end

-- 비디오 얻기
function local_class:get_x_log()
	local x_log = get_field_object('xlog')

	-- floating 아이템 획득처리
	stage:SendPickStageItem(x_log.Name, nil, function(data)
		local has_value, value = data:TryGetValue('AddedItem')
		local added_item = value

		if added_item ~= nil then
			CS.Oak.StageProgress.Current:AddItem(x_log.KeyIndex)

			has_value, value = added_item:TryGetValue('Id')
			local item_id = value

			has_value, value = user.Items:TryGetValue(item_id)
			if has_value then
				CS.Oak.AddItemStageLogic.Execute(value, user_party.Leader)
			end
		end
	end)

	local tape_id = x_log.FieldObjectBehaviour.Item.ItemId
	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ItemGetEvent, { ItemId = tape_id, NotForInventory = true }, 'x_log_video_title', 'x_log_video_desc')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.VideoFoundEvent.Create(tape_id))
end

return local_class

--[[QuestAttribute

]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.requester = nil

	self.see_intro = false

	self.flower_id = 20002
	self.flower_num = 4
	self.requester_name = "requester_old"
	self.maid_name = "maid"
	self.magician_name = "magician"
	self.zone_name = "magician_and_maid"
	self.sfx_swing_name = "01_swing_01"

	quest_icon.PreLoad()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= "teatans_1_4" then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.controller.scene:add_callback('ThrowFlower', { controller = self, func = self.throw_flower } )

	self.requester = get_character(self.requester_name)
	self.requester.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= "teatans_1_4" then
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.requester = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) and
				e.Zone.Name == self.zone_name then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.requester_noticed, self))
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.requester) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.quest_open, self))
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:requester_noticed()
	quest_icon.SetSubstageIcon(self.requester)
	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:requester_noticed())
end

function local_class:quest_open()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.requester)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	character_util.align_party(self.requester, "down")
	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:quest_start())

	floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party_leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, "left")
	coroutine.yield(character_util.mario_jump(user_party_leader, "left"))
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	coroutine.yield(stage_util.new_stage_theatre_show(
			{ substage_name = "substage_2_8",
			  substage_open_string_key = game_string:Format("opened_stage", game_string:GetString("substage_2_8")) }))

	music_player.StageBgmState = CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field
	coroutine.yield(quest_util.activate_quest(self.controller))
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:throw_flower()
	local maid = get_character(self.maid_name)
	local magician = get_character(self.magician_name)
	local drop_item_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.DropItem)

	for i = 1, self.flower_num do
		local rand_x = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-0.3, 0.3)
		local rand_z = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-0.3, 0.3)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.sfx_swing_name)

		local target_pos = magician.Position + vector(rand_x, 0, rand_z)
		local cur_flower = drop_item_util.create_item({pos = maid.Position, target = target_pos,
		                                               itemid = self.flower_id, notforinven = true, amount = 1,
		                                               lootstate = "dontfindlooter"})

		drop_item_list:Add(cur_flower)
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	for i = 0, drop_item_list.Count - 1 do
		drop_item_list[i].ConsumeTarget = nil
		drop_item_list[i]:ConsumeComplete()
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

local EventProgress = {

	open_second_cage = 4,

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.magician = nil
	self.maid = nil
	self.old = nil
	self.event_brazier = nil
	self.brazier_holdable = nil

	self.is_discovered = false
	self.opened_cage_num = 0

	self.invader_num = 9

	self.magician_name = "magician"

	self.old_name = "requester_old"

	self.cage_door_name = "cage_door"
	self.key_door_name = "keydoor"
	self.event_battle_gate_name = "event_battlegate_"

	self.first_cage_zone_name = "first_cage"
	self.join_maid_zone_name = "join_maid"
	self.see_magician_zone_name = "see_magician"
	self.last_battle_zone_name = "battle"
	self.second_marker_zone1 = "BATTLE_1"

	self.reset_marker_name = "discovered_"

	self.battle_group_name = "invaders"

	self.marker_name = "magician_and_maid"
	self.tracker_name = "magician_and_maid_s2_tracker_0"

	self.talk_name1 = "magician_and_maid_cage_"
	self.talk_name2 = "magician_and_maid_discovered"
	self.talk_name3 = "magician_and_maid_s2_20"
	self.talk_name4 = "magician_and_maid_talk_old"

	self.discovered_event_name1 = "invader_discovered_a"
	self.discovered_event_name2 = "invader_discovered_b"
	self.discovered_event_name3 = "invader_discovered_c"
	self.reset_event_name = "reset"

	self.open_key_door_state = "open_key_door"

	self.dust_effect_preset = "FX_slime_buttbounce"

	self.hit_dummy_sfx_name = "01_hit_dummy_02"
	self.gimmick_door_down_sfx_name = "02_gimmick_door_down_01"
	self.gimmick_door_down2_sfx_name = "02_gimmick_door_down_02"
	self.stage_clear_sfx_name = "01_stage_clear_01"
	self.ghost_detect_sfx_name = "01_ghost_detect_01"

	self.open_cage_Scene_name = "section_2_open_cage_"
	quest_icon.PreLoad()
end

function local_class:enter()

	if stage.Name == "teatans_1_4" then
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
		self.old = get_character(self.old_name)
		self.old.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	if stage.Name ~= "substage_2_8" then
		return true
	end

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress ~= 1 then
		self.event_progress = EventProgress.idle
		coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:setting_2())
	else
		if self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.open_key_door_state) == -1 then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.idle
			coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:setting_2())
		else
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.open_key_door
			self.opened_cage_num = 3
			coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:setting_2_open_keydoor())
		end
	end

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.dust_effect_preset)

	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')

	self.controller.scene:add_callback('FireOnBrazier', { controller = self, func = self.fire_on_brazier } )
	self.controller.scene:add_callback('OpenLastCage', { controller = self, func = self.open_last_cage } )
	self.controller.scene:add_callback('DustEffect', { controller = self, func = self.dust_effect } )

	self.magician = get_character(self.magician_name)
	self.maid = get_character(self.maid_name)

	if self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.open_key_door_state) ~= -1 then
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.magician, user_party, true)
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.maid, user_party, true)
	end

	self.event_brazier = get_field_object(self.brazier_name)
	self.brazier_holdable = self.event_brazier.Holdable
	self.event_brazier.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance

	for i = 1, self.cage_num do
		local active_cage = false
		if self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.open_key_door_state) == -1 then
			active_cage = true
		elseif i == self.cage_num then
			active_cage = true
		end

		if active_cage then
			local cur_cage = get_field_object(string.format("%s%d", self.cage_name, i))
			cur_cage.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

			table.insert(self.cage_list, cur_cage)
		else
			local animator = get_field_object(string.format("%s%d", self.cage_name, i)):
			GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

			animator:Play("open", -1, 1)
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == "teatans_1_4" then
		quest_icon.SetQuestAccepted(self.old)
	end
	if stage.Name ~= "substage_2_8" then
		return
	end

	if self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.open_key_door_state) == -1 then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-15.5, 1, 22.5))

		for i = 1, self.door_num do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(string.format("%s%d",
					self.door_name, i)))
		end
	else
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
		self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-62.5, 0, -1))

		for i = 1, self.door_num do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(string.format("%s%d",
					self.door_name, i)))
		end
	end

	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, string.format("%s %d / 4",
			game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name), self.opened_cage_num))
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name == "teatans_1_4" then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
		self.old.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		self.old = nil
	end

	if stage.Name ~= "substage_2_8" then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.magician = nil
	self.maid = nil
	self.event_brazier = nil
	self.brazier_holdable = nil
	self.event_progress = nil
	self.cage_list = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent) then
		self:on_door_opened_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.first_cage_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.first_cage_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.first_cage_event
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.first_cage, self))
		end
	end

	if zone_name == self.join_maid_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.join_maid_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.join_maid_event
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.join_maid_event, self))
		end
	end

	if zone_name == self.see_magician_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.find_magician_Event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.find_magician_Event
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.find_magician_event, self))
		end
	end

	if zone_name == self.last_battle_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.last_battle then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.last_battle
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_event, self))
		end
	end

	if self.event_progress == EventProgress.open_first_cage and zone_name == self.second_marker_zone1 then
		ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, vector(-33.5, 0, 2))
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.magician) then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.join_magician_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.join_magician_event
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.join_magician_event, self))
		end
	end

	if self.cage_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.cage_list do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.cage_list[i]) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.open_cage_event, self, i))
			end
		end
	end

	local old = get_character(self.old_name)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, old) then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(old, self.talk_name4)
	end
end

function local_class:open_cage_event(cage_index)
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	self.opened_cage_num = self.opened_cage_num + 1
	self.cage_list[cage_index].Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	if cage_index == 1 then
		self.event_progress = EventProgress.open_first_cage
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
		self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-31, 0, 19.5))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(string.format("%s%d", self.door_name, 3)))
	elseif cage_index == 2 then
		self.event_progress = EventProgress.open_second_cage
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
		self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.magician)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(string.format("%s%d", self.door_name, 1)))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(string.format("%s%d", self.door_name, 4)))
	elseif cage_index == 3 then
		self.event_progress = EventProgress.open_third_Cage

		local key_door = get_field_object(self.key_door_name)
		if key_door ~= nil then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, key_door.Position + vector(0, 1, 0))
		end
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(string.format("%s%d", self.door_name, 2)))
	end

	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, string.format("%s %d / 4",
			game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name), self.opened_cage_num))

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	local dir = (self.cage_list[cage_index].Position - user_party_leader.Position).normalized * 0.4

	user_party_leader.Direction = dir:ToDirection()
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(user_party_leader, dir, 0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = "sword_attack", loop = false})

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.hit_dummy_sfx_name)
	user_party_leader:RemoveAnimation()
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	local animator = self.cage_list[cage_index]:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	animator:Play("open", -1)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.gimmick_door_down_sfx_name)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))
	coroutine.yield(lua_helper.call_nullable(self.controller.scene, string.format("%s%d",
	self.open_cage_Scene_name, cage_index), self.controller.scene))

	if cage_index == 3 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.cage_door_name, false))
	end

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:open_key_door()

function local_class:battle_event()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.maid)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.magician)

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:section_2_battle())

	character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.magician, user_party, true)
	character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.maid, user_party, true)

	for i = 1, self.invader_num do
		local cur_invader = get_character(string.format("%s%d", self.invader_name, i))
		character_util.convert_to_monster(cur_invader, self.battle_group_name)
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(cur_invader, user_party_leader, "battle")

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.maid)

	coroutine.yield(screen_util.play_stage_clear())

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:section_2_epilogue())

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.stage_clear_sfx_name)
	screen_util.fade_out_circular(2, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear, "image")

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(2))
	CS.Oak.Game.Instance:StageToLobby(true)

function local_class:discovered(event_name, finder)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.ghost_detect_sfx_name)

	character_util.jump(finder, 0.5, 0.3)
	character_util.set_anim(finder, {name = "relrease"})
	character_util.set_emotion(finder, {name = "mad"})

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local cur_party =
		character_util.jump(user_party[i], 0.5, 0.3)
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], {name = "embarrassed"})
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], {name = "scared"})
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(finder, {key = self.talk_name2, skip = true})

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(finder, {self.reset_event_name, event_name}))

	local marker = CS.Oak.MarkerInfo()

	if event_name == self.discovered_event_name1 then
		marker = field:GetMarker(string.format("%s%d",self.reset_marker_name, 1))
	elseif event_name == self.discovered_event_name2 then
		marker = field:GetMarker(string.format("%s%d",self.reset_marker_name, 2))
	elseif event_name == self.discovered_event_name3 then
		marker = field:GetMarker(string.format("%s%d",self.reset_marker_name, 3))
	end

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do

		local marker_dir = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetOpposite(marker.direction)
		local marker_tovector = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(marker_dir)
		local constants = CS.Oak.Constants
		character_util.set_position(user_party[i], marker.position + marker_tovector *
				constants.DistBetweenPartyMembers * i)
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], marker.direction)
		user_party[i]:RemoveAnimation()
		user_party[i]:RemoveEmotion()
	end

	finder:RemoveAnimation()
	finder:RemoveEmotion()

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	self.is_discovered = false

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:fire_on_brazier()
	character_util.set_direction(self.magician, "down")
	character_util.set_anim(self.magician, {name = "staff_cast"})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.magician, {name = "attack"})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.magician, {key = self.talk_name3, skip = true})

	command_util.execute_burn(self.event_brazier, self.event_brazier)
	self.event_brazier.Holdable = self.brazier_holdable

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))
end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.gimmick_door_down2_sfx_name)
	local animator = self.cage_list[#self.cage_list]:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

			self.magician.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0.3))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.dust_effect_preset):Instantiate(
			self.magician.Position + vector(0.5, 0, -0.3))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.dust_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.magician.Position)

end

local local_class = newclass('MagicianAndMaidSection3')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = MagicianAndMaid @
		Comment = 거대 여관3에서 도움을 요청하는 메이드. @
		Index = 2 @
		NextSections = 3 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.maid = nil
	self.target_door = nil
	self.substage_map = nil

	self.is_door_shaked = false
	self.door_shake_finished = false
	self.is_door_open = false
	self.see_request = false

	self.stage_name = "titantavern_1_3"

	self.maid_name = "maid"

	self.door_name = "magician_and_maid_door"
	self.substage_name = "substage_7_6"
	self.zone_name = "magician_and_maid"

	self.marker_name = "magician_and_maid"
	self.tracker_name = "magician_and_maid_s3_tracker_0"

	self.branch_name1 = "magician_and_maid_s3_talk_branch_0"
	self.branch_name2 = "magician_and_maid_s3_talk_branch_1"

	self.hit_dummy_sfx_name = "01_hit_dummy_02"

	quest_icon.PreLoad()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorClosedEvent), 'on_event')

	self.maid = get_character(self.maid_name)
	self.maid.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	self.maid.SpineController:SetAttachment("[base]weapon1", "empty")
	self.maid.SpineController:SetAttachment("[base]weapon2", "empty")

	self.target_door = get_field_object(self.door_name)
	self.substage_map = get_field_object(self.substage_name).FieldObjectBehaviour

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name))
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorClosedEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.maid = nil
	self.target_door = nil
	self.substage_map = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent) then
		self:on_door_opened_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.DoorClosedEvent) then
		self:on_door_closed_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end

	if e.Zone.Name == self.zone_name then
		if not self.is_door_shaked and not self.is_door_open then
			self. is_door_shaked = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.door_shake, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.maid) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.quest_start, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_door_opened_event(e)
	if e.DoorHandleName == self.door_name then
		self. is_door_shaked = false
		self.is_door_open = true
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.maid)
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name))
	end
end

function local_class:on_door_closed_event(e)
	if e.DoorHandleName == self.door_name then
		self.is_door_shaked = true
		if self.door_shake_finished then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.door_shake, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:door_shake()
	local intervalTime = 0.25
	local attackAnimDuration = 0.5

	while self.is_door_shaked do
		character_util.set_anim(self.maid, {name = "attack", loop = false})

		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = self.hit_dummy_sfx_name, play_pos = self.target_door.Position})

		self.target_door:Shake(0.04, attackAnimDuration)

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(attackAnimDuration))
		character_util.set_anim(self.maid, {name = "idle"})
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(intervalTime))
	end

	self.door_shake_finished = true
end

function local_class:quest_start()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.maid)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	character_util.align_party(self.maid, "down")

	if not self.see_request then
		self.see_request = true
		coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:section_3())
	end

	local wait = true
	local is_positive = false

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name1),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
			is_positive = true
		end})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name2),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.user_party_leader, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if is_positive then
		coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:section_3_positive())
		-- coroutine.yield(self.substage_map:OpenStage())
		-- quest와 엮인 서브스테이지는 Quests 시트의 Pre/ProgressOpenStages를 이용해서 열고 클라단에서는 연출만 보여주도록 수정
		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.SubStageLogic.ExecuteOpenSubStage, self.substage_name, "substage_7_6_narration")
		coroutine.yield(quest_util.progress_section(self.controller))
	else
		coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:section_3_negative())
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name))
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.maid)
	end

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.FallInHoleEndEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.maid = nil
	self.magician = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.FallInHoleEndEvent) then
		self:on_fallin_hole_end_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if stage.BattleManager:GetBattleForMyParty() ~= nil then
		return false
	end
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.battle_zone_name then
		if not self.see_battle_Event then
			self.see_battle_Event = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == "upstair" then
		self.is_in_chase_zone = false;
	elseif zone_name == "chase" then
		self.is_in_chase_zone = true;
	end

	local marker_pos

	if zone_name == self.up_stair_zone_name then
		marker_pos = vector(71.5, 0, 0.5)
	elseif zone_name == self.down_stair_zone_name1 then
		marker_pos = vector(17.5, 0, -34)
	elseif zone_name == self.down_stair_zone_name2 then
		marker_pos = vector(40, 0, -64.5)
	elseif zone_name == self.mouse_hole_zone_name then
		marker_pos = vector(10.5, 0, -101.5)
	end

	if marker_pos ~= nil then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
		quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, marker_pos)
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name1))
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.maid) then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.maid, self.talk_name1)
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.end_event, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_fallin_hole_end_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Fool, get_field_object(self.hole_name)) and
	lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, user_party_leader) and
	user_party_leader.Position.y < 0.5 and
	self.is_in_chase_zone then
		if not self.see_chase_event then
			self.see_chase_event = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.chase_event, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:quest_start()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	camera_util.move(vector(12.5, 0, 0.5), 0)
	music_player:PlayStageMusic(self.bgm_name, CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	local magician_offset = self.magician.SpineController.SpineOffset
	self.magician.SpineController.SpineOffset = magician_offset + vector(0, -0.3, 0)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))
	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:section_4_intro())

	self.magician.SpineController.SpineOffset = magician_offset

	character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.maid, user_party)
	self.maid.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.Immortal = true

	screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.DirectionalStageEntry(vector(3, 0, 0.5),
	CS.Oak.Direction.Right, game_string:GetString(stage.Name)))

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
	self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(71.5, 0, 0.5))
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name1))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:chase_event()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.maid)

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:section_4_chase())

	character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.maid, user_party)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:battle_event()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.maid)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:section_4_battle())

	music_player:RemoveStageMusicClip(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field)

	for i = 1, self.mouse_num do
		local cur_mouse = get_character(string.format("%s%d", self.mouse_name, i))
		character_util.convert_to_monster(cur_mouse, self.battle_group_name)
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(cur_mouse, user_party_leader, "battle")
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(false))
	character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.maid, user_party)
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name2))
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:end_event()
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name))

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.maid)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:section_4_end())

	local loop_out = false

	while not loop_out do
		local wait = true

		local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name1),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
			Callback = function()
				wait = false
				loop_out = true
			end})
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name2),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
			Callback = function()
				wait = false
				loop_out = false
			end})

		ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.magician, branches)

		while wait do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if not loop_out then
			coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:section_4_end_negative())
		end
	end

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:section_4_end_positive())

	if self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.add_magician_to_party) ~= 1 then
		coroutine.yield(self:add_magician())
	end

	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.add_magician_to_party, 1)
	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:section_4_end_a())

	if self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.add_maid_to_party) ~= 1 then
		coroutine.yield(self:add_maid())
	end

	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.add_maid_to_party, 1)

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:section_4_end_b())

	coroutine.yield(screen_util.play_stage_clear())

	coroutine.yield(quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 1))

	screen_util.fade_out_circular(1, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear, "image")

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.5))

	CS.Oak.Game.Instance:StageToLobby(true)
end

function local_class:add_magician()
	local is_max_party = user_party.Count >= CS.Oak.User.Me.Party.MaxLimitCharacterCount

	local char_spec = CS.Oak.CharacterSpecId
	local alreadyhascharacter = user:GetCharacter(char_spec.Swindler, true) ~= nil

	local character_theatre_data = CS.Oak.CharacterTheatreData()
	character_theatre_data.Character = self.magician

	character_theatre_data.AlreadyHasInParty = alreadyhascharacter
	character_theatre_data.VoiceId = self.magician_voice_id

function local_class:hold_magician()

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name == 'snowmountain_1_3' then

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	kid_boy.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	kid_girl.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FullEnter == true and e.FieldObject == user_party_leader and e.Zone.Name == self.start_zone_name then
			if self.is_see_prologue == false then
				self.is_see_prologue = true
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.quest_start, self)
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		local kid_leader = get_character(self.kid_leader_name)
		local kid_boy = get_character(self.kid_boy_name)
		local kid_girl = get_character(self.kid_girl_name)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, kid_leader) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.request, self)
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, kid_boy) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.kid_talk, self, kid_boy))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, kid_girl) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.kid_talk, self, kid_girl))
		end
	end

	return false
end

end

	local kid_leader = get_character(self.kid_leader_name)

	yield_return(self.controller.scene, 'quest_start')

	quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(kid_leader)
end

function local_class:request()
	local kid_leader = get_character(self.kid_leader_name)

	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(kid_leader)

	party_util.align_party(kid_leader, 'right')

	if self.is_skip_request == false then
		yield_return(self.controller.scene, 'request')
		self.is_skip_request = true
	end

	local is_accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId, false)

	if is_accepted then
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		yield_return(self.controller.scene, 'accept_1')

		-- 서브 스테이지 언락
		coroutine.yield(stage_util.new_stage_theatre_show({ substage_name = "substage_3_5", substage_open_string_key = game_string:Format("opened_stage", game_string:GetString("substage_3_5")) }))
		music_player.StageBgmState = CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		yield_return(self.controller.scene, 'accept_2')

		floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party_leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)

		character_util.remove_anim(kid_leader)

		yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
	else
		screen_util.quest_decline_Event()

		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		yield_return(self.controller.scene, 'decline')

		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(kid_leader)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class
