function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'fans_signboard' and not self.fans_go_over_signboard_over then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fans_go_over_signboard, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'eugene_go_down' and not self.eugene_go_down_over then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.eugene_go_down, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'assassination_camera_panning' then
			if not self.assassination_camera_panning_over then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.assassination_camera_panning, self))
			end

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.kingsman_eugene) and e.Zone.Name == 'eugene_go_over_door' and not self.eugene_go_over_door then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.eugene_go_over_door_so_door_closed, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'change_extra' and not self.change_extra_over then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hulk_change_to_invader, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'coffee_shop' and e.FullEnter then
			self:change_marker('coffee_shop_out_door', true)

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'sleeping_shop' and e.FullEnter then
			self:change_marker('sleeping_shop_out_door', true)

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'empty_room_1' and e.FullEnter then
			self:change_marker('empty_room_1_out_door', true)

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'empty_room_2' and e.FullEnter then
			self:change_marker('empty_room_2_out_door', true)

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'burywood_got_talent_room' and e.FullEnter then
			self:change_marker('burywood_got_talent_out_door', true)

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'inception_room' and e.FullEnter then
			self:change_marker('inception_room_out_door', true)

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'manner_maketh_man_room' and e.FullEnter then
			self:change_marker('manner_maketh_man_door_out', true)

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'second_floor_room' and e.FullEnter then
			self:change_marker('second_floor_room_out_door', true)
		end

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.director_bale) and self.fans_go_over_signboard_over and not self.bale_talk_over then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_bale, self))
		end

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_5' and not self.assassination_over_bale_talk_start_over then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.assassination_over_bale_talk_start, self))
		end

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e.Params ~= nil and e.Params.Length == 2 then
			if not self.is_discovered then
				self.is_discovered = true

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.assassination_failed, self, e.Sender))
			end
		end

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent) then
		if e.IsTurningOn and e.SwitchObject == get_field_object('movie_switch_1') and
				self.movie_switch_1_clicked == false then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fans_go_over_door_but_no_eugene, self))
		end

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'coffee_shop' and e.FullLeave then
			self:change_marker('coffee_shop_out_door', false)

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'sleeping_shop' and e.FullLeave then
			self:change_marker('sleeping_shop_out_door', false)

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'empty_room_1' and e.FullLeave then
			self:change_marker('empty_room_1_out_door', false)

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'empty_room_2' and e.FullLeave then
			self:change_marker('empty_room_2_out_door', false)

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'burywood_got_talent_room' and e.FullLeave then
			self:change_marker('burywood_got_talent_out_door', false)

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'inception_room' and e.FullLeave then
			self:change_marker('inception_room_out_door', false)

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'manner_maketh_man_room' and e.FullLeave then
			self:change_marker('manner_maketh_man_door_out', false)

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'second_floor_room' and e.FullLeave then
			self:change_marker('second_floor_room_out_door', false)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:change_marker(fo_name, is_zone_enter)

	if is_zone_enter then
		if self.is_marker_on_eugene then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('kingsman_eugene')
			self.is_marker_on_eugene = false
			self.have_to_marker_on_eugene = true

			--마커이동 (문/계단으로)
			local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
			local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(fo_name, quest_id, is_story, get_field_object(fo_name))

		elseif self.is_marker_on_bale then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('director_bale')
			self.is_marker_on_bale = false
			self.have_to_marker_on_bale = true

			--마커이동 (문/계단으로)
			local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
			local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(fo_name, quest_id, is_story, get_field_object(fo_name))

		elseif fo_name == 'second_floor_room_out_door' then
			if self.have_to_marker_on_eugene or self.have_to_marker_on_bale then
				--마커이동 (문/계단으로)
				local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
				local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(fo_name, quest_id, is_story, get_field_object(fo_name))
			end

		elseif fo_name == 'sleeping_shop_out_door' or fo_name == 'coffee_shop_out_door' then
			if self.have_to_marker_on_eugene or self.have_to_marker_on_bale then
				--마커이동 (문/계단으로)
				local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
				local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(fo_name, quest_id, is_story, get_field_object(fo_name))
			end

		end

	else
		if fo_name == 'second_floor_room_out_door' then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(fo_name)

		elseif self.have_to_marker_on_eugene then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(fo_name)

			if fo_name == 'sleeping_shop_out_door' or fo_name == 'coffee_shop_out_door' then
				if user_party.Leader.Position.z > 31 then
					ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(fo_name)
					return
				end

			end

			--마커이동 (유진으로)
			local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
			local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('kingsman_eugene', quest_id, is_story, self.kingsman_eugene)

			self.have_to_marker_on_eugene = false
			self.is_marker_on_eugene = true

		elseif self.have_to_marker_on_bale then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(fo_name)

			if fo_name == 'sleeping_shop_out_door' or fo_name == 'coffee_shop_out_door' then
				if user_party.Leader.Position.z > 31 then
					ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(fo_name)
					return
				end

			end

			--마커이동 (아이스크림 상점으로)
			local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
			local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('director_bale', quest_id, is_story, self.director_bale)

			self.have_to_marker_on_bale = false
			self.is_marker_on_bale = true
		end

	end
end

function local_class:fan_and_guard_crash_routine()
	local fan_list = {}
	for i = 1, 5 do
		fan_list[i] = get_character('fan_guard_2_' .. i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fan_list[i])
		character_util.set_anim(fan_list[i], {name = 'push', upper = true, loop = true})
		character_util.set_emotion(fan_list[i], {name = 'love'})
		fan_list[i].Interactable.Talk = 'movie_main_s8_0_' .. i % 2
	end

	local staff_list = {}
	local staff_origin_pos_list = {}

	for i = 1, 5 do
		staff_list[i] = get_character('staff_guard_2_' .. i)
		character_util.set_direction(staff_list[i], 'right')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(staff_list[i])
		character_util.set_anim(staff_list[i], {name = 'push', upper = true, loop = true})
		character_util.set_emotion(staff_list[i], {name = 'attack'})
		staff_origin_pos_list[i] = staff_list[i].Position
	end

	local fan_default_pos_list = {
		vector(70, 0, 2),
		vector(70, 0, 1),
		vector(70, 0, 0),
		vector(70, 0, -1),
		vector(70, 0, -2),
	}

	local fan_attack_strings = {
		'movie_main_s8_0_0_0',
		'movie_main_s8_0_0_1'
	}

	local staff_defense_strings = {
		'movie_main_s8_0_0_2',
		'movie_main_s8_0_0_3'
	}

	local staff_attack_strings = {
		'movie_main_s8_0_0_4',
		'movie_main_s8_0_0_5'
	}

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_crowd_shout_03'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_dash_06', parent = fan_list[3]})

	for k, v in pairs(fan_list) do
		wp_util.move_way_points(v, {waypoints = fan_default_pos_list[k], speed = 4})
	end

	wait_for_sec(5.55 / 4)	-- 5.55만큼, 4초동안 이동

	for _, v in pairs(staff_list) do
		local effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(v.Position + vector(0.2, 0.4, 0))
		effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.4

		character_util.move_to(v, v.Position - vector(0.5, 0, 0), nil,
				2, false, false, false)
		character_util.set_anim(v, {name = 'push', upper = true})
		character_util.set_emotion(v, {name = 'damaged'})
		character_util.jump(v, 0.2, 0.25)

		character_util.spine_pulse_color(v, unity_class.color.red, 1, 0.5, 0.5)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(v, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.5)
	end

	for _, v in pairs(fan_list) do
		character_util.move_to(v, v.Position + vector(0.15, 0, 0), 0.25,
				nil, false, false, false)
		character_util.jump(v, 0.2, 0.25)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local staff_move_speed = 2

	for _, v in pairs(staff_list) do
		character_util.set_anim(v, {name = 'push', upper = true})
		character_util.set_emotion(v, {name = 'attack'})
		character_util.move_to(v, v.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), nil,
				staff_move_speed, true, true, false)
	end

	for _, v in pairs(fan_list) do
		character_util.move_to(v, v.Position - vector(0.15, 0, 0), 0.5 / staff_move_speed,
				nil, true, true, false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5 / staff_move_speed)

	local r_1, r_2, rand_str_1, rand_str_2

	local push_dur = 2

	while self.is_fan_staff_crashing do
		for _, v in pairs(fan_list) do
			character_util.set_anim(v, {name = 'push', upper = true})
			character_util.move_to(v, v.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), push_dur,
					nil, false, false, false)
		end

		for _, v in pairs(staff_list) do
			character_util.set_anim(v, {name = 'push', upper = true})
			character_util.set_emotion(v, {name = 'attack'})
			character_util.move_to(v, v.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), push_dur,
					nil, false, true, false)
		end

		r_1 = random_util.get_random_int(1, #staff_list)

		rand_str_1 = random_util.get_random_int(1, #staff_attack_strings)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(staff_list[r_1],
				{ key = staff_attack_strings[rand_str_1], bubble_direction = 'lt' })

		wait_for_sec(push_dur * 1.5)

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(staff_list[r_1])

		if not self.is_fan_staff_crashing then
			break
		end

		for _, v in pairs(fan_list) do
			character_util.set_anim(v, {name = 'push', upper = true})
			character_util.move_to(v, v.Position - vector(0.5, 0, 0), push_dur,
					nil, false, true, false)
		end

		for _, v in pairs(staff_list) do
			character_util.set_anim(v, {name = 'push', upper = true})
			character_util.set_emotion(v, {name = 'damaged'})
			character_util.move_to(v, v.Position - vector(0.5, 0, 0), push_dur,
					nil, false, false, false)
		end

		r_1 = random_util.get_random_int(1, #staff_list)

		r_2 = random_util.get_random_int(1, #fan_list)

		rand_str_1 = random_util.get_random_int(1, #staff_defense_strings)
		rand_str_2 = random_util.get_random_int(1, #fan_attack_strings)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(staff_list[r_1],
				{ key = staff_defense_strings[rand_str_1], bubble_direction = 'lt' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(fan_list[r_2],
				{ key = fan_attack_strings[rand_str_2], bubble_direction = 'rt' })

		wait_for_sec(push_dur * 1.5)

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(staff_list[r_1])
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(fan_list[r_2])
	end

	for i = 1, 5 do
		local fan = get_character('fan_guard_2_' .. i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fan)
		character_util.set_anim(fan, {name = 'push', upper = true, loop = true})
		character_util.set_emotion(fan, {name = 'love'})
	end

	for i = 1, 5 do
		local staff = get_character('staff_guard_2_' .. i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(staff)
		character_util.set_anim(staff, {name = 'push', upper = true, loop = true})
		character_util.set_emotion(staff, {name = 'attack'})
	end
end

--베일에게 말을 걸면 선택지가 뜨고, 촬영장으로 진입할 수도 있다.
function local_class:talk_with_bale()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	self.bale_talk_over = true

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('director_bale')
	self.is_marker_on_bale = false

	character_util.align_party(self.director_bale.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 'right', 1, 'arc')

	if self.in_on_air == false then
		self.in_on_air = true
		--유진 기분이 많이 안좋아보이던데...
		character_util.set_anim(self.director_bale, {name = 'idle', loop = false, scale = 1})
		character_util.set_emotion(self.director_bale, {name = 'tired', loop = true})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.director_bale, {key = 'movie_main_s10_0', skip = true})

		--무슨 일 있었는지 알아?
		character_util.set_anim(self.director_bale, {name = 'question', loop = false, scale = 1})
		character_util.set_emotion(self.director_bale, {name = 'tired', loop = true})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.director_bale, {key = 'movie_main_s10_1', skip = true})

		--선택지
		local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
		local wait_for_branch = true
		local choice = 0
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString('movie_main_s10_talk_branch_0_0'),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
			Callback = function()
				wait_for_branch = false
				choice = 0
			end
		})
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString('movie_main_s10_talk_branch_0_1'),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Forced,
			Callback = function()
				wait_for_branch = false
				choice = 1
			end
		})
		local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
		choice_state.Branchs = branches
		choice_state.Talker = self.cordination_staff

		ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)
		while wait_for_branch do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if choice == 0 then
			--고작 아이스크림 때문에?
			music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_02'})
			character_util.set_anim(self.director_bale, {name = 'idle', loop = true, scale = 1})
			character_util.set_emotion(self.director_bale, {name = 'surprise', loop = true})
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.director_bale, {key = 'movie_main_s10_1_0', skip = true})

			--흠...
			character_util.set_anim(self.director_bale, {name = 'question', loop = false, scale = 1})
			character_util.set_emotion(self.director_bale, {name = 'tired', loop = true})
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.director_bale, {key = 'movie_main_s10_1_0_0', skip = true})

		else
			--에이~
			character_util.set_anim(self.director_bale, {name = 'bomb_idle', loop = true, scale = 1})
			character_util.set_emotion(self.director_bale, {name = 'smile', loop = true})
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.director_bale, {key = 'movie_main_s10_1_1', skip = true})

			--나 베일의 위대한 각본을 의심할 리 없어!
			character_util.set_emotion(self.director_bale, {name = 'smile', loop = true})
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.director_bale, {key = 'movie_main_s10_1_2', skip = true})
			character_util.set_anim(self.director_bale, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, scale = 1, sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01'})

			wait_for_sec(1.5)

			--유진을 발탁한 사람이 바로 나라고!
			character_util.set_anim(self.director_bale, {name = 'cross_arm', loop = true, scale = 1})
			character_util.set_emotion(self.director_bale, {name = 'doyagao', loop = true})
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.director_bale, {key = 'movie_main_s10_1_3', skip = true})
		end

		--어쨌든, 준비 됐어?
		character_util.set_anim(self.director_bale, {name = 'bomb_idle', loop = true, scale = 1})
		character_util.set_emotion(self.director_bale, {name = 'idle', loop = true})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.director_bale, {key = 'movie_main_s10_2', skip = true})

	else
		-- 준비 됐어?
		character_util.set_anim(self.director_bale, {name = 'bomb_idle', loop = true, scale = 1})
		character_util.set_emotion(self.director_bale, {name = 'idle', loop = true})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.director_bale, {key = 'movie_main_s10_2_0', skip = true})
	end

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local wait_for_branch = true
	local choice = 0
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('movie_main_s10_talk_branch_1_0'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			choice = 0
		end
	})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('movie_main_s10_talk_branch_1_1'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			choice = 1
		end
	})
	local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
	choice_state.Branchs = branches
	choice_state.Talker = self.director_bale

	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)
	while wait_for_branch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if choice == 0 then
		--좋아! 다음 씬은 네가 잠입과 암살을 해내는 씬이야!
		character_util.set_anim(self.director_bale, {name = 'idle', loop = true, scale = 1})
		character_util.set_emotion(self.director_bale, {name = 'smile', loop = true})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.director_bale, {key = 'movie_main_s10_3', skip = true})

		--너의 독무대가 될 테니까 잘 해보라고!
		character_util.set_emotion(self.director_bale, {name = 'smile', loop = true})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.director_bale, {key = 'movie_main_s10_4', skip = true})
		character_util.set_anim(self.director_bale, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false, scale = 1, sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01'})
		wait_for_sec(1.2)

		--촬영장으로 페이드인/페이드 아웃 이동
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_stage_in_teleport_01'})
		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

		local bale_staff_special = get_character('bale_staff_special')

		character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, vector(53.5, 0, -55))
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'up')
		character_util.set_position(self.director_bale, vector(53, 0, -48))
		character_util.set_position(bale_staff_special, vector(54, 0, -48))

		character_util.set_direction(bale_staff_special, 'left')
		character_util.set_direction(self.director_bale, 'right')

		for i = 1, 5 do
			local enemy = get_character('invader_soldier_sneak_' .. i)
			character_util.set_direction(enemy, 'down')
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	else
		character_util.set_anim(self.director_bale, {name = 'idle', loop = true, scale = 1})
		character_util.set_emotion(self.director_bale, {name = 'attack', loop = true})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.director_bale, {key = 'movie_main_s10_5', skip = true})
		self.bale_talk_over = false
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.director_bale)
	party_util.reset_controllers()

end

	field_ui_manager:Show()

function local_class:assassination_failed(detector)
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 발견자 소리지름
	character_util.normal_jump(detector)
	character_util.set_anim(detector, {name = 'release'})
	character_util.set_emotion(detector, {name = 'mad'})

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_runaway_01'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01'})
	party_util.set_anim({name = 'embarrassed', loop = true})
	party_util.set_emotion({name = 'surprise'})

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.normal_jump(user_party[i])
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 감독 mad, jingak
	character_util.set_emotion(self.director_bale, {name = 'mad'})

	-- 감독한테 포커스 감
	camera_util.move_async(self.director_bale.Position, 0.5, {ignorecameragrids = true})

	character_util.set_anim(self.director_bale, {name = 'jingak', loop = false})

	-- 컷! 컷!!!!!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_02'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.director_bale,
			{key = 'movie_main_s10_18', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true})

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(detector, { 'reset', self.assassination_event_name }))

	local reset_pos = vector(53.5, 0, -49.5)

	-- 다시 앞으로 돌아감
	party_util.position_party(reset_pos, 'up', 'linear')

	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.director_bale)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(detector)

	camera_util.move(reset_pos, 0, {end_target = user_party.Leader})

	for i = 1, 5 do
		local enemy = get_character('invader_soldier_sneak_' .. i)
		character_util.set_active_state(enemy, 'enabled')
		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.sender = nil
		heal_info.target = enemy
		heal_info.heal = enemy.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.isRevive = true

		command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)

		enemy.Position = self.invader_pos_list[i]
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.is_discovered = false

	yield_return_func(self.disable_skill, self)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

-- field ui의 hide/show 사이에 불리지 않으면 문제가 생길 수 있음
function local_class:disable_skill()

	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	coroutine.yield()

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton)

end

function local_class:change_marker(fo_name, is_zone_enter)

			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('assassination_door')
			self.is_marker_on_as_door = false
			self.have_to_marker_on_as_door = true

			--마커이동 (문/계단으로)

			local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(fo_name, quest_id, is_story, get_field_object(fo_name))

		elseif fo_name == 'second_floor_room_out_door' then
			if self.have_to_marker_on_as_door then
				--마커이동 (문/계단으로)
				local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
				local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(fo_name, quest_id, is_story, get_field_object(fo_name))

			if self.have_to_marker_on_as_door then
				--마커이동 (문/계단으로)

				local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(fo_name, quest_id, is_story, get_field_object(fo_name))

			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(fo_name)

	self.is_zone_event_enable = false

	party_util.align_party(self.director_bale, 'left', 1, 'linear')

	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{{'movie_main_s10_talk_branch_1_0', 'mercy'}, {'movie_main_s10_talk_branch_1_1', 'normal'}})

	if result == 2 then
		character_util.set_anim(self.director_bale, {name = 'release', loop = true, scale = 1, sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
		character_util.set_emotion(self.director_bale, {name = 'attack', loop = true})

		local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('head_explosion', quest_id, is_story, self.director_bale)

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		return
	end

	local hollywood_valentine_villain = get_character('hollywood_valentine_villain')
	local hollywood_foot_sword = get_character('hollywood_foot_sword')

	self.head_explosion_start_over = true

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_stage_in_teleport_01'})
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	local player_pos = vector(53.5, 0, -34)
	character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, player_pos - vector(0, 0, 1))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'up')
	character_util.set_position(self.kingsman_eugene, vector(64.5, 0, -30.5))
	character_util.set_direction(hollywood_valentine_villain, 'down')
	character_util.set_position(hollywood_valentine_villain, vector(54.5, 1, -28))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hollywood_valentine_villain)
	character_util.set_position(hollywood_foot_sword, vector(52.5, 1, -28))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hollywood_foot_sword)
	character_util.set_position(self.director_bale, vector(53.5, 0, -34))
	character_util.set_direction(get_character('bale_staff_special'), 'left')
	character_util.set_position(get_character('bale_staff_special'), vector(57, 0, -33))

	local explode_npcs = {}

	local explode_npc_z = {
		-32, -31.5, -31, -31, -31, -31.5, -32
	}

	for i = 1, self.head_explosion_num do
        local head_bomb = get_character(self.head_explosion_name..i)

		character_util.set_position(head_bomb, vector(49.5 + i, 0, explode_npc_z[i]))

		character_util.set_direction(head_bomb, 'down')
		if i ~= 4 then
			character_util.set_anim(head_bomb, {name = 'gauntlet_idle', loop = true, scale = 1})
		else
			character_util.remove_anim(head_bomb)
		end

		character_util.set_emotion(head_bomb, {name = 'doyagao', loop = true})

		table.insert(explode_npcs, head_bomb)
    end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	--베일의 레디~ 액션 장면
	--카메라 중심 베일로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(self.director_bale.Position, 1, {use_unscaledtime = false, ignorecameragrids = true})

	--자~ 다들 준비됐지?

	character_util.set_anim(self.director_bale, {name = 'idle', loop = true, scale = 1})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.director_bale, {name = 'idle', loop = true})

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.director_bale)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.director_bale, {key = 'movie_main_s8_7_4', skip = true,

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.director_bale)

	--베일 퇴장
	character_util.move_to_async(self.director_bale, vector(57, 0, -34), nil, 5, true, true)

	character_util.set_direction(self.director_bale, 'left')

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	local queensman_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_queensman_04', loop = true})
	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, player_pos, nil, 1.5, true, true)

	camera_util.move_async(hollywood_valentine_villain.Position, 0.5)

	--전원 전투 태세!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01'})
	character_util.set_anim(hollywood_valentine_villain, {name = 'release', loop = true})
	character_util.set_emotion(hollywood_valentine_villain, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hollywood_valentine_villain, {key = 'movie_main_s11_22_0', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true})

	--후후후...
	character_util.set_anim(hollywood_valentine_villain, {name = 'cross_arm', loop = true})
	character_util.set_emotion(hollywood_valentine_villain, {name = 'doyagao'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hollywood_valentine_villain,
			{key = 'movie_main_s11_22_1', skip = true})

	--덤벼보시지 배리 하트!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01'})
	character_util.set_anim(hollywood_valentine_villain, {name = 'cross_arm', loop = true})
	character_util.set_emotion(hollywood_valentine_villain, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hollywood_valentine_villain, {key = 'movie_main_s11_22_2', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true})

	character_util.remove_anim(hollywood_valentine_villain)

	--인베이더들이 전투 태세를 갖춘다
	camera_util.move_async((user_party.Leader.Position + explode_npcs[4].Position) / 2, 0.5)

	while true do
		local result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
				{{'movie_main_s11_talk_branch_0_0', 'intellect'},
				 {'movie_main_s11_talk_branch_0_1', 'brutal'},
				 {'movie_main_s11_talk_branch_0_2', 'mercy'}})

		if result == 1 then -- 춤을 췄을 때
			local dance_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_amb_cf_02'})

			character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'smile'})
			character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
			character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'dance', loop = true})

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			local moving_npc = explode_npcs[7]
			local npc_pos = moving_npc.Position

			local player_pos = user_party.Leader.Position

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(moving_npc)

			wait_for_sec(0.2)

			camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)

			dance_sfx:Stop()

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
			character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'damaged'})

			music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_hit_critical_01'})
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(moving_npc.Position + vector(-0.7, 0.4, 0))

			local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
					'physics', true, vector(-1, 0, 0), 10000, 0.05,
					CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

			local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(user_party.Leader, knock_back_info)
			user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))

			user_party.Leader.SpineController:DamageSquish(1)
			user_party.Leader.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			moving_npc.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')

			wp_util.move_way_points_async(moving_npc,
					{waypoints = npc_pos, speed = 4, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down})

			character_util.set_anim(moving_npc, {name = 'gauntlet_idle', loop = true, scale = 1})

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

			wp_util.move_way_points_async(user_party.Leader,
					{waypoints = player_pos, speed = 3, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up})

		elseif result == 2 then -- 공격 시
			local wp = explode_npcs[4].Position + vector(0, 0, -0.7)
			local move_speed = 5
			local move_dur = (wp.z - player_pos.z) / 5

			character_util.jump(user_party.Leader, 0.5, move_dur)

function local_class:explode_head(character)
	character_util.stop_shake(character)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(character)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_firework_02', volume = 0.7})
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_s_fireworks_explosion'):Instantiate(character.Position + vector(0, 0.7, 0)).transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.3

	local r_1 = random_util.get_random_int(1, 2)

	if r_1 == 1 then
		character_util.set_direction(character, 'left')
	else
		character_util.set_direction(character, 'right')
	end

	character_util.set_anim(character, {name = 'unique/explosion_dead2', loop = false, scale = 1})
end

function local_class:explode_npcs_move(npcs)
	local wp_list = {
		{
			vector(npcs[1].Position.x + 1.5, 0, npcs[1].Position.z),
			vector(npcs[1].Position.x + 1.5, 0, -41)
		},{
			vector(npcs[2].Position.x + 0.5, 0, -35),
			vector(npcs[2].Position.x + 0.5, 0, -41)
		},{
			vector(npcs[3].Position.x + 0.5, 0, -35),
			vector(npcs[3].Position.x + 0.5, 0, -41)
		},{	-- 4
			vector(npcs[4].Position.x + 0.5, 0, npcs[4].Position.z),
			vector(npcs[4].Position.x + 0.5, 0, -41)
		},{	--5
			vector(npcs[5].Position.x - 0.5, 0, -35),
			vector(npcs[5].Position.x - 0.5, 0, -41)
		},{	--6
			vector(npcs[6].Position.x - 0.5, 0, -35),
			vector(npcs[6].Position.x - 0.5, 0, -41)
		},{	-- 7
			vector(npcs[7].Position.x - 1.5, 0, npcs[7].Position.z),
			vector(npcs[7].Position.x - 1.5, 0, -41)
		}
	}

	local move_order = { 2, 6, 3, 5, 1, 7, 4 }

	for k, v in pairs(move_order) do
		wait_for_sec(0.1)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.explode_npc_wp, self, npcs[v], {waypoints = wp_list[v], speed = 6, play_sfx = true}))
	end

function local_class:staff_worrying(pos)
	local hollywood_valentine_villain = get_character('hollywood_valentine_villain')

	character_util.normal_jump(hollywood_valentine_villain)
	character_util.set_emotion(hollywood_valentine_villain, {name = 'surprise'})

	local staffs = {
		get_character('bale_staff_last_1'),
		get_character('bale_staff_last_2'),
		get_character('bale_staff_last_3'),
		get_character('bale_staff_last_4'),
		get_character('bale_staff_special'),
	}

	if self:is_character_holding(staffs[2]) then
		character_util.release_hold_object(staffs[2], staffs[2].CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(staffs[2], {key = 'movie_main_s11_51', skip = false})
	end

	if self:is_character_holding(staffs[4]) then
		character_util.release_hold_object(staffs[4], staffs[4].CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(staffs[4], {key = 'movie_main_s11_51', skip = false})
	end

	for _, v in pairs(staffs) do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(v)
		character_util.normal_jump(v)
		character_util.set_emotion(v, {name = 'surprise'})
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.stop_shake(staffs[2])
	character_util.stop_shake(staffs[4])

	local end_pos_list = {
		pos + vector(0.35, 0, 0.7),
		pos + vector(0, 0, -0.7),
		pos + vector(-0.35, 0, 0.7),
		pos + vector(0.7, 0, 0.35),	-- 1st
		pos + vector(0.7, 0, -0.35),
	}

	local last_dir_list = {
		CS.Oak.Direction.Down,
		CS.Oak.Direction.Up,
		CS.Oak.Direction.Down,
		CS.Oak.Direction.Left,
		CS.Oak.Direction.Left,
	}

	local wp_list = {
		{ vector(56.5, 1, -28.5), vector(56.6, 0, -29.5), end_pos_list[1] },
		{ vector(50, 0, -33), end_pos_list[2] },
		{ vector(50.5, 1, -28.5), vector(50.5, 0, -29.5), end_pos_list[3] },
		{ vector(53, 0, -32), end_pos_list[4] },
		{ end_pos_list[5] }
	}

	local start_order = {4, 1, 2, 5, 3}
	local start_delay = {0, 0.2, 0.3, 0.1, 0.2}

	for i = 1, #staffs do
		local real_index = start_order[i]
		local staff = staffs[real_index]

		local cb = function()
			character_util.set_emotion(staff, {name = 'tired'})
		end

		wait_for_sec(start_delay[i])

		wp_util.move_way_points(staff, { waypoints = wp_list[real_index], speed = 7, run = true,
										   last_direction =  last_dir_list[real_index], callback = cb,
										 play_sfx = true})
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(staffs[1], {key = 'movie_main_s11_52', skip = false})

end

function local_class:is_character_holding(character)
	return character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState ~= nil and
			lua_helper.type_compare(character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState)
end

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.scene_1_zone_entered = false
	self.scene_1_talk_to_director = false
	self.battle_1_zone_entered = false

	self.stage_name = 'movie_1_4'
	self.scene1_door_name = 'scene1_door'

	self.battle_enemy_name = 'battle_1_'

end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	self.character_setup()

	local invader_director = get_character('hollywood_director_invader')

	if invader_director.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		invader_director.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)-- RemoveRelatedEvent
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_routine, self))
end

function local_class:start_routine()
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local darth_guardian = user_party.Leader
	local eugene = get_character('jedi_eugene')

	eugene.Position = vector(0.5, 0, 10)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(eugene, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(true)
	darth_guardian.Position = vector(0.5, 0, 6)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(darth_guardian, 0, 0)

	-- 베일이 미리 조명을 들고 있는다.
	local bale = get_character('hollywood_director')
	character_util.shake(bale, 0.02, 999)
	local holdable_light = get_field_object('holdable_light_1')
	command_util.execute_holdup(bale, holdable_light, bale.Position
	+ 0.7 * unity_class.vector3.back, 0.12, false)

	+ 0.7 * unity_class.vector3.back, 0.12, false)

	command_util.execute_holdup(human_staff_female, holdable_camerabox, human_staff_female.Position
	+ 0.7 * unity_class.vector3.back, 0.12, false)

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(get_character('darth_guardian'), CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.StarwarsMiniGame.Play, 0)

	-- 촬영장비를 들고 있는 중에 Talk대사

	-- 끄응...

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))

	local hollywood_director = get_character('hollywood_director_invader')
	if hollywood_director then
		hollywood_director.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'scene_1' and not self.scene_1_zone_entered then
			self.scene_1_zone_entered = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_1_intro, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'scene_1_exit' and not self.scene_1_talk_to_director then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_1_comeback, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'battle_1' and not self.battle_1_zone_entered then
			self.battle_1_zone_entered = true
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('hollywood_director_invader')) and not self.scene_1_talk_to_director then
			self.scene_1_talk_to_director = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_1_welcome_to_invader_pictures, self))
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('holdable_light_1')) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_1_throw_light, self))
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:scene_1_comeback()
	-- 인베이더 감독
	local invader_director = get_character('hollywood_director_invader')
	-- 인베이더 스태프
	local invader_staff_1 = get_character('invader_staff_1')
	--local invader_staff_3 = get_character('invader_staff_3')

	-- UI를 숨긴다.
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	-- 플레이어 컨트롤을 빼앗는다.
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	-- 나가려고 하면 인베이더 감독이 붙잡는다.
	-- 소히 교실 참고: https://youtu.be/1jbMMh1aLBU?t=47
	character_util.look_at(invader_director, user_party.Leader)
	character_util.look_at(invader_staff_1, user_party.Leader)

	-- 카메라 이동
	camera_util.move_async(invader_director.Position + vector(-2, 0, 3), 0.5)

	-- (Shout) 어딜 가려고! 넌 남아서 나랑 얘기좀 해!
	invader_director:SetAnimation('release', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_director, {key = 'movie_main_s12_11_1', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true, type_speed = 0.0001})

	-- UI를 표시한다.
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	-- 플레이어가 컨트롤을 되찾는다.
	camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 0.5, {end_target = user_party.Leader})

	-- 플레이어 다시 Scene 1 zone 안으로 복귀
	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, vector(0.5, 0, 16), nil, 2, true, true)

	invader_director:RemoveAnimation()
	character_util.set_direction(invader_staff_1, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(invader_director, 'left')
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

	-- human_staff_male

		vector(6, 0, 10)
	}

	-- 베일이 쓰러져 있고, 부하들이 다가가 위로를 건넨다.
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.5))

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(human_staff_female, pos_list_9, 3, false, 'stop', 'floor', CS.Oak.Direction.Left)
		character_util.move_waypoint(human_staff_male, pos_list_10, 3, false, 'stop', 'floor', CS.Oak.Direction.Left)

	end))

	-- 카메라가 플레이어 중심으로 이동하며 컨트롤을 되찾는다.
	-- 카메라 디폴트 상태로 줌아웃

	camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 0.5, {end_target = user_party.Leader})

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(invader_director)

function local_class:scene_1_throw_light()
	local holdable_light_1 = get_field_object('holdable_light_1')
	local holdable_camerabox = get_field_object('holdable_camerabox_1')
	local holdable_chair = get_field_object('holdable_chair_1')

	holdable_light_1.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance

	holdable_light_1.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	holdable_light_1.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1, 2, 1))

	holdable_camerabox.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
	holdable_camerabox.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance

	holdable_camerabox.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1, 2, 1))

	holdable_chair.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
	holdable_chair.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
	holdable_chair.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	holdable_chair.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1, 2, 1))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

	}

	self.z_camera = false

	-- 카메라 감독이 플레이어를 따라 다닐 것인가?
	self.follow_camera_director = false

	self.stage_name = 'movie_1_4'

	self.battle_enemy_name = 'darth_vader_enemy_'
	self.qte_enemy_name = 'darth_vader_qte_enemy'
	self.door_enemy_name = 'darth_vader_door_enemy_'
	self.battle_door_name = 'darth_vader_battle_door'

	self.director_name = 'hollywood_director_invader'
	self.camera_director_name = 'camera_director'
	self.camera_name = 'darth_vader_camera'

	self.staff_name = 'invader_staff_'
	self.blueprint_enemy_name = 'blueprint_enemy_'
	self.hollywood_director_name = 'hollywood_director'
	self.hollywood_staff_name = 'hollywood_staff_'
	self.eugene_name = 'jedi_eugene'

	-- 반복해서 재생되는 Sfx AudioSource
	self.loop_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_starwars_swordlight')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit_sword')

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.idle

	local marker = field:GetMarker('quest_main_section_13').position
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'main_section_13', marker)

	-- 총 쏘는 적들
	local rifle_enemies = {}
	table.insert(rifle_enemies, get_character(self.qte_enemy_name))
	for i = 1, 4 do
		table.insert(rifle_enemies, get_character(self.battle_enemy_name .. i))
	end

	-- 피격 대상에 대미지 표시가 나오도록
	local shoot_handler = {
		on_hit = function(_, _, hit_info, _)
			if hit_info.target then
				if hit_info.target.SpineController then
					unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(hit_info.position)
					CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(user_party.Leader, 0, unity_class.color.gray, user_party.Leader.Position)
				end
			end
		end
	}

	-- ShootHelper
	self.shoot_helpers = {}
	for _, v in pairs(rifle_enemies) do
		local pattern_info = { columns = 1 }
		local proj_data = game_data_service.GetData('ProjectileData')
		local proj_spec = proj_data:GetSpec('rifle_bullet'):Clone()
		local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(shoot_handler, v)
		local shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional, ps,
			proj_spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachBullet)
		table.insert(self.shoot_helpers, shoot_helper)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	if self.shoot_helpers ~= nil then
		for k, _ in pairs(self.shoot_helpers) do
			self.shoot_helpers[k] = nil
		end

		self.shoot_helpers = nil
	end

	self.progress_enum = nil

	self.loop_sfx = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then

		if not e.FullEnter or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then return false end

		local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

		if zone_name == 'darth_vader_battle' and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.idle then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.battle_scene
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_darth_vader_battle, self)
			return true
		end

		if zone_name == 'follow_camera_director' then
			if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.battle_scene then

				self.follow_camera_director = true
				return true
			end
		end

		if zone_name == 'after_darth_vader_battle' and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.battle_scene then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.after_battle_scene
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.after_battle_scene, self)
			return true
		end

		if zone_name == 'talk_eugene_director' and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.after_battle_scene then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.exit_eugene_and_director
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_eugene_and_director, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then

		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then return false end

		if e.Zone.Name == 'follow_camera_director' then
			self.follow_camera_director = false

			local camera_director = get_character(self.camera_director_name)
			character_util.remove_anim(camera_director)

			return true
		end

	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then

		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and
			not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then return false end

		if e.CameraGrid.name == 'darth_vader_grid' and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.idle then
			self:first_scene_setting()
			return true
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
			self.qte_complete = true
			return true
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'darth_vader_battle' then
			self:end_darth_vader_battle()
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 다스 베이더 전투 장면

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(director, { key = 'movie_main_s13_4', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(director)

	character_util.set_anim(director, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	-- 특히 {0}! 여기서 너희 가디언들의 사악함을 여과 없이 보여줘!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(director,
		{ key = game_string:Format('movie_main_s13_5', user.Name), skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(director)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })

	character_util.set_emotion(director, { name = 'attack' })
	-- 레디!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(director, { key = 'movie_main_s13_7', skip = true })

	-- 감독 퇴장
	local director_way_point = {
		director.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0),
		director.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, -6)
	}

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(director, director_way_point, 7, true, 'stop',
			nil, CS.Oak.Direction.Down, true)

	-- 암전 + 붉은 라이트 세이버
	camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.back, 1)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_evolve_result_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	field:Tint('darth_vader', unity_class.color.black, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party.Leader, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'down')

	local camera_director = get_character(self.camera_director_name)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(camera_director, 0, 0)

	-- 위, 가운데 문 닫기
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('scene2_door_top_left'))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('scene2_door_top_right'))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('darth_vader_battle_door'))
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	-- 액션!!!
	self.loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_exploration_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_movie_end_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 1)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(director, { key = 'movie_main_s13_8', skip = true,
								bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos = director.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0.5) })

	director.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	local qte_enemy = get_character(self.qte_enemy_name)

	local rifle_enemies = {}
	table.insert(rifle_enemies, qte_enemy)
	for _, v in pairs(battle_enemies) do
		table.insert(rifle_enemies, v)
	end

	-- 적들 어리둥절
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local dir = {'right', 'right', 'left', 'left', 'right'}
	for k, v in pairs(rifle_enemies) do
		character_util.set_direction(v, dir[k])
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for _ = 1, 2 do
		for _, v in pairs(rifle_enemies) do
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'small_monster' })

			if v.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
				character_util.set_direction(v, 'left')
			else
				character_util.set_direction(v, 'right')
			end

			wait_for_sec(0.1)
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	-- 뭐...뭐지?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(qte_enemy, { key = 'movie_main_s13_11', skip = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 광선검 연출
	self.loop_sfx:Stop()

	local starwars_sfx_name = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(CS.Foundations.GameEnvironment.IsKongJapan,
			'01_starwars_02_kong', '01_starwars_02')

	self.loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = starwars_sfx_name, loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_lightsaber_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })

	local sword_light_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_starwars_swordlight')
	local sword_light_effect = sword_light_pool:Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0.3, 0, -0.2))
	sword_light_effect.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 1, 0.5)
	sword_light_effect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, -45, 0))
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	for _, v in pairs(rifle_enemies) do
		character_util.set_direction(v, 'up')
	end

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party.Leader, 1, 2)
	field:RemoveTint('darth_vader', 4)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(camera_director, 0.8, 2)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	field:Tint('darth_vader', unity_class.color.black, 0, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 적들이 다스 베이더를 공격

	-- 으아아아아아아!!!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(battle_enemies[2], { key = 'movie_main_s13_31' })

	local target_dir = {}
	for _, v in pairs(rifle_enemies) do
		local target_direction = (user_party.Leader.Position - v.Bounds.center).normalized
		table.insert(target_dir, target_direction)
		character_util.set_anim(v, { name = 'rifle_shoot2' })
	end

	-- 플레이어 피격 연출
	for i = 1, 30 do
		for k, v in pairs(self.shoot_helpers) do
			v:ShootDirectionAtPosition(rifle_enemies[k].Bounds.center + vector(0, 0, 0.5), target_dir[k])
			wait_for_sec(0.01)
		end
		wait_for_sec(0.01)
	end

	character_util.set_anim(camera_director, { name = 'idle', loop = false })

	for _, v in pairs(rifle_enemies) do
		character_util.remove_anim(v)
		character_util.set_anim(v, { name = 'rifle_shoot2', loop = false })
	end

	-- QTE 이벤트
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')

	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'cast2' })

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe('left')

	while not self.qte_complete do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 0)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	-- QTE 성공
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(camera_director, 1, 0)

	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'throw', loop = false, remove_after = 0.5 })

	character_util.remove_anim(camera_director)

	for _, v in pairs(rifle_enemies) do
		character_util.remove_anim(v)
		character_util.set_anim(v, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
	end

	-- qte 적이 왼쪽 벽으로 날아감
	field:RemoveTint('darth_vader', 0)
	local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info('physics', true, {-1, 0, 0},
		35000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

	command_util.publish_knock_back(user_party.Leader.Owner, qte_enemy, knock_back_info, nil)

	character_util.set_direction(qte_enemy, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(qte_enemy, { name = 'damaged' })
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_mech_stomp_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'small_monster' })

	character_util.remove_anim(qte_enemy)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.move_async(battle_door.Bounds.center, 1)

	local door_enemies = {}
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local enemy = get_character(self.door_enemy_name .. i)
		table.insert(door_enemies, enemy)
	end

	-- 살려줘!!!
	local attack_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_dummy_02', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'small_monster' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'combat' })
	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'field' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(door_enemies[1], { key = 'movie_main_s13_10', skip = true })

	camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 1)

	attack_sfx:Stop()

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.z_camera_move, self))

	-- 적으로 변경

		character_util.remove_anim(v)
		character_util.convert_to_monster(v, 'darth_vader_battle', 'darth_vader_battle')
	end

		character_util.remove_anim(v)
		character_util.convert_to_monster(v, 'darth_vader_battle', 'darth_vader_battle')
	end

		'persistent_no_damage', 0, false, false)

function local_class:z_camera_move()
	local camera_director = get_character(self.camera_director_name)
	local camera = get_field_object(self.camera_name)
	local current_pos = camera_director.Position
	while self.z_camera do
		camera_util.move(vector(25.5, 0, user_party.Leader.Position.z), 0)

		-- 카메라 감독이 플레이어를 따라다니며 찍음
		if self.follow_camera_director then

			camera_director.Position = camera_director.Position:GetXy0(user_party.Leader.Position.z)
			camera.Position = camera_director.Position + vector(0, -0.1, 0.2)

			-- 카메라 감독이 움직이면 걷는 애니메이션 실행
			if current_pos ~= camera_director.Position then
				character_util.set_anim(camera_director, { name = 'walk' })
			else
				character_util.remove_anim(camera_director)
			end

			current_pos = camera_director.Position

		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'scene_3' and not self.scene_3_zone_entered then
			self.scene_3_zone_entered = true
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'scene_3_exit_top' and not self.scene_3_talk_to_director then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_3_comeback, self))
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('hollywood_director_invader')) and not self.scene_3_talk_to_director then
			self.scene_3_talk_to_director = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_3_action, self))
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if (e.BattleGroupName == 'battle_3') then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_3_eugene_falls, self))
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 이벤트존 위로 나가려고 하면 인베이더 감독이 붙잡는다.

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 0.3, {end_target = user_party.Leader})

function local_class:scene_3_action()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('main_section_14')

	-- 이후 말걸 수 없게 변경
	if self.invader_director.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		self.invader_director.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	-- 플레이어 컨트롤을 빼앗는다.
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	character_util.move_to(user_party.Leader, vector(48, 0, 13), 1.5, nil, true, true)

	-- 카메라를 인베이더 감독 중심으로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(self.invader_director.Position + 3 * unity_class.vector3.left, 1.5)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')

	-- 유진 아래에서 입장

	self.eugene.Interactable.Talk = nil

	self.eugene:RemoveEmotion()
	self.eugene.Position = vector(51, 0, 7)
	character_util.move_to_async(self.eugene, vector(51, 0, 13), 1.5, nil, true, true)
	character_util.set_anim(self.eugene, { name = 'sword_idle' })

	self.invader_director:SetAnimation('attack', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.invader_director, {key = 'movie_main_s14_3_2', skip = true})

	-- 알겠지 유진?
	self.invader_director:SetEmotion('smile', true)
	self.invader_director:SetAnimation('cast2', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.invader_director, {key = 'movie_main_s14_3_3', skip = true})

	-- 유진 끄덕인다.

	user_party.Leader:RemoveAnimation()
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))
	character_util.set_direction(self.eugene, 'left')
	self.eugene:SetEmotion('attack', true)
	character_util.set_anim(self.eugene, { name = 'sword_idle' })

	-- 그럼, 레디!

	camera_util.resize_to(3, 0.5)
	self.invader_director:SetEmotion('attack', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.invader_director, {key = 'movie_main_s14_4', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true})

	-- 액션!!!
	character_util.set_anim(self.invader_director, { name = 'jingak', loop = false })

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.7))
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_movie_end_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	camera_util.shake(0.15, 1)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.invader_director, {key = 'movie_main_s14_5', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true})
	self.invader_director:RemoveEmotion()
	self.invader_director:RemoveAnimation()
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	-- 인베이더 감독이 카메라 뒤로 물러난다.

	camera_util.resize_to(3, 1)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(2.5))

	-- 네가 내 아버지를 죽였잖아!!

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, {key = 'movie_main_s14_5_3', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true})

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'movie_main_s14_5_4', 'mercy' }, { 'movie_main_s14_5_5', 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 한 번이라도 선택했다면 스테이지 전체에 걸쳐 기억
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, 'said_i_am_your_father', 1)
        yield_return(self, 'scene_3_ng')
    else
        yield_return(self, 'scene_3_ending')
    end
end

local local_class = newclass('MovieMainSection15')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = MovieMain @
		Comment = 스타워즈 엔딩 @

		NextSections = 15 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.progress_enum = {
		-- 초기 상태
		idle = 1,
		-- 엔딩씬 시작
		start_ending = 2,
		-- 유진과 전투
		fight_eugene = 3,
		-- 감독 떨어짐
		fall_director = 4
	}

	-- 현재 진행도
	self.current_progress = nil

	self.held_director = false

	self.stage_name = 'movie_1_4'

	self.ending_eugene_marker = 'ending_eugene'

	self.director_name = 'hollywood_director_invader'
	self.staff_name = 'invader_staff_'
	self.hollywood_director_name = 'hollywood_director'
	self.lucas_name = 'lucas'

	-- 반복해서 재생되는 Sfx AudioSource
	self.loop_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_event')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_starwars_movie_scene_explosion')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit_sword')

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.idle

	local marker = field:GetMarker('quest_main_section_15').position
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'main_section_15', marker)

	local lucas = get_character(self.lucas_name)

	if lucas.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)  then
		lucas.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)-- RemoveRelatedEvent
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end
end

function local_class:exit()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

		local director = get_character(self.director_name)
		if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, director) then
			if zone_name == 'fall_director' and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.start_ending then
				self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.fall_director
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.fall_director, self)
				return true
			end
		end

		if not e.FullEnter or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then return false end

		if zone_name == 'ending_scene' and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.idle then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.start_ending
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_ending_scene, self)
			return true
		end

	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ThrowEvent) then
		local director = get_character(self.director_name)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, director) then
			-- 던져진 상태가 끝나면 애니메이션 제거
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				coroutine.yield(nil)

				while lua_helper.type_compare(
					director.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState) do
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end

				if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.start_ending then
					quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'main_section_15', director)
				end

				speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(director)
				character_util.set_anim(director, { name = 'idle' })
			end))
			return true
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent) then
		local director = get_character(self.director_name)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, director) then
			character_util.set_anim(director, { name = 'embarrassed' })

			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_villain_scream_01')
			-- 이거 놔!!! 당장 놓지 못해?!?
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(director, { key = 'movie_main_s15_33' })

			local marker = field:GetMarker('quest_fall_director').position
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'main_section_15', marker)

			return true
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then

		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and
			not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then return false end

		if e.CameraGrid.name == 'ending_scene_grid' and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.idle then
			self:scene_setting()
			return true
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then
		local eugene = get_character(self.eugene_name)
		local leader = user_party.Leader

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, eugene) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, leader) then

			if e.HpBefore - e.Info:GetTotalDamage() < 1 then
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_lightsaber_02')
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_musarame_hit_01')

				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.lose_player, self)
			end

			return true
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		-- 조지 루카스 npc와 대화
		local lucas = get_character(self.lucas_name)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, lucas) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_3_talk_to_lucas, self))
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 감독이 낭떠러지로 떨어짐
function local_class:fall_director()
	local director = get_character(self.director_name)
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local eugene = get_character(self.eugene_name)

	while director.Position.y > 1.8 do
		-- Respawn되며 여길 못 빠져나가는 경우도 있으므로 방어코드 추가
		if lua_helper.type_compare(director.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectIdleState) then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.start_ending
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	message_system:SendSync(director, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fall_down_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.set_anim(director, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(eugene)
	character_util.set_emotion(eugene, { name = 'surprise' })

	-- 떨어지는 연출
	local fall_duration = 0.5
	character_util.spine_rotate(director, 360 * 2, fall_duration + 0.5)
	director.SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.zero, fall_duration + 0.5)
	-- 낙하 계산
	local start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(director.Position)
	local end_pos = start_pos + vector(1, 0, 0)

	local fall_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(0, 19.6, director.Position.y, 0)
	fall_calculator:ScaleTime(0.7)

	local current_y = director.Position.y

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < fall_duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		time_passed = time_passed + dt
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / (fall_duration + 0.5))

		fall_calculator:Proceed(dt)
		current_y = fall_calculator:GetDistance()

		local current_xz = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

		director.Position = current_xz + current_y * unity_class.vector3.up

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(director)

	-- 씬 전환 후 떨어지는 연출
	yield_return_func(self.fall_image_scene, self)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local invader_staffs = {}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local staff = get_character(self.staff_name .. i)
		table.insert(invader_staffs, staff)
	end

	character_util.set_emotion(eugene, { name = 'surprise' })

	-- 감독님?!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_staffs[1], { key = 'movie_main_s15_34', skip = true })

	local staff_way_points = {
		{
			vector(0, 0, -1),
			vector(2, 0, -1),
			vector(2, 0, 1)
		},
		{
			vector(0, 0, -2),
			vector(2, 0, -2),
			vector(2, 0, -1)
		},
		{
			vector(0, 0, 1),
			vector(2, 0, 1),
			vector(2, 0, 0)
		}
	}

	for k, v in pairs(invader_staffs) do
		for i = 1, #staff_way_points[k] do
			staff_way_points[k][i] = staff_way_points[k][i] + v.Position
		end

		character_util.move_waypoint(v, staff_way_points[k], 6, true,
			nil, nil, 'right', true)
	end

	wait_for_sec(wp_util.get_duration(invader_staffs[2].Position, staff_way_points[2], 6))

	character_util.set_direction(eugene, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(eugene, { name = 'surprise' })
	-- <플레이어>...!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eugene,
		{ key = game_string:Format('movie_main_s15_35', user.Name), skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local hollywood_director = get_character(self.hollywood_director_name)

	character_util.set_direction(hollywood_director, 'up')
	-- 뭐, 뭐야?! 진짜로 던진거야?!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hollywood_director, { key = 'movie_main_s15_36', skip = true })

	-- 그래도 되는거였어?!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hollywood_director, { key = 'movie_main_s15_37', skip = true })

	for _, v in pairs(invader_staffs) do
		character_util.set_direction(v, 'left')
	end

	character_util.set_anim(invader_staffs[1], { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	-- 이 구역질 나는 인간놈들이!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_staffs[1], { key = 'movie_main_s15_38', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(invader_staffs[1])

	character_util.set_anim(invader_staffs[3], { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	-- 네놈들 해고야! 전원 해고!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_staffs[3], { key = 'movie_main_s15_39', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(invader_staffs[3])

	character_util.set_anim(invader_staffs[2], { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	-- 당장 나가!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_staffs[2], { key = 'movie_main_s15_40', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(invader_staffs[2])

	character_util.set_direction(eugene, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(hollywood_director, 'right')

	-- 뒷걸음질 치는 npc들과 다가오는 npc들
	local characters = {}
	table.insert(characters, leader)
	table.insert(characters, eugene)
	table.insert(characters, hollywood_director)
	for _, v in pairs(invader_staffs) do
		table.insert(characters, v)
	end

	character_util.set_emotion(eugene, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_emotion(hollywood_director, { name = 'surprise' })

	for k, v in pairs(characters) do
		if k < 4 then
			character_util.shake(v, 0.04, 1)
		end

		character_util.move_to(v, v.Position + unity_class.vector3.left, 1.5,
			nil, false, true)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 엔딩 크레딧
	yield_return_func(self.ending_credit, self)

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

	-- 스테이지 종료
	CS.Oak.Game.Instance:StageToWorldmap('exit', 'movie_1_5', nil, true, nil)
end

-- 이미지 위치로 이동 후 떨어지는 감독 연출
function local_class:fall_image_scene()
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	camera_util.move(vector(-300, 0, -300), 0)
	camera_util.resize_to(5, 0)

	-- 에셋 번들 가져오기
	local bg_asset_bundle
	local load_asset_bundle_cb = function(res)
		bg_asset_bundle = res
	end

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.AssetBundleManager.Instance.LoadAssetBundleAsync,
		CS.Foundations.AssetBundleManager.Instance, 'ondemand/movie/theatres', load_asset_bundle_cb)

	local bg_name = 'darth_vader_bg.jpg'

	local load_asset_cb = function(texture_bytes)
		if texture_bytes then
			local texture = CS.UnityEngine.Texture2D(2, 2, CS.UnityEngine.TextureFormat.RGBA32, false)
			if CS.UnityEngine.ImageConversion.LoadImage(texture, texture_bytes.bytes, true) then
				local rect = CS.UnityEngine.Rect(0, 0, texture.width, texture.height)
				-- 텍스쳐를 스프라이트로 생성
				local sprite = CS.UnityEngine.Sprite.Create(texture,
						rect,
						vector(0.5, 0.5),
						100,
						0,
						CS.UnityEngine.SpriteMeshType.Tight,
						unity_class.vector4.zero,
						false)

				-- 새 오브젝트를 만들어서 SpriteRenderer를 붙여줌
				local new_obj = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject()
				new_obj.transform.position = vector(-300, 0, -300)
				new_obj.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(90, 0, 0))
				local sprite_renderer = CS.GameObjectExtensions.GetOrAddComponent(new_obj,
					typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer))

				if sprite_renderer then
					sprite_renderer.sprite = sprite
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- 바이트를 이미지로 변경
	coroutine.yield(bg_asset_bundle:LoadAssetAsync(bg_name, load_asset_cb))

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	-- 감독 떨어질 위치 세팅
	local director = get_character(self.director_name)
	director.Position = vector(-312, 2, -299)
	director.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false
	director.SpineController:Scale(6 * unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.3, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local fall_duration = 2

	-- 떨어지는 연출
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_villain_scream_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.spine_rotate(director, 360 * 4, fall_duration)
	director.SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.zero, fall_duration)

	-- 낙하 계산
	local fall_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(-16, -8, 312, 0)
	fall_calculator:ScaleTime(0.55)

	local current_x = 312

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < fall_duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		time_passed = time_passed + dt
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / fall_duration)

		fall_calculator:Proceed(dt)
		current_x = fall_calculator:GetDistance()

		local current_z = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(-299, -299.8, progress)

		director.Position = vector(-current_x, 2, current_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 폭발 이펙트
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local bomb_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_wolf_boss_bomb_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local explosion_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_starwars_movie_scene_explosion')
	local explosion_effect = explosion_pool:Instantiate(vector(-299.9, 2, -300.9))
	explosion_effect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 180, 0))
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 1.4)
	wait_for_sec(1.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fade_out_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	self.loop_sfx:FadeOut(2)

	bomb_sfx:FadeOut(1)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.3, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	self:ending_setting()
	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
end

-- 엔딩 크레딧
function local_class:ending_credit()
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local wait = true
	local end_callback = function()
		wait = false
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(screen_util.fade_out_async, 0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear'))
	end

	local start_callback = function()
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(screen_util.fade_in_async, 0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear'))
	end

	local ending_credit_state = CS.Oak.UI.MovieCreditPopUpState()

	ending_credit_state.ActorTuples =
		{
			CS.Oak.LuaScriptQuestUtil.CreateStringTuple(game_string:GetString('movie_credit_s4_1_1'),
				game_string:GetString('movie_credit_s4_1_2')),

	 		CS.Oak.LuaScriptQuestUtil.CreateStringTuple(game_string:GetString('movie_credit_s4_1_3'),
			 	game_string:GetString('movie_credit_s4_1_4')),

	 		CS.Oak.LuaScriptQuestUtil.CreateStringTuple(game_string:GetString('movie_credit_s4_1_5'),
				 game_string:GetString('movie_credit_s4_1_6')),

	 		CS.Oak.LuaScriptQuestUtil.CreateStringTuple('', game_string:GetString('movie_credit_s4_1_7'))
		}

	ending_credit_state.MovieTitle = game_string:GetString('movie_credit_s4_title')

	ending_credit_state.Ratings = {'', '', ''}

	ending_credit_state.TypeFlag = CS.Oak.UI.MovieCreditType.ActorIntroduce | CS.Oak.UI.MovieCreditType.MovieRating

	ending_credit_state.CloseCb = end_callback
	ending_credit_state.StartCb = start_callback
	ending_credit_state.IsVisibleCancelledLabel = true
	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.MovieCreditPopUp.Instance, ending_credit_state,
		typeof(CS.Oak.UI.MovieCreditPopUp))

	local starwars_sfx_name = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(CS.Foundations.GameEnvironment.IsKongJapan,
			'01_starwars_02_kong', '01_starwars_02')

	local bgm_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = starwars_sfx_name, loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	bgm_sfx:FadeOut(0)
end

	-- UI를 숨긴다.
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	-- 플레이어 컨트롤을 빼앗는다.
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	-- 플레이어는 어디에서 말을 걸든 루카스의 우측으로 이동한다.
	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, lucas.Position + unity_class.vector3.right, nil, 2, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')

	if self.controller.quest_progress:GetCustomState('said_i_am_your_father') ~= -1 then
		character_util.set_anim(lucas, {name = 'success', loop = true})
		-- 아까 '내가 네 아버지다' 대사 끝내줬어!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lucas, {key = 'movie_s14_1', skip = true})

		character_util.set_emotion(lucas, {name = 'smile', loop = true})
		character_util.set_anim(lucas, {name = 'jingak', loop = false})
		-- 내가 만약 나중에 영화를 만든다면 그 대사를 써먹어도 될까?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lucas, {key = 'movie_s14_2', skip = true})
		character_util.remove_anim(lucas)
		character_util.remove_emotion(lucas)
	else
		character_util.set_emotion(lucas, {name = 'tired', loop = true})
		character_util.set_anim(lucas, {name = 'question', loop = false})
		-- 흠... 아까 했던 마지막 대사보다 더 나은 대안이 있지 않았을까?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lucas, {key = 'movie_s14_3', skip = true})

		character_util.set_emotion(lucas, {name = 'smile', loop = true})
		character_util.set_anim(lucas, {name = 'jingak', loop = false})
		-- 이를테면 "내가 네 아버지다" 라든지?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lucas, {key = 'movie_s14_4', skip = true})
		character_util.remove_anim(lucas)
		character_util.remove_emotion(lucas)
	end

	-- UI를 표시한다.
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	-- 플레이어가 컨트롤을 되찾는다.
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

return local_class
